passages.title: The Rival Lords of Fire
passages.text:
You stand before the true Lord of the Firelands, mortal. This land is mine by right, claimed from the ashes of Ragnaros himself.

However, there are still some who foolishly oppose my reign. I would take great pleasure in destroying their worthless souls, but I will not honor them with death by my hands.

They must be humiliated for their insolence, and there is nothing more humiliating than being slain by a mere mortal.

Amuse me shaman. Prove your worth and destroy my rivals!

passages.title: Traversing the Heavens
passages.text:
If you are not opposed, <name>, I would accompany you on your journey through Skywall.

There are wonders here that my eyes have never before beheld, and it would be my great honor to join you.

Our quest to resurrect the mighty Thunderaan and unite the four great elemental lords will be no easy task.

Lead the way, Farseer, and I shall follow.

passages.title: The Champion's Call [WIP]
Winterhoof Cleansing
passages.text:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. The well is to the southeast, but be warned: whoever did this may still be there, laying in wait.

This may prove very dangerous, <name>. Be careful...but do not let the defilers of our well escape.

passages.title: REUSE ME
passages.text:
<name>, we will need to bolster our army by any means necessary to have any hope of driving back the legion. The kvaldir are cursed beyond redemption, but they are fierce warriors and are a resource we should not overlook. They are bound to obey whomever posesses Helya's Horn. You must obtain it. 

Her so-called helarjar were tasked with guarding it. You will have to take it from them.

passages.title: Armies of Legionfall [DEPRECATED]
passages.text:
The Legion has increased their assaults across our lands. We must be the spearhead and convince the forces of Azeroth to come together! 

Under your leadership, old grievances must be put aside for the sake of our very survival. It is a daunting task, but I know of one who is worthy to take it on.

The orc warrior, Eitrigg, is well respected by all Horde. Ask him to spread our message!

passages.title: Whispers from the Shadows
passages.text:
Hero, we have a problem.

The ancient Necrodark cult has returned.

When Dargrul was the Underking he would quell these cultists whenever they appeared, keeping them from exploring the vault of Neltharion.

But now, with Dargrul gone, they are sieging the vault in force.

We must stop them before they find what they are looking for.

passages.title: REUSE ME
REUSE ME
REUSE ME
First Impressions
Blood Bonded
Secretest Fish
passages.text: <Danielle Anglers in Mechagon may be interested in this fish.>

passages.title: Secretest Fish
passages.text:
Where did you find this fish? It opens up many new possibilities for fish research!

With just a little adjustment, I can modify a rudimentary lure, adapting it to attract more fish than ever!

Of course it might just attract more fishermen instead!

passages.title: Not My Table
passages.text:
<You have decided to neither follow Zekhan to Swamp of Sorrows, nor report this event back to Sylvanas.

Instead, you find yourself longing to spend a sun-soaked afternoon relaxing, and you know just the spot.

Sometimes, it's nice to let others take care of things.>

passages.title: Freeing the Light
passages.text:
Ah... you are not in league with the ogres. Please, you must aid me.

I have been bound against my will by dark magic. I ask only that you free me.

Take a piece of my light. Use it to dispel the shadow energies that are keeping me captive.

passages.title: Freeing the Light
passages.text: Use my light to dispel the necrotic energies binding me to this place.

passages.title: Freeing the Light
passages.text:
You have my thanks, <name>. I must leave this world, but I wish you luck. 

Take my blessing. May it aid you against these monsters.

passages.title: The Dark Ranger's Pupil
passages.text:
Thank the abyss you're here, fellow hunter!

I'm concerned about Dark Ranger Velonara, who frequents the Trueshot Lodge. Velonara is a good friend, and I fear she is in peril.

She's been training an apprentice dark ranger, a lad named Prelus. Newly raised, she said. At any rate, Prelus ran off after receiving a letter from his brother, and now Velonara has gone to Tirisfal Glades to find him.

I have a bad feeling about all this. Would you be willing to check on her safety?

passages.title: Finding the Lost Expedition
passages.text:
Captain Garrick went ahead to find survivors. It looks like she lit a fire.

Meet her up ahead to see what she found. 

I'll look further within the island for survivors... and the source of the magic that attacked us.

passages.title: Finding the Lost Expedition
passages.text:
The others... taken... 

Need... food...

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text:
I'm glad you made it out in one piece. 

Judging by the nearby shipwrecks, I think it's safe to say the missing expedition ran aground here, too.

We can't move until we've got the remaining survivors back on their feet. 

Unfortunately, our remaining supplies have been stolen by murlocs! 

I need you to recover enough first aid supplies for the wounded. 

Then we can begin searching for the missing expedition.

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text: Did you recover the first aid kits? Don't take the murlocs lightly.

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text: Excellent work. Let's get the survivors back on their feet.

passages.title: Northbound
passages.text:
The quilboar kidnapped the rest of the expedition and took them to the north.

I heard mention of needing more sacrifices for some sort of ritual...

Please, you must rescue them!

passages.title: Northbound
passages.text: I've got some good news and some very, very bad news.

passages.title: Down with the Quilboar
passages.text:
From what I can gather, the quilboar are performing a shadow ritual on one of the expedition members.

Their chief is Geolord Grek'og. He is the one who seeks to drain the life from our friend.

Slay Grek'og and save the captive member of the expedition. He may know where the others were taken.

passages.title: Down with the Quilboar
passages.text:
Thanks for saving my life! They said this would be a run of the mill, uneventful expedition.

It definitely was NOT! And I couldn't be happier!

passages.title: The Scout-o-Matic 5000
passages.text:
You look like a <race> that needs help finding the scattered members of our alliance expedition!

Luckily, you have happened to rescue the one and only Lindie Springstock, inventor extraordinaire! 

I've got my Scout-o-Matic 5000 all set to go. It'll fly up in the air and let you scout the entire area.

I'll give you the honors. Use my Scout-o-Matic 5000 to find the rest of the expedition.

passages.title: The Scout-o-Matic 5000
passages.text: Give me a moment to re-size the Scout-o-Matic, then you can ride it!

passages.title: The Scout-o-Matic 5000
passages.text: There's no problem a little re-sizing can't fix! Let's find something to stomp those undead flat!

passages.title: The Harpy Problem
passages.text:
We need to find the remaining survivors of my expedition before the ogres sacrifice them for their dark ritual!

I saw one of the survivors being dragged away by some harpies. They have a roost to the north.

Kee-La and I will meet you up there with a scouting report.

passages.title: The Harpy Problem
passages.text: It seems the harpies are up to no good. We'll need your help with this.

passages.title: Aspirant Elynna
passages.text:
<name>! You've returned to the Maw! Glory be with you!

I have news. It seems that one of the aspirants lost in the attack on Honorveil is being held here, in the Jailor's Armory. Her name is Elynna, and she's on the tenth floor.

That's all I know for now. We shall speak again when I know more.

passages.title: The Rescue of Meredy Huntswell
passages.text:
Our expedition's mage, Meredy Huntswell, is being held by the harpies!

We've got to stop their ritual and rescue Meredy.

You lead the charge. Kee-La and I will back you up if things look dire.

passages.title: The Rescue of Meredy Huntswell
passages.text: Ye rescued me from a grim fate! Bein' a practicin' mage, I always figured one of me own spells would do me in, not a harpy!

passages.title: Harpy Culling
passages.text:
The harpies are preparing for a dreadful assault, <name>. 

They plan to attack our allies back at camp! 

Harpies swoop in and snatch their victims before bringing them back to their nests... to feast.

We have to stop them. Slay the harpies and their worgs to ensure their forces are too weak to stage an assault.

passages.title: Harpy Culling
passages.text: We must do what we can to fight the harpy menace. Take them down, as well as their worgs.

passages.title: Harpy Culling
passages.text: That should keep our camp safe for now. We must hurry and stop whatever these ogres have planned.

passages.title: Westward Bound
passages.text:
Captain Garrick wants us tae search west o' camp fer any other members of the expedition.

Alaria and I will go on ahead. Meet us tae the west and we'll see what we can find.

passages.title: Westward Bound
passages.text: A giant pit of spiders right on our doorstep! Aren't we the lucky ones?

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Eyes
passages.text:
We need to get inside Darkmaul Citadel, rescue the captain of the expedition, and stop the ogre behind all of this.

Meredy is going to cast an illusion to make you look like an ogre, and you're going to take us all in as "prisoners."

I'll be hiding my efforts to suppress the shadow magic in the meantime.

Speak with Meredy when you're ready for her to cast the spell.

Her illusion spell should be temporary, as long as she casts it in the proper way.

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Eyes
passages.text: We're close to stopping all of this. We just need to push a little further.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text:
Did you notice the catapults on our way up? It appears the ogres plan to attack our allies below.

Lindie anticipated something like this and provided several bombs to handle siege weapons.

Just don't shake them too hard.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text: Don't worry about the bombs. They'll blow up those catapults just fine.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text: Great work! I'll have tae tell Lindie that his bombs worked perfectly.

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text:
The Re-Sizer v9.0.1 barely works on inanimate objects. I have no idea what it will do to organic matter!

But if we do nothing, Wrathion will die!

Desperate times call for massively experimental science, <name>.

Take the Re-Sizer v9.0.1. I'll follow you around and calibrate it.

We're going to whip up a giant boar!

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text: Be careful where you point the Re-Sizer v9.0.1. Make sure you're only using it on the boars in the immediate area.

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text:
I never thought I'd be so relieved to be face to face with a giant, scientifically enhanced boar.

Let's go save my son.

passages.title: To Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text:
We've rescued everyone except for the expedition's captain. Lindie's Scout-o-Matic spotted her just outside Darkmaul Citadel.

Meredy has come up with an... interesting plan to rescue the captain. It may be our only chance.

Come. We'll convene in the shadow of Darkmaul Citadel, and there we will begin our rescue mission.

passages.title: To Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text: All right, <name>. I hope you're a good actor, because you're about to play to a very tough crowd.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text:
Prepare yourself, <name>. We're nearing the island where the previous expedition was lost.

Warm up on these combat dummies. We need everyone ready for whatever we find on that island.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text: Don't be shy. Just walk up to the target dummies, select them, and use your main attack.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text:
Good, looks like you've kept up your <class> training during our voyage.

I'm concerned about the sudden turn in weather. Spar with Private Cole while I speak with the ship's crew.

Cole's report will determine where we'll place you on our initial expedition team.

passages.title: Bottom Feeders
passages.text:
Oh this is bad. This is really bad.

Every time one of the lads makes it down here they don't come back. Things that come down here... they sort of stay down here one way or another.

Let's make a deal. You're a Maw Walker. You go find Cudgelface and the Chamberlain while I get this here carriage back in service and then we all get out of here before somethin' tries to eat us and THEN go to work on us.

passages.title: Bottom Feeders
passages.text:
Ah good. No one got ate.

Carriage is ready to go when you are.

passages.title: On The Road Again
passages.text: Right lads! All aboard!

passages.title: On The Road Again
passages.text: We are not getting the carriage through that.

passages.title: To Darkhaven
passages.text:
Across this bridge is the hamlet of Darkhaven. It is fortified by those loyal to Sire Denathrius. These pitiful rebels would not dare approach it.

However, getting to it may prove challenging. Here, I shall carry the anima, you make sure no one throws us back into the Endmire.

passages.title: To Darkhaven
passages.text: It may not look like it, but this rebellion is on its last leg. Those who stand against the Master are fools who will know a new form of pain and suffering.

passages.title: Invitation of the Master
passages.text:
The great Sire Denathrius, Master of Revendreth, and King of the venthyr, has asked me, his loyal Chamberlain, to escort you safely to his personal gardens. This is an honor never before bestowed upon a living mortal. 

You should feel honored.

Come, join me in the carriage and we shall ride to the castle in style.

passages.title: Invitation of the Master
passages.text:
Oh good, still not dead yet?

You see where the Lord Chamberlain or Cudgelface landed?

passages.title: A Plea to Revendreth
passages.text:
Revendreth is quite possibly the most... efficient... realm at extracting anima. Perhaps they can lend aid where others cannot. 

Know that while souls sometimes return from Revendreth, they are never the same when they do. It is a dark realm, where those the Arbiter deems worthy of a chance of redemption are sent.

Their path, however, is not an easy one.

Kah-Sher will assist you in opening the gateway to Revendreth. Meet him in the Ring of Transference.

passages.title: A Plea to Revendreth
passages.text:
Sorry for the state of things. Usually a venthyr would be here to greet you. Been a while since we seen anyone come through that gate.

All good, though, as I know the welcome speech better than a good mornin' whipping.

passages.title: The Sinstone
passages.text:
Well, you ain't like the others. Usually you're supposed to be dead before you come here. Ah well. A sin is a sin and a stone is a stone, as it goes.

Let's get you sorted out with your sinstone. This way, if you please.

passages.title: The Sinstone
passages.text: Hopefully these wretched creatures did not bore you with their inane babble.

passages.title: The Grove of Terror
passages.text:
Ah, yes. You've done me a great favor in delivering the Accuser, Maw Walker. 

To celebrate, I must insist that you take part in a sacred tradition of Revendreth: The Penitent Hunt. It is a duty we undertake to strike a humbling fear into the hearts of the most... stubborn souls.

Fear can be a very powerful motivator for change.

Meet the Fearstalker in the Grove of Terror below. There you will prepare.

passages.title: The Grove of Terror
passages.text:
Welcome to the Grove of Terror.

Here you will see the beginning of the process for the anima you seek.

passages.title: A Dreadful Roundup
passages.text:
Welcome to The Banewood, Maw Walker.

As Huntmaster it is my duty to lead the Fearstalk. Our first order of business is to collect the souls selected for the hunt.

In the woods behind me we have souls who have been ripening for several hundred years now. Go choose the souls who will be hunted today.

passages.title: Feeding Time is Over
passages.text:
A crucial element to a successful Fearstalk is our tool: the fangs of a terrorbeast.

Their fangs are perfect for revealing the scent of their prey once bound to a soul. There's plenty of them in the forest surrounding the ripening souls. 

Go and collect some from their corpses. Their population is a bit large right now anyhow.

passages.title: Pardon Our Dust
passages.text:
Ah yes, the Greeter.

It seems this Mnemis unit has been deactivated. Anima has been so scarce of late, and with no new souls entering our gates... I suppose it was a prudent measure. Anima is our most precious resource, after all.

There are some centurions nearby. A portion of their Anima could serve our needs.

Ah! One of our most helpful stewards is here to lend her aid. She will guide you in the collection effort.

Return when you have sufficient Anima and we will power the Greeter once more.

passages.title: Pardon Our Dust
passages.text: <The centurion is unresponsive.>

passages.title: Pardon Our Dust
passages.text: <The centurion emits a soft chime.>

passages.title: On Lysonia's Trail
passages.text:
Our scouts have reported spotting Lysonia and Uther en route to the Temple of Humility.

As the de facto leader of the Forsworn, we must not allow her to stand free, twisting the minds of those around her.

The disciples of Humility have not answered our beckons. I have sent Kleia ahead to reconnoiter. Meet her outside the temple.

passages.title: On Lysonia's Trail
passages.text: The entire temple is overrun with Forsworn. We must find the survivors!

passages.title: Aerial Reconnaissance
passages.text:
The temple grounds are crawling with those loyal to the Forsworn.

If I were still an aspirant, this task would be monumental. Luckily, that is no longer the case.

Let us survey the situation from the sky. We can both take stock of the challenges ahead and find any survivors we can.

passages.title: Aerial Reconnaissance
passages.text:
Fortunate that you both found us. 

There are many wounded. I have been able to keep them alive, but it has taken all of my focus. You must help us push back against the Forsworn.

passages.title: Sacred Scrolls of Humility
passages.text:
The Forsworn are ransacking the library, looking for specific texts amongst our archives.

We cannot allow them to uncover the scrolls they are searching for. Find any set aside scrolls and return them to me for safekeeping.

passages.title: Sacred Scrolls of Humility
passages.text: The scrolls throughout these temples cover many topics, from information on different worlds, to training pillars, to ancient rituals.

passages.title: Sacred Scrolls of Humility
passages.text: It seems they are gathering information on performing one of our strongest rituals. But for what purpose?

passages.title: Succumbing to Pride
passages.text:
The aspirants that spend the most time at this temple are those who must face their pride.

I was one of them, once.

During our surveillance, I saw Forsworn forcing these aspirants to fall to their vices then toss them aside as if they meant nothing.

You must stop the Forsworn. Free the aspirants from a terrible fate.

passages.title: Succumbing to Pride
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. These aspirants will live to improve themselves and serve Bastion.

passages.title: Distorted by the Maw
passages.text:
Lysonia's forces are rerouting the anima collectors to spew Maw energy across the temple. They hamper our forces while strengthening their own.

The collectors have been tainted. Take Compassion and destroy them to halt Lysonia's boon.

passages.title: Distorted by the Maw
passages.text: Do not worry about the collectors. With the drought, they have been barely functioning for quite some time.

passages.title: Compassion, Blade of Humility
passages.text:
<You find a familiar sword impaled into one of the Forsworn corpses. The Paragon of Humility must have left it behind in pursuit of Lysonia.

It seems inert, as if all its anima has been used. Perhaps you could restore it to its usual glory.>

passages.title: Compassion, Blade of Humility
passages.text: The Paragon rarely uses his weapon. He prefers debate and reason over the use of force.

passages.title: Compassion, Blade of Humility
passages.text:
Compassion!

The Paragon chased Lysonia in such a rush, he left his sword behind. This may be key to expelling the Forsworn from the temple.

Take it with you, and may it serve you well.

passages.title: The Power of the Maw
passages.text:
Lysonia flees to the Maw to enact her dark rituals. As the Maw Walker, you are the only one who can pursue her.

Take Kleia and my blade. She must be stopped.

passages.title: The Power of the Maw
passages.text: I can feel the oppression here, as if it were a real weight on my body.

passages.title: A Step Too Far
passages.text:
My initial scouting revealed things I did not believe at first.

The Mawsworn hold Forsworn captive here, transforming them against their will.

Though the Forsworn stand against the Archon, they are still kyrian. It is our duty to free them.

passages.title: A Step Too Far
passages.text: I cannot stand idly by while my brothers and sisters are tormented.

passages.title: A Step Too Far
passages.text:
Exiled by the Archon... failed by Lysonia...

Where can they go?

passages.title: Kyrian No More
passages.text:
Mawsworn kyrian... I have not seen one since that vision when we first met.

I am not intimidated. They are enemies of Bastion, of the Archon, and it is our duty to defeat them.

passages.title: Kyrian No More
passages.text:
If my mind were ever to be twisted by the Maw... I ask that you cut me down.

I cannot bear the thought.

passages.title: Time to Reflect
passages.text:
I knew that Devos had powerful allies. I turned a blind eye. When Lysonia took her place... I was blinded by my loyalty.

I have much to reflect on.

We may not be allies, but I have one request. Please, escort me from this wretched place. I will leave you be... but do not leave me here in the Maw.

passages.title: Time to Reflect
passages.text: It is unfortunate to hear that Lysonia has escaped us again... The revelations of both her master and her new powers are quite concerning.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin
passages.text:
One step remains until we may begin the Penitent Hunt.

You and the other hunters will first siphon a small amount of anima from the souls. It will come with ease. The soul's time in the Grove of Terror causes trace anima to release.

This anima helps us venthyr in tracking the prey's fear.

I also ask that you do us the honor of signaling the hunt.

<The Fearstalker hands you an anima stake and a hollowed dredbat fang.>

Use these to complete the task.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin
passages.text: The ceremony must continue.

passages.title: Let the Hunt Begin
passages.text:
Well done. Perhaps in death you will make a fine hunter.

I can practically taste the fear we will inflict.

passages.title: Blinding the Eye
passages.text:
You finally arrived <name>. Dat dark mojo on you has lingered for too long. N'Zoth be defeated and we need to cleanse all de traces of his infection from you.

Dis won't hurt. Much.

Tell me when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: A Reflection of Truth
passages.text:
I sent the Fearstalker far from here with that trap--buying us some time.

On the other side of this mirror lies the depths of Castle Nathria, the fortress of Denathrius himself. There, a meeting between Denathrius and one of his lackeys is about to take place.

Join me through the mirror, <name>. You shall see the truth of this "drought" first hand.

passages.title: A Reflection of Truth
passages.text: We barely made it. Denathrius will surely be on our trail soon.

passages.title: I Don't Get My Hands Dirty
passages.text:
You heard Sire Denathrius. Today, I ascend to the Court of Harvesters.

You are fortunate to have the honor of witnessing my rise to power.

The traitors have barricaded the bridge ahead. Clear a path for me, so that I might cross it undisturbed.

Nothing can stand against me now that I have a Harvester's medallion.

But I will not waste my power on this rabble.

passages.title: I Don't Get My Hands Dirty
passages.text: Clear the way for Lord Chamberlain!

passages.title: I Don't Get My Hands Dirty
passages.text: <Echelon grunts.> You're late.

passages.title: Devour This
passages.text:
Though the souls are our primary target, another challenge has arisen.

The Banewood has seen an infestation of devourers: disgusting vermin who gorge themselves on the anima we need to survive. A fitting challenge for any true hunter, no?

I should only thank the Master that they have remained in a few secluded pockets. I loathe to think that their numbers could multiply. Let us exterminate them before they pose a true threat.

passages.title: Devour This
passages.text: Are the devourers finished?

passages.title: Devour This
passages.text: Once you master fear, all crumble before you.

passages.title: The Accuser's Sinstone
passages.text:
Lord Chamberlain will cross the bridge when it pleases him.

Before he arrives, you will seize the Accuser's sinstone.

Wise venthyr like Lord Chamberlain hide their sinstone, so that it can never be used against them.

The Accuser is too proud to hide her sinstone. Instead, she puts it on display for all to see.

Boasting of the many, many sins she's overcome.

Proud. Arrogant. Most importantly, foolish.

Her sinstone lies on the altar before us, seemingly unguarded. Retrieve it.

passages.title: The Accuser's Sinstone
passages.text: Is that truly the best you have to offer?

passages.title: The Stoneborn
passages.text:
The Stone Legion is not even here yet? This is an outrage.

If we do not do something quickly, the rebels will overrun this filthy hamlet.

Here, take the anima and go activate a few of the stoneborn along the periphery of Darkhaven. Take whatever is left over to the Quartermaster and tell her to do her job.

I will try to commune with the Master and see if he can send reinforcements.

passages.title: The Stoneborn
passages.text: Darkhaven. Such a pitiful hamlet filled with unworthy supplicants.

passages.title: The Stoneborn
passages.text: This is all that remains of our tithe? The Tithelord is not one for excuses. We may need to gather a second tithe quickly or he will condemn us all to the Ember Ward.

passages.title: Inquisitor Vilhelm's Sinstone
passages.text:
Inquisitor Vilhelm has taken exceptional precautions to protect his sinstone.

Broken into several pieces and hidden from sight, he believed his sinstone would be safe from us.

But his plan had the same weakness as most: he trusted weak-willed underlings.

I "interrogated" several dredgers to learn where they helped the inquisitor hide the broken fragments of his sinstone.

Find all the fragments and bring them to me.

passages.title: Inquisitor Vilhelm's Sinstone
passages.text:
<As Echelon holds the sinstone fragments, anima binds draw the pieces into one another, reforming into a completed sinstone.>

We are ready to proceed.

passages.title: Sinstone Delivery
passages.text:
Lord Chamberlain has held off the Accuser to buy us the time we needed to break the ward on her sinstone.

But, thanks to your delays, our reinforcement of his position is overdue.

I will collect the Accuser's sinstone and carry us to the battle.

passages.title: Sinstone Delivery
passages.text:
This is, in fact, one of the larger sinstones I have seen.

This will be easy to exploit.

passages.title: The Master Awaits
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I am General Kaal. Those stoneborn who remember their oaths to the Master are under my command.

The path between here and Sire Denathrius is no longer secured by my forces. I am pulling my troops from this ward to support the Master's will elsewhere. 

Sire Denathrius has dispatched me to bring you directly to him. Myskia can carry you.

passages.title: The Master Awaits
passages.text: Mind your manners when speaking to Sire Denathrius. He is a being older than your world.

passages.title: The Master Awaits
passages.text: Wait! Please, Maw Walker, allow me to announce you to the Master.

passages.title: The Authority of Revendreth
passages.text:
adventurer, a proud <race> <class>. I know your name and your deeds. I can taste your regrets and your shame.

More importantly, I know what you might become. You can be the beacon for the Shadowlands to rally behind. The symbol my people need to set aside these petty squabbles and help fix the problems that afflict all reality.

Before you stands the Court of Harvesters, my most loyal and trusted venthyr. Where once there were seven, only four remain. 

Introduce yourself to them, for where they go, my power follows

passages.title: The Authority of Revendreth
passages.text: My eyes are everywhere.

passages.title: The Authority of Revendreth
passages.text: Now, Maw Walker, arise as a weapon of ordained power within my dominion.

passages.title: The Accuser's Secret
passages.text:
Now that I possess the Accuser's sinstone, I can finally end her treasonous charade once and for all!

Protect me while I study this sinstone, and you will be rewarded as first among my retainers.

After I crush her with my incredible power, I will seize control of the Halls of Atonement and receive the Master's reward.

This feat heralds my own ascension to the Court of Harvesters!

passages.title: The Accuser's Secret
passages.text:
<Lord Chamberlain smiles wryly.>

The Halls of Atonement are under my control.

passages.title: The Accuser's Fate
passages.text:
You now stand in the presence of a Harvester, Maw Walker.

<Lord Chamberlain breathes in deeply and smiles.>

I will use the Accuser's medallion to solidify my foothold over the Halls of Atonement.

Meanwhile, the Master has requested that you deliver both the Accuser and the medallion that he loaned to me.

Myskia will be along shortly to retrieve you. Do not keep the Master waiting.

passages.title: The Accuser's Fate
passages.text: I trust you have the medallion that I loaned to the Lord Chamberlain?

passages.title: The Accuser's Fate
passages.text:
<Sire Denathrius smiles as you hand him the medallion.>

I am pleased to see that you can be trusted with great power.

passages.title: Dutybound
passages.text:
Welcome to the fight, <name>. You're with us now.

Take a moment and introduce yourself. I will meet you by Draven at the lodge.

passages.title: They Won't Know What Hit Them
passages.text:
Luring the Fearstalker here will prove pointless unless we can tilt the odds. She will surely show up with a small army. 

Plant these anima containers. When the time comes, we will release their contents into the air, dousing her and her forces in a thick layer of anima.

That should get the devourers infesting this place to flock to them like moths to a flame.

passages.title: They Won't Know What Hit Them
passages.text: The devourers will rip them to shreds.

passages.title: A Few Bumps Along the Way
passages.text:
This territory is strategic to our defense, we can not allow these abominations to force our retreat!

Seize control of two of the locations marked on your map. Defend them from enemy attack till the flag is planted and the location captured.

passages.title: Lysonia's Plan
passages.text:
Lysonia has brought the Paragon to his knees! The Maw powers she wields are far too potent.

We must stop her.

passages.title: Lysonia's Plan
passages.text: <The Paragon of Humility clutches his body in pain.>

passages.title: Lysonia's Plan
passages.text:
I am weakened, but I will heal.

She searched for pride that does not exist within me.

passages.title: The Assault on Dredhollow
passages.text:
The time is upon us, Maw Walker. The Fearstalker's hunters are descending upon us.

We have done all we can do to prepare for their assault. Here.

<The Accuser gives you an ornate staff.>

I fashioned this out of the supplies you brought me. Use it to destroy the Fearstalker's forces.

The fight begins.

passages.title: Where is Prince Renathal?
passages.text:
This is not victory, adventurer. If Prince Renathal does not return, we've merely delayed defeat.

The Prince was last seen during an assault on the Master's keep alongside Duke Theotar.

We don't know the Prince's fate, but we've learned that Duke Theotar was banished to the Ember Ward.

The Ember Ward is a land of madness and torture. Blighted by the Light, the Master sends his most hated enemies there to suffer unending agony.

Enter the Ember Ward, find Theotar, and discover the Prince's fate.

passages.title: Where is Prince Renathal?
passages.text: You no go here. Here for bad buds!

passages.title: Ani-Matter Animator
passages.text:
This area is rich with the remains of fallen soldiers... some of which still carry a spark of potential.

I've created what I call the "Ani-Matter Orb," with which you can reanimate the skeletal matter littered throughout the foundry. 

Let us see how many of the new animates would join our cause.

As for those who don't... well, they should be quite accustomed to being slain by now.

passages.title: Ani-Matter Animator
passages.text: Do we have enough animates?

passages.title: Ani-Matter Animator
passages.text: These reanimated troops will be put to good use.

passages.title: Walk the Path, Aspirant
passages.text:
If you wish to stand before the Archon, there is a path you must walk. Thankfully, it is well worn and serviceable even in these dire times.

Though you are not destined to become kyrian, our ways may be of interest to you. Learn well, learn fast, and perhaps the Archon will take notice and grant you this audience you seek.

Aspirant Kleia will show you the way. Archon's eyes upon you.

passages.title: Walk the Path, Aspirant
passages.text: Your journey is just beginning, <name>. I hope you can help us, and I hope we can help you.

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Etherwyrms
passages.text:
Forge is cold, yes? Need LOTS of anima to light.

<Sika references her scroll.>

Times before now, anima is everywhere, yes? Now it hides. Small bits, weird places.

We know that etherwyrms -- flappy scale-things that are blue -- eat anima. They are not dead, so they are finding anima to eat still, yes?

Maybe if we take what they have eaten, we can use it to light the forge. This will probably kill them.

Sad, yes. But! We will not take too much. Just a little.

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Etherwyrms
passages.text: Did you find anima? Small pieces, even?

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Etherwyrms
passages.text:
<Sika pokes the squishy substance.>

It glows. This means anima. Forgelite will be pleased.

passages.title: On the Edge of a Revelation
passages.text:
Ah! Good. You answered the call.

As you can see, there are many aspirants who require our aid. Myself and the other disciples are hard pressed to deal with all of them. Some are in greater need than others.

Aspirants are most at risk when they are on the precipice of a revelation. It is a critical moment that we cannot allow to pass without intervention.

You must push them, one way or another.

Find the most vulnerable among your peers and do what you can to help them find the path forward.

passages.title: On the Edge of a Revelation
passages.text: My disciples will be grateful for your aid, <name>.

passages.title: On the Edge of a Revelation
passages.text: Your service is noted. Thank you.

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Drought Conditions
passages.text:
In days past, keeping a forge burning was a trivial task. The anima extractors could run constantly without ever running dry.

Now, even turning an extractor on is a risk. Etherwyrms, without the anima streams to feed on, are attracted to any source of anima. They are a frequent nuisance.

I am going to ask that you risk their attentions. Activate the extractor and guard it until it can accumulate what little anima remains.

Bring me the product it collects. Let us hope it is enough.

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Drought Conditions
passages.text: Is the extractor functional? How much were you able to acquire?

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Drought Conditions
passages.text: That is... somehow more and less than I expected. It will have to do.

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Flower Power
passages.text:
For forge to light, need more anima. Always more. Never too much, for forge!

<Sika consults her scroll and nods vigorously as she reads.>

Out in fields, there is a glowy flower. The round thing inside. Bulb? It glows. So, has anima. From the ground, we think.

According to scrolls, it is called Adrima's Lily. We do not know who Adrima is. But the lily is good.

Get flowers, too. Not just bulbs. Petals make stewards happy, too. 

Thank you!

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Flower Power
passages.text: Do you have flower bulb things?

passages.title: The Cycle of Anima: Flower Power
passages.text:
Oh. They smell nice! And they glow lots.

This is good. Yes.

passages.title: The Temple of Purity
passages.text:
Greetings.

I am Kosmas, Disciple to the Temple of Purity.

The temple is a place of cleansing. Its sole purpose is to free aspirants of the burdens they carry with them from life. It is a place of quiet reflection even for those who have shed their burdens.

Of late, those who look to us for purification have grown numerous. My fellow disciples are stretched terribly thin. I have come to ask the aid of all able-minded aspirants.

Your help is needed. Please report to the Hand of Purity at once.

passages.title: The Temple of Purity
passages.text: Thank you for volunteering.

passages.title: Bring Me Their Heads
passages.text:
I swore to the grave of Vistara the Fallen that I would bring him the head of the one who betrayed him. 

Though that was eons ago, it is an oath I must fulfill. Whatever fate ultimately befell the traitor, it is likely that his head can still be found nearby.

Slaughter everyone here. Surely one of them must be the traitor... or be in possession of his head.

passages.title: Bring Me Their Heads
passages.text: Do you have the traitor's head?

passages.title: Bring Me Their Heads
passages.text: I have asked many others to collect heads as well! So even if none of these are the traitor's head, we shall find it eventually!

passages.title: Blade of Blades
passages.text:
The finest sword in existence has been lost!

Never in your pitiful adventures have you encountered such a blade, mortal. Foe Cleaver was forged to strike down the titans themselves!

I have wielded it against countless adversaries. Emissaries of the Light, minions of the Void, meddlers from the Gardens of Life... all have fallen before me! Soon the very planes of reality will kneel to my greatness!

Once I find my weapon, that is.

I insist you help me reclaim it. I know it's here somewhere!

passages.title: Blade of Blades
passages.text: Have you found Foe Cleaver? Well? HAVE YOU?!

passages.title: Blade of Blades
passages.text:
Foe Cleaver! Now my crusade of conquest begins!

You... you act as if you've seen finer swords, mortal. How dare you!

Just you wait. You'll kneel before me just like all the rest!

<The animate mutters and grunts.>

passages.title: Assessing Your Strength
passages.text:
The trial to come will test you in ways you can likely only imagine.

I can see both from your past and from your demeanor that you are no stranger to combat. I would like to know where your strengths lie so we may address any weaknesses we find before your trial.

You will find three praetorian soldiers created for this purpose, each stronger than the last.

Defeat them all and I will consider your strength sufficient to continue at this time.

passages.title: Assessing Your Strength
passages.text: How fares the combat?

passages.title: Assessing Your Strength
passages.text: Impressive. I see I have little enough to teach you.

passages.title: The Chamber of First Reflection
passages.text:
Ah, Athanos. It remains undefeated, as intended.

Still, you have exceeded any expectation I might have had. You are stronger than many that have come before you.

You have come here for a purpose, and Kleia has illuminated a path that she believes you can walk. I agree. I have opened the way to the Crucible's final rite.

Follow the path to the south and east. There you will find the entrance to the Chamber of First Reflection.

Kleia will instruct you further. Go in service, <name>.

passages.title: The Chamber of First Reflection
passages.text: Gather yourself. This is how you will find your way before the Archon. I am certain of it.

passages.title: The Ladder
passages.text:
Within the Theater of Pain, <brother/sister>, legends rise like cream to the top.

Listen to me, <brother/sister>. If you have the courage to step into that sacred arena, you're going to face the greatest threats in all of existence! The cards will be stacked against you, but only those who can work together will emerge as champions.

Gather your team and meet this challenge head on! Enter the Theater of Pain and defeat the opponents within! Prove that you can rise to the top!

passages.title: The Ladder
passages.text: Greetings, brother. Have you faced the madness of the arena?

passages.title: The Ladder
passages.text:
Well fought, brother! You've begun your rise to the top!

But keep up with your training and stay ready. In Maldraxxus, there is always a challenger waiting to take your place.

passages.title: A Hand Offered
Sign Your Own Death Warrant
passages.text:
Ember Ward only for bad buds!

<Stonehead squints at you and shakes head.>

You not look like other bad buds!

Bad buds come with bad paper!

passages.title: Sign Your Own Death Warrant
passages.text: Bad buds come with bad paper!

passages.title: Sign Your Own Death Warrant
passages.text: This bad paper look very bad...

passages.title: The Greatest Duelist
passages.text:
A mortal in Revendreth. Well, well, well... you are primed to be at the head of high adventure.

The name you may call me is Nadjia the Mistblade, and, if I might be so humble as to say, I am the finest duelist that has ever wielded a sword.

This trap you found me in was a lesson learned in getting paid in advance. Release me and my blade is yours to command for as long as I find you interesting.

Do we have an accord?

passages.title: The Greatest Duelist
passages.text: That consecrated iron really leaves one feeling stiff afterward.

passages.title: The Greatest Duelist
passages.text:
That was FUN! I have not felt so alive in centuries. Everything about you is just... different, and invigorating.

I can continue to assist you until you are ready to leave the Endmire but then we will need to part ways for a time. I have some unfinished business regarding someone who put me in a cage.

passages.title: If You Want Peace...
passages.text:
Maldraxxus is a land which revels in strife and conflict. But they should also be bound by honor.

If their honor has been tossed aside, then they may move their forces beyond just Bastion.

Take care, danger lies beyond that gate. It is a realm of heroes as well as a realm of villains.

passages.title: If You Want Peace...
passages.text: Well? Why aren't you out there fighting?

passages.title: To Die By the Sword
passages.text:
What's this? You fly no colors! Where is the pride in your house, gladiator?

Bah, this drought has left us with slim pickings indeed, if this is the best Maldraxxus can muster!

I remember the old days. The strongest souls arriving, then being divided among the five houses...

No matter. The tournament beckons. Enter the arena! Fight for glory!

By the look of you, it's likely you won't last long. Try to make a name for yourself in the time you have left.

passages.title: To Die By the Sword
passages.text: What are you waiting for? Put on a show!

passages.title: To Die By the Sword
passages.text:
You survived? Really...

I admit, that was unexpected.

passages.title: Chasing Madness
passages.text:
<This wretched shamble of a venthyr mumbles uncontrollably as it claws at the ground.

It looks up suddenly and points its finger at you.>

An adversary with no ferry cannot be merry unless it is wary!

<It seems to be waiting for a response from you.>

passages.title: Chasing Madness
passages.text:
Well, aren't you an unexpected windfall?

I'm afraid I've no tea to offer you at the present. Forgive my poor manners.

passages.title: Unbearable Light
passages.text:
Have you encountered an ash ghoul yet? Wretches crawling on the ground. Jump on everything. Terrible table manners.

That is the unfortunate fate awaiting all venthyr exposed to the Light for too long. The overwhelming pain it causes us breaks our willpower, our mind, and finally our body.

With the right skills, it is possible to reverse the Light's desecration if it is treated quickly.

But the ash ghouls in this Light-burned crater are beyond redemption. There is only one mercy left.

passages.title: Unbearable Light
passages.text: If only I'd been able to help them earlier...

passages.title: Unbearable Light
passages.text:
<Exposure to the Light is clearly causing Theotar to lose control of himself.>

My... sincerest apologies...

passages.title: Theotar's Mission
passages.text:
Oh the Accuser sent you? How keen!

I do, in fact, know the fate of Prince Renathal... at least part of it.

When our assault on the Master's keep failed, we were both captured. I was banished to the Ember Ward, but the Prince was dragged off to Sinfall.

I'm cultivating an escape from this Light-blighted land to follow after him, but the Light here... it makes it hard to think.

My parasol once protected me, but the ruffians destroyed it. Help me rebuild it, and we'll find the Prince together.

passages.title: Theotar's Mission
passages.text: My preferred colors are pink and white, if you can find it.

passages.title: Theotar's Mission
passages.text:
<Exposure to the Light is clearly causing Theotar to lose control of himself.>

Gubbins... Where are you?

passages.title: Lost in the Desiccation
passages.text:
<Exposure to the Light has rendered Theotar incapable of forming coherent sentences.

Instead of telling you how to get to his hideout, he mumbles incoherently while pointing in random directions.>

Lost... Syb... Tubbins... Late for tea...

<You'll have to find Theotar's hideout a different way.>

passages.title: Lost in the Desiccation
passages.text:
<Gubbins and Tubbins speak in unison.>

Dis not good.

passages.title: An Inspired Moral Inventory
passages.text:
<name>! You are well! I am glad of it.

Many of the ascended who once served this place have betrayed us. To turn so wholly against all that the kyrian stand for is... unimaginable.

<The acolyte places a heavy spear in your hands.>

This is a tool that has seen little use before today. Its sole purpose is to inspire a moment of reflection in those it touches. It will show them the error of their ways.

If they remain unrepentant, then there is no hope for them. They must die.

passages.title: An Inspired Moral Inventory
passages.text: They betrayed us.

passages.title: An Inspired Moral Inventory
passages.text: I saw them perish. It is more than they deserved.

passages.title: The Enemy You Know
passages.text:
My heart is filled with dread. If it truly is Lysonia who leads them now...

No. What is important is that we restore the great vespers. So long as their mighty voices are corrupted, all who hear them will suffer as this temple does. It is only a matter of time before all of Bastion succumbs.

They will no doubt try to stop you. I will hold their leader's attention as long as I can.

If I do not survive... my disciple will see you safely from this place. Go in service.

passages.title: The Enemy You Know
passages.text: Our fight is not yet over, <name>.

passages.title: Purity's Prerogative
passages.text:
Do you feel it, <name>?

That cold hand that grips your throat? That chill settled in the pit of your stomach? That is the touch of the Maw, as certain as the Archon's will.

I do not know how Lysonia came to possess this power, but we must act quickly.

I will inform the Archon of what transpired here. You will act where my Hand could not. I will explain as we fly.

Speak to me when you are prepared to leave the temple.

passages.title: Purity's Prerogative
passages.text:
We will see not a moment's rest today, will we?

<Kleia eyes the fragment warily.>

passages.title: Silence in the Stalks
passages.text:
Hmm. Well that's not... great. But no cause for alarm, yet!

It has been a long time since our ring withdrew from here, and we probably need to go to its source to get it to return!

Unfortunately, I haven't heard from the Chief Mushroomancer, Cortinarius, since the crisis began.

Please, find him and help us rejoin the rings! Head west of Dreamsong Fenn to the Stalks. You can't miss them... just follow the mushrooms!

passages.title: Silence in the Stalks
passages.text: Finally, a friendly face! Are you with the Hunt? You don't look like you're from around here....

passages.title: Shaking 'Shrooms
passages.text:
The mushrooms in there need your help, <class>!

Some of the larger mushrooms become laden with spores. It is one of my duties to help disperse them and grow the grove, but it is too dangerous for me in there.

If you're going to go in, do you mind giving any particularly full mushrooms a good shake for me? That should get most of the spores loose until we can secure the grove.

passages.title: Ring Repairs
passages.text:
The damage wrought here is severe, but it can be reversed.

My master is weakened by all this destruction, but mushrooms are difficult to completely eradicate. By restoring power to the rings throughout the grove, we can strengthen them once again.

Take this beacon. Use it near a damaged mushroom in a ring, and watch how quickly nature can heal its wounds.

passages.title: Ring Repairs
passages.text: Together we are strong.

passages.title: Fighting For Fungus
passages.text:
Behold, Marasmius!

This is his home, his heart. Every mushroom in Ardenweald, maybe even all of the Shadowlands, stems from here. And the masked fae want to take him for their own purposes. As chief mushroomancer, I cannot abide this.

Our foes may look mindless, but they are clever. They will have tracked my position by now.

I shall make my final stand here, and hope that Marasmius is strong enough to lend his aid.

Will you stand with me, <class>?

passages.title: Fighting For Fungus
passages.text: <About time you showed up! Good thing I took care of all those young ones, eh?>

passages.title: Tubbins's Tea
passages.text:
Theotar teach Tubbins special tea that make Light go away!

Tubbins good tea maker!

Watch Tubbins make Theotar feel good!

Then Tubbins feel good!

passages.title: Tubbins's Tea
passages.text: Tubbins make tea!

passages.title: Tubbins's Tea
passages.text: Tea ready! Tubbins give to Theotar!

passages.title: My Way or the Hyphae
passages.text:
<An old, booming voice fills your mind.>

Hmph. More are coming.

I would rather not lose more of myself, and I don't want you to think I'm not appreciative of the work you and Cort here have done.

How about you take a ride on the rings and give those oafs a good thrashing? We'll teach them not to mess with Marasmius and his fae rings!

passages.title: My Way or the Hyphae
passages.text: Hah! I haven't felt that young in ages!

passages.title: [REUSE]
passages.text:
I like you, youngling. You are not like the others, sitting in their fancy court, leaving old Marasmius to keep the network running.

I'll open up the ring by the celestial tree nearby as a thank for all your help. You can use it to come back and visit me whenever you like.

You come back now! There will always be plenty for you to do here. Might even be something special in it for you.

passages.title: An Abominable Discovery
passages.text: adventurer. Come with me. I could explain, but it's easier to understand if you see it for yourself.

passages.title: An Abominable Discovery
passages.text: Gharmal's gluttony knew no bounds.

passages.title: It's a Dirty Job
passages.text:
This muck pool is all out of order. The anima shortage has taken its toll here for sure. 

You see, the pools require filth and fiber to grow dredgers effectively. The problem is every time I try to treat the pool, the dang devourers are on my back!

Now the untreated muck is starting to coagulate into these elementals! Can you go and toss some of the filthy rubble into the pool to restore it?

passages.title: It's a Dirty Job
passages.text: I can smell it from here. Thanks for that, <name>.

passages.title: Prized Possession
passages.text:
This chest is different. It's larger than the others... but more importantly, it's locked.

<Mograine bashes the lock apart.>

Now, let's see what's inside.

passages.title: Prized Possession
passages.text: How did they acquire that?

passages.title: Prized Possession
passages.text:
The Mantle of the Primus... 

Fate favors us today.

passages.title: The Mantle Returned
passages.text:
The Mantle of the Primus...

I can hardly believe it. That Gharmal possessed it. That they did not use it against us. That we reclaimed it.

This could prove vital toward our efforts to restore Maldraxxus. We must return it to Baroness Draka at the Seat of the Primus immediately.

passages.title: The Mantle Returned
passages.text: I'll send scouts to continue the search, but this... this is a huge boon for us.

passages.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Dredger
passages.text:
Thanks for getting the stone, <name>. While you were out I went ahead and dredged up a few more folks.

Now we just need to re-shape these dredgers into a biggun.

passages.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Dredger
passages.text: What do you want?

passages.title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Dredger
passages.text: Bootus ready.

passages.title: Running a Muck
passages.text:
Bootus ready to smash devourer skulls.

Hop on.

passages.title: Running a Muck
passages.text: Enders smashed?

passages.title: Running a Muck
passages.text:
Nice work, <name>. 

Bigguns can be... a bit much sometimes.

passages.title: Light Lost
Arms for the Poor
passages.text:
This trench is strewn with the remnants of countless attacks upon the Seat of the Primus by forces which threatened the Shadowlands.

Each time, Maldraxxus claimed victory.

Now scavengers pick at scraps in hopes of buying their way into one of the three remaining houses. In these desperate times, we must gain every advantage possible over our rivals.

If we arm these scavengers and offer them a second chance at glory, we can bolster the ranks of the Chosen.

passages.title: Arms for the Poor
passages.text: There should be plenty of weapons found on this old battlefield.

passages.title: Arms for the Poor
passages.text: And now we test them.

passages.title: Walk Among Death
passages.text:
This trench echoes with necromantic energies unleashed in the countless battles waged here. That power has coalesced into chaotic entities we call deathwalkers.

In simpler times, we would have sent troops out to subdue them to serve the House of the Chosen. But with war brewing, there is no time for that.

Eliminate this potential threat, before our enemies turn them against us.

passages.title: Walk Among Death
passages.text: Everything in this land is dangerous. There is no room for weakness.

passages.title: Enemy of My Enemy
passages.text:
I have no doubt you have questions. Know that we share enemies in this land.

For now, we must move. I will get you to a safer location and then we can speak.

passages.title: The First Act of War
passages.text:
Look around you, adventurer. This army is all that remains to defy the treachery of the other two houses.

I must regroup with the margrave and discuss strategy. War will soon be upon us.

I would ask that you prepare for the coming battle alongside the rest of our forces. We cannot afford for a single soldier to falter.

Seek out Baron Vyraz. He has earned countless victories for Maldraxxus. I fear his blades must soon be turned upon our former allies.

passages.title: The First Act of War
passages.text: What are you waiting for?

passages.title: The First Act of War
passages.text: Mark my words, recruit. We will crush the other houses for their acts of treason.

passages.title: The House of the Chosen
passages.text:
<Draka gestures to the sky.>

Look there, mortal. That is the necropolis of Margrave Krexus, who leads the House of the Chosen. It is my honor to serve as his baroness.

Let us ride to our fortress. There we can gather our strength and make ready for the battle to come.

passages.title: The House of the Chosen
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: The House of the Chosen
passages.text:
The Chosen are all that remains of what the Primus stood for.

We are the last hope of this realm.

passages.title: Garden in Turmoil
passages.text:
Please excuse me for not standing. I would rather not disturb these creatures.

If you have a desire to help the creatures of Bastion, Zosime needs aid to regain control of our garden. You will find her just down this path.

Go in service.

passages.title: Garden in Turmoil
passages.text: Oh, you're here to lend a hand? Wonderful!

passages.title: Gharmal's Tower
passages.text:
Gharmal collected anything they believed to be an item of power.

We'll need to search the tower. There is almost certainly something here of value to us.

passages.title: Gharmal's Tower
passages.text: That is definitely something. Let's open it and find out.

passages.title: An Unfortunate Situation
passages.text:
Laurent, mirror maker to the Master. Pleasure to meet you. Excuse my disheveled appearance. It appears I've found myself in a most unfortunate situation.

I was attempting to travel on royal business when my mirror sent me to this wasteland instead.

Not a moment after I arrived, a band of exiles ripped the clothes right from my back, making it impossible for me to traverse this unforgiving terrain.

Assist me and I will endeavor to create a mirror which will allow us to escape this wretched place.

passages.title: An Unfortunate Situation
passages.text: Have you recovered my belongings?

passages.title: An Unfortunate Situation
passages.text: This is it? Are you sure there wasn't more?

passages.title: Foraging for Fragments
passages.text:
Forgive me. I don't mean to appear ungrateful, but my mirror fragments are missing.

I shouldn't be surprised, really. They're quite powerful and I'm sure the miscreants out here would be happy to get their hands on them.

Nonetheless, I will not let this deter me.

The Master sends his stone servants to smash any mirrors erected in this ward, so we should have no trouble finding fragments nearby.

passages.title: Foraging for Fragments
passages.text: Simone shouldn't be here!

passages.title: Foraging for Fragments
passages.text: This must be some sort of mistake!

passages.title: Light Punishment
passages.text:
The reasons we were banished here differ, but our goal once we arrive is always the same--to avoid becoming ash.

The Shrouded control the areas shaded from Light. Those that trespass within their stronghold are made to suffer. Our flesh blisters and burns, yet we do not die. Instead, our minds descend into madness from the pain.

I do not claim to know the crimes of those trapped within the Light, but I know this is not the Maw. It is not our role to punish.

Free the others as you have freed me.

passages.title: Light Punishment
passages.text: Penance, not punishment. It seems the Master has forgotten the difference.

passages.title: Light Punishment
passages.text: You freed them, yes? Let us hope they found some small sliver of respite, where the Light cannot reach.

passages.title: When Only Ash Remains
passages.text:
Is this really what becomes of the exiled? Are they left here to burn to ash?

How could the Master allow such a thing? It is cruel. Heartless, even.

No venthyr would want to continue on like this. 

You must end their suffering.

passages.title: When Only Ash Remains
passages.text: I thought I knew our sire, but anyone who would do this to his subjects is not worth following.

passages.title: Escaping the Master
passages.text:
Now more than ever I wish to escape this place, but I cannot go back to serve the Master. Not after seeing what goes on here.

Simone and I are in agreement. With your assistance, I will craft a mirror that connects to a sanctuary controlled by the prince. We will leave this place and pledge our support to Renathal. 

But first, I'll need fragments of glass. The Shrouded seem to have plenty, and the fewer they have to make traps, the better.

passages.title: Escaping the Master
passages.text: Have you collected the fragments?

passages.title: Escaping the Master
passages.text:
<Laurent carefully examines the fragments before speaking.>

Yes, these should work. I'm almost certain.

passages.title: Mirror Making, Not Breaking
passages.text:
Denathrius does not allow mirrors to be erected within the ember ward. His stone servants shatter anything that so much as glints. 

I need you to remain vigilant as I make this mirror. I have no doubt that the Master's minions will try to stop us. 

Are you ready?

passages.title: Mirror Making, Not Breaking
passages.text:
Simone is right. We don't have time for idle chatter. Not here, at least.

The mirror we've repaired will take you to safety.

passages.title: Covering our Tracks
passages.text:
I belong to the House of the Chosen. We have a stronghold to the south, it should be safe there.

We'll fly the rest of the way. Approach my flayedwing when you are prepared.

passages.title: Disturbing the Peace
passages.text:
This anima drought isn't hard on just the kyrian. The wildlife of Bastion are suffering too!

Many creatures are becoming aggressive and menacing, wyrms and cloudfeathers especially. They are hurting the other wildlife and long beyond saving.

If someone doesn't clear this garden of these starved creatures, we can no longer meditate here. And if we can no longer meditate, that will make the anima shortage even worse!

passages.title: Disturbing the Peace
passages.text: We must deal with the anima-starved creatures so this place can return to a state of tranquility.

passages.title: Disturbing the Peace
passages.text: We can now better fulfill our duties here. I look forward to resuming my meditations. Thank you.

passages.title: Distractions for Kala
passages.text:
When the animals became aggravated, we left in a hurry. However, all of Kala's toys are still inside the garden.

Since you are going to be there, would you please collect them? Kala may be very large, but she is still young. She can be a bit of a troublemaker as well.

Hopefully the return of her toys will help keep her distracted.

passages.title: Distractions for Kala
passages.text: Do you have her playthings? She's becoming quite the handful!

passages.title: Distractions for Kala
passages.text: Kala! Look! <name> brought back your favorite things!

passages.title: A Test of Courage
passages.text:
I'm still new and haven't passed all of my Aspirant tests. But, I have an idea.

There is an artifact called Korinna's Allaying Crook. Korinna was a powerful Ascended who tamed the creatures of Bastion eons ago. Her staff has the power to prevent more creatures from succumbing to a savage, anima-starved state.

However, the artifact is protected and only one with great courage can retrieve it. I bet you could, <name>.

Go on ahead. The staff is in the reliquary to the north. I'll join you there shortly.

passages.title: A Test of Courage
passages.text: Were you able to retrieve the crook?

passages.title: A Test of Courage
passages.text: I told you she can be quite the troublemaker. Ugh, Kala!

passages.title: In Agthia's Memory
passages.text:
Greetings, mortal!

Are you here to learn about the legacy of Agthia, Paragon of Courage?

I welcome you to walk the grounds of this ancient battleground to learn of the battle that occurred here, and the heroic Paragon who saved all of Bastion and the Shadowlands.

passages.title: In Agthia's Memory
passages.text: Agthia did not only live a life of courage, but one of service to all of the Shadowlands.

passages.title: In Agthia's Memory
passages.text:
It is an eternal tug of war between the cosmic forces of existence. 

They constantly vie for power over each other but if one fell, all worlds would fall into chaos.

passages.title: Agthia's Path
passages.text:
Now that you have familiarized yourself with the events leading to the battle that took place here eons ago, it is time to experience it for yourself.

Ring the bell, take a deep breath, and walk in Agthia's steps.

passages.title: Agthia's Path
passages.text: To arms, kyrian! We must stand strong before the forces of the Void!

passages.title: Warriors of the Void
passages.text:
These Void invaders are wiping our forces from existence!

My disciples fall, returning their anima to the lands.

If we fail to drive them from our lands, more than kyrian will be lost. First Bastion, then the Shadowlands as a whole.

passages.title: Warriors of the Void
passages.text:
Wherever you step, you leave a wake of vanquished Void forces in your path.

You give your peers time to breathe.

passages.title: On Wounded Wings
passages.text:
I see my peers fall in pain, their wounds from the Void overtaking them.

We cannot allow ourselves, or each other, to give up hope.

Share your anima with our wounded brothers and sisters. Help them stand tall for another fight!

passages.title: On Wounded Wings
passages.text:
My disciples resolve, standing to fight another day.

I will not take that in vain.

passages.title: Wicked Gateways
passages.text:
The forces of the Void are infinite.

They travel through the Great Beyond by creating portals, twisting gateways between our planes.

Quickly, move to close these portals. Cripple the swell of their forces for as long as we can hold.

passages.title: Wicked Gateways
passages.text: New portals shall open, but we can prevent the swell for a time.

passages.title: Wicked Gateways
passages.text:
Do not revel in our victory. More shall break through.

We must use this opportunity to strike.

passages.title: Shadow's Fall
passages.text:
Despite our efforts, the Void stands strong. All of the forces of Bastion fight, and fall one by one...

The Void cannot destroy us!

They are led by Tezulat the Annihilator, scourge of a thousand realms. This day, his reign of terror will end!

passages.title: Shadow's Fall
passages.text: We shall sing the songs of Agthia, hero of Bastion, for eternities to come.

passages.title: Shadow's Fall
passages.text: Now you have bore witness to Agthia's great sacrifice.

passages.title: Tough Love
passages.text:
Heavens! Kala has flown off with Korinna's Allaying Crook!

I saw her fly into her den to the west. I must warn you, she can become very protective when she's in there. Please be careful, but do not be afraid to give her some tough love. She is exceptionally resilient.

Here, take her slobber ball. It's her favorite and may help to distract her.

passages.title: Tough Love
passages.text: Do you have the crook?

passages.title: Tough Love
passages.text: With the crook and Korinna's guidance, I can begin to bring this place and its creatures back to their former state of respite. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Moving Mirrors
passages.text:
What sort of horrific trap is this? The Light is being reflected directly on her! 

Simone's a dear friend of mine! Free her from that thing, please!

passages.title: Moving Mirrors
passages.text:
Denathrius may not have set the mirrors, but it's his fault I am here.

Those that rouse his suspicion are sent here to suffer, even once loyal servants like myself.

passages.title: Through the Veil
passages.text:
I like you, youngling. You put in the work while the others sit in their fancy court, leaving old Marasmius to keep the fae rings thriving.

Here, take one of my spores back with you to the Heart of the Forest. Find somewhere nice and cozy for me to rest, will you?

Come back and visit me whenever you like. Cort and I can keep an eye on things for now, but there will always be plenty for you to do here. Might even be something special in it for you.

passages.title: Through the Veil
passages.text:
Ahh, it's nice to stretch out again. I've missed this place, you know.

<Marasmius pauses for a moment.>

Don't tell anyone here I said that, all right?

passages.title: A Fate Most Noble
passages.text:
Welcome, Worthy One!

I am Greeter Mnemis. It is my duty and pleasure to assist you on this, your first day among the kyrian.

Allow me to congratulate you. Your fate is reserved for the most noble of souls. Only those who lived a life of service may call Bastion home.

I am certain you have many questions- all new aspirants do! Please allow me the honor of introducing you to the next chapter of your existence.

We will begin when you are ready.

passages.title: A Fate Most Noble
passages.text: Please alert me to your needs and concerns, Worthy One.

passages.title: A Fate Most Noble
passages.text: I hope that was informative and relaxing.

passages.title: Bring Your Own
passages.text:
Scunner, a roiling mass of flesh and slime, has crawled out of the ruins of the House of Plagues. 

He emits a toxic vapor that impairs the functions of those who attempt to fight him. You can try it, Maw Walker, but it's doubtful you could hurt him on your own.

Constructs are built to fight creatures like Scunner. So gather a force of them and eliminate the threat.

passages.title: Bring Your Own
passages.text: Very fine work, Maw Walker.

passages.title: No Friend Left Behind
passages.text:
I would care for nothing more than to serve as navigator again, but my dearest friend suffers. I cannot stand to abandon him.

I can feel Twigin now. He struggles against the binding web of the spiders who once served us. More victims of this senseless conflict...

Though it pains me to say it, you must slay our spiders and gather their caustic venom. You can then use it to free Twigin.

If not out of empathy, rescue him for the sake of your plans. My skills will be useless without his direction.

passages.title: No Friend Left Behind
passages.text: Please spare him this pain.

passages.title: No Friend Left Behind
passages.text: Thank you for returning me to my sister.

passages.title: The Impossible Plan
passages.text:
Everything is in place for us to seize a necropolis. I will coordinate our efforts and meet you at the Seat of the Primus. 

Draka will undoubtedly commend you on your success. I, however, will do so once our mission is complete.

passages.title: The Impossible Plan
passages.text: You've done well, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Whisper of Hope
passages.text:
Akarek's demise has cast a dark shadow upon our house... but it is in the shadows where we thrive.

I know that not all the Eyes have perished. They could lie in wait, hidden for eternity, if such was demanded of them.

But it is time to reclaim our destiny. Take my sigil through the wreckage and awaken any Eyes who remain.

We will seize our victory.

passages.title: Whisper of Hope
passages.text: The baroness inspires great dedication. I trust in her plans.

passages.title: Better Off Dead
passages.text:
Our defense is tenuous at best, but the enemy is still hesitant to attack.

As long as they fear us, they won't be probing our defenses. 

You must keep the pressure on the enemy. Attack their positions all along our line.

passages.title: Trouble in the Banks
passages.text:
Ah, be welcome in my glade, Maw Walker. You are safe here.

While it is regrettable that Sorcha must wait for her weapons, it is of paramount importance that I keep my charges safe. I will do anything to prevent them from suffering as the rest of Ardenweald.

Perhaps I could ask a small favor of you. I have not heard from the gatherers at the Banks of Life in some time. Would you mind checking on them to make sure they are well? I would go myself, but I must deal with Sorcha. Seek out Foreman Thorodir.

passages.title: Trouble in the Banks
passages.text: Ah, the Lady sent you? Well, I have some bad news.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Amber Grease
passages.text:
Foreman,

Our supply of gris is running low. You know as well as I do that there is no end to Glitterfall Basin's need of it.

I've overheard from some of the other workers that you have a bit of a gorm problem. But the bigger the gorm, the bigger the gris, right?

If you happen to harvest some more, we can certainly put it to good use.

<The work order is signed: "Cavina.">

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Amber Grease
passages.text: Do you have something for me?

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Amber Grease
passages.text: It really is a remarkable substance. We use it in practically everything! Construction, mending, crafts, and it can even be added to rations.

passages.title: Unsafe Workplace
passages.text:
You've returned just in time! Fae are in danger!

It seems our actions have enraged the gorm. They are even more aggressive than they were before!

While some fae were able to evacuate, there are still many who are trapped down there.

Take this jar and slather anyone you find with a generous helping. That should heal their wounds and give them a chance to escape.

passages.title: Unsafe Workplace
passages.text: Thank you for rescuing them.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: More Husks!
passages.text:
I need more husks, Thorodir! The Lady herself wants to make sure we are outfitted with the finest armor.

They've been soaking in the waters long enough to be workable. Find some time to retrieve them before our hunters find themselves without adequate protection.

<The work order is signed: "Cavina.">

passages.title: Supplies Needed: More Husks!
passages.text: What's that you have there?

passages.title: Supplies Needed: More Husks!
passages.text:
I'm glad you found my note. Husks such as these need to soak in running water for several days before they can be shaped without breaking.

At least you were able to salvage something.

passages.title: Gifts of the Forest
passages.text:
These gorm have gone out of control! We need to stop them.

I have a plan, but I cannot do it on my own. We lure the gormlings to the Banks of Life by using special totems that are drained of their anima. If you can retrieve the wood required for the totem, I can prepare the ritual.

Take these pipes. Find the Culex trees growing on the banks and play a song for them. You will recognize them by their pale green leaves. The wood must be given freely for the ritual to work.

passages.title: Gifts of the Forest
passages.text: We need that lure for my clever plan. It's very clever, you're going to love it.

passages.title: Gifts of the Forest
passages.text: Good. This should do it!

passages.title: Tied Totem Toter
passages.text:
Hope you've caught your breath.

The totem is now a big, tasty beacon to all the nearby gorm. They're going to want to eat it and you're going to be carrying it!

We need to rehome the smaller ones. If they stay here they're just going to get big and angry again. If you can drop off a few groups of them outside the Banks of Life we can make sure they find their way to more balanced feeding grounds.

Let Thorodir know when you're done. I will let him know the plan.

passages.title: Tied Totem Toter
passages.text: Fluttercatch always was a clever one. Well done.

passages.title: The Final Leg
passages.text:
Please, I must get to Glitterfall Basin.

I thought I was being careful. I did not realize I was being hunted until it was too late. Such is the nature of the forest.

I am too close to fall here. The Lady herself invited me to come join her. She said I would be safe.

Can you take me to her?

passages.title: The Grove of Creation
passages.text:
I probably would have been digested if not for you. And while that sounds like a fascinating phenomenon, I am glad I did not experience it... firsthand.

You have a knack for solving problems and you're not afraid to get your hands dirty with our tools. Might I suggest paying a visit to Glitterfall Basin, to the west? It is home to our finest minds and workshops, and I am sure they could use your help in this drought.

The Lady of the Falls is droman there. She will know where you can best help!

passages.title: The Grove of Creation
passages.text:
Master Sha'lor sent you? Such a darling.

Next time you see him you can tell him that it's perfectly safe here.

passages.title: Silk Shortage
passages.text:
We are running short on silk! We use it for so many things, like instruments, weapons, and tools. But our supply has dried up!

We are in desperate need for fresh silk.

Our main hub of silk production is in the Gossamer Cliffs. If you could, seek out Caretaker Lillythistle, and see what the holdup is!

passages.title: Silk Shortage
passages.text:
Of course silk shipments have stopped!

The entire glade has been attacked by changelings and spriggans! Our poor silkstriders are so stressed out, we can't get any silk from them!

Can you help us?

passages.title: Meeting Blightcaller
passages.text:
There's no time to rest, <name>.

Our troops are returning from our latest skirmish against the Alliance. Many are dead or severely injured. 

Our warchief, the Dark Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, has requested aid in this war against the Alliance.

I recommended you for an operation that is planned. Nathanos Blightcaller is waiting to speak with you.

Before you go, I'll catch you up on what has happened.

passages.title: Meeting Blightcaller
passages.text:
Hmph, so you're the recruit that saved Breka's son from an island? I thought you'd be taller.

The Dark Lady has need of capable soldiers. Breka recommended you for this task.

<Nathanos sneers>

We'll see how long you last.

passages.title: The Things That Haunt Us
passages.text:
As you will soon learn, a ritual cleansing can be a... painful process.

In most cases, the upwelling of emotion is harmless. It can even generate anima under the right circumstances.

However... sometimes the result is far less pleasant. Negative memories can take a form of their own and manifest in a violent fashion.

I fear Pelagos' attempt at cleansing has brought forth such monsters. You must destroy them, and quickly.

passages.title: The Things That Haunt Us
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: The Things That Haunt Us
passages.text: The things that bind us can be violent. The insight we gain is no reason to let them run rampant.

passages.title: Prince Renathal
passages.text:
You! They say you are a Maw Walker. Well, time to put that to the test.

My master, Prince Renathal, was the one who started the rebellion. He knew Denathrius was working towards something truly nefarious, and attempted to stop him.

The rebellion failed, and Renathal was flung into the Maw.

I propose you and I venture into the Maw. There is an old device here that only you will be able to use. Together, we can recover my Prince. You need him, if you are to have any hope of success.

passages.title: Prince Renathal
passages.text: Your fighting style lacks... finesse.

passages.title: Prince Renathal
passages.text: So this is the Maw. I can feel it leeching my essence. Be on your guard.
