passages.title: Cages For All Occasions
passages.text:
Okay, do not lose focus. I can feel Renathal's presence. It is faint but I can sense he is outside of the tower, at least.

Come, let's find him and get out of here.

passages.title: Cages For All Occasions
passages.text: I recognize you. Azeroth has been very busy lately, and her champions have been very much at the forefront of events. We must talk as soon as time allows.

passages.title: A Royal Key
passages.text:
I am not about to question whatever twist of fate led you to me. Your timing could not be better.

This cage was custom built to contain me. There is one key, and of course it is on the armor of that large brute over there.

Vanquish him and take the key. Be swift, the Jailer's eyes are always on this area.

passages.title: A Royal Key
passages.text: There was an age when I knew how to pick a lock even this elaborate. Sadly that was so long ago I seem to have fallen out of practice.

passages.title: A Royal Key
passages.text: Well, you are quite resourceful. Give me twenty five of your kind and some proper gear and we could defeat the Master.

passages.title: Torghast, Tower of the Damned
passages.text:
My allies were taken into the Tower of the Damned, and so we must follow.

I do not think we must venture deep into those halls, which is good as I do not believe either of us is in shape for a fight like that.

Come, let us find our way to one of the most dangerous towers in all of existence.

passages.title: Torghast, Tower of the Damned
passages.text: It is only a matter of time before the Master detects my presence. We must be swift and violent of action if we are to stop Sire Denathrius.

passages.title: Refuge of Revendreth
passages.text:
Sinfall is more than a ruin. It was once a place of dark magic and experimentation.

When the Light retaliated and scorched the Ember Ward, the walls of this place stood. It is fortified, supplied, and filled with secrets. A perfect staging ground for our upcoming conflict.

But first, take me to meet these allies who led you to Vorpalia. We must take stock of what resources we have to work with.

passages.title: Refuge of Revendreth
passages.text: So few left, but we will make do.

passages.title: The Aspirant's Crucible
passages.text:
I have given Kalisthene's words some thought.

If you are to learn our ways, we should proceed as if you were an aspirant yourself. The next step is to journey through the Aspirant's Crucible.

It is a place of reflection, training, and cleansing. For an aspirant, it is where they prepare for the long journey ahead. For you... I hope you will learn how you might help us in this time of crisis.

Word of your arrival has likely spread. We will not keep them waiting.

Take my steed, and go in service.

passages.title: The Aspirant's Crucible
passages.text:
<The Forgelite studies you for a moment, then nods.>

Welcome. You are not what we expected, but we are glad to have you nonetheless.

passages.title: A Life of Service
passages.text:
Curious. You are unlike any aspirant that has come before, that much is certain.

You will notice that we have an audience. It has been a long time indeed since we welcomed another to the path. We are all eager to see what deeds brought you to us.

Simply approach the dais before you and gaze into the flame. The Watcher will pull forth your memories of those you served in life, and you will be transported back to those moments to aid them once more.

passages.title: A Life of Service
passages.text: Such a display is certain to raise our spirits.

passages.title: A Life of Service
passages.text:
I confess... I was hoping for a small spectacle to lift the spirits of the aspirants in my care.

I was not expecting to have my own lifted, as well. Thank you for that.

passages.title: A Forge Gone Cold
passages.text:
I have seen firsthand that you are a most capable soul.

Kleia has told me of your purpose here. She has spoken of the hopes she places in you. I am not yet certain if I am ready to do the same.

There is one small task that I would set before you, however. My forge has grown cold without anima to keep it burning bright. I long to practice my craft again.

My helper, whom you have met before, can elaborate on our needs.

You will find Sika near the forge. I will follow shortly.

passages.title: A Forge Gone Cold
passages.text: Hello again! This one is glad to see you!

passages.title: The Archon's Answer
passages.text:
Your cleansing is complete, and you are whole.

Our plan was a success. Undergoing such a rite, so soon after your arrival, has attracted Kalisthene's attention once more. 

Now is our opportunity to request an audience with the Archon.

Stand before her and be proud of what you have accomplished. No matter what happens now, you have done all that any aspirant could hope to.

passages.title: The Archon's Answer
passages.text: You are worthy of Bastion's grace, <name>. May it serve you well.

passages.title: Step Back From That Ledge, My Friend
passages.text:
This disciple... such emotion...

<Eridia stares at Nikolon for a long moment.>

Rarely do ascended require such rigorous cleansing, but I cannot deny what is readily apparent. This disciple will fall if I do not intervene.

There is no time to lose. Come. I will instruct you.

... I only hope we are not too late.

passages.title: Step Back From That Ledge, My Friend
passages.text:
<Eridia grips her hammer with pale knuckles.>

How... how are they so numerous?

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text:
<The scroll's runes shift and change as you attempt to read it. At first glance, it appears illegible.

Similar scrolls have appeared all over the Temple of Purity.

Eridia will be interested in these.>

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text: We must defend the temple, <name>.

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text:
These words... this voice...

How do I know this voice?

passages.title: Stonevigil Unrest
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I'm sure you've met my associate, Baroness Draka.

I have recruited her to help us with the growing threat of the Tithelord. His involvement with the Maldraxxi renegades is troubling.

One conspiracy begets another. So I recruited Draka to help us end it.

We must not treat this situation lightly. We first need to put an end to his oppression of Stonevigil Overlook. That way we can we win over the hearts and minds of his subjects.

passages.title: Stonevigil Unrest
passages.text: Thank you for your quick arrival, <name>.

passages.title: To the Estate
passages.text:
A window of opportunity has presented itself to us, <name>.

With his supply line cut off, Vartox dead, and people turned against him, the Tithelord should be no match for us. However, I must admit I do fear what tools he may have acquired from his Maldraxxi cohorts.

His base of operations is just down the road: the Caretaker's Manor, named for the Harvester whom he replaced.

We will meet you there.

passages.title: To the Estate
passages.text: Let us finish what we started.

passages.title: War with the Horde
passages.text:
Good to see you've received proper training as a <class>.

We'll need it for what's next. The Alliance's war with the Horde has reached a fevered pitch... and we've lost a lot of good soldiers.

King Anduin is looking for aid in an operation to bolster our forces. I told him you'd be a good fit for the job.

Before you meet him, let me get get you caught up on what has been happening so far.

passages.title: Fangs and Minds
passages.text:
The denizens of Stonevigil have been wrung dry by the Tithelord's greed. 

While some have taken up arms against these injustices, most are too downtrodden to act. We need them on our side to take him down.

<Prince Renathal hands you a heavy scroll dripping with anima.>

Go, show them the hypocrisy of their oppressor! Send them to me with the promise of sanctuary.

passages.title: Fangs and Minds
passages.text: More hands for the rebellion. They can taste the truth.

passages.title: The Maldraxxian Job
passages.text:
We cannot hope to hold the Seat without a necropolis. Khaliiq reports that Vashj is ready to set her plan in motion.

Meet with her and the other Eyes at Nurakkir. Do what must be done.

passages.title: The Maldraxxian Job
passages.text: We are pleased to see your return.

passages.title: Keep to the Path
passages.text:
That's everything on the list for this part of the forest. Lady Moonberry said to meet her in Tirna Vaal. It's just down the road; I'm going to fly ahead so everyone knows to expect you.

Just stay on the path and you won't be eaten. Probably. See you soon!

passages.title: Keep to the Path
passages.text: Hey! You survived!

passages.title: Keep to the Path
passages.text:
Featherlight says you've kept up your end of our deal. That's great to hear!

I have some news to share about getting you an audience with the Queen.

passages.title: Dreamweaver
passages.text:
Troubled winds sweep across Tirna Vaal. The boughs tremble in concern over the Queen's arrival. All must be as it should be.

Dreamweaver's wings droop with the weight of worry. Chaos swirls around the wildseeds under his care.

Calm the churning waters of the grove. Bring harmony to discord and let Dreamweaver flutter once more.

passages.title: Dreamweaver
passages.text:
You're new, aren't you? Not a fae, not a soul, nor are you bound for a wildseed.

And the droman sent you here to help me? Well, this just got very interesting.

passages.title: Nothing Goes to Waste
passages.text:
The gormlings are industrious creatures. Naturally, they are our source of gorm gris.

Gormlings are cute, small, and hungry, like Gloober here! Except he is not hungry right now, because I just fed him. Look at that little belly...

<Ahem>. I digress.

Gormlings will be drawn to consume anything that is not brimming with anima. They find it simply delicious. 

Take that wildseed there, and bring it into their pen. Then, see if you can get the gormlings to feast upon it!

passages.title: Nothing Goes to Waste
passages.text: Have you fed the gormlings?

passages.title: Nothing Goes to Waste
passages.text:
Well done!

The gormlings may be easily distracted, sometimes, but they are such helpful little creatures.

That is, when they are small.

The big ones are a different matter. But don't worry about those! I'm sure we won't have to deal with them.

passages.title: Collection Day
passages.text:
Now, we can collect the gorm gris for Guardian Kota!

Once the gormlings have eaten something, we can 'encourage' them to give it back up. What they produce, we call gorm gris!

My Gormherd Branch should encourage them to do this safely. 

Go on, give it a try on good ol' Gloober first.

What has me worried is how the other gormlings might behave. They have been acting so strangely lately!

passages.title: Collection Day
passages.text:
I wonder what would happen if I overcharged the Gormherd Branch... would that be more efficient? Or would it make things explode?

... probably explode.

passages.title: Collection Day
passages.text:
Oh, this isn't right at all! The gormlings are supposed to return to their normal, adorable little selves.

What in the Queen's name is happening to them?

And there's no more gorm gris to give to Kota! This won't do at all.

passages.title: Delivery for Guardian Kota
passages.text:
This is most disturbing, indeed. The gorm are just too... wild, now!

I wonder if the drought is making everything delicious to them, and that is why.

This isn't enough gorm gris, either. And I do not want to disappoint Kota..

But, I also don't want to put you through more trouble collecting it. I will go myself into the burrows nearby, to see if I can find any more for her.

Would you take this gorm gris to her for me, please?

passages.title: Delivery for Guardian Kota
passages.text:
Master Sha'lor has gone to the burrows himself, to try and find more gorm gris?

... for me?

That reckless, thick-horned sylvar! He will get himself killed!

passages.title: Just Act Natural
passages.text:
With this disguise you will blend right in. I... know a Forsworn artificer on the inside who should prove useful. You need to remain convincing, however.

The most important thing is to get to Kalliope's spear before the Forsworn manage to do so. The shrine has many defenses, but it's only a matter of time before they find it.

I am somewhat ashamed. Many of the aspirants here used to be friends. So much has been lost.

passages.title: Just Act Natural
passages.text:
What is it? Don't just mill about.

Oh, it's you...

passages.title: Ages-Echoing Wisdom
passages.text:
Hmph. Even if I wanted to give her weapons, I cannot. My glade is under attack!

Most of my people were driven out during the attack on the growthworks but a few of the elders stayed behind. Whether to delay the enemy or see the friends to safety, they are not here where it is safe.

Each elder can perform extraordinary works and could make the weapons in no time at all. Rescue the elders and then we'll talk about using their talents for the good of Ardenweald.

passages.title: Ages-Echoing Wisdom
passages.text: Good! I am glad you found them alive. Of course, we will be unable to put them to work until the threat is dealt with and they are able to continue their crafts in peace. I'm sure Sorcha will understand.

passages.title: Idle Hands
passages.text:
If you want my help then you are going to need to help me first.

There is a group of spriggans that have assaulted the growthworks to the northeast. They are causing all manner of havoc and I simply will not abide this trespass into my lands.

Go there and teach them a lesson. If they will not flee, then slay them on the spot!

passages.title: Idle Hands
passages.text: Good. It is the way of nature for the stronger to prevail.

passages.title: The Sweat of Our Brow
passages.text:
Ah, an outsider! You are perfect for this task.

The spriggans are known for their mischief. They have been cursing our tools and supplies and trapping unsuspecting workers!

Like our curses, they must obey the rules. You'll need shimmerdust for baskets, thread made of gossamer for harps, and minty fresh breath for the soulwebs. How odd.

Good luck and let the Lady of the Falls know when you're done. She'll be delighted to hear it!

passages.title: The Sweat of Our Brow
passages.text: Cursed tools? And you brought them back? Un-cursed!? I must say, I was not entirely expecting you to be quite so successful.

passages.title: Craftsman Needs No Tools
passages.text:
Oh, I am quite all right! There's just one little thing....

One of these fiends made off with my lucky mallet! I simply cannot leave my mallet behind. I do not even use it much any more, but it is quite lucky and I always keep it with me.

Please, I cannot even think about building anything without it. Do keep an eye out for it, will you?

passages.title: Craftsman Needs No Tools
passages.text: It is small, and quite lucky. I am sure you will know it when you see it.

passages.title: Craftsman Needs No Tools
passages.text: Oh, you found it! How lucky, do you see?

passages.title: Spirit-Gathering Labor
passages.text:
You are not like the others.

The waters here carry deep power. Power most have forgotten. But the tirnenn forget very little.

Power flows through the earth just as water flows with power. Flows can be trapped for a time, dripping. Drop by drop they drip into vessels.

Search for the vessels beneath the falls. Collect the power.

passages.title: Spirit-Gathering Labor
passages.text: Drip, drip, go the falls. Drop, drop, goes the power. Power of the earth.

passages.title: Spirit-Gathering Labor
passages.text: Much power courses through. We need only the smallest dustings. Your labors please me.

passages.title: Outplayed
passages.text:
Now we can strike down their leader, friend.

It just so happens that I have a large pouch of puffpetal powder right here. Why don't you take it and toss a few handfuls around the workshop floor at the top of the falls? If they are still there, I imagine they will have an... unfortunate reaction.

While you do that I will gather the other elders and make our way to Glitterfall Basin. Speak with the Lady when your task is done.

passages.title: Outplayed
passages.text: Ah, the hero of the hour returns! Thank you for liberating my supplies. Our grove desperately needs them in these trying times.

passages.title: Bring More Friends!
passages.text:
This is only the beginning, friend.

I must thank you again for rescuing me. Now that we have found a safe route, I am but the first of many. Druids from all around Ardenweald have heard of the safety of this glade, and I wish to bring them all here.

I have known Roriel for most of my time in this place. She is a capable healer, despite her appearance. She would be a fine addition to this place.

She was last seen near Tirna Fein to the west. Please let her know the way is clear.

passages.title: Mark of Humility
passages.text:
Quartermaster, you've arrived.

Those fools over there still haven't gotten past the first barrier. We need to get into that cave to have any chance at recovering the Spear of Kalliope.

Our research discovered the phrase, "Only the humble find their way. Even heroes kneel before virtue." But those fools have been working on that clue for ages.

Go figure out the problem and get inside that cave. We need its mark to open the final vault.

passages.title: Mark of Humility
passages.text: Have you acquired the mark?

passages.title: Mark of Humility
passages.text: Well done, quartermaster. Well done. The Spear of Kalliope is almost within my grasp!

passages.title: The End of the Beginning
passages.text:
<Renathal struggles to speak, his wounds evident.>

I knew Denathrius had hoarded anima, but this... this is beyond imagining.

The Jailer will surely use this power to shatter his bonds. Should he break free of the Maw, all the realms of Death will fall.

We must continue to press the fight against Denathrius. Alas, we cannot hope to succeed alone.
 
Return to Oribos with Draven and speak to the Honored Voice, Tal-Inara. Tell her what you have seen this day and implore her to action.

passages.title: The End of the Beginning
passages.text: We have sensed something horrific has happened. Quickly, tell me everything.

passages.title: The Looming Dark
passages.text:
It is good you have returned safely from Revendreth, <name>. We sensed a betrayal that has shifted the infinite threads of fate.

The Maw surges with power. We must know the cause.

passages.title: The Looming Dark
passages.text: As the bearer of this news, you must bear this burden as well.

passages.title: The Looming Dark
passages.text: You have done well. See that you continue to do so.

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text:
Each covenant is vital to the Shadowlands. Though they often seem at odds with one another, this too is part of the Purpose.

All the covenants need to grow strong to face the threat of the Jailer. But your efforts cannot be divided. They must be focused upon a single path. Other mortals may make a different choice.

The time has come for you to take a side. 

Speak to your allies. Then make your choice at the map of the Shadowlands before me.

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text: Have you made your decision yet?

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text: All is as expected. Trust always in the Arbiter's plan.

passages.title: An Estate Within the Old Gate
passages.text:
I believe I know how we can obtain the Countess's medallion and avoid making any new enemies.

Before being cast out into the Light, I held a prominent position within the Countess's court. She bestowed upon me an estate with direct access to her private chambers. 

If the estate still stands, you can use it to sneak into the Countess's manor and steal the medallion without ever drawing your weapon. 

Take this note to my trusted butler, Bogdan. He will provide whatever assistance you need.

passages.title: An Estate Within the Old Gate
passages.text: What is this? A note from the Duke?

passages.title: An Estate Within the Old Gate
passages.text:
<Bogdan reads the words quickly, his eyes welling with tears as a smile spreads across his face.>

The Duke lives? What splendid news!

passages.title: The Key to Rebuilding
passages.text:
If we plan to revive the estate, we'll first need the keys!

When Theotar was exiled to the Ember Ward, he lost all titles and property, meaning that the estate fell into the hands of another aristocrat. 

The new owner is a mystery to me, but household staff almost always carry keys on them as they do their business within the Old Gate. 

Recover the key and we'll be on our way to rebuilding the manor.

passages.title: The Key to Rebuilding
passages.text: Have you recovered the key?

passages.title: The Key to Rebuilding
passages.text: Ah, this is it! We should have no trouble accessing the manor now.

passages.title: Reestablishing the Household
passages.text:
Unfortunately, when ownership of the estate changed hands, the staff were all displaced and forced to find new work. Some of us found suitable roles within favorable households. After all, everyone needs a sommelier! 

Others were not so lucky. They're still here in the Old Gate, taking odd jobs to survive. I'm sure they'll be eager to work for the Duke again once they learn we're reestablishing the household.

Seek them out and present this offer of employment.

passages.title: Reestablishing the Household
passages.text: Don't worry about Florin. He'll come around.

passages.title: Reclaiming Thornhill Manor
passages.text:
I've done some digging and discovered that Viscount Nicolae is the new inhabitant of Thornhill Manor. 

A vile thing, he is. It'll take us weeks to rid the estate of his stench!

Hopefully, you can rid us of him in a much timelier fashion. 

I'll gather the rest of the staff and together we can reclaim Thornhill Manor.

passages.title: Reclaiming Thornhill Manor
passages.text: I cannot stand the thought of someone else occupying Thornhill Manor.

passages.title: Reclaiming Thornhill Manor
passages.text: Why would our lady choose such a lout as her paramour? Regardless, Thornhill Manor is ours once again.

passages.title: A Discreet Entrance
passages.text:
I can assure you--this is not how we left the place. Never would we ever let the manor fall into such a state. 

At least the mirror is still intact, that's what's important. You can use it to enter the Countess's private chambers discreetly and recover the medallion. 

Go, quickly, before word spreads of what we've done. We'll do our best to restore the manor while you're gone.

passages.title: A Discreet Entrance
passages.text: How nice it is to finally come face to face with the revered Maw Walker.

passages.title: A Meal and A Deal
passages.text:
Even though you arrived here uninvited, you weren't unexpected. I know all that goes on within my district. 

As such, let us share a meal and speak of the matters at hand.

I believe there's a way in which we can both get what we want.

passages.title: A Meal and A Deal
passages.text: Please, enjoy my hospitality.

passages.title: A Meal and A Deal
passages.text: So, we have a deal then?

passages.title: Killing the Messenger
passages.text:
I make it my business to know what is going on within my district. 

Traditionally we use stone fiends to relay messages, but my informants have alerted me to some suspicious communications going on within the Old Gate. 

A venthyr has been hired to run missives between two undisclosed parties. When someone puts that much effort into concealing their identity, it can never be good.

Find this courier and recover whatever missives they might be carrying.

passages.title: Killing the Messenger
passages.text: Has it been done?

passages.title: Killing the Messenger
passages.text:
<The Countess maintains a stoic expression as she carefully scans the missive, her grip tightening the longer she reads.>

This letter was penned by Andrei of House Iremoore. I'd know that scrawl anywhere. And it would appear he's plotting to overthrow me.

passages.title: An Invitation to Treachery
passages.text:
While the missive made it clear that Andrei is displeased with my position, nothing in the letter identifies his co-conspirator. 

All we really know is that they are trying to gain access to my soiree this evening so they can carry out their plans. Let's make it easy for them, shall we? 

Head into the Redelav District and deliver an invite to the prominent houses. This way, we'll be sure the traitors show up.

passages.title: An Invitation to Treachery
passages.text: No one will be able to turn down an invite to one of my infamous soirees.

passages.title: Beautiful, But Deadly
passages.text:
The Redelav District is home to the most affluent venthyr in all of Revendreth. Its denizens spare no expense on the upkeep of their extravagant gardens.

Well worth the effort, I must say. For the Redelav District is the only place where Duskmire mushrooms can grow. They are as beautiful as they are deadly.

Would you mind collecting a few? Their uses are varied, and it's always a good idea to have some on hand.

passages.title: Beautiful, But Deadly
passages.text: Do you have the mushrooms?

passages.title: Beautiful, But Deadly
passages.text:
<The Countess inspects the mushrooms with a wry smile.>

A rich color means the spores will be potent.

passages.title: Mix, Mingle, and Meddle
passages.text:
Once the party begins, I will be occupied with a plethora of nobles that wish to cling to my side. 

This is why I need you to mingle. Speak with the attendees and see if you can determine which house is conspiring against me. 

Be warned, invited guest or not, these aristocrats can smell an outsider. You won't receive a warm welcome from everyone.

passages.title: Mix, Mingle, and Meddle
passages.text: One among my guests is the traitor. I need you to find out who.

passages.title: Mix, Mingle, and Meddle
passages.text: Have you identified the traitorous house?

passages.title: Enacting Immediate Justice
passages.text:
There are likely many in attendance who wish me harm. 

I trust you have done your job in determining which house has been working with Andrei?

Once they are named, I trust you will enact immediate justice.

passages.title: Enacting Immediate Justice
passages.text: The traitorous house will be uncovered and swiftly dealt with.

passages.title: Enacting Immediate Justice
passages.text: Justice has been served, and an uprising quelled.

passages.title: Neither Enemy nor Ally
passages.text:
I hope you now see the importance of the role I play. 

My parties serve a greater purpose. Keeping the influential and elite entertained helps quell uprisings. If their minds are consumed by trivial things, they don't have time to plot or plan. 

Sometimes, battles are best fought before they begin. Giving you my medallion is an example of that. 

We may not be allies, but we are not enemies, either.

passages.title: Neither Enemy nor Ally
passages.text: Have you secured the medallion?

passages.title: Neither Enemy nor Ally
passages.text: The Countess gave it up without a fight? We might have an ally in her yet...

passages.title: Elysian Hold
passages.text:
One more step yet remains before your initiation is complete.

You must now enter Elysian Hold, entryway to the rest of the Spires of Ascension and the vantage point from which the ascended safeguard Bastion and our aspirants in training.

Once there, we shall ensure you are fully acquainted with the hold's offerings. Since you lack wings, I shall escort you there.

passages.title: Elysian Hold
passages.text: Welcome home, <name>.

passages.title: Dangerous to Go Alone
passages.text:
There is one last thing you must do before we can act to clean up Denathrius's chaos.

You must have a soulbind.

All kyrian undergo this sacred ritual--albeit typically many aeons before they stand before the Archon herself.

Soulguide Daelia will guide you in this process. Seek her out in the chamber below.

passages.title: Dangerous to Go Alone
passages.text: I see even now that your soul burns brighter than most.

passages.title: Soul Meets Body
passages.text:
To soulbind with another is not an irrevocable bond. However, it is not to be entered into lightly.

You will experience one another's pasts. Your hopes, fears, dreams, your very memories--if any still linger. You will become kindred spirits in the truest sense.

Once complete, your connection will transcend physical space and make you stronger in more than mere brawn.

passages.title: Soul Meets Body
passages.text: Take your time. This is a significant step in your journey to ascension.

passages.title: Soul Meets Body
passages.text: Your journey together is just beginning.

passages.title: More Work?
passages.text:
Your world has a saying that "you cannot be in two places at once."

Without a soulbind, that is true. Thankfully we have resolved that matter. Such physical limitations are a mortal construct.

Christen our newest addition to the Hold in the ramparts above, then seek out Koros and you will see.

passages.title: More Work?
passages.text: I am Koros, head communicator of the hold. A pleasure.

passages.title: Across the Shadowlands
passages.text:
As kyrian we are responsible for ensuring that every last soul that enters the Shadowlands is sent to their appropriate eternity.

However, our eternal charge does not end in Oribos.

There are countless matters in the Shadowlands that need attention--far more than any one of us can handle. That, my friend, is where I come in.

Consider me your eyes in the field. Allow me to demonstrate with a simple task, so that you may both reap the benefits of my services.

passages.title: Across the Shadowlands
passages.text: Good things are worth waiting for.

passages.title: Across the Shadowlands
passages.text: You see, my mortal friend, it truly is that simple!

passages.title: All That Remains
passages.text:
Just as you must work with your soulbind in an eternal partnership to ensure peace in our realm, so must you work to restore the flow of anima in the sky above.

Capheus, one of the great Mikanikos's students, has specialized in the craft of directing what anima we have to the temples that need it most.

Given the great drought of anima that plagues us if anyone could use assistance, it would be her.

passages.title: All That Remains
passages.text: Yes, yes, you! You can help!

passages.title: All That Remains
passages.text: The others speak of you! Come! Let me know you too!

passages.title: Power in the Sky
passages.text:
This device you see here can be used to send anima to our temples and aid our people.

As each temple regains its flow of anima, it will begin to function once more. You may find these functions useful in your journeys, or you may even find new challenges that await you.

Once you have brought some anima to our sanctum, use the device to direct it to a temple, and see the results for yourself.

passages.title: Power in the Sky
passages.text: Does the anima flow?

passages.title: Power in the Sky
passages.text:
Good, anima is flowing again. You will want to return to the device periodically and channel more anima.

As you gather more anima and channel it into Bastion, the flows will grow stronger. Though they will not last for long right now, eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making a permanent connection.

Once, the skies of Bastion were alight with the flows of anima. With your help, they will be again.

passages.title: A Unique Opportunity
passages.text:
All the anima in the Shadowlands will not restore Elysian Hold to its full glory without willing souls to ensure its many capabilities function properly.

Soulguide Daelia is one of our most veteran watchers. She has been tasked with bringing souls to these halls once more.

You should pay her a visit within the Sanctum of Binding to see if you might be of aid.

passages.title: A Unique Opportunity
passages.text: Your arrival is most timely, Maw Walker.

passages.title: The True Crucible Awaits
passages.text:
I confess, <name>. I had little hope when you first arrived.

Kleia is convinced that your presence here is a sign of things finally improving in Bastion. I was... skeptical.

<The Forgelite gestures to her forge.>

What you have done for me will not soon be forgotten. There is a path beyond the Crucible. To walk it, you must overcome a trial. It will be difficult. Such a thing takes eons for most.

You are not most.

Kleia and Pelagos will tell you more. They await you near the sparring grounds.

passages.title: The True Crucible Awaits
passages.text:
The Forgelite's gratitude goes deeper than you know.

Now. You must turn your attention back to our purpose here.

passages.title: Assessing Your Stamina
passages.text:
The trial ahead will test you on many levels. I, like Kleia, wish to assess your willingness to endure.

Look around you. All the aspirants here train for the very trial you are to attempt. Some have been here, honing their skills, for centuries. Ages. Some grow quickly, some do not.

Your task is to engage them in friendly, armed combat. Among the kyrian this is known as a combat meditation.

Help them find focus, and they shall help you do the same.

Return to me when you feel ready to continue.

passages.title: Assessing Your Stamina
passages.text: Trust in the process, <name>.

passages.title: Assessing Your Stamina
passages.text:
To fight so many, in so short a time, is truly a feat of stamina.

I am tired just looking at you.

<Pelagos laughs.>

passages.title: Baron of the Chosen
passages.text:
Our forces at the Spearhead are under siege from Margrave Gharmal's vanguard. If Vyraz himself is leading the defense, then the situation must be dire.

The House of Constructs shapes flesh to forge bodies for its forces. They were once an indispensable ally, but have become a fearsome enemy.

Margrave Krexus trusts your might. No doubt you will have need of it.

passages.title: Baron of the Chosen
passages.text: I expect much of you, mortal. Help lead our frontal assault on the construct forces!

passages.title: Mark of Knowledge
passages.text:
There is another matter for which I need your assistance. My researchers and interrogators have been tirelessly working on the second chamber. So far they don't have any leads.

I need you to speak to them and see if they've made any progress. Tell them, if they have nothing to show, then they will soon find themselves at the end of my sword.

Get me that mark, quartermaster!

passages.title: Mark of Knowledge
passages.text: Did you bring the mark? If not, then why are we speaking?

passages.title: Mark of Knowledge
passages.text: One step closer to my goal.

passages.title: The Absolution of Souls
passages.text:
Do you not yet understand the purpose of Revendreth, Maw Walker?

The souls under our care teeter on the brink of permanent damnation. Even with perfect attention and careful processing, not every soul can escape the Maw and be elevated to a higher destiny.

That is true under the best of circumstances.

Currently, due to your installation of the Chamberlain at the Halls of Atonement, we're instead witnessing the worst of circumstances.

We must return to the Halls of Atonement and enforce order.

passages.title: The Absolution of Souls
passages.text: It is worse than I feared.

passages.title: An Abuse of Power
passages.text:
The souls have suffered tremendously under the Lord Chamberlain.

We venthyr subjugate souls to our will so that we may lead each to the absolution it requires--willing or not.

The Lord Chamberlain, however, has been using our relics and rituals to abuse the souls under his authority. He binds the souls to their sinstones, perverting their very essence!

Use these ritual chains on the abused soul and subjugate it to your will. We must attempt to absolve it.

passages.title: An Abuse of Power
passages.text: Every lost soul is a tragedy.

passages.title: An Abuse of Power
passages.text:
That soul is now lost forever. Such wasted potential...

The Lord Chamberlain will answer for this offense.

passages.title: The Proper Souls
passages.text:
We must save as many souls as we can from the fate we have just witnessed.

Search the halls for souls who have escaped the Lord Chamberlain's perverse rituals. Subjugate them and bring them to me inside the Halls of Atonement.

Together, we will make certain that each soul is appropriately processed and cared for.

passages.title: The Proper Souls
passages.text: If even one soul can be saved, it is worth it.

passages.title: The Proper Souls
passages.text: Every lost soul must be tended to.

passages.title: The Proper Tools
passages.text:
There are very specific procedures that we must follow to best tend to the souls under our care. You and I will follow them exactly.

I can mask your garish appearance, but you must acquire the necessary ritual tools on your own.

Requisition them from the depraved venthyr serving the Lord Chamberlain nearby.

passages.title: The Proper Tools
passages.text: We will do this the proper way.

passages.title: The Proper Tools
passages.text: Good. You are ready for the ritual.

passages.title: The Proper Punishment
passages.text:
Thankfully, I am not the only one who remembers the high calling of the Halls of Atonement and its servants.

These avowed ritualists have been working covertly to preserve the integrity of the halls.

They report that the Lord Chamberlain relies on a particularly gifted soulflayer to teach other ritualists how to corrupt the souls.

Give him the reward he deserves.

passages.title: The Proper Punishment
passages.text: There is no excuse for perverting our ancient rituals.

passages.title: The Proper Punishment
passages.text: His just reward would be the Maw, but this will have to do.

passages.title: Ritual of Absolution
passages.text:
The ritual of absolution is a sacred rite that forces souls to discard the burdens of their mortal lives.

The soul must be a willing participant if the ritual's effect will be meaningful and long-lasting. We often spend ages preparing a soul for a single absolution ritual.

The Lord Chamberlain has neglected his duty. These souls are overdue for absolution, practically bursting with anima.

We will perform the ritual ourselves, and hurry these souls along their journey.

passages.title: Ritual of Absolution
passages.text: Absolution is where mercy meets justice.

passages.title: Ritual of Absolution
passages.text: Absolution does not come easy. Nor should it.

passages.title: Ritual of Judgment
passages.text:
After all rituals of absolution are complete, each soul must face its final judgment in Revendreth.

There are three potential verdicts:
If proven unworthy, it is condemned to the Maw for eternity.

If fully absolved of its sins, it is either elevated to a venthyr or returned to the Arbiter to be assigned its new destination.

Our most sacred ritual, the judgment, determines this fate.

One such ritual is happening now. I will disguise you and we will participate to ensure a just verdict.

passages.title: Ritual of Judgment
passages.text:
I sacrificed more than you realize to save this soul.

I would do it again, because it is right. Do you understand yet?

passages.title: Archivist Fane
passages.text:
Well, our disguises are superfluous now. We will not be welcome after disrupting their depraved ritual.

Despite what we've observed here, some steadfast venthyr do still remain within these halls. Those who have not forsaken our vocation, and carry on with our calling.

Archivist Fane is one such as these. Aid his endeavors however you can. We will need his insight to loosen the Lord Chamberlain's grip over these halls.

I must tend to Gresit. He has much to learn.

passages.title: Archivist Fane
passages.text:
Some very angry judges recently passed through here.

<Archivist Fane grins.>

Tell me everything you did to antagonize them. Don't skip a single detail!

passages.title: The Sinstone Archive
passages.text:
You said Inquisitor Traian oversaw the ritual?

<Archivist Fane searches the massive archives in this chamber.>

We archivists maintain strict records of every soul that passes through these halls.

Or at least we're supposed to. The sinstones of powerful venthyr tend to go "missing."

<Archivist Fane rolls his eyes.>

I don't see his sinstone here. He might've stolen it, or someone could be hoarding it as blackmail.

Help me complete my archives, and I'll get you any sinstone you need.

passages.title: The Sinstone Archive
passages.text: Sinstones are the most powerful weapon in Revendreth.

passages.title: The Sinstone Archive
passages.text:
<Archivist Fane's eyes light up when you hand him the archives.>

This is a lot of potential leverage...

passages.title: Rebuilding Temel
passages.text:
Revendreth demands penance from all, and it would appear that even you are not exempt.

<Cryptkeeper Kassir grins.>

Do not fear, I have no intention of exacting revenge for the violence you inflicted upon me.

But I cannot offer you Temel either.

The Lord Chamberlain--who you so wisely chose to install as master of these halls--deemed Temel a threat to his control.

His thugs bashed Temel to bits and scattered the pieces among these crypts. It's not the first time I've had to rebuild him.

passages.title: Rebuilding Temel
passages.text: No matter how broken Temel is, I can rebuild him.

passages.title: Rebuilding Temel
passages.text:
<Cryptkeeper Kassir inspects the pieces of Temel you brought him.>

They bashed you real good, didn't they, Temel? Nothing I cannot fix...

passages.title: Atonement Crypt Key
passages.text: <This key is marked with a sigil that matches the crypts in the Halls of Atonement. What is the Lord Chamberlain hiding away in there?>

passages.title: Atonement Crypt Key
passages.text:
The atonement crypts are meant to be used as storage for souls who require additional... processing before their next ritual.

The Lord Chamberlain's idiots are using them like prison cells and treasure rooms. You are doing us all a favor by opening them whenever you find a key.

passages.title: Hunting an Inquisitor
passages.text:
You may have noticed that inquisitors are protected by the Lord Chamberlain's magic. A potent consequence of wielding the Master's medallion.

But now that we have access to Inquisitor Traian's sinstone from the archives, we have the power needed to break through those defenses.

Locate the inquisitor, and order Temel to read out from his sinstone. Declaring the true name and sins of the inquisitor will shatter his defenses and make him vulnerable for a short window of time.

Be ready to strike.

passages.title: Hunting an Inquisitor
passages.text: Truth, wielded properly, is a potent weapon.

passages.title: Hunting an Inquisitor
passages.text:
Decorous and deserved.

I hope this will be the first of many corrupt inquisitors we fell together.

passages.title: Resource Drain
passages.text:
Usually repairs easy. Anima everywhere!

Except drought means we can't just pull it from air. Other sources needed!

Take this. Drain anima from cloudstriders. Not ideal, but desperate times.

passages.title: Resource Drain
passages.text: Drought has big effects. Feel bad for cloudstriders.

passages.title: Resource Drain
passages.text: This is enough to repair Gatamatos, and then some!

passages.title: We Can Rebuild Him
passages.text:
Gatamatos needs numerous repairs to meet functional standards.

Upkeeping phalynx is part of the role. Lend a hand so we may finish the repairs thoroughly and quickly.

passages.title: We Can Rebuild Him
passages.text: As long as you keep your phalynx in working condition, they will obey without hesitation.

passages.title: We Can Rebuild Him
passages.text: He may appear to be returned to perfect shape, but he must be re-tested and trained.

passages.title: Combat Drills
passages.text:
Our phalynx units excel in combat. They are thoroughly trained in taking foes down by the legs, as well as hunting down beasts gone awry.

I need you to take stock of Gatamatos's fighting routines. Take him into the cavern below and practice his combat against the wyrms there.

passages.title: Combat Drills
passages.text: Excellent. His combat routines are acceptable.

passages.title: Superior Programming
passages.text:
Phalynx listen to their orders. Never disobey!

Larions are wild beasts. Can attack. Could eat a steward, probably!

Untamed larion lives close. Has chased many stewards, very scary! Please take care of it.

passages.title: Superior Programming
passages.text: Wild beasts. Terrifying! No thank you! I work with very safe phalynx.

passages.title: Superior Programming
passages.text: Can be at peace, no wild larion to eat me. Hoo...

passages.title: Tactical Formation
passages.text:
The principal step of our training regiment for our phalynx is formational drills. They must recall standard kyrian battle formations, and how to flow from one to the next.

Formational training is the final piece of information that Gatamatos is still missing. Please aid in retraining him.

passages.title: Tactical Formation
passages.text: A good soldier marches in order.

passages.title: Tactical Formation
passages.text:
And with that, I believe that Gatamatos is once again functioning at standard.

Thank you for your aid.

passages.title: Spirits of the Glen
passages.text:
Animals of the forest, mortal souls given form, frolic in the glen. Their anima, a boon to the weald, given freely as rain on the leaves.

But danger lurks in the shadows. A dark storm of malice and enmity tears at the trees. Creatures seeking shelter find only peril.

Rescue them.

passages.title: Spirits of the Glen
passages.text:
What's this? What's this?

The Tall Tree has sent you to help us? Help us!

passages.title: Nothing Left to Give
passages.text:
Oh no, oh no!

My friends, they gave so much. So much of their anima, they lost their forms! We all take a form when we come here, you see. Something that suits us!

But we give our anima, we give! To help the groves. And we give so much... sometimes too much.

I still have some anima. I still have my form! Get me to my friends! We can get THEIR forms back!

passages.title: Nothing Left to Give
passages.text: Oh dear, oh dear. My friends are in trouble!

passages.title: Nothing Left to Give
passages.text:
You found them! You found my friends! They have their forms!

Now we have one last thing to do. One last thing!

passages.title: They Need to Calm Down
passages.text:
Spriggans! Nasty spriggans. They came to the grove. They messed it all up!

They took the anima from the soul webs! We were collecting it, yes. Collecting it for the Tall Tree and their grove. The spriggans have to pay!

Beat them up! Then use this soulweb to take back the anima. We need it! They don't!

passages.title: They Need to Calm Down
passages.text: Did you destroy them? Did you make them pay?

passages.title: They Need to Calm Down
passages.text:
Stolen! They stole the anima! They ran like crazy and...

Wait that's normal. They're always that bad. Stupid spriggans!

passages.title: Mizik the Haughty
passages.text:
Bad spriggans! Bad! They take our anima. We lose our forms! And one is worst of all.

Mizik! He tells the others what to do. And he rides a gorm! Big, nasty gorm!

Get him. Get him!

passages.title: Mizik the Haughty
passages.text:
Gone! The bad spriggan is gone! Spirit Glen will be ours again.

Now to leave. We have to leave.

passages.title: In Need of Gorm Gris
passages.text:
Our neighboring grove at Glitterfall Basin has sent out a desperate plea for gorm gris.

It may have humble origins, but it is an important ingredient for our artisans and crafters. As this drought goes on, it has become increasingly difficult to collect.

I would like to help them out, with the resources that we are able to spare.

Please, find Master Sha'lor out by the Tranquil Pools, where he keeps our little gormling population.

Ask him for more gorm gris.

passages.title: In Need of Gorm Gris
passages.text:
Kota has asked for gorm gris?

<Master Sha'lor beams with excitement.>

I would be happy to oblige her request! Come, let me show you how this works.

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text:
You have truly proven yourself a hero in the eyes of those who are its absolute judge.

I thank you for giving me the honor of holding it, even for this briefest moment. However, it is only proper that you be the one to enshrine the spear at it's rightful resting place.

Let us meet at Elysian Hold where you can do the honors.

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text: <The resting place of the spear lies before you.>

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text: <Place the Spear of Kalliope in its rightful place knowing that only a true hero can do so.>

passages.title: Lead By Example
passages.text:
Margrave Krexus expects much of you, mortal. Show these soldiers how a true champion of the arena vanquishes their foes and claims victory!

Meet these traitorous constructs head on. Leave none standing!

passages.title: Lead By Example
passages.text: What?

passages.title: Lead By Example
passages.text: That should strike fear into their stolen hearts.

passages.title: A Temple in Need
passages.text:
<Eridia peers down at you.>

Your face is new to me.

<Eridia frowns.>

I regret that this shall be your introduction to our temple. As my disciple has informed you, we seek the aid of all available aspirants to tend to those in our care.

Do not trouble yourself over the specifics of the work that is needed. Those devoted to this temple will guide you. Seek out the disciples within.

You may find me within the temple when you have given your aid.

passages.title: A Temple in Need
passages.text: Have you lent my disciples your aid?

passages.title: A Temple in Need
passages.text: You have proven yourself adept at this task. You have my gratitude.

passages.title: Offensive Behavior
passages.text:
Fine work, adventurer. We've advanced with minimal casualties. 

From this new forward position, we can strike directly at the enemy commander. The troops you rallied will join the attack. Together, we will bring this battle to a decisive end.

Locate General Alver and sound the horn.

passages.title: Offensive Behavior
passages.text: Your leadership is inspiring. These troops would follow you anywhere!

passages.title: Breaking Down Barriers
passages.text:
As I suspected, Stitchflesh's assistants are carrying on his work. Whatever they're building, we need to destroy it.

They've secured the chamber with a soul barrier and several bile spewers. We must find a way through!

Thales said he may have a suggestion.

passages.title: Breaking Down Barriers
passages.text: Is the barrier down?

passages.title: Breaking Down Barriers
passages.text: It seems these kyrian are more stalwart than I expected. Let us avenge their fallen kin.

passages.title: Archon Save Us
passages.text:
Most of the aspirants were slaughtered and dismembered on arrival. They were the lucky ones. 

The lead surgeon decided that the only things worth taking from me... were my eyes. I was discarded afterward and left to my rot. Archon save me, the screaming...

I think there are other survivors being held nearby. Can you aid me in freeing them?

passages.title: Archon Save Us
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Archon Save Us
passages.text:
Only four survivors... I know I should be grateful that there were any at all, but...

What sort of monsters would do this to anyone, let alone to their own people?

passages.title: Give Them a Hand
passages.text:
The corpses are brought to this pit for processing. Their flesh is liquified and congealed before being shaped into new constructs.

We can hinder their production by extracting the animates from the pool prematurely. Use this hook to do so.

Do not let Baron Halis catch you. He has a reputation for cruelty, even within his own house.

passages.title: Give Them a Hand
passages.text: The weak make way for the strong, such is the way of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Give Them a Hand
passages.text: Slowing the production of new constructs should earn our soldiers some reprieve, however brief.

passages.title: A Burden Worth Bearing
passages.text:
Mevix may be here for blood, but what I want is to spare my fallen kin from a terrible fate.

Most of my fellow kyrian were either slain in combat or shortly after arriving here. If their corpses were bound for this pit, then perhaps we can recover them before they are thrown into it.

Take the stewards with you and gather the bodies of my brethren. I will not allow them to be made into monsters.

passages.title: A Burden Worth Bearing
passages.text: Were there any left?

passages.title: A Burden Worth Bearing
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Though they are lost, at least their remains will not be defiled.

passages.title: A Deadly Distraction
passages.text:
Vyraz's assault on the House of Constructs may have failed, but we can still make them bleed now that we're inside.

Slaughter as many as you can. I will hunt down the masterminds behind these new production efforts.

passages.title: A Deadly Distraction
passages.text: Complacency is every soldier's worst enemy. No one is safe in times of war, not even within the walls of their own fortress.

passages.title: The Spear of Kalliope
passages.text:
The Spear of Kalliope is finally in my grasp!

With it, I will lay waste to all the Forsworn's enemies. Now behold while I take my prize!

passages.title: The Spear of Kalliope
passages.text: Did you find the spear?

passages.title: The Spear of Kalliope
passages.text: The spear! You've saved it from the hands of the Forsworn.

passages.title: In The Flesh
passages.text:
The souls of the fallen kyrian... I can sense their pain and confusion. They yet exist within the construct!

Please, we must not destroy it. Doing so would consign the souls within it--the souls of my brethren--to oblivion. 

Perhaps... perhaps they can aid us in escaping to freedom. I will soothe the souls within the construct while you direct its actions.

passages.title: In The Flesh
passages.text: My fallen kin...

passages.title: In The Flesh
passages.text:
We escaped!

We will recuperate here for now. At least until we find a way to return to Bastion.

Thank you for showing me what courage is, my friend.

passages.title: Eyes on the Problem
passages.text:
Our enemies rally at our gates. We cannot rely on daring air strikes to hold them at bay.

Vashj has a plan to permanently bolster our defenses. With your help, it might actually succeed.

Do what you can to assist her. She seems more... agreeable toward you than she is with me.

passages.title: Eyes on the Problem
passages.text: Our foes will regret opposing us.

passages.title: Bug Bites
passages.text:
Margrave Stradama eagerly awaits the completion of our latest potion!

However, I seem to have misplaced my stockpile of venom sacs. How embarrassing! I have felt a touch out of sorts lately...

Would you please do me a favor and fetch some more? We cannot continue our work without them!

passages.title: Bug Bites
passages.text: Now where did I put my venom sacs...

passages.title: Bug Bites
passages.text: You found my venom sacs! What a helpful apprentice you are!

passages.title: Spores Galore
passages.text:
My brightest apprentice, you return to me at last!

You worried me--you see, I heard the loudest clatter while working on one of my experiments... Before I knew it, I was here, and you'd disappeared!

Wherever you went is no matter. You're back now, and we have much to do!

Come, my apprentice--we must fetch our ingredients first.

Can you smell the spores germinating around us? We should pull some up to use in our endeavors!

passages.title: Spores Galore
passages.text: Such marvelous spores, my apprentice!

passages.title: One Big Problem
passages.text:
We must go after Master Sha'lor. Tirna Vaal needs him! And I... I...

I will report to the droman. They must know that Sha'lor is in danger. Then, I will enter the burrows myself from the south and help you defeat it.

For now, see what you can find. I refuse to believe that he is gone.

That monster will know the fury of a vorkai.

passages.title: One Big Problem
passages.text: What's gotten into these gorm?

passages.title: One Big Problem
passages.text:
Well done. You drove the beast hard enough that she spat out Sha'lor. Now she hides in her den.

She has nowhere else to run.

Now we end this.

passages.title: Burrows Away
passages.text:
<The ground has been freshly dug, and there are signs of more tunnels all over the place.

Collapsing a few burrows would go a long way toward keeping Tirna Vaal safe from gorm infestation.>

passages.title: Burrows Away
passages.text:
The gorm are digging even MORE burrows beneath Ardenweald? This is very bad news indeed. 

Thank you for taking it upon yourself to close them down. That should give us some time to reinforce our defenses.

passages.title: Queen of the Underground
passages.text:
You tracked the massive gorm here to her den, and we've found Master Sha'lor.

Perhaps not entirely unscathed, but he lives. That is enough.

One last task remains. Let us end this.

passages.title: Queen of the Underground
passages.text: Tirna Vaal will not be safe with that monstrosity about.

passages.title: Queen of the Underground
passages.text:
How is that possible? The matriarch she... they feasted on the pods. What if there are others like her out there in Ardenweald?

We must report this immediately.

passages.title: Slime, Anyone?
passages.text:
While I know we're both eager to complete our potion, I believe the best lesson I can share with you is patience.

Patience and slimes, of course!

With the help of slimes, we'll have our laboratory back in working condition. It's just as I taught you: combine your ingredients in the cauldron. Mix until the viscosity is just right...

Oh, listen to me--acting as if you've never concocted your own sentient being!

Go on, my apprentice! The slimes are calling!

passages.title: Slime, Anyone?
passages.text: Go on, now! You can do it!

passages.title: Slime, Anyone?
passages.text: What a precious slime!

passages.title: Applied Science
passages.text:
<What appears to be an old journal sits on Marileth's table, now mangled and missing pages.

The entries that are legible seem to have been written by Marileth when he was still sane, before the fall of his house.

Perhaps if you find the journal's missing pages, you will gain more insight into what befell the House of Plagues.>

passages.title: Applied Science
passages.text: Oh--and what are these?

passages.title: Hazardous Waste Collection
passages.text:
Ah, slimes: the dearest of friends and infinitely useful! They will help us craft our potion.

But it seems our tools have been scattered around, doused in toxic refuse. Margrave Stradama would be so disappointed at my lack of respect for lab safety!

Your slime can comb through the refuse, diluting the plague's harmful agents. Simply pull the cleaned equipment from the body of your slime!

Slimes... what would we do without them?

passages.title: Hazardous Waste Collection
passages.text: Has your slime been useful? I'm sure it has!

passages.title: Hazardous Waste Collection
passages.text: You and your slime are bonding!

passages.title: Part of the Pride
passages.text:
Pelodis insists that phalynx are superior to all autonomous beings, taking orders without fail.

But where is the nuance? Where is the reward for your effort?

Larions make fantastic companions, but you must build a relationship with them. Introduce yourself to my pride. You will see that each has a personality of their own.

passages.title: Part of the Pride
passages.text: Larions are free-thinking beings. They will decide whether you are accepted within the pride.

passages.title: Part of the Pride
passages.text: My pride is generally wary of newcomers, but they seem to accept your presence.

passages.title: Larion at Large
passages.text:
Some larions are more particular about the people they bond with than others.

Lentios is my companion, the larion I trust most with my life. I love the others as well, but he is a part of my soul.

One of my pride, Andira, has posed a struggle for me to bond with. She ran off into the pastures once again, and I fear she's gotten into something she shouldn't have.

Would you mind finding her and bringing her home?

passages.title: Larion at Large
passages.text: Andira and I do not see eye to eye. I know she will be a loyal companion... but perhaps to somebody else.

passages.title: Larion at Large
passages.text: Incredible! It seems Andira has taken a liking to you. Perhaps you would be interested in bonding with her further?

passages.title: With Lance and Larion
passages.text:
Say what you want about phalynx, but Larion will always have one major advantage.

Wings!

A bonded larion will hunt alongside you whether you are on the ground or in the air. 

Take my javelin and Andira then go out into the fields to hunt the cloudfeathers there. You'll feel the boon of larion companionship firsthand!

passages.title: With Lance and Larion
passages.text: It is such a satisfying experience to see your larion take wing to help take down your prey.

passages.title: Providing for the Pack
passages.text:
Even beings of the Shadowlands need to eat. They may not do so quite like your world, but it is similar enough.

The pride's favorite prey is the juvenile cloudfeathers found nearby. Prove to Andira that you are a contributing member of the pride by taking her out to hunt for their next meal.

passages.title: Providing for the Pack
passages.text: Larions bond through hunting. Working together with Andira to collect food is vital to your relationship.

passages.title: Providing for the Pack
passages.text: Providing for the pride is an important step on your path to earning your loyalty here.

passages.title: On Larion Wings
passages.text:
As a flightless being, you will unfortunately never feel the joy of flying alongside your companion.

However... you could still fly with Andira.

It seems you have earned Andira's trust more than I've seen her with anybody else. Would you like to try a flight course?

Take wing with Andira, then fly through the rings. Don't stray off course or take too much time to get between rings or she will leave you behind!

passages.title: On Larion Wings
passages.text: I set up the flight course to train the larions to listen to aerial commands. They know where to go!

passages.title: On Larion Wings
passages.text:
The feeling of soaring through the air, the gentle flap of your larion's wings...

Even though I have my own wings, there's no feeling quite like it.

passages.title: The Night Market
passages.text:
<Dracho motions to keep your voice down.>

I need some assistance, I promise you will be paid handsomely. 

At the edge of The Banewood lies some ruins. These ruins are home to a marketplace run by some brokers. They won't let me back there. Let's just say that my goods were deemed to not be up to their authenticity metrics. 

But you... you're a Maw Walker! Bring them this package and exchange it for some Surberries from Ardenweald. 

Just don't say I sent you.

passages.title: The Night Market
passages.text:
Ah, Briar Thorn Roses! Excellent. 

Don't go just yet. We need to talk.

passages.title: A Very Special Guest
passages.text:
Listen. It is obvious you are doing this deal on Dracho's behalf. 

I believe Ta'xera, the boss around here, would be very interested in striking a deal with someone of your talents.

She resides in the manor at the top of the hill. I recommend you don't keep her waiting.

passages.title: A Very Special Guest
passages.text:
I have hoped for your eventual arrival, Maw Walker. 

Dracho is no longer a partner of ours. Normally we would extend this punishment to you for attempting to subvert our rules. But you being who you are... changes things.

Let's strike a deal. 

You bring things of interest to me directly. No middlemen. No tricks. 

We provide payment and our wares when necessary. Do we have a deal?

passages.title: ...Even The Most Ridiculous Request!
passages.text:
A fan of the competition, are you? Perhaps you would like to be more than a mere spectator?

I will give you a small task... one that not only benefits me, but that also gives you a chance to meet some of the storied competitors here.

As you can see, our three remaining houses have sent champions to attend the Contest of Conquest. Talk with them and attend to what needs they might have.

passages.title: ...Even The Most Ridiculous Request!
passages.text: What now?

passages.title: ...Even The Most Ridiculous Request!
passages.text: We would be so lost without your help. Truly.

passages.title: Juicing Up
passages.text:
I've conceived a task befitting of your "talents".

Have you heard of the House of Plague? Crafters of toxins and potions. They suffered a tragic accident--a true, true shame.

Herein lies the problem: I have long used the work of the plague devisers to bolster my arena performance. Without a potion of their creation, I'd find the fight unnecessarily taxing.

The brokers do have such potions, but they "do not like my face." Could you obtain such a potion for me?

passages.title: Juicing Up
passages.text: I know Scrapper Minoire sent you. She always enhances herself to win the fight.

passages.title: Side Effects
passages.text:
Scrapper Minoire's use of enhancers creates unpredictable betting implications. It is quite unhealthy... for our profits!

For a nominal fee, Au'larrynar can provide you with a "special" enhancer that Minoire will not be able to resist: a potion that turns the one who imbibes it into the ultimate combatant... and teaches them a lesson in restraint, as well.

I cannot wait to see Minoire's next match in the arena!

passages.title: Side Effects
passages.text: This is an unexpected turn of events.

passages.title: Side Effects
passages.text: Scrapper Minoire will have to forfeit her spot in the contest.

passages.title: Halls of Atonement: Your Absolution
passages.text:
The depravity outside of these halls is only a whisper of the true horrors being committed under the Lord Chamberlain's guidance inside the Halls of Atonement.

If you truly wish to curb this corruption, you must dethrone the imposter that you installed here.

Atone for your own mistake. Kill the Lord Chamberlain, so that we may begin to restore permanent order to this place.

passages.title: Halls of Atonement: Your Absolution
passages.text:
A large step in our journey to reclaim the honor of these halls... but not the last.

I shall send word to the Accuser immediately.

passages.title: Our Forgotten Purpose
passages.text:
I have no quarrel with you, Maw Walker.

The Lord Chamberlain and his abhorrent followers have debased these halls with their perversions of the rituals. Abusing souls and destroying their potential for pathetic mockeries of power.

The Accuser would never have allowed this. I have heard rumors that you may still be in contact with her. If so, please inform her of the situation here.

She will bring these depraved dogs to heel.

passages.title: Our Forgotten Purpose
passages.text:
I am already working to undo the Lord Chamberlain's mistakes.

Yes, you may assist me.

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text:
I hope that working with my phalynx has swayed you, <name>.

Let us meet with Nemea. There you can decide whose way of life is superior, and which you would prefer to pursue.

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text: Surely you must agree that the ease of phalynx companionship suits you.

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text: It is done.

passages.title: Show, Don't Tell
passages.text:
As a new champion of the Court, you'll need to be properly introduced to the rest of the Night Fae. And that calls for something big. Bold. Memorable. A demonstration of who you are and where you've come from. Something with... flair.

Normally, we spend ages crafting a masterpiece presentation. But we don't have time for that! We'll just have to improvise.

<Moonberry winks.>

Commune with me so I can pick up the highlights! I'll make sure it's a show to remember!

passages.title: Show, Don't Tell
passages.text: Oh good! You're here! No time to rehearse, but that shouldn't be too much of a problem.

passages.title: Break a Leg
passages.text:
The show is about to begin! You... that's what you're going to wear? Well, I suppose it works.

For your grand introduction, we will re-enact recent victories and events that took place on Azzinoth. Er, Azeroth. That's where you're from, right?

The Starlight Company has graciously volunteered to assist us in this production. We've recruited some special guests as well! 

Don't worry about the script. This is your story, after all!

Just try not to get too much blood on stage. It's hard to clean.

passages.title: Break a Leg
passages.text: Well, that wasn't... terrible.

passages.title: Break a Leg
passages.text: Not bad! Not great, but not bad. Quickly now, we'll need to help set the stage for the next act!

passages.title: The Fourth Wall, er, War
passages.text:
It's time for the next act of your theatrical introduction: the Grand Drama Of Azereth!

Azeroth. Right. All these worlds are hard to tell apart.

Help set the stage, then come back here. You'll need to play a few other characters before you appear as yourself again.

Get a move on! We have a lot to cover!

passages.title: The Fourth Wall, er, War
passages.text: Come on, come on! We have a crowd to please!

passages.title: The Fourth Wall, er, War
passages.text:
I can honestly say I have never seen a performance quite like this.

Now... On to our grand finale! A battle for your world that is certain to make the court sit up and take notice!

passages.title: What's My Motivation?
passages.text:
Now for our finale! A thrilling performance of the most recent trials on Azathoth!

<Featherlight checks his notes.>

Azeroth. Whatever. It features an artificial god, a powerful magic ice princess, an infamous queen, and an eldritch abomination of unspeakable terror! Who doesn't love a good drama with a dash of existential horror?

You're back to playing yourself, so just... do whatever heroes are supposed to do!

passages.title: What's My Motivation?
passages.text: Well! That was exciting.

passages.title: What's My Motivation?
passages.text:
A fair enough performance! 

I think everyone's more acquainted with your world and the role you've played within it.

Next time, the set design will be a bit more... prepared. But for now...

<Moonberry nods at Ysera.>

I think your friend wishes to have a word. Don't take too long. We still have to hold the final induction ceremony at the Heart of the Forest.

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text:
A stunning performance... in more ways than one.

So much has transpired on Azeroth in my absence. But there was one dream I did not see portrayed onstage.

I dreamt of Tyrande, engulfed in darkness, twisted by anger and a thirst for vengeance. I witnessed a forbidden ritual, the rise of a new Night Warrior, and a hunt that can end only in tragedy. That too must be real.

<Ysera shakes her head.>

The Winter Queen awaits you in the Heart of the Forest. We had best be on our way.

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text: Welcome to the Hunt.

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text: Your actions here will echo beyond the veil. Aid the forest, and all mortal worlds may yet be saved.

passages.title: Forest Disappearances
passages.text:
A moment of your time, friend?

A short while ago a sylvar named Partik came seeking the aid of our grove. He said his village was under attack by the gorm and was in danger of crumbling away altogether. I told him we could not spare any soldiers, but their people were welcome to take refuge with us.

However, it has been some time since he left and I have not seen or heard anyone from that region since.

Can you go investigate? He came from the northeast.

passages.title: Forest Disappearances
passages.text: No, no... what is happening!?

passages.title: Mysterious Masks
passages.text:
The village, my friends, gone. They are no more.

I came back from the nearby grove to find them... like this. Even Lavrash, my best friend! He came at me with only violence in his heart.

They are all wearing these masks now, and they are not themselves anymore.

Please, deliver them from this fate. Bring me their masks and perhaps we can decipher this mystery.

passages.title: Mysterious Masks
passages.text: For so many to fall, I did not think I was gone that long....

passages.title: Mysterious Masks
passages.text: These masks must contain some secret to the possession.

passages.title: A Desperate Solution
passages.text:
<A well-made, if well-worn, journal catches your eye.

Thumbing through the pages, it is clear that this journal once belonged to someone prominent from this group of night fae. The last few pages are torn out of the book.

Perhaps if the rest of the pages were located then Partik could help decipher what happened here.>

passages.title: A Desperate Solution
passages.text: What's that you've got there?

passages.title: A Desperate Solution
passages.text: <Partik quickly reads over the last few pages. His face turns pale.>

passages.title: Cult of Personality
passages.text:
Some of my people are still alive! We must rescue them!

The prisoners are kept in cages throughout the ridge, waiting for this horrible fate to befall them.

Please, set them free. We cannot let what happened to Lavrash happen to them!

passages.title: Cult of Personality
passages.text: So few.... But each one is one more friend we can bring to bear against this madness!

passages.title: Cut the Roots
passages.text:
It's just as I feared, friend. The entire village is turned, just like Lavrash.

Lewor would have transformed the other elders as soon as possible. They are all strong in their own right. Brave Fiona, clever Bitterfly....

It pains me to say this, but they must be destroyed. For the good of Ardenweald and the forest, slay our former leaders before they can infect the rest of the land!

passages.title: Cut the Roots
passages.text: If they fell, then what hope do we have?

passages.title: Cut the Roots
passages.text:
<Partik gulps and turns pale.>

That's all of them, then? Good.

passages.title: All An Aspirant Can Do
passages.text:
I think we can agree that such a reply feels... somewhat hollow.

I choose to take faith that we have done all we can. All of us. I do not know what comes next, but perhaps the path will reveal itself. In the meantime, Pelagos and I will return to Aspirant's Rest for a moment of respite.

We will meet you there, though there is no need to hurry.

passages.title: All An Aspirant Can Do
passages.text:
<Kleia smiles warmly at you.>

Does this mean you intend to stay?

passages.title: The Eternal Forge
passages.text:
The Forgelite Prime has taken up the mantle of building our new Crest of Ascension.

No ordinary tools or materials will do. He will require Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons, Hammer of the First Forgelite. It sits at the shrine to the First Forgelite in the Eternal Forge.

The Forsworn have taken over this forge to create their own endless centurion army. You must meet Mikanikos at the forge, push back the Forsworn, and retrieve Phaestus for our own uses.

passages.title: The Eternal Forge
passages.text:
<name>! Can you believe what the Forsworn have done to my forge?

Must find Phaestus and halt their operation!

passages.title: Stewards of a Feather
passages.text:
You! Maw Walker!

The forge was bustling. Many forgehands, on task!

Then Forsworn came. Some followed their demands, turned to their side.

But not all! Yes, rescue forgehands so they can aid us. Work to be done!

passages.title: Stewards of a Feather
passages.text: I tried to save, but am no hero. Can only try to organize chaos.

passages.title: Stewards of a Feather
passages.text:
You did it! Many forgehands return today. Maybe one day the rest return too?

We will help.

passages.title: A Partner for Eternity
passages.text:
Before returning to the Hold, one more thing to do.

Defeat the Forsworn and their centurion army!

This goliath here can help with just that. My finest creation yet!

I need an extra pair of hands. Yours will do.

passages.title: A Partner for Eternity
passages.text: Trust he is no ordinary goliath. An extension of my hand itself!

passages.title: A Partner for Eternity
passages.text:
A partner that embodies my inner strength.

A worthy centurion indeed!

passages.title: Building the Base
passages.text:
The Crest is almost complete.

I give you the honor of the final touch.

You have done much. Please, take Phaestus and give the final blow!

passages.title: Building the Base
passages.text: Please care. Phaestus is older than you could dream!

passages.title: Building the Base
passages.text:
Perfection!

It is beautiful, yes? Not done yet, but much work led to great reward.

passages.title: Dismantling the Opposition
passages.text:
The Forsworn mobilize!

We cannot allow them to march.

Attune to Bron, share your power with him.

Between the three of us, we shall destroy this new centurion army!

passages.title: Dismantling the Opposition
passages.text: Bron was not meant as a tool of destruction, but will excel at it with you!

passages.title: Dismantling the Opposition
passages.text: Exhilarating! Bron grows stronger with your power.

passages.title: Friend to the Forgelite
passages.text:
With Phaestus in hand, we can start building Crest.

Let us return to Elysian Hold. Triumphant!

passages.title: Friend to the Forgelite
passages.text:
Mikanikos returned not long ago with his new centurion. Quite the unique unit.

Of course, the return of Phaestus to kyrian hands is good news indeed. The Archon will be pleased.

passages.title: Antiquated Methodology
passages.text:
You possess the correct mindset for retraining a phalynx. I believe you could find great success here.

Before you commit, I implore you to go across the hill and introduce yourself to my rival, Nemea. She believes that her unreasonable, free-willed larions are better partners than my perfect phalynx.

Experience her lifestyle so that you may know how much greater my work is.

passages.title: Antiquated Methodology
passages.text:
Pelodis sent you, did he?

Sure his phalynx follow orders, but where is their depth?

passages.title: Success Without Soul
passages.text:
The larions seem to truly enjoy your company, Andira most of all.

I hope you've come to understand and appreciate the nuance of working with a beast with free will.

Now you must spend time with Pelodis, down the hill. His phalynx may be effective, but working with them only brings hollow satisfaction.

I am sure working with the phalynx will only strengthen your appreciation of larions.

passages.title: Success Without Soul
passages.text:
I understand you met with Nemea first.

Take solace in the fact that you will not be working with crazed beasts here.

passages.title: Brace for Impact
passages.text:
That's it for warming up. You and the other new recruits are a promising bunch, I'll tell you that much.

Hold on... what's that sound? I think something big is headed our way!

passages.title: Brace for Impact
passages.text:
This ship may not make it to the island.

Hold on to something sturdy and stick with your fellow recruits. We'll get through this.
