passages.title: Stand Your Ground
passages.text:
I hope this rain isn't a bad omen... this is supposed to be a simple rescue mission.

You'll be sparring with me today. We have to make sure you can handle yourself once we make landfall.

Let's see what you've got!

passages.title: Stand Your Ground
passages.text:
Having trouble? Happens to the best of us. Just stay calm, select your target, and use one of your abilities on it.

Make sure your target is in front of you. We don't want another incident like when Bjorn tried to throw an axe over his shoulder.

passages.title: Stand Your Ground
passages.text: You're a skilled <class>, recruit. I think you'll prove a welcome addition to the main rescue team.

passages.title: Wake Up, Get Up, Get Out There
passages.text:
They need your help!

Not all of the faeries have been turned yet. Some remain prisoner, but they have these masks on their faces....

You've got to help them! I'm not strong enough to pry off the masks, but you could! You could stop the guards from getting us too!

passages.title: Wake Up, Get Up, Get Out There
passages.text:
You saved my friends!

<Primrose gives you a small grin.>

We... we make a pretty good team, huh?

passages.title: Blooming Villains
passages.text:
Something stinks, traveler. The air to the west is rotten with malice.

Shimmerbough has long been a peaceful way station along the Path of Rebirth. The faeries there delight in revelry and celebration. But now their glade has fallen silent.

Scouts bring reports of the strange masked night fae. I know little other than that they are a threat.

For the sake of Ardenweald, they must be eliminated. Slay any you encounter.

passages.title: Blooming Villains
passages.text: Grim work, but necessary. May they be reborn into useful vassals of Ardenweald once more.

passages.title: Break It Down
passages.text:
I've seen the ritual. It's... terrifying.

But the altars seem to be the key. If only I had my pyrotechnic powder, I could blast them to bits!

<Primrose is silent for a moment, then takes a deep breath.>

If you could get the powder and guard me, we could blow up those altars.

I stashed as much as I could in our dwellings. They don't seem to care any more.

You don't have wings, but a pinch of faerie dust should work for a short time.

Let's do this before I change my mind!

passages.title: Break It Down
passages.text: We did it! All the altars are destroyed!

passages.title: Beneath the Mask
passages.text:
It's time to end this.

When I first hid, I saw a dark shape on the northeast platform. I think that's their leader.

Now that they can't perform any more rituals, we should be able to scare them off.

<Primrose pauses for a moment.>

I... I just wanted to say thank you. I never could have done this without your help. Now, let's drive out this enemy and retake the village!

passages.title: Beneath the Mask
passages.text: I see. This is terrible news.

passages.title: Take the High Ground
passages.text:
The commander of the constructs, General Alver, is a master tactician. A frontal assault has no chance of victory against him. It will be a bloodbath.

His forces have flanked us and secured the high ground. From that position, he can rain destruction upon us unopposed.

We will take the ridge from him before that can happen.

passages.title: Take the High Ground
passages.text: With that ridge clear, we'll be safe to advance.

passages.title: Words Have Power
passages.text: The Stoneborn Rebels have left behind recruitment pamphlets. Recovering these for the venthyr may earn some much needed favor.

passages.title: Words Have Power
passages.text: Uncouth and vile documents, but written in a rather elegant hand. The Prince always had better penmanship than sense.

passages.title: Words Have Power
passages.text:
Ugh, vile things. Give them to me and I will see them properly disposed of.

Here, for your troubles. Perhaps this reward will help wipe the filth of these documents from your fingertips.

passages.title: Watcher Emil
passages.text:
Watcher Emil is my trusted overseer of the catacombs. Before I was thrown into the Maw, half of the mirror was entrusted to him.

I had him stationed at the Catacombs of Regret. But I do not know where in the sprawl he is.

There is a guard station near the entrance to the catacombs. Start the search there. There is an officer who can help us, I--I can't remember who. That is, provided they survived this whole mess.

You must find Emil at once. We may not have much time.

passages.title: Watcher Emil
passages.text: A friend of the Curator?

passages.title: Watcher Emil
passages.text:
That wasn't the first assassin I've had to deal with so far. And it won't be the last.

The Curator must have sent you. Someone has turned our allies at Archivam against us... 

I have the mirror shard she entrusted to me. We must move quickly, friend.

passages.title: Combing the Catacombs
passages.text:
When the anima drought began, our defenses began to fail. 

Our guards, weakened by the lack of anima, became overrun as the sinstones this land is built upon rose up around us. Not to mention the manifestations of the souls who can no longer be tended to are running wild.

You may be able to help us, mortal. Please, we can barely hold this position... and I don't know for how much longer.

passages.title: Combing the Catacombs
passages.text: Thank you. Do me a favor and don't tell the Curator? She won't be pleased with the state of things.

passages.title: TBD
passages.text: Bribe Boulderfoot

passages.title: Break Out
passages.text:
Our reinforcements never came, leaving us unable to tend to the souls here. They have begun to break out of their cells. Many of them are not ready for the next step in the process.

Take these iron chains. They can be used to rein them under your control. 

Once you have a soul bound, you can return them to any intact cage you can find.

passages.title: Break Out
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. The souls are filled with vanity, rage, and sadness.

Some more confinement will help them confront their past.

passages.title: The Hills Have Eyes
passages.text:
The other houses have yet to launch a full scale assault, but do not mistake their cowardice for incompetence.

Any tactician worth their weight in maldracite knows the value of espionage. I suspect that the agents of our foes skulk within our own ranks as we speak.

Take one of my hounds. It will know our enemies by their scent. Once the pests have been discovered, exterminate them.

passages.title: The Hills Have Eyes
passages.text: Get moving!

passages.title: The Hills Have Eyes
passages.text: If they cannot properly evade detection, then they do not deserve to survive.

passages.title: Someone Worth Saving
passages.text:
Are you familiar with Kael'thas Sunstrider? He was a powerful leader on your world for a time.

The immense anima of that lingering power attracted the Master's attention, to the eternal detriment of Kael'thas's soul.

<The Accuser's lip curls in disgust.>

Every soul deserves a chance at redemption, adventurer.

If you do not believe that, believe me when I say that this soul is immensely powerful and still at risk of self-destruction.

Release him so that we may walk his path of redemption together.

passages.title: Someone Worth Saving
passages.text:
It shall not be easy to redeem Kael'thas Sunstrider, and the outcome is far from guaranteed.

But we must attempt it nonetheless.

passages.title: The Many Sins of Kael'thas Sunstrider
passages.text:
Kael'thas Sunstrider was on the verge of destruction when we rescued him from Castle Nathria.

Denathrius had infused Kael'thas with unimaginable amounts of anima, each bit carrying with it the sins of others.

It made his soul strong, but unstable--confused and pushed to the edge of its own existence.

Trust me when I tell you that Kael'thas Sunstrider has enough sins of his own.

Assist me in identifying which of the many sins heaped on his soul are truly his burden to bear.

passages.title: The Many Sins of Kael'thas Sunstrider
passages.text: The ritual of absolution allows me to peer directly into a soul to see every sin weighing it down.

passages.title: The Many Sins of Kael'thas Sunstrider
passages.text:
To be clear: We did not absolve Kael'thas Sunstrider of any of these sins.

He might never be absolved of them. It must ultimately be his choice to change.

But we did stabilize his soul, which means he will at least have the opportunity to make that choice.

passages.title: Dredgers Left Behind
passages.text:
When Prince Renathal fled Darkwall Tower, he was forced to leave many people and belongings behind.

The powerful relics and weapons were long ago carted off to the Master's lair. But the Prince's dredgers were forced to stay and serve the Master's traitorous lackeys here instead.

You will be a welcome sight to them--a sign that the Prince has not forgotten them.

If they are willing to fight, help them escape and I will ensure they are brought safely to Sinfall.

passages.title: Dredgers Left Behind
passages.text:
I must admit, I did not expect the dredgers to be quite so eager to fight for their own freedom.

The Prince inspires all of us, I suppose.

passages.title: Learning to Sacrifice
passages.text:
Kael'thas remains unstable in his current state, bursting at the seams with anima.

He is also an arrogant, selfish moron.

Thankfully, I have a lesson that can address both concerns.

True leaders sacrifice of themselves to empower those under their care.

Many stoneborn and gargon, including the Prince's own pet, were left dormant in Darkwall by the Master's forces.

Order Kael'thas to forfeit portions of the anima trapped inside of him to reanimate those dormant stoneborn to aid us.

passages.title: Learning to Sacrifice
passages.text: Kael'thas Sunstrider may be ready for the ritual of absolution now.

passages.title: Use My Strengths
passages.text:
<Kael'thas looks around to make sure the Accuser is out of earshot.>

the Accuser is so obsessed with my negative traits that she has failed to see my strengths!

Even in death, I am incredibly powerful. the Accuser herself said that Denathrius infused me with anima to make me strong.

Let us use that strength for good while I have it!

This tower once belonged to the Prince of this realm, correct? Let us find his usurper and gain vengeance!

Vengeance is a virtue I have always appreciated.

passages.title: Use My Strengths
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Use My Strengths
passages.text:
I do not expect Kael'thas to agree or even understand the value of mercy immediately.

Absolution is a long, slow process. This was only the first step.

passages.title: We Each Must Carry Our Own Sins
passages.text:
The Master chained Kael'thas's sinstone to his soul via a dark, corruptive process that left Kael'thas scarred and overburdened.

He bears the weight of not only his own sins, but the sins of countless other souls on his back. That would be a crushing burden for even the most noble of souls--which Kael'thas is not.

Let us hope your time with Kael'thas has prepared his soul for my ritual.

I must break that cursed burden by removing the foreign sins from his soul, or else we'll lose him forever.

passages.title: We Each Must Carry Our Own Sins
passages.text: This must work.

passages.title: We Each Must Carry Our Own Sins
passages.text:
I cannot comfortably call this a success, but it is likely the best outcome we could have hoped for. Carrying one's sins is no small feat, yet it can be liberating.

Take this chain, if you wish, to display your commitment to owning your own sins. Kael'thas needs it no longer.

passages.title: Blackbale Betrayers
passages.text:
When the Prince made his final stand at Darkwall Tower, he called for aid from the many noble houses here in the Chalice District.

None came.

Most simply avoided the conflict, out of self-preservation. A shameful, but understandable choice.

However, one house took action. Lord Blackbale replied with cruel mockery and sent his stoneborn to aid the Master's armies instead.

Prince Renathal has not forgotten that betrayal.

Kael'thas seeks vengeance? Let him have some. Start with the stoneborn.

passages.title: Blackbale Betrayers
passages.text: The Blackbale seem to have grown more influential since the Prince's fall.

passages.title: Blackbale Betrayers
passages.text:
Did any of the Blackbale venthyr show signs of regret?

We had hoped to recruit some to our cause eventually.

passages.title: Maldraxxian Weapons
passages.text:
<The weapon you find seems unlike those wielded by most venthyr, yet the marks it bears are unmistakably familiar...

It would be wise to seek out more such weapons and bring them to the Accuser.>

passages.title: Maldraxxian Weapons
passages.text: What are you carrying? Those do not belong here...

passages.title: Maldraxxian Weapons
passages.text:
The Blackbale venthyr are wielding the weapons of the Maldraxxi army?

That would mean...

passages.title: Reconnaissance... for my, uh, Recovery
passages.text:
It appears I am at your mercy once more, adventurer.

Far be it from me to tell you the best way to absolve my sins as the Accuser insists we do.

However...

In that note, the Tithelord arranged a meeting with his contact in Darkhaven. Do you know where that is?

If you do, we could investigate, gather more information, and present that information to the Accuser and Prince Renathal.

I imagine that would be quite useful to them.

And a very selfless act of assistance on my part, do you not agree?

passages.title: Reconnaissance... for my, uh, Recovery
passages.text:
A lich? So close?

Can you feel its presence? I once could...

passages.title: Death's End Destruction
passages.text:
It appears we have discovered a common enemy to pursue, adventurer.

Wherever that necromancer ran off to is no doubt filled with traitors, undead armies from another realm, and at least one lich...

It cannot be a sin to kill such as these. To demolish the camp of these invaders and betrayers must be a virtue.

A virtue I crave. Let us pursue it with haste.

passages.title: Death's End Destruction
passages.text: I hope they put up a fight.

passages.title: Death's End Destruction
passages.text: Traitors and cowards. I have time for neither!

passages.title: Strategic Executions
passages.text:
I confess that I do not comprehend the full array of potential consequences wrought by the Tithelord's anima-sharing arrangement.

But I am very aware of the dangers posed by a lich with access to power.

I am also very aware that resolving this situation is important to the Accuser, which, given my current situation, makes it important to me.

We should eliminate the muscle behind the anima transfer logistics. Without that, the shipments will halt.

passages.title: Strategic Executions
passages.text: They really do grow their monsters big here, do they not?

passages.title: Strategic Executions
passages.text: The bigger they are... the bigger the explosion at the end. Ha!

passages.title: Lady Ouix'Ara
passages.text:
Can you feel it? The chill in your bones... the energy... power...

She's here. The lich.

Take me to her. I must speak with her, in my own way.

passages.title: Lady Ouix'Ara
passages.text: No good has ever come from a lich, <name>.

passages.title: Lady Ouix'Ara
passages.text: It was unlikely that she'd tell us anything useful, but I had to try.

passages.title: Mirror to Maldraxxus
passages.text:
I've received word that Laurent's made substantial progress with his repairs. 

Once the mirror has been restored, we can realize our efforts to recover the final medallion. 

Head to the ramparts and see if his work is near completion.

passages.title: Mirror to Maldraxxus
passages.text: This mirror is my greatest achievement. It links directly to the necropolis that floats above the bone fields of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Special Access
passages.text:
Mateo will have the other mirror shard we need to access the medallion. He is likely in my former manor in Archivam.

It is guarded by Nourman, a loyal dredger. Nourman is ever committed to his duties, regardless of the situation.

Mateo likely maintained the same rule to access the manor--possess the fangs of those granted access. If you collect the fangs of the commanders of his operation, Nourman will let you pass.

passages.title: Special Access
passages.text: Oi, you want to access the manor? Let me see your fangs.

passages.title: Special Access
passages.text:
<Nourman carefully inspects the fangs.>

Checks out. Strange that you got so many. 

Say, you don't look like a venthyr. 

<Nourman shrugs.>

Don't matter to me. You got the fangs, you go inside. Them's the rules.

passages.title: An Eye for an Amulet
passages.text:
Archivam has been overrun by Denathrius's lackeys. 

We must eliminate these intruders. From the look of things, they have resorted to tearing Archivam down to the core for any evidence of the Curator's medallion.

Go, <name>. Stop them before it is too late.

passages.title: An Eye for an Amulet
passages.text: Are they dead?

passages.title: An Eye for an Amulet
passages.text: Yes! The rest of those rats will think twice about working with Denathrius.

passages.title: In the Shadow of our Failures
passages.text:
I will personally tend to the absolution of Kael'thas Sunstrider. His current state and trauma requires nothing short of perfect intervention and instruction to correct.

I would welcome your assistance in this. I sense a bond between Kael'thas and yourself. I think your presence may help inspire him down a better path.

If you're willing, meet us at Darkwall Tower.

Prince Renathal suffered a great defeat there once. Perhaps a better fate will be found this time.

passages.title: In the Shadow of our Failures
passages.text: I'm pleased you came. Let's begin.

passages.title: Crypt Crashers
passages.text:
There's one more thing I forgot to mention. Apologies, <name>.

The mirror, once complete, is inherently cursed by design. 

You need to locate my Death Lotus Powder. It was in one of the crypts in Archivam... I cannot recall which one. 

I'm afraid you may have to brute force this one, <name>.

passages.title: Crypt Crashers
passages.text: Do you have the powder?

passages.title: Crypt Crashers
passages.text: Excellent. Now we can enter the mirror safely.

passages.title: Something Old, Something Used
passages.text:
Want new luckydos? Chordy is best at finding luckydos!

Want to go look around with Chordy?

<Chordy looks at you pleadingly with his large eye.>

passages.title: Something Old, Something Used
passages.text: Did we find anything good?

passages.title: Something Old, Something Used
passages.text: These are valuable resources. Thank you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Anima Attrition
passages.text:
This is not some simple raid or protest. These stoneborn mean to steal the anima this convoy was carrying.

That anima was destined to be tithed to the Master. There is a drought on and we cannot let these vagabonds and miscreants steal our hard-earned anima.

Recover the tithe if you can and I will see to your notoriety.

passages.title: Anima Attrition
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: Anima Attrition
passages.text: Well done, mortal. Stoneborn require anima to exist. Without it, they return to their stone form. This supply hurt them more than destroying thirty of their rebels.

passages.title: Parts to a Whole
passages.text:
Damien has some great dreams, but without more abominations, this training facility will not succeed! 

I have a plan though! If we can't recruit more abominations, then we shall make them ourselves!

I need you to make some corpses, then mark them for harvesting with a flag. I will do the rest.

passages.title: Mirror, Mirror...
passages.text:
We have what we need to get you through, <name>.

My medallion lies on the other side of the mirror. Once through, my medallion will be there... somewhere. 

Please be careful. My mind may be weakened, but I do remember working with the Accuser to protect the crypt's interior.

I should be able to tell you everything about this place, but I am afraid that just is not the case anymore.

passages.title: Mirror, Mirror...
passages.text: My medallion? Do you have it?

passages.title: Mirror, Mirror...
passages.text:
You found the medallion! I wish you had found it under better circumstances. I do miss celebrating.

But I should reward you. Yes, a reward! You must take these. May they serve you well!

passages.title: Continued Care of Kael'thas
passages.text:
Kael'thas is free from the twisted corruption of the Master, but he is not truly "free" yet.

He carries more than enough burdens from his own sins to condemn him to the Maw.

We must be vigilant in encouraging and forcing him to atone for his mistakes. If he cannot right the many wrongs of his mortal life, he will be doomed forever.

You are having a positive effect on him. Please, accompany us down to the Chalice District for his next lesson.

passages.title: Continued Care of Kael'thas
passages.text: We're ready to begin our next lesson.

passages.title: Return to Sinfall
passages.text:
<name>, we must get the medallion back to Sinfall as soon as possible. 

We saw how fierce Mateo's forces were, just imagine what destruction Denathrius will bring if we linger around.

I will return to Absolution Crypt in a moment. With all the work you've done, I can begin to resume my duties.

My first order of business will be to recruit a new sinkeeper. Oh how I dread interviews...

passages.title: Return to Sinfall
passages.text: Did you retrieve the Medallion of Avarice?

passages.title: Return to Sinfall
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>.

With the Curator's medallion in hand, we are one step closer to victory.

passages.title: Containing the Night
passages.text:
It is fortunate you are here, <name>.

Thiernax believes he may know how to save Tyrande from the fate he himself suffered as the Night Warrior.

Let us hear what he has to say.

passages.title: Containing the Night
passages.text: It cannot be easy for Thiernax to share his memories of becoming the Night Warrior... or the pain that followed.

passages.title: Containing the Night
passages.text: Thiernax suggests a bold plan. Locating the other former Night Warriors will not prove easy.

passages.title: Tracker Tracking
passages.text:
We will require the aid of an expert tracker if we are to find the other Night Warriors.

The Wild Hunt possesses legendary skills in such matters. No quarry can elude them.

Speak with Lord Herne. With one of his hunters at your side, your search will surely be successful.

passages.title: Tracker Tracking
passages.text: Ah, yes. I know of whom you speak.

passages.title: Monster Hunting
passages.text:
Make ready, <class>. We hunt a worldeater.

They are the largest of devourers, massive beings who can drain anima from an entire region within a matter of moments. 

With Ardenweald suffering from the drought, a worldeater's presence could prove disastrous.

Still, we must not rush into battle without first understanding our prey. Tread the Elder Stand with me. Even creatures such as these leave spoor.

Knowing our quarry will be what allows us to slay it.

passages.title: Monster Hunting
passages.text: This problem just got a lot larger. We need a new plan.

passages.title: Acid Reflux
passages.text:
We will need to be properly prepared before we can face Voras.

The digestive juices of Ardenweald's gorm dissipate the anima in their food. Ingesting them causes devourers no small discomfort.

For a beast of that size, we will need a lot of it to have any effect. There should be plenty of gorm in the hive to the east.

Long ago, an artisan gave me a tool that he said would be useful against the gorm, should I ever need it. You may borrow it.

passages.title: Acid Reflux
passages.text: We will need those digestive sacs if we are to disrupt the worldeater enough to slay it, <name>.

passages.title: Acid Reflux
passages.text:
<Reldorn hefts the sacs, which bulge uncomfortably.>

So many? Just how big is this thing you two are hunting, anyway?

passages.title: Anima Instincts
passages.text:
Voras is clearly content to roam the Elder Stand. We will need a way to lure it to us once we are ready to fight.

Did you notice the wildseeds in the clearing where we spotted it? Voras must be feasting on the concentrated anima contained within them.

There should still be some expended wildseeds from before the drought in the Gormhive. Let us create bait too tempting for Voras to ignore.

passages.title: Anima Instincts
passages.text: It may take several wildseeds, but with enough concentrated anima, we should be able to lure out Voras.

passages.title: Anima Instincts
passages.text: I am amazed that this contains so much concentrated anima. You will surely lure a devourer to you with this!

passages.title: Voras, The Realm Eater
passages.text:
We have everything we need, <name>. Now only the kill remains.

We set the lure, weaken the beast, and land the final blow.

Hunting is a battle of wills. Life or death hangs in the balance for all of us. It has always been this way, on Azeroth as in Ardenweald.

Let the hunt begin.

passages.title: Voras, The Realm Eater
passages.text: Voras cannot continue to leech anima from Ardenweald. We must stop it now.

passages.title: Voras, The Realm Eater
passages.text: The hunt is over. We have prevailed.

passages.title: Spoiling For A Fight
passages.text:
Your contribution of anima has aided our operation here greatly. Several of our more famous competitors have come here lured by the flow of new anima.

Would you like to test yourself versus the famous Sabriel? There could be much profit for everyone, if you were to defeat her.

I can add her to the schedule, she will appear soon if you defeat the other challengers.

passages.title: A Farewell to Arms
passages.text:
The Maldraxxi toil away just behind us. I care not if you consider them allies or traitors, so long as you remove them from Revendreth.

Destroy their encampment. Purge it from our soil, and ensure such an affront never occurs again.

The means are not important. All that matters is that these heretics remember the consequences of trifling with true power.

passages.title: A Farewell to Arms
passages.text: Well?

passages.title: A Farewell to Arms
passages.text: Let this prove our sense of honor.

passages.title: Echoes of Tirna Noch
passages.text:
It is clear that we need more anima than this grove can provide. I may know of a way we can acquire some.

Many of the masked fae have been collecting anima for some unknown purpose. I propose we take it back from them.

The Wild Hunt has tracked them to Tirna Noch... my former grove.

Long has it been since I walked beneath its boughs. Not since it was left to wither so that other groves might survive.

I remember it well...

passages.title: Echoes of Tirna Noch
passages.text:
I never thought I would return to Tirna Noch. The place of so many memories. So many regrets...

But now is not the time for sentimentality. Now is the time for action.

passages.title: Mementos
passages.text:
At Heartwood Grove, I heard tales about the fall of Tirna Noch. I never thought that I would see it with my own eyes.

It brings me great sadness. And I wonder... if this is the fate that awaits my old grove as well.

I can't believe that everything that was once here is truly gone. 

Perhaps there are still some mementos that can be recovered. Something to remember the fallen.

passages.title: Mementos
passages.text: Is this what lies in store for Heartwood Grove? For my old home?

passages.title: Mementos
passages.text:
Thank you.

I know these are just objects, but they mean so much. Sometimes just holding a piece of one's past can be a comfort.

It means not everything is lost.

passages.title: Take What You Can
passages.text:
We know that these invaders have taken over the remains of the grove. 

But why? Why are they gathering anima and bringing it all to one place?

And how did they enter Ardenweald?

We should stay alert and take as much anima as we can find. Perhaps some good can come out of all this loss.

passages.title: Take What You Can
passages.text: I sometimes mourn what was lost. And then I remember what work there is still left to do.

passages.title: Take What You Can
passages.text:
This anima will help Dreamweaver complete his ritual... and perhaps save spirits who otherwise would have been lost.

Good work.

passages.title: He's Drust in the Way
passages.text:
Only the heart of a grove can hold the sheer massive quantity of anima I'm sensing. 

When my grove was sacrificed, the anima within its heart was reclaimed. Now it brims with anima once again.

Anima that was stolen from other groves.

We must secure the heart not just for our own sake, but for the entire forest.

I suspect that we will not be allowed to simply trot our way in there. Be prepared for anything.

passages.title: He's Drust in the Way
passages.text:
We made it to the heart. Well done.

If that is what all the Drust are truly like, then Ardenweald is in a dire situation, indeed.

passages.title: Go for the Heart
passages.text:
I was right! A great deal of anima has been stored inside the heart of the grove.

The Drust must have collected it from all over Ardenweald.

And now, we will take it back.

Quickly, destroy that barrier and grab the heart. Niya and I will protect you.

passages.title: Go for the Heart
passages.text: We will reclaim this anima. The Drust will not use it for their own ends.

passages.title: Go for the Heart
passages.text:
Now that we have the heart, we need to find a way out of this place.

And I hear the distinct sound of approaching enemies...

passages.title: Deadly Reminder
passages.text:
Our defense is tenuous at best, but the enemy is still hesitant to attack.

As long as they fear us, they won't be probing our defenses. 

You must keep the pressure on the enemy. Attack their positions all along our line.

passages.title: Accusatory Missive
passages.text:
We have received word from Revendreth. It seems that Maldraxxi conspirators have been found skulking within their realm.

An emissary from Sinfall wishes to discuss the anima reserves we discovered. 

Join me. We depart immediately.

passages.title: Accusatory Missive
passages.text: The pleasure is mine.

passages.title: Planned Demise
passages.text:
Our defense is tenuous at best, but the enemy is still hesitant to attack.

As long as they fear us, they won't be probing our defenses. 

You must keep the pressure on the enemy. Attack their positions all along our line.

passages.title: Scrounging for Scrolls
passages.text:
The kyrian are known for their collection of scrolls and writings. I'm particularly interested in their texts regarding those who have joined their ranks.

Why is it that some of the greatest fighters are sent to Bastion and not to Maldraxxus?

Perhaps research can divine the answer.

passages.title: Scrounging for Scrolls
passages.text: Let's see, where did that paper go?

passages.title: Scrounging for Scrolls
passages.text: This will be very helpful. It's a shame so many people aren't willing to share their knowledge. Hoarding it is simply foolish.

passages.title: There's Always a Paper Trail
passages.text:
I noticed that you were surprised to find those strange weapons here.

I sense the essence of their power as well. It is strangely familiar...

We must discover where the weapons came from and who imbued them with such power.

<Kael'thas smiles.>

If you and I present the proof to the Accuser together, perhaps she shall allow us to hunt down whoever is behind all of this!

passages.title: There's Always a Paper Trail
passages.text: You found something?

passages.title: There's Always a Paper Trail
passages.text:
A lich?! The Tithelord is working with a lich from Maldraxxus?!

How? To what ends?

<The Accuser composes herself.>

Do you appreciate how troubling this is, <name>?

This has never happened. This is not supposed to happen.

Prince Renathal will know what to do.

passages.title: You're Dead To Me
passages.text:
Your cooperation is expected, but I await results.

Our reconnaissance has revealed a Maldraxxi encampment in the Endmire. We speculate that your kind have been siphoning the Master's stockpiles of anima.

I have called for a carriage to take us there. Let us make haste.

passages.title: You're Dead To Me
passages.text: We have arrived. Let us not dally.

passages.title: Sparkles Rain from Above
passages.text:
You found the heart of the grove! And it's full of anima!

The Drust don't seem to like the idea of you taking it from them. They're massing in great numbers all over the forest!

We need to get you and the others out of here safely.

I can help. How do you feel about dishing out a little sparkly mayhem?

passages.title: Sparkles Rain from Above
passages.text:
You found and took their anima right from the heart of the grove? Impressive.

Dreamweaver will be most pleased. But I expect that we will soon encounter some unhappy visitors.

We must move quickly to aid the spirit in this wildseed... before we are overrun.

passages.title: The Two Sides of History
passages.text:
You mortals always say that history is written by the victors. But in the Shadowlands, I have found that to be untrue.

Everyone has their own version of events. I would like to know them all. 

There was an author of history books who made her abode in Revendreth's Darkfall Tower. She wrote from the venthyr's perspective of various incursions and battles alongside the Primus. 

If we could find copies of her works...

passages.title: The Two Sides of History
passages.text: You found them! What wonderful insight into the minds of the venthyr.

passages.title: Hidden Mirror
passages.text:
If Renathal is going to put the Harvesters' medallions to use, he's going to need a conduit to focus that power. Denathrius's corruption taints the forges of Revendreth. Our best option is in Bastion.

As denizens of Revendreth, Bastion will not allow us to enter through Oribos. 

We will need you to activate a mirror hidden away there long ago. Take this.

We concealed it at a rarely used site, the Veiled Enclave. There should be no one there, especially with the drought.

passages.title: Hidden Mirror
passages.text:
It's been quite a while since I've seen these plains. 

I am surprised the illusion lasted as long as it did. It was concealed here many years ago for operations in the Master's name.

No matter, let us make haste. We are not here on a simple observation mission.

passages.title: A Tense Reunion
passages.text:
We are looking for the forgelite prime, Mikanikos.

Only he will be able to craft the device we need. I've seen some of his creations. Truly impressive constructs and weaponry that rival even the mightiest of us stoneborn. 

When last I encountered him, it was at his workshop. A place of wonders known as the Eternal Forge.

We will meet you there. Traveling as a group may draw too much attention.

passages.title: A Tense Reunion
passages.text:
Just let me do the talking. One wrong move and they will surely revoke this trust.

Now is not the time for more bloodshed between realms.

passages.title: Assistance from Sinfall
passages.text:
In order to defeat the Forsworn, the Crest needs an artifact that embodies repentance, atoning for past mistakes and moving forward.

I have an artifact in mind. 

Long ago, many souls from Revendreth arrived in Bastion. Purer souls than we have ever received from Revendreth.

They bore the mark of the Seal of Contrition, a focus that expedited their cleansing.

Go to Revendreth and find this seal so that we may harness its power.

passages.title: Assistance from Sinfall
passages.text:
I am truly sorry I do not have more answers... the Maw scattered my mind quite a bit.

I will help to the best of my ability.

passages.title: Overhead Intelligence
passages.text:
The Countess knows the fates and goings-on of every noble in Revendreth. It is the best way to keep them in her debt.

However, she has a dark secret. Despite what she may say... she was once mortal.

We will need to find where she keeps her sinstone. No easy feat, of course.

We will need to gather some intel. The venthyr of the Chalice District are constantly gossiping. Collect their letters from the couriers until you learn something of interest.

passages.title: Overhead Intelligence
passages.text:
Three houses that find themselves in the Countess's favor... Peculiar.

Sounds like you are going to explore the Redelav District!

passages.title: Shards of the Countess
passages.text:
The venthyr travel long distances through enchanted mirrors. The keys we look for are not as we have in Bastion, but rather shards of a mirror that will lead to the sinstone's location.

Based on the intel you found, we know which three houses hold these shards.

Primrose, Darkvein, and Sinfang.

Go to their manors and retrieve the shards. We will find the frame to piece them into.

passages.title: Shards of the Countess
passages.text: I am sure you caused quite a ruckus amongst the nobility. We must work quickly.

passages.title: Collecting Dust
passages.text:
If I know the Countess, which I do, her sinstone will have stronger protection than mere keys.

She is quite fond of curses to protect her gateways. I am capable of creating a residue that should protect us, but it requires the petals of a specific flower you can find in Redelav gardens.

Collect the petals of these flowers so that I may protect us from the dangers to come.

passages.title: Collecting Dust
passages.text: I will need many petals to protect the four of us.

passages.title: Collecting Dust
passages.text:
<The Curator sifts through the petals.>

It may be a stretch, but I believe I can make this work.

passages.title: Sins of the Past
passages.text:
The Countess built her reputation on being a native venthyr, never a soul.

Revealing her sinstone to the world would be catastrophic. This is the leverage we need for the information we seek.

She will tell us where Alwin is. Where the seal is.

This mirror leads to her estate. I will follow behind you as backup, but the kyrian shall wait here.

Don't let her threaten you. You hold the power.

passages.title: Sins of the Past
passages.text:
You are lucky that the Curator is by your side, Maw Walker.

If you dared this stunt on your own, you would never see your precious Bastion again.

passages.title: Sins of the Past
passages.text:
I shall tell you the story of the Seal of Contrition.

Then you are to leave. Immediately.

passages.title: Land of Light
passages.text:
The Ember Ward is filled with outcasts from Revendreth society, whether they rebelled, crossed a noble, or simply looked at Denathrius wrong.

It is a Light-scorched land that drives venthyr mad, unless they manage to stay within the shadows.

If Alwin is there, it may be too late.

Let us visit Theotar at the Sanctuary of the Mad. I'm sure he will be pleased to see you.

passages.title: Land of Light
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, welcome back to Revendreth!

Allow me to connect you with someone who may be of service.

passages.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words
passages.text:
<The ash ghoul inspects you, checking your weapons and armor closely.

He shifts his eyes from you to your kyrian companions before checking back in with Theotar, who nods to him.

Alwin motions for you to follow him.>

passages.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words
passages.text:
<Alwin looks to you, then to Kleia.

He nods, resolve in his eyes.>

passages.title: Skulking in the Darkness
passages.text:
I had only heard tales of the Ember Ward before now.

It's breathtaking... yet terrible.

The Light burns the venthyr here, scorching their flesh and driving them mad.

The only reprieve is darkness, but thugs have taken over every inch of shelter outside of this sanctuary.

There is no redemption for them. Only justice.

passages.title: Skulking in the Darkness
passages.text: When people fall to their vices, they must be judged accordingly.

passages.title: Light Respite
passages.text:
We passed many ash ghouls on the way here, screaming in pain from their Light-dispensed burns.

And after meeting Alwin and the others here, my heart aches for them.

They have lost much of who they once were, and suffer daily for it.

Please, collect some berries from the Ashen Traverse. I believe I could impart anima into them to create a healing salve to soothe their wounds.

It is the least I can do.

passages.title: Light Respite
passages.text:
The denizens of the Ember Ward have suffered enough for their mistakes.

The Light goes too far in its punishment.

passages.title: Light Respite
passages.text: It is my duty to help those in pain. This salve shall help.

passages.title: The Folly of Envy
passages.text:
<Alwin points at a venthyr on the ledge above.

He lets out a slight, low rumble.>

passages.title: The Folly of Envy
passages.text: Alwin has brought us far. We must retrieve the Seal!

passages.title: The Folly of Envy
passages.text: Could it really be? The object of our long search...

passages.title: Parting Words
passages.text:
With the seal in hand, we must return to Bastion.

Alwin has received his justice. He has bequeathed the seal to our care.

Let us say our goodbyes at the Sanctuary of the Mad, then head home.

I look forward to returning to the blue skies and open fields of Bastion.

passages.title: Parting Words
passages.text: You return! With good news, I hope?

passages.title: Parting Words
passages.text: Concern about Kalisthene's report... but not my problem! Seal should work perfectly.

passages.title: Stuff We All Get
passages.text:
A lot of competitors meet their end in the Theater of Pain. But their weapons are still good as new!

It can get expensive to equip a fresh recruit, especially if you're not sure they'll survive their first bout. That's why we outfit them with "slightly used" armaments.

Gather them up for me, would you? Can't let a good weapon go to waste!

passages.title: Stuff We All Get
passages.text: The weapons you collect could be wielded by a future champion!

passages.title: Stuff We All Get
passages.text: These weapons will be put to good use. Hopefully, we won't have to collect some of them again.

passages.title: No Friend of Mine
passages.text:
Tools. I cannot work without my tools!

Famos, my former apprentice, stole them all when she went to the Forsworn.

It breaks my heart. She had so much promise.

She must be stopped.

passages.title: No Friend of Mine
passages.text: I need my tools. My work cannot be done without them.

passages.title: No Friend of Mine
passages.text: My tools. At least Famos took care of them.

passages.title: The Right Stuff
passages.text:
Building something that can help in your mission will require some metal.

The constructs of the Forsworn have metal parts, suitable for what we need. Tainted by the Forsworn, they will need some additional work.

Collect their metal and smelt them in the flames of the Eternal Forge to purge the corruption.

passages.title: The Right Stuff
passages.text: Do you have the metal?

passages.title: The Right Stuff
passages.text: Metal will do. Good work.

passages.title: The Restless Dreamer
passages.text:
Now that we have the anima we need, we must attune the heart of Tirna Noch to the shrines of Hibernal Hollow. 

Then we can bring the wildseed's nightmares into the light and dispel them.

Take the heart to the shrines just outside of Hibernal Hollow, in the Dreamshrine basin. Then bring the heart back to the wildseed to complete the preparations for the ritual.

But be careful. Minions of the Drust seem to be amassing near the grove.

passages.title: The Restless Dreamer
passages.text: The spirit dreams.

passages.title: The Restless Dreamer
passages.text:
You're a natural at this. Now we can bring the spirit's nightmares into the open and deal with them directly.

If we succeed, she will be so much more at peace.

passages.title: Despoilers
passages.text:
Your efforts at Tirna Noch have enraged the Drust. 

Those creatures of decay and destruction swell at our borders, and already they pierce our defenses.

Now we see their real faces, and know the true nature of our foe.

Strike at them. It will buy us time for you to conduct Dreamweaver's ritual.

passages.title: Despoilers
passages.text: This is just the beginning of their attack. But it is still a heavy blow dealt to them. Thank you.

passages.title: Caring for the Caretakers
passages.text:
The Drust attacked so quickly, they captured some of the spirit tenders of this grove!

It's not an easy job to do, between the drought and monsters and everything. I should know.

Please, see if you can get them out of whatever terrible magic those invaders have cast on them.

passages.title: Caring for the Caretakers
passages.text:
Those Drust really are cruel to us fae! Those spirit tenders were just trying to do their job...

Thank you for helping them.

passages.title: Drive A Dredge Between Them
passages.text:
First, we ruin their operation. Questions can come later.

I scouted from the overlook as we rode in. Necromancers charge crystals full of siphoned anima. Three dredgers stack them onto carts.

Kill those dredgers and everything will grind to a halt.

passages.title: Drive A Dredge Between Them
passages.text: Are you ready?

passages.title: Drive A Dredge Between Them
passages.text: Well done.

passages.title: A Perfect Circle
passages.text:
I've come up with the perfect design to fit your needs--a crown capable of channeling the powers of the Harvesters.

I need one more tool to put it together, a mold. Circular objects difficult to get right.

Go up to my old storage. A perfect mold exists there. I'm sure of it.

Perhaps in one of my old trunks. Go rummage around for it, will you?

passages.title: A Perfect Circle
passages.text: Crown must be perfect!

passages.title: A Perfect Circle
passages.text: Perfectly crafted. Just what we need.

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text:
Missing something sacred.

Forsworn ransacked our shrine to the First Forgelite and took her hammer. My hammer!

Defeat their commander, retrieve Phaestus. You must go now!

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text: Without Phaestus, we cannot forge your crown!

passages.title: Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons
passages.text:
Phaestus returns! Glorious day.

Many thanks, friend. This hammer has been passed down for eons! It belongs in my masterful hands.

passages.title: It's Treason, Then
passages.text:
We've halted their efforts, but we still have more to do.

Sin'dane must have sent someone to oversee the encampment.

Find and slay whoever is in charge. Only then can we be sure their work has ended.

passages.title: It's Treason, Then
passages.text: Still more schemes...

passages.title: It's Treason, Then
passages.text:
The Banished One... The Pauldrons of Imperium...

This lich, Kel'Thuzad, meddles with powerful forces.

passages.title: Taking The Seat
passages.text:
A wise choice, <name>. Under your command, we will restore honor and glory to Maldraxxus.

Your strength can change the Shadowlands for the better. Only with the Necrolords will you reach your full potential.

For now, make your way to the Seat of the Primus. Baroness Draka will meet you there and guide you further.

passages.title: Taking The Seat
passages.text: Welcome back to the fight, <name>.

passages.title: The Speaker of Elune
passages.text:
Fortune smiles upon us, <name>. We have found a soul in Ardenweald who was once a Night Warrior in life, as Tyrande is now. 

His name is Thiernax. I am told he assists in tending to the spirits resting in the Garden of Night.

Seek him out and petition him for aid. I pray he will have wisdom to share.

passages.title: The Speaker of Elune
passages.text: Oh, dear.

passages.title: The Speaker of Elune
passages.text:
<Qadarin watches Thiernax race off. He sighs before turning to you.>

My apologies. Thiernax may have seemed curt, but there is a reason for his reluctance to speak of the Night Warrior.

If you have a moment to help me out in the garden, I can elaborate. Then I will see what can be done to convince Thiernax to help your mother.

passages.title: Forging a Champion
passages.text:
Of all the souls who have reached that stone, only you discovered its true purpose.

I am no zealot, but clearly there is a deeper meaning in this. We would be wise to investigate further.

Find Bonesmith Heirmir at her forge. She is the most renowned smith in Maldraxxus, and the last remaining apprentice of the Primus himself.

She will know what course to take.

passages.title: Forging a Champion
passages.text: Something else?

passages.title: Forging a Champion
passages.text: This is going to take a bit of work.

passages.title: Maintaining Order
passages.text:
Communication is the key to victory. The greatest strategists are rendered useless if their orders go unheard.

Deliver my orders to Summoner Perex, Drill Sergeant Telice, and Secutor Mevix.

And do it quickly. Every moment we waste is one our enemy will have to their advantage!

passages.title: Maintaining Order
passages.text: That should ensure we stand ready for war.

passages.title: Ossein Enchantment
passages.text:
A potent blade requires potent components. I know of something that would suit our needs.

Recently a monstrosity trained by the constructs was snared by our soldiers at the eastern side of our stronghold. Vyraz insists we can siphon "intelligence" from the beast's mind.

Hmph. The will of the Primus trumps the desires of an ambitious baron!

The bones of that beast would forge the perfect hilt for this blade. I say you lay claim to them.

passages.title: Ossein Enchantment
passages.text: Brave enough to manage this?

passages.title: Ossein Enchantment
passages.text: Good! I knew that beast would prove no challenge for you.

passages.title: Slaylines
passages.text:
Gaining entrance to the Sepulcher is no easy feat, <name>!

Not only were guardians put in place, but an elaborate magical lock was created to seal the door. 

To open the way, the two obelisks which control the lock must be fed anima. Fortunately, there are some empowered crystals in the area we can use for this purpose.

Locate the focus crystals and redirect their anima flow into the obelisks. Then the secrets of the Sepulcher will soon be ours!

passages.title: Slaylines
passages.text: Have you activated the two obelisks?

passages.title: Slaylines
passages.text: You have done it! The door is unlocked!

passages.title: Secrets Among the Shelves
passages.text:
Now that the door to the Sepulcher is unlocked, we can venture inside.

And by "we", I mean "you". Until it's safe, at least.

The volumes within contain the collected wisdom of the greatest military minds of Maldraxxus. For the good of the Necrolords, do whatever is needed to gather these precious volumes.

It is safe to assume that the books will be protected by traps. The Primus wouldn't want just anyone laying their hands on this knowledge.

Once you clear a path, I'll join you.

passages.title: Secrets Among the Shelves
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Secrets Among the Shelves
passages.text:
Fine work so far.

Access to the secret archives is almost ours!

passages.title: A Complete Set
passages.text:
This is only volume one?

We can't just take the first volume. A rare item like this is only useful if it's in a complete set!

Grab as many of the other volumes as you can, I will have to prepare a larger expedition to remove all of these volumes.

passages.title: A Complete Set
passages.text: Did we get all the volumes?

passages.title: A Complete Set
passages.text: So much valuable knowledge saved, and it would not have happened without your help.

passages.title: Connecting the Dots
passages.text:
The old baron for the House of the Chosen? Ah, yes! I do think I remember seeing him! An angry soul, but very good at fighting.

He went off to meet with some member of the House of Rituals. There were a few of his guards with him.

While it's been quite some time since he passed this way, you may be able to find some signs of where he went towards the old footpath up the mountains.

passages.title: Crown of the Harvesters
passages.text:
Power you seek to focus is volatile. Need the Eternal Forge's flames to get it done. 

Without the blessing of the flames, I fear it will overwhelm the wearer.

Bring venthyr friend. His magic will prove useful. Need you to absorb impurities. 

<Mikanikos hands you an elegant container.>

Use this to capture imperfections that burn off during the process.

passages.title: Crown of the Harvesters
passages.text: It is done then?

passages.title: Crown of the Harvesters
passages.text: Perfection.

passages.title: Broken Webs
passages.text:
My husband once served our people as the Speaker of Elune--until he became the Night Warrior. His feelings on the matter are... complicated, to say the least.

Spriggans have been ripping the garden's soulwebs. Would you please help me repair them? I will recount our story as we work.

passages.title: Broken Webs
passages.text: Just one more.

passages.title: Broken Webs
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. This task is much easier with help.

I hope you do not think too poorly of Thiernax. His history with the Night Warrior ritual is rife with misplaced guilt and remorse, but I am certain I can get him to see sense and offer his aid.

passages.title: A Plea to the Harvesters
passages.text:
You come during strange times. Every day the tithes we must pay to the Tithelord increase, and our ability to get anima dwindles. 

What souls we have to work with here are near their final judgment and we lack the resources to harvest them without endangering the hamlet.

If you have the ear of Lord Chamberlain, then you might be able to pass a message to the Master himself. 

Here, take this letter. Please see that it makes it to the hands of the Chamberlain.

passages.title: A Plea to the Harvesters
passages.text:
Oh, the peasants have asked for help have they? 

Those who are loyal would know that sacrifices are essential to the survival of Revendreth. Yes, these are dark times with anima and new souls both being in short supply. 

But we must all do our part, no matter how painful.

passages.title: Heavy is the Head...
passages.text:
Crown is unstable due to Sire's lingering influence from the medallions. A test run should solve.

Socketed one of your medallions. Witness its power focused into a weapon of destruction. 

Perfect opportunity. Forsworn finished colossi construction. Destroy them. Bring the Forsworn the end they crave. 

Careful. Theotar informed me how powerful magic this is. The crown will hunger, must control it.

passages.title: Heavy is the Head...
passages.text: Bring the Forsworn the destruction they crave.

passages.title: Heavy is the Head...
passages.text:
You're alive. The crown started to feed off your soul.

Looks like there is still work to do. Mikanikos says the Sire's influence remains present in the crown. 

He says he has a plan.

passages.title: Ultimate Makeover
passages.text:
We now control the Apparatus of Abominable Construction! We can use it to create new constructs to contain worthy souls.

Emeni is the best choice to be first. Her combat skills are unmatched, and you may need her to help secure the Stitchyard.

You will assist me in rebuilding Emeni's construct.

passages.title: Rebellious Souls
passages.text:
Please hear us out, Maw Walker.

When Margrave Gharmal launched his attack on Bastion, there were many, such as Emeni and myself, that opposed his actions. 

Fearing dissent, Gharmal removed many souls from their constructed bodies and imprisoned them. Emeni escaped the prison, but most did not.

Help us free the other souls, and we can build you an army of constructs far greater than any that serve Gharmal.

passages.title: Rebellious Souls
passages.text: Do not let Emeni's sour disposition deter you. Your aid is greatly appreciated, Maw Walker!

passages.title: Find The Way
passages.text:
I apprenticed at the Stitchyard for many eons. I even worked in the Body Banks with surgeon Stitchflesh to design Emeni's last construct.

If we gain control of the Body Banks, we will have the parts necessary to rebuild Emeni and create new bodies for other souls we rescue. 

Lead us to there and we'll see if we can get it operational.

passages.title: Find The Way
passages.text: I never imagined myself returning to this place.

passages.title: A Little Pruning
passages.text:
Spriggans sometimes invade the garden to spread mischief and mayhem. There is no end to the trouble they bring with them.

Usually, the Wild Hunt keeps them in check... but their huntsmen and huntresses have had far more pressing concerns as of late. Thiernax and I have been helping to keep the garden clear, but he's run off somewhere to brood.

<Qadarin shakes his head.>

You would be doing me a favor if you helped me clear the Queen's garden of these vermin.

passages.title: A Little Pruning
passages.text: At least here we only have to worry about spriggans. Other parts of the forest are not so fortunate.

passages.title: A Little Pruning
passages.text: Hopefully they'll get the message and go back from whence they came!

passages.title: The Slaughter Daughter
passages.text:
When I was locked up, I made a list of all the constructs that betrayed me... it is a lengthy list!

Help me teach these constructs the mistake they made. I want to destroy everyone on my list, along with Yardmaster Pralak, who is number one on the list!

passages.title: The Slaughter Daughter
passages.text: I feel like we've made our point, <name>.

passages.title: Bottled Up Inside
passages.text:
There were many souls that opposed Margrave Gharmal's attack on Bastion. Those of us that spoke out, were stripped our bodies, imprisoned in the Etheric Vault, till our souls faded away, starved of anima.

My friends are still imprisoned in the vaults. We will free them, and build an army of constructs to fight for you!

passages.title: Bottled Up Inside
passages.text: We make a good team, <name>.

passages.title: Skin in the Game
passages.text:
This task is probably above your capabilities, but listen anyway.

As a construct I was feared throughout the Shadowlands. The magnificent skin of my construct was impervious to mortal weapons, it was a work of art that took years to perfect.

When I was removed from my construct, it was Faldo Iscar who took great delight in stealing that skin. He keeps it on himself as a souvenir.

Kill Faldo Iscar, and get my skin back!

passages.title: Skin in the Game
passages.text: When I was alive, you might have been my friend... or maybe my dinner.

passages.title: Skin in the Game
passages.text: My cold blood warms to you. You may be a suitable ally.

passages.title: Loose Threads
passages.text:
We're missing a few tools and parts for sewing a construct. We need these items if we're to rebuild my construct!

Search the surrounding area. See if you can find us what we need.

Search tables for the Skewering Needles, you can find haulers that carry Razorthread Spools, and look for Clotting Patches on constructs you kill.

passages.title: Loose Threads
passages.text: You are good at this.

passages.title: Loose Threads
passages.text: You should consider a constructed body, perhaps I can design you one someday.

passages.title: Weapon of Mass Construction
passages.text:
We are in luck!

Surgeon Stitchflesh and his assistant have not returned from Bastion. The entire Stitchyard is lightly guarded.

We must work fast. See if you can get the equipment operational. Once it is active, we can begin the construction process.

passages.title: Weapon of Mass Construction
passages.text: We will control the means of production!

passages.title: Weapon of Mass Construction
passages.text: We're almost done! Just one more step to complete the construction!

passages.title: Dressing the Kill
passages.text:
<Huln listens to your explanation, then pauses thoughtfully.>

I believe I understand, <name>. But I cannot help you right now.

Allow me to explain. In the meantime, will you carve up this carcass with me? Your prey always has something to teach you.

passages.title: Dressing the Kill
passages.text: The more quickly you carve, the more quickly I can help you.

passages.title: Dressing the Kill
passages.text: Excellent. This confirms my suspicions.

passages.title: The Forest Has Eyes
passages.text:
That dream! With the teeth and the claws and the heart... heart-wrenching sacrifice?

<Moonberry chokes up for a moment then collects herself.>

Sorry! While we were in dreamland, possessed spies have snuck into Hibernal Hollow! 

They must be hunted down and slain before they can report back on the grove's defenses.

Here, borrow a bit of my magic. Seek out the ones hidden in the shadows and smite them!

passages.title: The Forest Has Eyes
passages.text: Have you uncovered all those pesky spies yet?

passages.title: The Forest Has Eyes
passages.text: These Drust are bold to send spies into my grove! Very bold... and very foolish.

passages.title: Bell of Remembrance
passages.text:
<The bell is scratched and damaged. You remember the Curator being very interested in this item.

Maybe someone at the Crypt of the Forgotten will know more.>

passages.title: Bell of Remembrance
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker.

Why have you come to me? I have heard so much about you.

passages.title: The Droman's Call
passages.text:
Our enemies close in swiftly, <name>. We must sound the call to defend the grove!

Use this horn to call upon our protectors. Summon the Wild Hunt to slay those who would attack us.

passages.title: The Droman's Call
passages.text: The Hunt will hear our call and ride to defend the grove!

passages.title: The Droman's Call
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt rides to our aid... but not from the west?

That is where Hunt-Captain Korayn was tracking a dangerous foe. She and her hunting party must have been waylaid.

passages.title: Missing!
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt has answered the call to defend us... except for Hunt-Captain Korayn and her forces.

She had led her hunting party to the west, on the trail of a powerful foe. They may have encountered trouble.

Find her and provide whatever aid she requires. 

We need her hunters and her leadership if our defenses are to hold.

passages.title: Missing!
passages.text:
These Drust thought to send a force to strike us from behind. 

<Korayn smirks.>

Your call brought my fellow huntsmen and huntresses to reinforce us. Our foes were the ones caught by surprise.

passages.title: Awaken the Dreamer
passages.text:
Much of the Queen's focus has centered on the Grove of Awakening, where rejuvenated spirits emerge from their wildseeds and return to their worlds.

Perhaps it is fitting you carry a wounded spirit with you.

<Lord Herne studies Ysera's wildseed for a moment before a slow grin spreads across his face.>

This one fights with all of her being. Even now she clings to existence. 

Come, stranger, let us see what fate the Queen will decree for this one.

passages.title: Awaken the Dreamer
passages.text:
<The Winter Queen turns her gaze upon you.>

How curious to see someone like you in my forest.

passages.title: The Queen's Request
passages.text:
Dire portents indeed. 

I have used what little anima we possess to save our groves and the spirits they nurture. So many were lost... all as the Heart of the Forest grew ever weaker.

Keeping the Banished One bound within the Maw will require more anima than Ardenweald can spare.

<The Queen considers for a moment.>

Sire Denathrius is a master of anima extraction. Journey to Revendreth and inform him of our plight. I know he will lend us his aid.

Your allies in Oribos can open the way.

passages.title: The Queen's Request
passages.text: What has transpired in Ardenweald? Tell me everything.

passages.title: A Place To Call Home
passages.text:
You didn't end up on my list... so, I guess we're friends... for the moment.

Rathan took the soul you freed to Butchers Block near the Seat of the Primus. 

Let us meet him there and plan our next step together.

passages.title: A Place To Call Home
passages.text: This spot will do great for us. We can build new constructs, and a home for ourselves.

passages.title: [PH] Get Memories from Archives
passages.text:
We are going to need a little bit of preparation before we can face Voras.

The gorm of Ardenweald have developed special digestive juices that can isolate and dissipate anima in their food. It causes the devourers no small discomfort.

For a beast of that size, we will need a lot of the stuff to have any effect. Let us head to <HIVE MIND> and find a suitable one.

Are you familiar with the use of a rod of reclamation? It is quite useful against the gorm. You can borrow mine.

passages.title: Take the Bull by the Horns
passages.text:
I've carved out quite the reputation as a tauralus wrangler. Everyone needs a tauralus!

You do some work for me, and people will know who you are as well.

Take this bone splinter and poke a few juicy nibblers. Use them to lure a tauralus to you, then ride it back to me.

passages.title: Take the Bull by the Horns
passages.text: You want to be famous? Get the tauraluses I wanted?

passages.title: Take the Bull by the Horns
passages.text: These are some good tauraluses. Thanks for the help, mortal!

passages.title: A Common Peril
passages.text:
Each house in Maldraxxus has two barons. Before the fall of my first house--the House of Eyes--our margrave sent my fellow baroness to investigate suspicious behavior in the House of Rituals.

I have not heard from her since. Either she has found something... or has become another casualty of their treachery. 

Her orders took her to the Decay in the east. If you can find the baroness, give her this summons. 

We were not friends, she and I, but she is a formidable combatant. We could use her might.

passages.title: A Common Peril
passages.text: Someone new...but someone familiar.

passages.title: A Common Peril
passages.text:
Be thankful I am the one you found here.

Others in Maldraxxus may not have seen the potential in your strength.

passages.title: REUSE ME
passages.text:
Suddenly the lack of fae and souls makes much more sense. These vile creatures must have taken them as they took my husband.

But I will get them back. If you are our new champion then you will help me for the good of Ardenweald.

<Thiernas snorts.>

Death did not part us. I will not be torn from him now.

passages.title: The Thornspeaker Captive
passages.text:
Good to know the old bear hasn't forgotten me.

Unfortunately, neither have the Drust. I was enjoying a peaceful afterlife before they showed up.

Do not bother trying to force open this cage. You can only unlock it with three separate keys, and each one is held by a different Drust commander.

They should be somewhere nearby. Find them.

passages.title: The Thornspeaker Captive
passages.text: I would love to help you, but as you can see... I am not exactly free to leave.

passages.title: The Thornspeaker Captive
passages.text: The Drust locked me in this cage and dragged Kivarr away! If you release me, I can show you where they went!

passages.title: [REUSE AS WQ]
passages.text:
They're draining us of our anima! Some of the weaker souls... They are close to danger. They need anima or they will lose cohesion and drift. Such a thing is dangerous, especially now with how imbalanced things are in Ardenweald.

I can spare some of my own energy, but I will not have enough for everyone.

Choose, champion. Who will be saved today?

passages.title: Meet the Queen
passages.text:
<name>, we need only one more piece to complete the Crest of Ascension.

Eons ago, our Crest was originally crafted with the assistance of the fae. Deep within Ardenweald lies a portal they maintain to ferry souls back to their worlds. It is a source of great power and the final key to rebuilding the Crest.

Seek out the Winter Queen in Ardenweald and plead our case. We've already sent Pelagos ahead as our envoy to arrange for your meeting.

passages.title: Meet the Queen
passages.text: We have lots of work ahead of us.

passages.title: Smack and Grab
passages.text:
Bonetooths are the backbone of Maldraxxus's armed forces. Those that have been trained well are in demand amongst all of the houses.
 
I always need new bonetooths to train, but they can be rather difficult to collect.

Bring me some of the younger ones, and I will reward you greatly. Be advised that you may need to weaken them before you are able to capture them.

passages.title: Smack and Grab
passages.text: Bring me back some bonetooths!

passages.title: Smack and Grab
passages.text: I am pleased with your work!

passages.title: Trial of Ascension
passages.text:
The Forsworn threat is ever looming, and our forces are dwindling. Now, more than ever, we need more Ascended.

Our generous Archon has blessed us with a portion of our anima stores to ascend our top aspirants to join our forces.

Kleia is amongst the chosen, and thus must complete her final trial.

As Pelagos is not yet prepared to ascend, I request you be Kleia's partner for this process. It is arduous and should not be embarked on alone.

She must bear her first soul.

passages.title: Trial of Ascension
passages.text: The Forsworn have taken the court. They are blocking us from our trial!

passages.title: Censers of Guidance
passages.text:
The Forsworn are going to great lengths to prevent us from ascension.

They mobilize to stand in our way, to dismantle our chances to partake in our rituals.

They have stolen the resources we need to start our trial. Defeat them and retrieve the incense they carry so that we may continue on this path.

passages.title: Censers of Guidance
passages.text: Each censer will require considerable incense. We must make sure we gather enough.

passages.title: Censers of Guidance
passages.text: Infusing this incense with our own anima shall lead us on our individual journeys.

passages.title: To Cross the Veil
passages.text:
Pallessa found a scroll detailing the ritual.

We will need to take our positions and speak a chant, surrendering some of our anima with every word.

Your presence is vital. I ask you to use the censers to burn the incense as we meditate. The rest should unfold on its own.

passages.title: To Cross the Veil
passages.text: I see you are a being of this world. Kleia should be honored to have you at her side.

passages.title: A Day in the Life
passages.text:
A Bearer's duty is to carry souls through the veil to Oribos, where they shall be judged and passed along to one of the realms of the Shadowlands.

This soul is ready to move on.

During this trial, you will experience his final moments before his death.

When you are prepared, you shall see how this soul passed.

passages.title: A Day in the Life
passages.text: Oh there you are, love. I've been looking for you!

passages.title: Faith Through the Darkness
passages.text:
This drought is... so much larger than I imagined.

Why did nobody tell us?

The burden of this knowledge weighs heavy... do we bear souls to their eternal torture?

We must return home.

passages.title: Faith Through the Darkness
passages.text:
I am glad that Kleia has returned successfully to us. Though she questions, she is resolute in her duties.

If only I could say the same for all of the aspirants.

passages.title: Stabbing Wasteward
passages.text:
I've been finding a lot of tauralus corpses lately, and I know it's all because those bonetooths Caleesy loves so much!

I spotted the one that's responsible for the slaughter just west of here. Get rid of it! 

And don't mention this to Caleesy!

passages.title: Stabbing Wasteward
passages.text: I hope you put an end to that creature.

passages.title: Stabbing Wasteward
passages.text: You've done fine work! Just don't tell Caleesy about it.

passages.title: The Forsworn Onslaught
passages.text:
Loyalty's betrayal shall not go unnoticed.

But while the Paragons defend the city proper, it is up to us to defend Elysian Hold.

I am very wounded... but I will hold strong. Pelagos and I will protect the survivors. You must aid in pushing back this assault!

passages.title: The Forsworn Onslaught
passages.text: Devos... she goes too far.

passages.title: The Forsworn Onslaught
passages.text:
And so the tides of battle turn.

Elysian Hold may be safe, but the Spires still need our aid!

passages.title: Forged by Trial
passages.text:
<name>, my friend.

I have thought of you as an ally for some time now. The thrill I felt when you decided to join us in Bastion... I knew you would be a boon unto our ranks.

Our bond has been forged by the trials we face. Without you, I could have fallen to my newfound knowledge as Achillon did.

I wish to cement our bond. I would be honored to soulbind with you.

passages.title: Forged by Trial
passages.text: You are an important part in my journey. I respect you greatly, and hope you feel the same.

passages.title: Forged by Trial
passages.text:
You, me, and our dear Pelagos.

I challenge anybody to name a better team.

passages.title: The Prime's Directive
passages.text:
All centurion are made to serve the kyrian.

That they now work against ME, the Forgelite PRIME, is an insult to all centurions in Bastion. Look at them! Praetors! Goliaths! All... PURPLE!

I hereby give you permission and expressly order you to extract their cores. I will repurpose them in a fitting manner. I will reclaim their anima to power the Locus.

I can build more. Do not pity.

passages.title: The Prime's Directive
passages.text: You have the cores?

passages.title: The Prime's Directive
passages.text: Excellent. Their anima will be put to better use.

passages.title: The Mnemonic Locus
passages.text:
<Mikanikos examines the scroll you retrieved for him.>

Right, right.

Soul mirrors and Locus are tied together. If we restore anima to mirrors, it should repair the Locus back to full functionality. Thankfully, the cores you brought should be sufficient.

All I need to do is enable conduits. Simple!

Well? Go on. You know how to use these, yes?

passages.title: The Mnemonic Locus
passages.text: I wait to hear the hum of anima, yes.

passages.title: The Mnemonic Locus
passages.text: I love the hum of anima. It has been a long time since I have heard it in such abundance.

passages.title: Getting Backstage
passages.text:
The next thing we need to prepare the vessel is a set of Night's Veil Flowers.

We use these flowers in our ceremonies, but since the drought we've just used them as props in our plays. There are certainly some backstage at the Star Lake Amphitheater.

I bet Moonberry is there for the rehearsal of their next play. As a bonus, this will work out quite nicely for me to get revenge on her.

<Willowblossom flashes a wicked grin.>

passages.title: Getting Backstage
passages.text: Do you have the flowers?

passages.title: Getting Backstage
passages.text: Mission accomplished! This will be so funny. Ah, sweet revenge.

passages.title: Glorious Pursuits
passages.text:
Perhaps Draka has forgotten her loyalties, but I will fulfill my mission.

My enemy--the lich Mor'Bitan--hides within the House of Rituals. For some reason, his underlings skulk in this marsh.

We have not learned why they are here, but my devoted have spotted Mor'Bitan's second-in-command, Mephiles the Loyal. He will have our answers.

Collect him for me. Once you capture him, slay his kin. Weaken his resolve.

I will prime my base for his interrogation.

passages.title: Glorious Pursuits
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Glorious Pursuits
passages.text: A simple task for such a storied hero.

passages.title: Trinkle Trinkle Little Twerp
passages.text:
<On the note are the scribblings for a plan to steal silkstrider larvae and cook them.

It is signed by someone named Trinkle.>

passages.title: Trinkle Trinkle Little Twerp
passages.text: Have you taken care of that nasty Trinkle?

passages.title: Trinkle Trinkle Little Twerp
passages.text: Nasty spriggan!

passages.title: Calling in All Favors
passages.text:
adventurer, the time has come.

We cannot allow Kel'Thuzad to wield the Ritualists' sorcery as a weapon. He must be destroyed.

Rally our forces. We march on the House of Rituals!

passages.title: Calling in All Favors
passages.text:
We were brought together by chance, but now we fight as one.

Our victory today will be one for all Maldraxxi.

passages.title: The Curator
passages.text:
I tasked the Curator with reacquiring the Medallion of Avarice.

However, since her return from the Maw, her mind has become... a bit chaotic. Do be kind, will you? 

I ask that you lend her assistance in her search. She is at the Crypt of the Forgotten.

passages.title: The Curator
passages.text: I require your assistance, Maw Walker.

passages.title: The Curator
passages.text:
We must retrieve those mirror shards before Denathrius's lackeys do. 

It is the only way to access the crypt I concealed my medallion within.

passages.title: The Vault of the Archon
passages.text:
Behind me is the entrance to the Vault of the Archon. As you can see, it is warded against all unauthorized intrusion.

To make yourself an authorized entrant, place the offerings you collected before the guardians. You may then browse the contents of the vault at your leisure.

Do consider that such access is coveted among the Forsworn and is the sole focus of their efforts here. I advise preparing for combat.

passages.title: The Vault of the Archon
passages.text: Please place the offerings, and you may enter.

passages.title: The Vault of the Archon
passages.text: I am very pleased to meet you. The Vault has not received visitors in some time.

passages.title: Before the Dawn
passages.text:
We shall need all we can muster if this day is to be ours.

Gather them all. The Watchers, Bearers, Centurions, and Collectors. Tell them that their Archon calls for them.

Our Paragons will clear a staging ground at the Court of Elation for the final assault.

passages.title: Before the Dawn
passages.text: I hope you are prepared, Maw Walker.

passages.title: The Greater Good
passages.text:
The Forsworn are our former brothers and sisters in arms...our former kin. But we must see this through.

We will hit them from all sides. Fight well, but do not forget that Lysonia is our ultimate objective. If she does not fall, then she will recruit more to their cause in time.

Follow the path, <name>.

passages.title: The Greater Good
passages.text: The day is ours at last, thanks to you.

passages.title: Convene the Paragons
passages.text:
We have defeated the Forsworn at every turn. Saved those not too far gone. Routed them from our blessed Archon's temples. Now only one remains.

The Temple of Loyalty.

Lysonia has grown desperate in defeat. Abandoned all we strive to uphold by embracing the Maw. She has rallied her most fervent loyalists to the temple, knowing we will come for her.

We shall need the Paragons to finish this. Summon them.

passages.title: Convene the Paragons
passages.text: Without the Paragons we cannot prevail against Lysonia.

passages.title: Convene the Paragons
passages.text: Now that the Paragons stand ready, we must rally the rest of our forces.

passages.title: Battle for Hibernal Hollow
passages.text:
This is where we make our stand. The Drust and their minions have us nearly overrun.

But we will not let them destroy Hibernal Hollow. Nor will they take our anima or our wildseeds.
