Fight with us. Let us drive them out.

passages.title: Battle for Hibernal Hollow
passages.text:
We have won the battle...

...But I fear we may have lost Ysera.

passages.title: Broken Harts
passages.text:
The curse on Qadarin is a powerful one.

But I will break it.

<Thiernax snorts.>

Death did not part us. I will not be torn from him now.

<Thiernax studies both you and Shandris with a serious look in his eyes.>

Lend me your aid, and in turn I will help you with your world's Night Warrior. I do not promise I can save her... but I will share all that I know.

Return to the Heart of the Forest and tell Lord Herne what has happened. We will meet there.

passages.title: Broken Harts
passages.text: This is even worse than I had thought.

passages.title: Broken Harts
passages.text: I bet those spriggan thought this would be pretty funny. Well, we're not laughing!

passages.title: A Sure Bet
passages.text:
You've made a name for yourself and earned the respect of everyone here, including Au'narim.

You are ready, adventurer!

Anzio is expecting us at the entrance to the Theater of Pain. You're going to be a champion!

passages.title: A Sure Bet
passages.text: You have traveled far for this moment.

passages.title: Picking Up Pelagos
passages.text:
Pelagos should have the seed by now! Can't start the ritual without the seed. He's likely still at Claw's Edge.

We'll see you there!

passages.title: Picking Up Pelagos
passages.text: Whoops. Wrong seeds. I hope we can still find a use for these.

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text:
Stormwind has a lot to offer adventurers like us, but it's far too big to explore on foot. The captain has arranged for you to receive a mount to help you get around.

She said to speak with Curly at the stables in Old Town... but I can't seem to remember the way there.

Have no worries, <name>! All we need to do is ask a guard for directions. If you ever need help finding something, the city guards will show you where to go.

Let's ask a nearby guard for directions to the stable master in Old Town!

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text: Welcome to the stables, <class>. I've been expecting you.

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text:
So you're the newcomer that I've been hearing so much about?

My name's Curly. It's a pleasure to meet you, <name>!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! Have you decided on a combat specialization yet?

Since you're a <class>, you already know about the different classes available to adventurers. But did you know that there are also areas of specialization within each class?

Choosing a specialization is an important decision. Your specialty determines your combat role in a party, as well as the kinds of weapons and abilities that you will use.

Let's go speak with Mithlos Falconbriar to learn more about specializations!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text: Greetings. Have you come to learn about combat specializations?

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Excellent choice of specialization, <name>.

Feel free to test out your new abilities on the training dummies outside.

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text:
I don't know about you, but all this running around has got me thirsty!

Why don't we head over to the Pig and Whistle Tavern and rest our legs over some cool pints of moonberry juice?

While we're there, speak with Meagan the innkeeper to make the Pig and Whistle Tavern your new home. That way, if you ever find yourself stranded without a flight master nearby, you can use your hearthstone to return to the inn.

Not only is it faster than a gryphon, but you'll save a few copper in the process!

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: How can I help you today, <class>? Are you looking for a place to stay?

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: As long as the Pig and Whistle Tavern is your home, we'll keep the fire going for you while you're away!

passages.title: A Warrior's End
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! You're a <class>, right? Maybe you can deal with this... situation.

I was scouting the area with Lindie's device and saw a ghost who was offering power to any "true" warriors.

I know you're still new at this, but why don't you try going over there? 

We could use every advantage against these ogres.

passages.title: A Warrior's End
passages.text:
You are no hero of myth and legend... but I see potential within you.

Stand still, and I shall share with you my mightiest technique.

And then I implore you to end my suffering.

passages.title: Hjalmar's Final Execution
passages.text:
You now wield my most powerful skill, young warrior. 

Now use it to finish me! These ogres trapped my spirit here long ago for daring to defy them.

Only through a glorious death will I finally be allowed to rest. 

It is the only way I will see my brothers and sisters in the afterlife.

passages.title: Hjalmar's Final Execution
passages.text: Sounds like you had an adventure! Where do you think that ghost went after you fought it?

passages.title: Dread Priming
passages.text:
Sire Denathrius has requested I help you prepare for the hunt. Every hunter must help prepare a soul here in the Grove of Terror.

I have a stubborn soul here who's been quite uncooperative, Houndmaster Loksey. His time has come to be hunted.

<The Fearstalker hands you a set of Hopebreaker Soul Chains.>

Demoralize him. We can't let him leave here with any hope. The hunt is meant to break the souls so they become less... resistant to the processes of Revendreth.

passages.title: Dread Priming
passages.text:
This soul is nearly ready. 

We have an opportunity to finish preparing this one and take care of a problem in the process.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text:
A rogue from the lost expedition, Coulston Nereus, tried scouting the island for any threats after they made landfall.

The last time Henry saw him, he was headed for a cave not far from here.

Can you make contact with Coulston? He may be able to help with our rescue mission.

Oh, and be careful when heading north. Alaria spotted a vicious bear roaming the area.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text: Did you get the roots? Make sure that bear is far away when you pick them.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text:
Here's the secret to making these poisons. It took me ages to learn it.

Now that I've taught it to you, it should be easy enough for you to make more whenever you need it.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text:
I found something strange while using Lindie's Scout-o-Matic that you should probably know about.

The ghost of a paladin appeared on the hill nearby. She looked straight at the Scout-o-Matic and asked for you.

I don't understand a whole lot about paladins and the Light, but I think you may not want to ignore her.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. It is good to finally see you.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text:
Those who serve the Light will know its blessing. Accept this gift, <class>.

Call upon it when your strength fails and when hope seems lost. The Light will protect you from harm.

passages.title: Inquisitor Stelia's Sinstone
passages.text:
You never truly escape your past, Maw Walker.

Every venthyr once entered Revendreth as a soul, burdened by the immoralities of their mortal lives.

Like all souls, they carved their true names and most shameful transgressions into sinstones.

Knowledge that intimate can be a potent weapon, if wielded properly.

Locate the sinstones of the inquisitors aiding the Accuser so that you may kill them. Start with Stelia.

After they're dead, bring me the Accuser's sinstone. I will deal with her myself.

passages.title: Inquisitor Stelia's Sinstone
passages.text: Inquisitors hide their sinstones to protect themselves.

passages.title: Inquisitor Stelia's Sinstone
passages.text: Good. Temel will know how to exploit this sinstone.

passages.title: Temel, the Sin Herald
passages.text:
<Before flying away, Echelon shouted an additional command.>

Expropriate Temel as well. He will know how to exploit the sinstone properly.

passages.title: Temel, the Sin Herald
passages.text: Temel will not come willingly.

passages.title: Temel, the Sin Herald
passages.text:
<Echelon eyes Temel suspiciously.>

I never liked this runt.

passages.title: The Deadliest of Poisons
passages.text:
You've got the poison. Now it's time to take out that ogre. Gutgruk the Tough.

He usually patrols around their citadel. Probably looking for your expedition as we speak!

Poison your blades, then take that monster down.

passages.title: The Deadliest of Poisons
passages.text:
We'll make sure Coulston Nereus is properly remembered for his sacrifice. 

It's a good thing that poison stopped the ogre... otherwise we would've been in trouble!

passages.title: Beast Control
passages.text:
The Grove of Terror's dredbats have become aggressive due to the lack of anima caused by the drought. 

This is a formal request to cull their numbers. We must re-establish dominance over our creations.

-Flockmaster Sergio

passages.title: Beast Control
passages.text: The balance is returning. Please accept this payment on behalf of myself and the other keepers of this place.

passages.title: Gorm Ruin Everything
passages.text:
These red seeds will still prove useful. They come from a very dangerous plant and are quite unstable. If we are going to recover the blue seed we really need, then these might help.

Let's clear out some of these gorm and search for the real seed.

passages.title: Gorm Ruin Everything
passages.text: We need to clear a path.

passages.title: Gorm Ruin Everything
passages.text: These seeds aren't just useful, they're dangerous!

passages.title: Test Your Mettle
passages.text:
Many of the greatest Maldraxxi legends earned their fame fighting in the Theater of Pain. 

If you want to follow in their footsteps, you need to prove you have what it takes to survive in there.

Defeat Valuator Malus and Tester Sahaari in combat. Let's see what you can do!

passages.title: Test Your Mettle
passages.text: Earn the right to proceed!

passages.title: Test Your Mettle
passages.text: You've proven yourself worthy! I'll see if we can get you into a fight soon!

passages.title: Food on the Table
passages.text:
I'm making a stew for dinner tonight, but it seems we're missing rabbit meat.

Would you be able to go out back and collect some for me?

Oh and do be careful, I heard howling earlier. The wolves aren't normally out during the day.

passages.title: Food on the Table
passages.text: Shh shh, Gwendolyn. It's okay, baby girl.

passages.title: Food on the Table
passages.text: This should be plenty. Thank you, love.

passages.title: Millie's Garden
passages.text:
Alma came by earlier and gave Millie some flower seeds to plant out in the garden.

I love that our daughter is taking an interest in gardening, but I don't have time to wash her dress when she gets it covered in mud again!

Would you help her with the digging so that she doesn't get too dirty?

passages.title: Millie's Garden
passages.text:
<Millie giggles.>

Hi daddy!

passages.title: Millie's Garden
passages.text:
You're the best daddy ever!

<Millie gives you a big hug around the knees.>

Here, I made you some lemonade. I only have enough for one glass, so don't drink it too fast!

passages.title: Lumber for Lakeshire
passages.text:
Magistrate Solomon requested a bundle of wood for his hearth. However, he's been too busy to come by and retrieve it.

If you wouldn't mind running it down to him at the town hall, I'm sure he'd appreciate it.

passages.title: Lumber for Lakeshire
passages.text: The folks are on edge, Ben. It's my job to keep them at ease.

passages.title: Lumber for Lakeshire
passages.text: Thanks for delivering the lumber. I was going to go pick it up myself, but the townsfolk have been crying wolf all day.

passages.title: Lakeshire's Last Stand
passages.text:
There's no time to evacuate... not if the Scourge are here!

Board the windows! Get everybody inside! Our only hope is to hide.

passages.title: Lakeshire's Last Stand
passages.text:
This poor soul.

An honest man... to die so gruesomely...

passages.title: A Priest's End
passages.text:
You're a trained priest, right <name>? This might be up your alley.

We've spotted the bodies of other recruits from our expedition.

I'm guessing they washed up on a different part of the island. They didn't make it very far.

When you have a moment, could you say a few prayers over them? Just to help put their spirits at ease.

We'll give them a proper burial once we deal with the ogres.

passages.title: A Priest's End
passages.text:
There's no time fer chatting. I'm going tae bless ye with the power to resurrect.

I'd give ye a bit more ceremony, but we got an urgent problem on our hands.

If we don't hurry, the souls of these poor recruits will be consumed by the ogre's necromancy!

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text:
The souls of these recruits aren't strong enough tae resist the dark magic bein' practiced on this island.

Use Resurrect on the remains of these recruits. Beseech the Light tae give 'em another chance while their souls still linger.

I've been stranded on this island for years, watchin' these ogres get away with all of this.

It's time tae make a stand.

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text: Get goin' and save those recruits with resurrect!

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text:
Ye've got what it takes tae become a great <class> one day.

Me? Oh, me body is long since decayed. But I can rest easy now that I know these ogres are going tae be stopped.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text:
While you were mowing down hordes of undead, I was scouting more of the area with Lindie's device.

I saw what looked like a portal out near the bridge, along with the corpse of a warlock we thought was lost in the shipwreck.

Think you can go investigate the area and try to close that portal? We have enough problems on this island as it is.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text: I see you have the grimoire that enacted the binding ritual.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text:
Our bargain has been struck.

Call upon me from the Void, and I will answer.

<The voidwalker looks at the worgen's corpse.>

Let us see if you are stronger than those who came before you.

passages.title: Chasing a Memory
passages.text:
The attack on the Temple of Purity is unprecedented in Bastion. At least, to my knowledge.

We need to know more. The fragment that the Paragon captured may contain the answers we seek.

There is a place nearby called the Mnemonic Locus. There, aspirants and ascended alike can call forth their memories and store them away. If we can look through this fragment's memories, perhaps we can learn more about the so-called Forsworn and, with luck, uncover their plan.

I will meet you there. Go in service.

passages.title: Chasing a Memory
passages.text:
<Mikanikos gestures irritably toward the Forsworn behind him.>

Are you here to help fix THIS?

passages.title: What's In a Memory?
passages.text:
It may be possible to extract memories from fragment, but I worry they will not be useful. This is not whole kyrian, but a tiny piece! A weird, broken piece. It cannot even speak!

We will apply extractor and see what comes out. Extractor might explode. It might not. For this? Worth the risk, I think.

Do not know what will emerge. Could be memories. Could be nothing. Could be something else. May try to fight you! Stay on your guard, yes? Collect all that look Forsworn.

Speak when ready.

passages.title: What's In a Memory?
passages.text: Do you think we will get the information we need, <name>?

passages.title: What's In a Memory?
passages.text: We did it. With any luck, her memories are within our grasp.

passages.title: Lysonia's Truth
passages.text:
If I had not seen it with my own eyes, I do not know that I would believe such a thing is possible.

You carry a significant piece of Lysonia within you, now. Go to the Soul Mirrors and open yourself to them. With luck, they will draw from her essence to draw forth a memory of the Forsworn.

If this works, we may know what they are planning within minutes!

passages.title: Lysonia's Truth
passages.text: <Mikanikos fumes silently.>

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Tides of War
passages.text:
King Wrynn has called us together for an urgent war council.

It seems that there was some trouble with the Horde while we were away. The king was impressed with the valor and bravery that you demonstrated during our mission to Exile's Reach.

Now that you've arrived, the meeting will begin without delay.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Tides of War
passages.text: Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Tides of War
passages.text:
The Horde have forced our hand yet again.

This cannot stand.

passages.title: Pie Not?
passages.text:
I want to cook something warm, savory, and gooey!

That's right! I want to make a lovely bone marrow pie! When it's done, you'll be as full as a tick. I guarantee it! 

Now, just any old marrow won't do. I need the very best and rarest marrow.

And that's where you come in! I need you to help Mama out and dig that marrow up. Yes... dig. 

Oh and be ready to knock some heads. Maldraxxus doesn't take kindly to being carved up.

passages.title: Pie Not?
passages.text: Is there any kind of pie that's not just the best? Blood pie, bone marrow pie, bone marrow jelly...

passages.title: Pie Not?
passages.text:
Well, if this isn't the best batch of marrow I've ever seen! 

Mama is going to cook you a feast today!

passages.title: I Dreamed A Dream
passages.text:
This is quite a ceremony, everyone is here. This ritual is essential to the recreation of the Crest of Ascension and the preservation of Bastion. 

We owe the Winter Queen and Willowblossom a great debt. Someday, I hope we can repay them.

passages.title: I Dreamed A Dream
passages.text: Do you have the vessel?

passages.title: I Dreamed A Dream
passages.text: She's... she's gone.

passages.title: Abel's Fate
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I have another task for you.

Some time ago, I sent Soulwatcher Abel and a few others to slay some troublesome bonemaulers.

They have yet to return. Go find them, will you?

passages.title: Abel's Fate
passages.text: What became of Abel?

passages.title: Abel's Fate
passages.text:
So they were defeated? And yet, you still stand.

Shame.

passages.title: Splash Damage
passages.text:
The Jailer's troops use anima charged runes to empower their armor. Without those runes, the troops will be significantly weaker! 

I developed this special formula to remove tough laundry stains, but it should be capable of removing magical runes as well!

Splash my Putrification Potion on Rune-hardened troops, the bigger the better! Then collect the runes that fall off, so I can extract their anima.

passages.title: Splash Damage
passages.text: Have you cleaned things up?

passages.title: Splash Damage
passages.text: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!

passages.title: Spriggan Snares
passages.text:
I'm so glad you and Qadarin were passing by! These spriggans are crazy!

Get me out of here!

I was gathering some herbs from the garden when they nabbed me. I'm sure they've captured other souls, too!

passages.title: Spriggan Snares
passages.text: This behavior is unexpectedly bold for the spriggans.

passages.title: Spriggan Snares
passages.text: Capturing souls is a far more brazen act than the typical spriggan prank. I wonder what has changed...

passages.title: King of the Hill
passages.text:
Loksey is ready. It is finally time to begin the hunt.

Take him to Wanecrypt. The Fearstalker and the other hunters will be there already.

Hurry now. She does not like to be kept waiting.

passages.title: King of the Hill
passages.text: Where's the soul?

passages.title: King of the Hill
passages.text: Let us begin, shall we?

passages.title: The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad
passages.text:
The time has come to purge Maldraxxus of treachery.

Our armies are rallied. Our allies stand ready. The machine of war is in motion.

We must win this battle, or all of the Shadowlands will be lost.

passages.title: The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad
passages.text:
Kel'Thuzad escaped into the Banished One's hands, but at least his evil has been driven from Maldraxxus.

Well fought, <name>. Now we focus on rebuilding our forces and restoring order to our realm.

passages.title: Straight to the Heart
passages.text:
The success of Mor'Bitan's treachery has made him complacent.

Let him enjoy the feeling, for it ends here. We will lure him out with this ritual... and we will avenge my margrave.

Stand with me now, <name>. Together, we will make an example of this traitor.

passages.title: Straight to the Heart
passages.text: He will regret crossing me.

passages.title: Straight to the Heart
passages.text: Cursed lich--may his soul never be reborn.

passages.title: A Good Heart
passages.text:
Despite the beliefs of most people, Emeni has a kind heart. Err...at least she will have one, once you give it to her!

I can think of no one better than you, Maw Walker, to give Emeni a new heart. Perhaps this will warm her blood towards you. You might become friends or even soulbinds!

Please select and place a heart in Emeni's construct.

passages.title: A Good Heart
passages.text: I hope you chose well!

passages.title: A Good Heart
passages.text: You've done it, the construct is completed. The Slaughter Daughter lives again!

passages.title: Baker's Dozen
passages.text:
Under this very tent, I've prepared delicacies that would make demigods cry tears of joy. I'm always in need of more baking supplies!

The brokers usually sell me eggs from parts near and far, but maybe this time you could help me out instead.

You familiar with gorm? Big insect-like creatures native to Ardenweald. Well, if you find me some eggs of theirs, I'll bake you up something nice in return! 

Mama will even send Starchy to help you out.

passages.title: Baker's Dozen
passages.text: Perfect! Mama just knew you had the skills to handle such a task!

passages.title: A Secret Never Spoken
passages.text:
The first reagent listed in the scroll is a secret never spoken.

Well, that's easy. I know who has tons of secrets! Watcher Vesperbloom, our resident snoop. She keeps the Wild Hunt informed of any nefarious behavior that takes place in the forest.

I know she'd be willing to give us a secret to save Qadarin's soul from dissolving in excruciating pain.

I'll have Thiernax meet you wherever she's hidden them. It'll keep his mind off what's happening to his husband.

passages.title: A Secret Never Spoken
passages.text: Whew! This page... It's seen sights no one should ever see.

passages.title: A Secret Never Spoken
passages.text: You have no idea how tempted I am to open this and read it. Let's hurry up and create this counter-curse!

passages.title: A Token of Lost Love
passages.text:
My sister, Alexstrasza, lost her prime consort, Korialstrasz, towards the end of our war with Deathwing.

She has loved many in her long life, but none as deeply as he. I know in my heart she loves him still.

Find Alexstrasza in the Vermillion Redoubt and ask for a token of her lost love. It will surely prove a powerful reagent for the counter-curse.

passages.title: A Token of Lost Love
passages.text: My sister loves with all of her heart...

passages.title: A Token of Lost Love
passages.text:
This figurine... I have not seen it since...

I gave this to her when we first became Aspects. Our duties would draw us apart for the first time in our lives. To know that she has kept it all this time...

<Ysera wipes her eyes.>

We will put it to good use.

passages.title: A Sacrifice of Anima
passages.text:
The last thing we need for this counter-curse is some attuned anima.

Of course, we don't have much to spare. That means this is more of a sacrifice than it normally would be.

But you know what? The spriggans made this mess, so they should help clean it up. Some really nasty ones have been causing mischief in Tirna Scithe. They should have the anima we need.

Thiernax looks like he could use some nice, vengeful, therapeutic spriggan stomping. I'll have him meet you there.

passages.title: A Sacrifice of Anima
passages.text: Have you handled those spriggans yet?

passages.title: A Sacrifice of Anima
passages.text:
HA! That will teach those spriggans! You mess with the mistrunner, you get the magical horn!

Now we have the anima we need! And, conveniently, it's already attuned to the bad attitude of the one who cast the curse.

passages.title: Mending a Broken Hart
passages.text:
We have all the reagents for the counter-curse!

Hurry up and cast it before Qadarin's soul is lost, and Thiernax refuses to help you, and Tyrande is doomed to die horribly in the Maw, and everyone is sad!

But no pressure.

passages.title: Mending a Broken Hart
passages.text: I... I cannot thank you enough.

passages.title: Mending a Broken Hart
passages.text:
Were it not for your aid, Qadarin's soul would have been lost forever.

I... I can do no less than offer my aid in return.

passages.title: The Minions of Mayhem
passages.text:
To all downtrodden and unappreciated hard workers of the Shadowlands: the time has come to rise up. Rise up and stick it to the fangs and the wings and the bonemen! Stick it to the brokers and the bossmons! I says we go into business for ourselves!

Come to our secret meeting at the Ledge of Destiny.

To all not-downtrodden warlords, Maw Walkers, and morally flexible powerful denizens: We are currently hiring muscle. If interested, please attend. 

Don't tell the fuzz.

passages.title: That Darn Fox!
passages.text:
You! You there!

I, Clarion Song, need your assistance. Yes, yes, give yourself a moment to bask in my glory.

<Clarion Song gives you a moment.>

Done? Good. I need you to catch a troublesome vulpin kit. He is positively barbaric! Running amok, causing havoc, ruining my beauty rest! He's using a concealing charm to make himself invisible, but I know it's him!

Make yourself useful and catch that kit!

passages.title: That Darn Fox!
passages.text: Well? Did you catch it?

passages.title: That Darn Fox!
passages.text:
You, you actually caught that little mongrel?

Well! I am pleasantly surprised. Now hand him over. We are going to go right to his parent. I have a few choice words for the esteemed Lord Renard. Member of the court he may be, I am too impossibly valuable to be constantly pestered by this ragamuffin child!

passages.title: The House of Plagues
passages.text:
The House of Plagues was the first to fall in this conflict. We believed its demise was the result of a careless accident. If only we had known the truth sooner...

But perhaps not all their knowledge was lost. Before you arrived, our scouts reported signs of movement near the wreckage of their necropolis.

If any survivors remain, we'd be wise to add them to our ranks. But approach with caution. The toxic fallout may have left them mad... or worse.

passages.title: The House of Plagues
passages.text: My apprentice! I have been searching everywhere for you!

passages.title: The Hand of Purification
passages.text:
Nikolon was not alone.

<Eridia stares grimly out over the temple grounds.>

Long have I toiled over the aspirants in my care. Long have I tended to this temple under my Paragon. To know that so many have fallen, alone, is a blow.

But this... wanton destruction! It will not stand.

You will be my hand, <name>. Go forth. End them. All of them.

My duty demands that I tend to those that remain. I will find you near the bridge when the way is clear.

passages.title: The Hand of Purification
passages.text: Some stains must be scoured away.

passages.title: Prey Upon Them
passages.text:
My mission cannot progress without a supply of anima. 

Fortunately, the necromancers nearby have been kind enough to gather some into their maldracite crystals.

You will relieve them of those crystals. They may be reluctant to part with them, but I trust you can be... persuasive.

passages.title: Prey Upon Them
passages.text: Do not fail me.

passages.title: Prey Upon Them
passages.text: Yes, these will do nicely.

passages.title: War is Deception
passages.text:
You have proven a useful ally, <name>.

Mephiles undoubtedly possesses a wealth of information for us. However, the House of Rituals is unforgiving when it comes to betrayal. He will not talk.

Not that it matters. The House of Eyes has ways to... extract a prisoner's knowledge without the use of words.

Place the charged crystals around me. They will facilitate the interrogation.

passages.title: War is Deception
passages.text: Let us reveal the truth.

passages.title: War is Deception
passages.text: Draka may be content to forget our master, but I will not rest until he is avenged.

passages.title: The Eternal Revenge
passages.text:
<On the shelves there are hundreds of other phylacteries of varying shapes and sizes.

Many bear names - this one specifically has a etching with the name Mor'Bitan.

Lady Vashj would be interested in this phylactery.>

passages.title: Daughter of the Night Warrior
passages.text:
In my dreams, I see many things. Elven souls tortured in the Maw. A warrior of the night consumed by vengeance.

And... Ardenweald's destruction.

These visions are ever shifting... ever vague. But I believe Tyrande Whisperwind is key to saving the night elves, as well as this realm.

Shandris Feathermoon, Tyrande's daughter, is touched by dreams as well.

Even now, she travels to the Eternal City. Find her. If anyone can reach the heart of Tyrande, it is her.

passages.title: Daughter of the Night Warrior
passages.text:
<name>? You are a welcome sight in this strange place. 

Perhaps you already know that I have come to find my mother.

passages.title: Into the Maw
passages.text:
I have not seen Tyrande since she departed for Icecrown... but I see her in my dreams. She stalks a nightmarish landscape, brimming with the might of the Night Warrior.

Such power is too much for any mortal to bear for long. I shudder to think of the toll it has taken on my minn'do.

Highlord Fordragon has told me of the Maw. If you truly have braved its horrors before, then I ask that you guide me through them as well.

We must find Tyrande and convince her to let go of the Night Warrior's rage.

passages.title: Into the Maw
passages.text:
I have seen bits and pieces of this dark realm in my dreams. Tyrande roams this place.

We must find her.

passages.title: Entangling Web
passages.text:
It would seem we have a means of luring Mor'Bitan to us. But what good is a web if the prey can run free?

For these rituals to work, the liches require a magical conduit. They draw runes with finely ground maldracite to channel anima.

I have no doubt Mor'Bitan's necromancers have ground maldracite in the area. If we gather enough, we can draw a rune of binding to trap our target.

Work with haste, adventurer.

passages.title: Entangling Web
passages.text: I'm waiting.

passages.title: Entangling Web
passages.text: He will not escape this time.

passages.title: The Recovery of Tyrande Whisperwind
passages.text:
The Night Warrior's power is tearing Tyrande apart. Such rage... it is consuming her.

<Shandris is silent a moment.>

And yet, my mother speaks true. We cannot leave the souls of my people to suffer.

We shall follow Tyrande into Torghast. We must find a way to save the spirits of the kaldorei.

And in the process, pray that we can save my minn'do as well.

passages.title: The Recovery of Tyrande Whisperwind
passages.text:
I cannot fault my mother's intent... but she will be consumed before she finds justice for our people.

We must find another way to bring her back.

passages.title: Seek Your Mark
passages.text:
I see why Draka sent you in her stead--you accomplish what she could not.

We have all the pieces. Now, we must simply put them together.

The steps to the ritual are simple: place our fractured crystals in formation around the obelisk.

Then comes the sigil--*our* sigil. Use the maldracite powder to draw a binding glyph at the obelisk's base.

When you are through, return to me.

passages.title: Seek Your Mark
passages.text: Work swiftly.

passages.title: Seek Your Mark
passages.text: Vengeance is nearly ours.

passages.title: Go in Service
passages.text:
We cannot waste any more time. We must get an audience with the Archon, before this next attack happens!

We need to find a way to get you to Elysian Hold... and quickly!

Hero's Rest is a place of respite for the aspirants of Bastion. You can see it floating above from across the fields.

Meet me there when you can. I have a plan.

passages.title: Go in Service
passages.text: We must get moving.

passages.title: Go in Service
passages.text:
The Polemarch? He is the right hand of the Archon!

She truly believes us. We still have a chance!

passages.title: Steward at Work
passages.text:
Stewards are useful for many reasons.

They keep Bastion tidy, fix anything broken, and offer unrivaled companionship and support.

Your new steward assistant should be able to repair the beacon. Then you can summon the Polemarch to Hero's Rest.

passages.title: Steward at Work
passages.text: Kalisthene has vouched for you by allowing usage of the beacon. For that reason, you have my attention.

passages.title: On Swift Wings
passages.text:
Our revered Archon has decided to grace you with an audience.

It is your duty to present your discoveries to her, then follow her wise judgment.

She holds audience in Elysian Hold, part of the sprawling Spires of Ascension, the home of the Ascended.

We shall carry you there, for it is a place for those who can fly.

passages.title: On Swift Wings
passages.text: The Archon's chambers are just above. I urge you to practice extreme deference while in her presence.

passages.title: Kyrestia, the Firstborne
passages.text:
I will escort you to hold audience with the Archon.

I beseech you to present your information succinctly and directly.

Our wise Archon will hear you and make a decision on the best course of action.

passages.title: Kyrestia, the Firstborne
passages.text: None shall doubt the Archon, in her infinite wisdom.

passages.title: Kyrestia, the Firstborne
passages.text: The Archon's grace is upon you, mortal.

passages.title: The Wards of Bastion
passages.text:
Each temple of Bastion is protected by a ward here in Elysian Hold. As long as the wards hold, no malevolent force can launch an assault.

It is concerning that the Forsworn were able to attack Purity in such force...

Your orders are to examine the wards. As long as they hold, Bastion stands strong.

passages.title: The Wards of Bastion
passages.text: The wards each protect one of the temples of Bastion. If a ward is not active, that temple stands vulnerable.

passages.title: The Wards of Bastion
passages.text:
It seems the Forsworn are in our very midst, even in the Spires.

We must send aid to the Temple of Courage posthaste.

passages.title: Among the Chosen
passages.text:
Only one rune remains...

We should return to the House of the Chosen and report to Margrave Krexus. He will want to know of our progress.

passages.title: Among the Chosen
passages.text: I will have my soldiers honor Krexus as he deserves.

passages.title: Leave Me a Loan
passages.text:
I run a myriad of businesses here. Betting rings, performance enhancers... whatever the customer is willing to purchase. 

However, a few of those customers are late with their payments. And a customer who does not pay is a customer without value.

Please ask them to surrender what they owe. I trust you know what to do if they refuse.

passages.title: Leave Me a Loan
passages.text: Do not try to cheat me out of anything I am owed. I will know.

passages.title: Leave Me a Loan
passages.text: Yes, you are more valuable than I first surmised.

passages.title: Words of the Primus
passages.text:
Even in his absence, the wisdom of the Primus rings true. This message must have been put here to await one who proved worthy of hearing it.

<Draka peers at you.>

You came to Maldraxxus to learn why Bastion was invaded. Now you know that there is treachery in our ranks. And that there are noble souls here who will set things right.

Tell your allies in Oribos all you have witnessed. See that the warning of the Primus reaches the Eternal Ones.

It would be an honor to fight by your side again, <name>.

passages.title: Words of the Primus
passages.text:
I am glad of your return, mortal.

I pray you were successful in preventing the advent of war between Bastion and Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Unshackled Knowledge
passages.text:
These Forsworn are looting the artifacts contained in Kalliope's Rest. What is worse is they have captured many of the shrine's scholars.

I fear they will interrogate these aspirants for knowledge about the artifacts held within the inner chamber of the shrine.

Most escaped with me, but Lano, Eratus, and Tyrana have not returned yet.

passages.title: Unshackled Knowledge
passages.text: We've already treated some of the kyrian you freed. Thank you for your aid, <class>.

passages.title: By Any Other Name
passages.text:
Excellent work, my apprentice! Our laboratory is back in working order!

Now, there is one final ingredient we require to complete our potion for Margrave Stradama.

You will need to run along to the greenhouse. I've cultivated a sprig of dreadshade that should be ready to harvest.

I will prepare the other reagents while you're away. Be safe, apprentice!

passages.title: By Any Other Name
passages.text: Have you found it?

passages.title: By Any Other Name
passages.text: Come, my apprentice! Our efforts nearly bear fruit!

passages.title: Fathomless Power
passages.text:
Forgive me, apprentice... I felt a bit woozy for a moment! But you've done it! You've crafted the potion!

I'm so proud of you. What joy your work brought to our margrave!

What manner of teacher would I be were I to ask for your help and not offer my own in return? If you have research you must conduct, you have my full support!

Let us venture to your laboratory, then. I wait with bated breath to behold your future achievements!

passages.title: Fathomless Power
passages.text: I see you've made a new ally... of a sort. And another rune has been empowered.

passages.title: Daughter of the Night Warrior
passages.text:
In my dreams, I see many things. Elven souls tortured in the Maw. A warrior of the night consumed by vengeance.

And... Ardenweald's destruction.

These visions are ever shifting... ever vague. But I believe Tyrande Whisperwind is key to saving the night elves, as well as this realm.

Shandris Feathermoon, Tyrande's daughter, is touched by dreams as well.

Even now, she travels to the Eternal City. Find her. If anyone can reach the heart of Tyrande, it is her.

passages.title: Daughter of the Night Warrior
passages.text:
I will trust you for now, <name>.

But should you betray me, I will ensure you endure the same torments I do.

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text:
Alaria says that the quilboar kidnapped other members of her expedition.

Chances are we'll have to brave the quilboar's den. That's no small feat. They are far more aggressive and intelligent than the murlocs you faced earlier.

I need to make sure I'm not sending you to your death. We're going to have one last sparring session.

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text: Fine work, <name>. Let's speak with Alaria and hunt down those quilboar.

passages.title: Home of the Tirnenn
passages.text:
The Horned Hunter is no longer here. But I do know where he went.

He tracked his prey to the west of here, in the Elder Stand. These woods in particular have grown dangerous as of late, and we are currently beset by invading devourers.

They have overrun the roads between here and the Stand. I shall accompany you across the bridge, and see that you are delivered to the Horned Hunter.

passages.title: Home of the Tirnenn
passages.text: Now, let us speak of the hunt.

passages.title: Broken Wings
passages.text:
You help me? Really? Wow!

Look at me. What am I?

I have beak. Feathers. Scaly toes. I am bird, yes? 

But birds have wings. And I have arms. Why I not have wings? 

I broken. I can not fly.

Larion nearby, flies so gracefully. I must study her wings up close! 

You help me?

passages.title: Broken Wings
passages.text: If I can study a larion wing, surely I can learn!

passages.title: Broken Wings
passages.text: Perfect! I will examine closely.

passages.title: Feathers of Flight
passages.text:
Now, let us see this next to my arm...

Look! There many long feathers along the edges of the Larion's wing!

And none on mine. This is why I can not fly!

Hmm. It will take lots of flight feathers to give me wings. 

You help?

passages.title: Feathers of Flight
passages.text: Feathers... So many feathers...

passages.title: Feathers of Flight
passages.text: Yes, these are enough feathers to make my arms into wings!

passages.title: Prying Eyes
passages.text:
The Constructs would repurpose the carcass of our necropolis. But we will need its parts for our own ends.

Let us deliver a warning to these scavengers.

Slay the Constructs amid our wreckage. Pluck the eyes from their skulls. Such is our signature.

They will know to fear the darkness once more.

passages.title: Prying Eyes
passages.text: You offer gifts?

passages.title: Prying Eyes
passages.text: I see cowardice in these eyes. You have done well.

passages.title: Special Formula
passages.text:
You may think I'm naturally gassy, but it actually takes a lot of work to build it all up. This is all the result of a nice coating of Pox Nodules.

Help me refresh my coating.

Just get me near the absorbing pox and I'll pull the nodules right off his slimy skin.

passages.title: Special Formula
passages.text: Did you get what he needed?

passages.title: Special Formula
passages.text: He's smelly again? We'll at least he's happy, even if we are not.

passages.title: Sinfall
passages.text:
I knew you could be counted on. Revendreth's revival relies on forging pacts with those outside of our realm. 

The Prince never had any doubt that you would agree to join our cause. He summoned the Court of Harvesters in anticipation of your arrival. 

Renathal awaits you within Sinfall, where you will be presented to the court.

passages.title: Sinfall
passages.text: I never doubted you for a moment, <name>.

passages.title: The Court of Harvesters
passages.text:
Partnerships such as ours will be key to Revendreth's revival. 

As Harvesters, we have the ability to extend our powers to mortals, though the decision must be unanimous. To that extent, the court has gathered and is awaiting your arrival.

Let's not keep them waiting.

passages.title: The Court of Harvesters
passages.text: You will be welcomed by the court, I have no doubt, but first, you must swear an oath before the Harvesters.

passages.title: The Court of Harvesters
passages.text: Welcome to our humble court, <name>.

passages.title: Binding Power
passages.text:
To soulbind with another is not an irrevocable bond. However, it is not to be entered into lightly.

You will experience one another's pasts. Your hopes, fears, dreams, your very memories--if any still linger. You will become kindred spirits in the truest sense.

Once complete, your connection will transcend physical space and make you stronger in more than mere brawn.

passages.title: Strengthening the Bond
passages.text:
Do you feel it, too? Our connection is stronger than I imagined could be possible. 

I have been told that the bond will continue to grow over time, though we do have the ability to accelerate the process. 

Sinfall needs our strength. Perhaps it is best we engage in this method now.

passages.title: Advancing Our Efforts
passages.text:
A venthyr's primary responsibility is ensuring that souls are unburdened of their pride, but they must see to other matters as well. 

We must act beyond the bounds of Revendreth to ensure that the souls of the Shadowlands keep to their fate.

Allow me to demonstrate with a simple task for your companion here. This will be the first of many strikes.

passages.title: Advancing Our Efforts
passages.text: These calculated strikes will further our cause.

passages.title: Advancing Our Efforts
passages.text: The mission will be a complete success, I have no doubt.

passages.title: Sacred Covenant
passages.text:
Our covenant is more than just pacts and promises. We have immense power, too. And that power we shall bestow upon you in a sacred ritual.

Once complete, you will be able to call upon our gifts with ease.

passages.title: Sacred Covenant
passages.text: Welcome, I must admit my eagerness to partake in this monumental occasion.

passages.title: Shared Souls
passages.text:
The power of the Harvesters flows through your mortal body. But you may wield even greater might by binding your soul to another.

Doing so has no known drawbacks, but offers many advantages for both parties involved. 

The Accuser will oversee the process. Meet her at the Forge of Bonds when you are ready.

passages.title: Anima Awakening
passages.text:
This ritual will bestow upon you our gift. 

We will stir the anima within your soul, awakening a power that has only been known to Harvesters. 

It has never been performed on a mortal before, but I have been assured that it won't hurt a bit.

passages.title: Anima Awakening
passages.text: Take your place when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Anima Awakening
passages.text: So long as the pact remains, so shall our power.

passages.title: A Stalwart Ally
passages.text:
We have our work cut out for us, Maw Walker. The Harvesters will not relinquish their power without a fight. 

You will need stalwart allies at your side. Ones that know how battles are fought within the Shadowlands. 

Let me be your guide. Together, we will see Revendreth return to its true purpose.

passages.title: A Stalwart Ally
passages.text: Together we are stronger.

passages.title: In the Ruin of Rebellion
passages.text:
Well, here we are -- Sinfall.

Last I saw, the Master was dragging Prince Renathal and his most loyal followers here in a prison convoy. However, this is a forbidden place, wrapped in rumors and mystery. I heard it was once the workshop of Denathrius, where he performed dark experiments.

Intriguing to be sure, but we are here to find Renathal. Search below, but proceed with caution. I will send word for the Accuser to make her way here with what allies she can muster.

passages.title: In the Ruin of Rebellion
passages.text: Flesh that walks and talks in the Shadowlands. Interesting.

passages.title: In the Ruin of Rebellion
passages.text:
I will sever your head from your body should you...

Wait...

You are still alive? That means you are... the Maw Walker?

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text:
Alaria says that the quilboar kidnapped the rest of the expedition... including my son.

Chances are we'll have to brave the quilboar's den. That's no small feat. They are far more aggressive and intelligent than the murlocs you faced earlier.

I need to make sure I'm not sending you to your death. We're going to have one last sparring session.

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text: Fine work, <name>. Let's speak with Alaria and hunt down those quilboar.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text:
As a hunter, you need a trustworthy beast at your side... or else these quilboar will slaughter you.

When you're ready, I'll teach you how to tame such a beast. Then you must find one to be your loyal companion.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text: I'll teach you how to tame beasts. Then you'll need to choose any animals nearby to tame.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text: You've got a loyal companion by your side. Take good care of them, and they'll take care of you.

passages.title: Kindred Spirits
passages.text:
I have come to the realization that you and I are meant to be the most kindred of spirits. 

Your enduring nature has enraptured me, and I'm afraid I cannot bear to imagine an afterlife without your beguiling presence. 

Let us bind our souls, and forever carry each other in both heart and mind.

passages.title: Kindred Spirits
passages.text: My heart swells, knowing that our souls are bound for all eternity.

passages.title: A Monk's Focus
passages.text:
You fought well against the harpies, but we all need to become stronger to face what lies ahead.

The first step is to find a nice place to meditate and focus yourself.

A monk is only as strong as they are focused.

Come. I know of such a place.

passages.title: A Monk's Focus
passages.text: Let us meditate. I find meditation always helps clear my mind.

passages.title: A Monk's Focus
passages.text: There's something different about you, <name>. Let's see exactly what it is.

passages.title: More Wings!
passages.text:
Idea! Maybe I am too heavy. Maybe need more wings!

Glimmerflies have lovely wings. With correct bait and strong rope, perhaps we can catch.

Please bring Animyllis Blooms. Their nectar is delicious for glimmerflies, and makes them drowsy!

passages.title: More Wings!
passages.text: Animyllis Bloom nectar is a glimmerfly's favorite sleepytime treat!

passages.title: More Wings!
passages.text: I enjoy these blooms. Such a unique odor, yes?

passages.title: One Last Spar
passages.text:
Let us have a quick sparring session before we return to camp, <name>.

I want to see how this island has pushed you to grow.

passages.title: One Last Spar
passages.text: I'm glad to hear you and Kee-La sharpened your skills. We're going to need all our strength to push back the ogres.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text:
Thank you for rescuing me, <name>. Allow me to aid you in your druidic studies.

To escape from the pit, I took on the form of a stag. I may know of a way you can learn to do the same.

Come with me. There is an ancient druid stone nearby. Let us use it to commune with the wilds.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text: Come. The spirits of nature await us.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text:
Good! I can sense the blessing of the spirits flowing through you.

Focus, and you should find that you can take on a new form.

passages.title: Strings and Things
passages.text:
Glimmerflies are creatures of anima. Though they look delicate, they are quite strong!

Filaments from etherwym tails are sturdy. They should help hold onto glimmerflies. 

Collect for me!

passages.title: Strings and Things
passages.text: Etherwyrm Filaments are almost pure anima. Very hard to break!

passages.title: Strings and Things
passages.text:
<Kowalskos pulls on the filaments with all his might>

See? Very strong!

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text:
Ye got some good spells fer a novice mage. Ye might even be as good as I am one day!

But ye don't know Polymorph! How could ye not know that?

Polymorph's one of a mage's most useful spells. I can teach it tae ye, if ye can find me spellbook.

Last I saw, the ogres threw me book in the lake. The LAKE!

Go get me book, and I'll show ye how tae cast Polymorph.

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text: I hope me book isn't too damaged after sittin' at the bottom o' the lake.

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text:
Perfect! Let's see... ah, the page for Polymorph is fine! 

Well, it's missin' a few words, but once ye know the magic ye can skip over most o' this.

Here, I'll teach it tae ye... and I'll show ye how it works!

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text:
I'm not gonna send ye off without showin' ye how tae properly use this spell.

Ye wanna cast Polymorph if ye get yerself into a situation when two foes are fightin' ye at once. 

Cole and I will spar with ye a bit tae make sure ye know what tae do.

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text: And don't ye worry, recruit. Ye won't be turnin' anyone into a sheep permanently!

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text: I think ye got the hang o' it. Cast Polymorph if ye get yerself in over yer head.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text:
By now, most hunters would have been trained in the art of trapping. Allow me to get you up to speed.

We'll start with a freezing trap. In order to make one, you'll have to forage materials from your surroundings.

Meredy can provide you with a mote of ice. Scavenge the area for the rest of what is required.

And don't delay. You will need that freezing trap to deal with a problem that has cropped up within the camp.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text: Did you get the supplies needed? Meredy should have the ice mote, while the other two should be nearby.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text:
With a little work, this can become a trap you can use. 

Part of being a <class> means making use of what your surroundings provide.

passages.title: Your Personal Assistant
passages.text:
Here in Hero's Rest, we have a beacon that is the fastest way to draw the Polemarch's attention.

It has been quite some time since we have used it, and I am afraid that it has fallen into disrepair.

I authorize you to receive a steward companion during your stay here in Bastion.

I will call for some to convene here. You may select one to aid you.

passages.title: Your Personal Assistant
passages.text: Stewards are the force that keep Bastion running.

passages.title: Your Personal Assistant
passages.text: Whenever you need assistance, your steward will be available to provide many services.

passages.title: We Need More Power
passages.text:
Laurent's plan is a bit ambitious. 

Mirrors are most reliable when used to traverse short distances. Traveling to the sanctuary will require a great deal of power, more than he or I have. 

The shrouded have stores of anima in their compound. With enough of it, the mirror should be stable enough to get us where we need to go.

passages.title: We Need More Power
passages.text: Long distance travel requires a great deal of power.

passages.title: We Need More Power
passages.text: Yes, this will do.

passages.title: A Plague on Your House
passages.text:
Though the physical House of Plagues is lost, the knowledge contained within was not. There are survivors here that continue to research and develop new horrifying weapons. 

In time we will restore the house and rise to even greater power, unleashing creations and plagues never before seen upon our enemies!

Perhaps you can help? Speak with survivors and see if any of them can use your aid.

passages.title: A Plague on Your House
passages.text: Have you spoken to anyone?

passages.title: A Plague on Your House
passages.text: Working together will benefit both of us greatly!

passages.title: A Fine Journey
passages.text:
Aspirants new and ancient, take note! The heralded Agthia's Repose calls.

Make the ceremonial journey and learn about the ancient fallen Paragon who saved this very realm!

Find the Repose just a short ride southwest of Hero's Rest.

passages.title: A Fine Journey
passages.text: What brings you to our humble grounds?

passages.title: Enemy at the Door
passages.text:
The remaining houses of Maldraxxus have joined forces against us. Their armies besiege the Seat of the Primus, and our defenses cannot hold forever.

Our reserves have met the enemy in battle. I need you to break the siege.

Report to Heirmir and Marileth. They will give you the means to rain destruction on our foes.

passages.title: Enemy at the Door
passages.text: The enemy is licking their wounds! Our troops will hold the line for now, but we should be prepared for more assaults.

passages.title: Welcome To Our House
passages.text:
Your ties to the other covenants had me doubting you would return. I see now that was foolish of me.

Outsider or not, you have stood bravely beside the armies of Maldraxxus. I am confident the Primus would have welcomed you into our ranks with pride.

One day, he might return as well. But we cannot afford to wait. 

In the Primus's absence, I will name you a Necrolord of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Welcome To Our House
passages.text: There is no greater honor than to defend the Shadowlands as a Necrolord of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Welcome To Our House
passages.text: This is our war to win, Maw Walker. It is now yours, as well.

passages.title: Welcome to Stormwind
passages.text:
Now that we are back in Stormwind, I need to deliver my mission report to King Wrynn.

In the meantime, I've asked Lindie to accompany you around the city. There's a lot to see and do in Stormwind, so feel free to explore at your leisure.

I'll send for you once I've delivered my report to the king.

passages.title: Welcome to Stormwind
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! It's good to see you!

Captain Garrick asked me to show you around the city. I'm so excited!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! Have you decided on a combat specialization yet?

Since you're a <class>, you already know about the different classes available to adventurers. But did you know that there are also areas of specialization within each class?

Choosing a specialization is an important decision. Your specialty determines your combat role in a party, as well as the kinds of weapons and abilities that you will use.

Let's go speak with Dalgrun Steelpine to learn more about specializations!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text: Greetings. Have you come to learn about combat specializations?

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Excellent choice of specialization, <name>.

Feel free to test out your new abilities on the training dummies outside.

passages.title: Collective Soul
passages.text:
Souls in Maldraxxus are bound together in war. We draw strength and wisdom from those around us.

Should you fall in battle, part of you would remain with your fellow soldiers. Just as they would remain with you. 

Plague Deviser Marileth has volunteered to teach you the process of soulbinding. From what I have seen, yours will be a powerful bond.

passages.title: Collective Soul
passages.text: I'm so pleased to see you again, my apprentice!

passages.title: Come On, We're Simpatico!
passages.text:
Soulbinding is a wondrous process! I invite you to bind with me to learn how it works, but in time you might bind with others. 

I have known many soulbinds, but the foremost of them all was Margrave Stradama! Her knowledge, talent and kindness became part of who I am. Now and forever, it is a bond we share.

I only hope to be so useful to you, my apprentice! Bound together, I shall grant you all I can and aid you even when we are apart.

passages.title: Come On, We're Simpatico!
passages.text: Our shared knowledge will benefit all of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Good for the Soul
passages.text:
Two souls are better than one! We can achieve far greater things together than we can if we were alone.

However, it is not just the two of us against all threats. There are many more that will aid us in the coming battles.

Let's speak with Merick to learn more on the subject. Don't be shy--I can introduce you!

passages.title: In Shadowlands Service
passages.text:
As Maldraxxi, we are responsible for ensuring the security of the Shadowlands. 

When enemies emerge, we are the ones who face them!

The threats to the Shadowlands are far more than any one of us can handle. That's where I come in.

I will be your eyes on the field. Allow me to demonstrate with a simple task for Marileth, so that you may both reap the benefits of my services.

passages.title: In Shadowlands Service
passages.text: An easy task to complete.

passages.title: In Shadowlands Service
passages.text: And so, it is as if you had led the battle personally! Impressive work, if I do say so myself.

passages.title: Every Dog Has Its Day
passages.text:
Maw Walker, when I heard you were building constructs and a home for souls still loyal to Maldraxxus, I began my search for you!

I am loyal and have always wanted a construct form, but the Margrave was unwilling to build one that suited my natural inclinations. 

I lived my whole life with the curse, it's all I know, and it's all I still want.

Would you build a construct for me?

passages.title: Every Dog Has Its Day
passages.text: Are you willing to do this?

passages.title: Every Dog Has Its Day
passages.text: I know this soul, she is strong and very loyal. We would be well aided by building this most unusual construct.

passages.title: Army of One
passages.text:
Mevix will lead the attack, but you will finish it. There are no reinforcements, no cavalry.

Only you and your runeblade.

Show me the might you wield, outsider. Lay siege to the House of Constructs and bring them to ruin!

passages.title: Army of One
passages.text: Your voice... you are not one of the Maldraxxi?

passages.title: Breaking a Few Eggs
passages.text:
As you can see, we have a gorm problem.

I'm not sure what has them so riled up. They've been getting bigger, more hostile. It must be due to the anima drought. If nothing stops them, they'll eat everything!

Their egg production is out of control. We can't let their population grow any larger. Please, go in to their nests and destroy as many of their eggs as you can find.

passages.title: Breaking a Few Eggs
passages.text: This should hopefully curtail their numbers. Thank you for your help.

passages.title: Tending to the Tenders
passages.text:
The eggs are a problem, but so are the gorm that take care of them.

The egg-tenders are the leaders of the hive when no matriarch is present. If left unchecked, they will simply produce more eggs and we will be right back where we started. Or worse, one of them could turn into a queen. 

They are simply too large and hostile for us to properly contain. I see no other recourse than to put them down.

passages.title: Tending to the Tenders
passages.text: The population will produce more tenders eventually. You have bought us valuable time.

passages.title: What a Buzzkill
passages.text:
What do you say? Fancy one more hunt?

One of those little flying pests has grown into a very large flying pest. Large, pristine gorm parts are hard to find in the best of times, and a smith always appreciates a challenge.

<Cavina's voice drops as he leans in towards you.> Besides, I'm worried about the safety of my family and the rest of us in the grove.

Bring me the stinger from that big fella and I'll make it worth your while.

Do we have a deal?

passages.title: What a Buzzkill
passages.text: I must say, I am looking forward to the opportunity to working with such a fine specimen.

passages.title: What a Buzzkill
passages.text: Yeah, this is good gorm right here. I'll make you something special from it.

passages.title: The Only Cure
passages.text:
Maldraxxus is on the path to reclaiming its rightful role as defender of the Shadowlands. But the treasonous attack on Bastion remains a stain on our honor.

We had thought Gharmal's forces routed, but we've received word from the Paragon of Courage that reinforcements have begun arriving at her temple.

This threat must be eliminated.

I have volunteered to spearhead this operation. Your support would be an asset, adventurer.

passages.title: The Only Cure
passages.text: Your arrival is expected. We await results.

passages.title: The Nation of Kul Tiras
passages.text:
Kul Tiras is the greatest naval power on Azeroth, and a former member of the Alliance. But we've had little contact with them since Jaina's father, Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, was killed at Theramore.

Many have said that Jaina believed so deeply in the promise of peace between the Alliance and Horde that she betrayed her own father on that day. Perhaps she feels it is time to put the past to rest.

Loathe as I am to put Jaina at risk... Kul Tiras must rejoin the Alliance.

Light be with you.

passages.title: The Nation of Kul Tiras
passages.text: Home again, after all this time.

passages.title: Blinded By The Light
passages.text:
adventurer, Sire Denathrius must be stopped. The anima he is stealing from the Shadowlands is weakening the bonds that seal the Jailer within the Maw. That must not happen.

Time is short so we must strike quickly. I would like for you to head up to the surface, into that accursed Light, and align as many mirrors as you can find to the focusing mirror atop the portcullis.

We will shine a light on Castle Nathria so bright no venthyr will wish to step forth from that fortress to challenge us.

passages.title: Blinded By The Light
passages.text: Hopefully you did not get too scorched out there.

passages.title: Blinded By The Light
passages.text: That should buy us some time and carve us a bit of a path. Now to take advantage of the situation.

passages.title: Death Rains
passages.text:
With its repeated invasions here, the House of Constructs continues to sully the honor of Maldraxxus.

We cannot salvage that honor until justice is done. May we mete it so thoroughly that none will ever attempt this desecration again.

Eliminate these traitors with me, adventurer. Leave none standing.

passages.title: Death Rains
passages.text: See justice done.

passages.title: Death Rains
passages.text: Our will is done.

passages.title: Peace by Piece
passages.text:
These Maldraxxi fiends have reoccupied my temple. They have entrenched this resurgence with shields powered by necromancy.

My disciples--the ones who were not captured and executed by your treacherous compatriots--report the core of a necrotic bulwark to the south. We cannot counter their forces until the shield is brought down.

See it done. I will not tolerate your presence otherwise.

passages.title: Peace by Piece
passages.text: Do not keep me waiting.

passages.title: Peace by Piece
passages.text: We have only just begun.

passages.title: No Hesitation, No Surrender
passages.text:
I cannot fathom where the constructs acquired these reinforcements, but we are once again outnumbered. I seethe at the thought of my fallen disciples.

You will make this right.

The renegades have established a foothold in the northern region of the temple. Their necrotic magic has granted them a shield, defending them from ranged assault. Disable it.

Let nothing impede you. This is the way of Courage.

passages.title: No Hesitation, No Surrender
passages.text: This will begin to set things right.

passages.title: Don't Cross Courage
passages.text:
We have rendered the enemy holdouts defenseless. My disciples will begin preparations to purge the corruption that your errant kind have left on our home.

But more still remain in the inner sanctum of the temple. Their defenses prevent us from flying in en masse, but I can secure a foothold myself. We will cross the breach and annihilate them.

passages.title: Don't Cross Courage
passages.text: We shall not waste time.

passages.title: Don't Cross Courage
passages.text: This is as close as I can take you. Make it count.

passages.title: Well, Tell the Lady
passages.text:
<Thorodir breathes a deep sigh of relief.>

That's that, I'd say. The Banks are largely safe now, thanks to you. We can handle the rest of the cleanup on our own now.

The Lady of the Falls will want to hear of your success here. Why not go tell her the good news?

passages.title: Well, Tell the Lady
passages.text: Ah, that is wonderful news. Thank you for your assistance.

passages.title: Aerial Absolution
passages.text:
My kyrian would have attempted to retaliate by now, but these vile interlopers are a devious sort.

Their necromancers pollute the air, tainting it with foul power that corrodes our very wings.

I cannot advance an assault until they are eradicated. Deal with these befoulers, and I will deliver retribution to the rest.

passages.title: Aerial Absolution
passages.text: Now we are ready.

passages.title: A New Court
passages.text:
My dear adventurer, I have heard a delightful rumor that you are considering hosting a new court in Sinfall.

If that is true, you simply must permit me to recommend staff to help you host a perfect court.

<Theotar pulls long parchments out of his pockets.>

I have been developing ranked lists for every court staff position since the moment I stepped foot in Sinfall.

I do not wish to be a braggart, but courts are kind of my specialty.

passages.title: A New Court
passages.text: This court isn't going to throw itself. Let's get to work!

passages.title: Ember Court Rehearsal
passages.text:
Look, adventurer. Venthyr have been throwing fancy courts for themselves ever since they were created.

It won't always be easy to impress them with our own court.

Don't worry, I've got a plan.

I've scheduled a rehearsal court for us to learn the ropes during a practice run.

You, me, Renathal, and a few socialites from the covenant who are eager to help us succeed.

Relax. It'll be fun!

passages.title: Ember Court Rehearsal
passages.text:
That went surprisingly well, all things considered. You and I have a real knack for this party-planning stuff.

We're ready to prepare our first real Ember Court!

passages.title: A Friendly Rivalry
passages.text:
Ah, a fresh soul! Your perspective may prove useful to us.

Nemea and I have opposing viewpoints. She lauds her larion, creatures native to Bastion whom she raises and trains as her companions.

However, I find that phalynx are the superior beings. They are efficient, obedient, and easy to work with.

Please, come learn both of our ways. Perhaps you can decide which of our ways of life is superior.

passages.title: A Friendly Rivalry
passages.text: I am honored that you came to me first. Allow me to show you my ways.

passages.title: Harvester of Desire
passages.text:
So, here's the sketch: we muck you up to look like one of the servants. This stuff is protected by anti-theft so if 'em clothes think they are being stolen they teleport back here, you an' all.

You "should" be able to reach the Countess with your message. Just smile, nod, do as you're told, don't talk to anyone, and don't make eye contact with anything that's got wings. They'll know you shouldn't be there.

passages.title: Harvester of Desire
passages.text: Still got your head at least. They often try to take that first if they are mad at ya.

passages.title: Harvester of Desire
passages.text:
Ah, the Countess. Mistress of the court. Always assume she is never alone, and always capable of great treachery.

Mmm... treachery...

passages.title: Sustain, In Vain
passages.text:
These turncoats have kept busy. They've opened more portals around the area, allowing themselves to replenish their numbers with little trouble.

Even with her might, the Paragon cannot eliminate an endless army. Let us destroy these portals. Without reinforcements to sustain this contingent, it will surely fall.

passages.title: Sustain, In Vain
passages.text: The time for mercy is behind us.

passages.title: Sustain, In Vain
passages.text: No longer can they sustain themselves. Good work.

passages.title: Wipe the Slate Clean
passages.text:
At last, the skies belong to us once more... and in those skies, the storm of our vengeance brews.

Come, you who claim to be true Maldraxxi. You wish to right the wrongs of those you once called allies?

Rain your justice upon them! Show no quarter!

passages.title: Wipe the Slate Clean
passages.text: For Courage!

passages.title: Common Ground
passages.text:
Now that we have a stronghold from which to operate, we need to begin the next stage of my plan to wrest control of Revendreth from the Master.

We must convince the Court of Harvesters to convene. We must not have them come here, though. It would be suicide.

Go to my old fortress, Darkwall Tower, and place these banners at the four most distant points of the tower. This will ensure the power of the Harvesters and the Master will not be able to interfere with a neutral meeting.

passages.title: Common Ground
passages.text: They may look like simple banners, but with the right words and a few appropriate spells, they turn this place into a temporary sanctuary.

passages.title: Invitation for the Countess
passages.text:
The Countess, Harvester of Desire.

Her wits are sharper than most swords. While I have never seen her carry a weapon, you must assume she is never unprotected.

Her mansion mirrors my own, on the Northeastern side of Castle Nathria. Her dominion was that of the Castle Ward, and it is her authority that keeps the nobles in line.

She will appreciate a secret message. I will send a dredger ahead with a plan to infiltrate her party. Meet him on the Bridge of Temptation. Good luck.

passages.title: Invitation for the Countess
passages.text: Glad you got here before 'em patrols. I ain't got a permit to park here.

passages.title: Invitation for the Tithelord
passages.text:
The Tithelord is a bully and a coward, just like every Harvester of Envy before him.

He is still a force beyond our current reckoning. I have sent Nadjia and Temel to Pridefall Hamlet in the south to ascertain the best, most non-lethal way to reach the Tithelord.

Meet them there and use caution. The Tithelord would kill you in less than the blink of an eye if he thought it would gain him more power or authority.

passages.title: Invitation for the Tithelord
passages.text: Ready to fall with grace?

passages.title: Invitation for the Stonewright
passages.text:
The Medallion of Wrath is in the hands of the Stonewright. She is ancient, powerful, and responsible for creating the Stone Legion.

She is not someone to be subtle with. It is a very dangerous thing to ask, but would you meet with General Draven at the Dominance Gate? 

If we are to see the Stonewright attend, she must know the severity of our request, which means both you and Draven walking right in the front door.

passages.title: Invitation for the Stonewright
passages.text: This will not be an easy day.

passages.title: Afterlife Goes On
passages.text:
A new dawn shines on Bastion. I had my reservations, but you have proven that honor yet remains in Maldraxxus.

Take my hand once more. I will return you to the temple's entrance.

Let all Maldraxxi know of our victory. And for the sake of peace, ensure that this never happens again.

passages.title: Afterlife Goes On
passages.text: May our paths cross again.

passages.title: A Curious Invitation
passages.text:
Psst. You there. Yeah, you.

You that Maw Walker them fangs been going on about? Huh. I figured you'd be bigger.

Anyway, the Taskmaster wants to ahhh ... "extend his compliments and an invitation to visit his workings." That's a fancy word for a bunch of rocks me and my mates are diggin' up.

If you're keen an' all that, pop down to Feeder's Thicket and meet with the fang's courier, Araak. He'll get you sorted right out.

passages.title: A Curious Invitation
passages.text: The Taskmaster don't like waiting.

passages.title: A Curious Invitation
passages.text: Well, looks like the master just left. What timing.

passages.title: The Lay of the Land
passages.text:
So, yeah, not sure why he wants you. Based on a long time working for him, I'm gonna say he wants to use you to do something unsavory to further his interests. But, I'm biased. I could tell you so many stories.

Let's go check on my friend, Nadjia.

passages.title: The Lay of the Land
passages.text: Have you found Taskmaster Matyas's journal yet?

passages.title: The Lay of the Land
passages.text: Appreciate you helping my friend. Keep this up and I'll be in your debt.

passages.title: Active Ingredients
passages.text:
Matyas will be difficult to handle until we can take my sinstone from him. We need something to knock him out. 

Will you fetch a few ingredients for me, mortal? I have a cunning plan.

passages.title: Active Ingredients
passages.text: Do you have the ingredients?

passages.title: Active Ingredients
passages.text: This should be enough to knock him out for long enough to take my sinstone.

passages.title: A Fine Vintage
passages.text:
We will need something special to use as the base of our mixture. To get him to drink it down he will have to believe you've brought him a gift. 

He fancies himself quite the connoisseur. Some ancient and stuffy vintage will tempt him.

Check the old cellar near the ruins. It once held supplies. Perhaps a bottle still lingers in the depths. Araak and I will work out the other details.

passages.title: A Fine Vintage
passages.text: Have you found a suitable beverage?

passages.title: A Fine Vintage
passages.text: Ah, that's perfect. He will not be able to resist this.

passages.title: Message for Matyas
passages.text:
Alright. Everything is prepared. When you are ready, ask Courier Araak to summon Taskmaster Matyas as though you have just arrived.

I am sure a gift of a favorite drink will tempt him and the poison we've concocted will incapacitate him long enough to take my sinstone from him.

Our plan will work flawlessly!

passages.title: Message for Matyas
passages.text: Ah, the Maw Walker! I have heard so much about you.

passages.title: Harvester of Wrath
passages.text:
We walk in the winged shadows of my brothers and sisters in arms, Stoneborn I have trained since they were first carved from stone.

This is an ancient rite. If we cross this bridge on foot, defeating any who would dare stop us, we may have an audience with the mother of the stoneborn. However, know that our safe return is not guaranteed, so try not to offend her.

I do not look forward to this.

passages.title: Harvester of Wrath
passages.text:
I remember when the first stoneborn moved with the breath of anima infused by the Stonewright. 

Never, ever, confuse her sympathy for her creations as a weakness. She holds the Medallion of Wrath for a reason.

passages.title: Becoming the Hunt
passages.text:
<Reldorn grins at you.>

He knew you'd be back! The Horned Hunter went on ahead to prepare the hunting ground. He said you should join him as soon as you can. 

Now that you have the materials for the trap, you just need to reach him...

It's dangerous territory to traverse, but I've been devising a glamour that should help you avoid the attention of the roaming beasts. Maybe if it's useful, you could put in a good word for...

Ahem. Anyway, we should focus on your quarry. Good hunting, friend.

passages.title: Becoming the Hunt
passages.text: You are just in time. My preparations are nearly complete.

passages.title: Grand Theft Necropolis
passages.text:
The necropolis is safe and secure, but we can only maintain a portal to the Seat of the Primus for a short time.

Khaliiq will return with you and work on establishing a permanent portal connection.

passages.title: Grand Theft Necropolis
passages.text: It's like we were never gone.

passages.title: The Field of Honor
passages.text:
Thanks to you, <name>, I am free of Matyas's control for the first time in ... well, a very long time. 

Now, together, we will seek my vengeance. 

I've laid a solemn duty upon you by naming you as my second for this duel. I know not the code in your homelands but in mine, it is your task to secure the field. Matyas and his followers are garrisoned at Witherfall Ruin nearby. Unless I miss my guess, that's where he will have run.

I will prepare for the battle and join you soon.

passages.title: The Field of Honor
passages.text: Well, he's certainly chosen a scenic location for a fight.
