passages.title: Archivist on the Edge
passages.text:
If the curse isn't removed, Qadarin will waste away until nothing is left! 

We used to bind and seal curses just like this all the time, but we haven't had to deal with one in ages. 

Go to Archivist Dreyden at the Grove of Memory. He will know which curse this is and can give you its scroll. 

Bring it back so we can figure out what we need in order to cast a counter-curse.

Hurry, <name>!

passages.title: Archivist on the Edge
passages.text: Please tell me you are here to help with the spriggan problem!

passages.title: An Expected Guest
passages.text:
While we await word from Huln, another matter of importance has arisen.

Bwonsamdi has returned to Ardenweald. Lord Herne believes he is here to request an audience with the Winter Queen.

The loa of death, however, pursues a different purpose. One that I have glimpsed in my dreams.

Meet with Bwonsamdi. Discover what fate has in store for the both of you.

passages.title: An Expected Guest
passages.text: Ol' Bwonsamdi knew ya gonna come see me. I got someting ya wanna hear...

passages.title: Something Extra for the Winter Queen
passages.text:
Ya did good wit' how ya handled Mueh'zala. Me be wantin' ta return da favor. We be friends, after all... riiiight?

Dat nasty loa be at me mercy now. Him been mutterin' about some tings he stole from ya Winter Queen. 

Come along ta me Necropolis. Ya can see what Ol' Bwonsamdi be talkin' about for yaself.

Ya gonna come back with someting nice for her majesty... reeeeeal nice.

passages.title: Something Extra for the Winter Queen
passages.text:
While ya be here, why not help clean up some of da trash outside me Necropolis? For old time's sake, eh?

Den we can be dealin' wit Mueh'zala.

passages.title: The Problem with Containing a Death Loa
passages.text:
Me know Mueh'zala still be hidin' someting. Ol' Bwonsamdi gonna find out what dat be.

But dis old loa's presence be drawin' all da undead in Nazmir ta me doorstep!

Me be needin' some time ta get Mueh'zala talkin'. 

Dere be a troll, Zel'han, leadin' da undead. Kill him and show Mueh'zala him broken armor.

Dat should end any hope he be havin' of escapin'.

passages.title: The Problem with Containing a Death Loa
passages.text: Zel'han be marchin' in here wit ya head. Me gonna enjoy seein' ya soul tortured in da Maw.

passages.title: The Problem with Containing a Death Loa
passages.text: Me got plans older dan you, <race>. Slaying Zel'han mean noting ta me... ya understand?

passages.title: Repair and Restore
passages.text:
You've already attuned several mirrors without incident. I do believe it's time you try your hand at repairing them instead.

It's quite easy once you've found the fragments, but there are a few things of note to keep in mind. 

Repaired mirrors are fragile and unpredictable. They often break with a single use, and it's never a guarantee that using one will translocate you somewhere safe. 

Here's a few shards to get you started. 

Restore the mirror to working order and see where it leads.

passages.title: Repair and Restore
passages.text: I have complete faith in your abilities.

passages.title: Repair and Restore
passages.text: You found a boon? Well done! One never truly knows what awaits beyond the mirror.

passages.title: Dark Mojo for a Dark Loa
passages.text:
How many times must de Necropolis come under attack? I suppose no one ever said worshipping Bwonsamdi would be easy...

Bwonsamdi seeks to force Mueh'zala into revealing his secrets, and I must do my part to help.

De undead swarming de Necropolis are animated by Mueh'zala's dark mojo. 

Bwonsamdi needs some of dat mojo to finish his ritual. Strike down de undead and claim it.

passages.title: Dark Mojo for a Dark Loa
passages.text: You got me dat mojo? I be usin' it ta control Mueh'zala durin' me ritual.

passages.title: Dark Mojo for a Dark Loa
passages.text:
Look at all dis mojo! Dis be just what me need ta make little Mueh'zala talk.

Don't ya be worryin' about da other undead out dere. Ol' Bwonsamdi got a plan for dem.

passages.title: Delaying the Other Side
passages.text:
Many of Bwonsamdi's worshippers did not make it inside when de undead began swarming de Necropolis.

We need a few more of dem to complete Bwonsamdi's ritual to uncover Mueh'zala's plans.

Take dis powder and throw it on de worshippers who are stuck outside. It should dispel de dark magic dat afflicts dem.

As for de ones who are already dead... dey will serve Bwonsamdi beyond de grave. Dat is all we could ever ask for.

passages.title: Delaying the Other Side
passages.text:
Ah good, ya got me all da livin' souls I be needin'.

Don't ya be worryin' about da ones who passed on. Ol' Bwonsamdi not lettin' dem go to da Maw.

passages.title: A Lost Soul
passages.text:
Many of us struggled to free ourselves when Gharmal imprisoned our souls here, but none more than Bacilia.

She was a great champion, but the confinement drove her mad and darkness consumed her soul. Though we tried to reason with her over the course of eons, it is clear that there is no coming back for her.

Please end her misery.

passages.title: A Lost Soul
passages.text: Have you completed this task?

passages.title: A Lost Soul
passages.text: I sense that her suffering has ended.

passages.title: No Peace In Death
passages.text:
<name>. I have a favor to ask, if I may.

This realm... The sense of honor and purpose that guides its denizens calls to me. 

My life was defined by such values. Maldraxxus, for a time, shared them with me... But I returned from the Maw to a land rife with treachery.

I'd like to speak with the Paragon about Bastion.

passages.title: No Peace In Death
passages.text: Come. There is much to show you.

passages.title: How to Get a Head
passages.text:
An eager rookie who wants to be champion of the arena? People love a story like yours, but the first step is to get you noticed. 

Here's the plan. Marcel Mullby needs bloodtusk skulls, but it takes a real fighter to get those!

You go kill some bloodtusks, use my knife to collect their heads, and deliver them to Mullby. That should get you recognition.

passages.title: How to Get a Head
passages.text: You deliver those skulls?

passages.title: How to Get a Head
passages.text: Good work, you're getting some recognition. I hear people talking about how you killed all those bloodtusks!

passages.title: Through the Shattered Sky
passages.text:
When Sylvanas shattered the Helm of Domination, she was touched by the power it released.

I can sense the echoes of that power, and I know where she has gone.

If you wish to rescue your leaders, the shattered helm can open a path. It cannot bring you back, however. That you must do on your own.

The risk is great, <name>, but there is no other way. We will begin the ritual at once.

passages.title: Through the Shattered Sky
passages.text:
Not the most ideal of arrivals, but at least we are still in one piece.

I have not seen any sign of Tyrande. Either she landed elsewhere or continued on without us. We should keep an eye out.

passages.title: A Fractured Blade
passages.text:
The chaotic energies of this place have scattered the Ebon Blade. 

I don't think Azeroth's blessings will reach you here, <class>. We will need allies if we are to survive this place.

We should find them quickly, before they are overcome.

passages.title: A Fractured Blade
passages.text: We have no time for chatter. Let's find those knights!

passages.title: A Fractured Blade
passages.text:
We've been in this place mere moments and already our forces are depleted. It will have to do.

Take this horn. It can be used to call upon the remaining Ebon Blade forces to rally against your foes.

passages.title: Ruiner's End
passages.text:
One of the... larger fiends... has several of our knights engaged...

Hurry to their aid... lest we lose more of our dwindling forces.

Go... it is too late for me...

passages.title: Ruiner's End
passages.text: Our allies fall as you stand idle.

passages.title: Ruiner's End
passages.text:
I am loath to leave some of our knights behind, but it is obvious we cannot stand against such foes. 

We must make sure their sacrifices are not in vain.

passages.title: On Blackened Wings
passages.text:
It's a relief to see friendly faces again. But we have little time for pleasantries.

Thrall is wounded, and we are being hunted by the denizens of this realm. We must seek shelter at once.

Come, I believe I know of a place.

passages.title: On Blackened Wings
passages.text: What are you doing? This is no time for talk!

passages.title: On Blackened Wings
passages.text:
Those images will keep our foes distracted for a time, but they will not give up their pursuit so easily.

We must make haste!

passages.title: A Flight from Darkness
passages.text:
There's a cave not far from here. If we hurry, we can seek refuge.

Those fiends will give chase if they spot us. Be prepared for a fight!

passages.title: A Flight from Darkness
passages.text: This way!

passages.title: A Flight from Darkness
passages.text:
Rest here while you can, <name>.

I will tell you what I know.

passages.title: A Moment's Respite
passages.text:
Anduin insisted that our allies would come for us. I confess I had begun to doubt him.

I'm sure you have many questions. I'll do what I can to provide answers, but I'm afraid even after... 

What has it been... weeks? Longer? Time loses all meaning in a place of such darkness.

Forgive me. Let me tell you what little I can.

passages.title: A Moment's Respite
passages.text: I will tell you what I can.

passages.title: A Moment's Respite
passages.text:
I need time to recover after that battle. Thrall could use rest, too.

While we rest, perhaps you and Mograine can seek answers.

passages.title: Field Seance
passages.text:
If these souls have information we need, we will take it from them.

Even after being shattered by the Banshee, the helm fragment given to you by Bolvar holds the power of Domination. With it, we should be able to take control of the spirits long enough to find out what they know.

They will need to be sufficiently weakened before we can break them. I'm confident you're more than capable of that task.

passages.title: Field Seance
passages.text: Do you wish to speak to me, or to the dead?

passages.title: Field Seance
passages.text:
Useless! These souls are far too fragmented to provide us with anything.

Wait... what is that?

passages.title: Speaking to the Dead
passages.text:
Look over to the ridge. There lies our quarry!

No telling how many souls are writhing together within that amalgam. With any luck, one of them might be coherent enough to give us answers.

passages.title: Speaking to the Dead
passages.text: What are you waiting for?

passages.title: Speaking to the Dead
passages.text:
Find enough mouths and one of them is bound to speak. 

Let's bring this thing back to the cave and find out what it knows.

passages.title: The Lion's Cage
passages.text:
Anduin is being kept in a place the shades call the Tremaculum. It's not far, but the way is perilous.

I have tried more than once to free him from his captors, but the forces holding him are too great for me to handle alone.

I'm counting on your presence to tip the scales.

passages.title: The Lion's Cage
passages.text:
I knew in my heart the Light wouldn't fail us.

Your presence here is the proof.

passages.title: An Undeserved Fate
passages.text:
I have seen many souls brought here during my detention. The Jailer seems to want to break them, to twist them into his service... or worse.

No soul deserves such a fate, <name>.

The Mawsworn here hold the keys to their chains. Free as many as you can and we'll get them away from here.

passages.title: An Undeserved Fate
passages.text: Free those souls, <name>. They should not be bound here.

passages.title: An Undeserved Fate
passages.text:
I knew I could trust you with this task. 

Though we face insurmountable odds, we must try to do what is right.

passages.title: By and Down the River
passages.text:
Our next step is clear. We must travel to Zovaal's Cauldron--a frightful place I've heard spoken of in fanatical whispers. It's a forge of sorts that lies across the River of Souls.

I have only been there a handful of times, but I have seen Baine held captive by the soldiers there. If fortune favors us, he'll still be nearby.

Once he's safe, we can see about finding this waystone the shade spoke of.

passages.title: By and Down the River
passages.text: We must hurry!

passages.title: By and Down the River
passages.text:
The Jailer has Baine!

This is worse than we feared...

passages.title: Wounds Beyond Flesh
passages.text:
Even as Baine's flesh mends, his spirit draws closer to death. I have seen dark magic like this before... among the Shadowmoon clan.

The Jailer's minions must have inflicted a similar malady upon Baine. 

The only cure for the Shadowmoon's curse was to find the object they used to poison the spirit and shatter it.

The sorcerers of this realm wield ornamental daggers. That might be what we're looking for.

We must find the one that they used on Baine--quickly!

passages.title: Wounds Beyond Flesh
passages.text: We can only hope Baine's curse was inflicted by one of the sorcerers here.

passages.title: Wounds Beyond Flesh
passages.text:
We were fortunate to find the sorcerer who poisoned Baine's spirit.

I will need your help breaking its link to the High Chieftain.

passages.title: A Good Axe
passages.text:
I was a damned fool for throwing my axe at that sea hag. We can't afford to lose focus.

The battle ahead won't be easy. I'll need another weapon to help us fight to the waystone.

Looks like these soldiers have plenty of armaments. Let's keep an eye out for one I can use.

passages.title: A Good Axe
passages.text: There should be something I can use around here...

passages.title: A Good Axe
passages.text:
This lacks the balance and craftsmanship of a good Frostwolf axe, but it will have to do.

Let's get moving.

passages.title: The Path to Salvation
passages.text:
We must move quickly if we wish to find the waystone. The soul mentioned it overlooks the Cauldron, which would put it somewhere upon the ridge on the other side.

Unfortunately, this area is swarming with enemy forces. We'd best avoid engaging them, lest we draw the Jailer's attention.

I can shield us from sight, but we all have to stay together.

passages.title: The Path to Salvation
passages.text: Stay close. We cannot risk being seen by the Jailer's forces.

passages.title: The Path to Salvation
passages.text:
We made it! 

If we can activate this waystone, we just might be able to escape this place!

passages.title: Stand as One
passages.text:
<Anduin examines the obelisk intently.>

I've never seen markings like these before. I've studied titan artifacts, but this appears to be made by a different hand. 

Hmm. It doesn't respond to me. I think Jaina's right. The waystone is reacting to your presence.

Perhaps you'll have better luck activating it.

Stay on your guard. The Jailer's forces paid this no mind when it was dormant, but there's no telling what they'll do if that changes.

passages.title: Stand as One
passages.text:
<The waystone appears to be waiting for something.

You reach out and touch its surface...>

passages.title: Research Ruination
passages.text:
The Cult of the Damned continue their work within the halls of Aldur'thar. 

Infiltrate their chambers and destroy their research. It may not stop them, but it will buy us valuable time.

passages.title: Research Ruination
passages.text: Making progress?

passages.title: Research Ruination
passages.text: We will see how long this postpones their efforts.

passages.title: Seek the Ascended
passages.text:
When you arrive in Bastion, seek out one of the kyrian. Explain that you require an audience with the Archon. Like the Arbiter, she is one of the Eternal Ones who rule over the Shadowlands.

If anyone can guide you to the truth, it is the Archon. Perhaps she will even know a way to end this anima drought.

Once you find the answers you seek, you are welcome to return to Oribos.

Purpose guide your path, mortal.

passages.title: Seek the Ascended
passages.text: The way is open again! Archon be praised!

passages.title: Welcome to Eternity
passages.text:
Forgive my reaction. You see, the way from Oribos has been closed for quite some time. We did not know if it would ever open again.

I welcome you, noble soul, to Bastion. Your deeds in life have earned you a most glorious fate! You are to become a kyrian, a winged bearer of the dead.

My name is Kleia. It would be an honor to introduce you to our beautiful realm. There is much you must learn before your journey can begin.

Gather yourself. When you are ready, we will venture on.

passages.title: Welcome to Eternity
passages.text:
The Greeter will soon answer all of your questions. That is its purpose, after all.

<Kleia smiles at you.>

I hope you are excited. I certainly am!

passages.title: From the Mouths of Madness
passages.text:
I cannot express my gratitude enough for your help, champion. 

We mustn't linger, however. The Jailer's forces will soon be alerted to the disturbance here.

Let us leave this place at once!

passages.title: From the Mouths of Madness
passages.text: The fiend is ready to talk. Let's get on with it.

passages.title: From the Mouths of Madness
passages.text:
I cannot say I enjoyed wielding the Helm of Domination. The magic it holds is... unsettling to the dead.

I gladly return it to your care.

passages.title: The Last Guy
passages.text:
You're not the first newcomer wanting to become famous. There've been a lot like you around! 

The last few wanted to prove themselves by killing a giant bloodtusk... none of them ever returned! You want to get recognition?

Go find all those missing newcomers and kill the bloodtusk yourself.

passages.title: The Last Guy
passages.text: Did you prove yourself?

passages.title: The Last Guy
passages.text: Too bad about the last few, but you're still here!

passages.title: The Deathspeaker's Devout
passages.text:
Though Deathspeaker Kharos has long since been slain, the cultists in the nearby mountains continue his nefarious work.

Clearly emboldened by the Scourge's resurgence and the rift in the sky, they once again kidnap our crusaders and perform their abhorrent alchemical experiments.

Go forth and purge those fanatics from their camp.

passages.title: The Deathspeaker's Devout
passages.text:
My, you made quick work of them.

We will continue to monitor the area and report any cultist activity to the justicar.

passages.title: Team Spirit
passages.text:
Even if we're competing against each other, we're all Maldraxxi. That means we cheer on everyone, regardless of which side they're on.

Enter the arena and douse the challengers with the contents of this flask. It may give them the edge they need to survive combat!

passages.title: Team Spirit
passages.text: Nice work firing up the combatants. They'll remember you helped them... if they survive.

passages.title: Take the Power
passages.text:
Wait! Before you enter, I would ask something of you.

While we have not had a wildseed in some time, we did keep stores of anima. It served us well in staving off the gorm.

Whatever has happened to my village, I do not want this power to remain in their hands. It will better serve Ardenweald in other groves.

Keep an eye out for any anima within the village. We will put it to better use elsewhere.

passages.title: Take the Power
passages.text: Were you able to find any anima?

passages.title: Take the Power
passages.text: May this find use in the forest. May their losses not be in vain.

passages.title: The Crumbling Village
passages.text:
This journal belonged to Lewor, the leader of our grove. It says he found something to use against the gorm, but what if it caused all this?

There is only one way to be sure. Come with me to the village. Or what remains of it.

passages.title: The Crumbling Village
passages.text: N-no... the village. They are all....

passages.title: Maw Manifested
passages.text:
Ya heard it from Mueh'zala himself... tanks to ol' Bwonsamdi. Dere be an ancient spirit trapped in da Maw. Me bettin' da Winter Queen gonna want it back.

Good ting ya been goin' down dere yaself, hm? Should be nice an' easy for ya.

Me gonna clean up da rest of da undead here. Meet ol' Bwonsamdi in Ardenweald when ya get back.

passages.title: Maw Manifested
passages.text:
All me trainin' as a shadow hunter been leadin' ta dis moment. 

Trackin' a spirit inside da Maw and savin' dem from eternal torture...

passages.title: On De Other Side
passages.text:
Ay dere, <name>... It be your ol' friend, Bwonsamdi!

I hear ya be workin' for da Winter Queen. Seems ya be makin' quite a name for yaself!

Ardenweald be in grave danger, but da Queen... well, she be too proud to deal with ol' Bwonsamdi.

Ya wanna save da forest, mon? Come visit me on da Other Side.

I gonna be waitin' for ya...

passages.title: On De Other Side
passages.text:
Welcome to da Other Side!

What ya tink, mon? Ya like what I done wit' da place?

passages.title: Taking Inventory
passages.text:
Dark forces be at work, <class>. 

Ardenweald be where loa go ta be reborn after dey die on Azeroth. But some of da loa who be sleepin' in Ardenweald have gone missin'!

Gotta be someone powerful behind it, takin' dem from right under da Winter Queen...

Ol' Bwonsamdi can't be havin' loa vanishin' from Ardenweald. Dat could be me someday! No, no... we gonna put a stop to dis!

Go back ta Ardenweald and search for da missin' loa.

passages.title: Taking Inventory
passages.text: Dark forces be at work in Ardenweald...

passages.title: Taking Inventory
passages.text: So Hakkar and Dambala be da ones gone missing? Hmm... we'd better find out where dey went!

passages.title: Following the Trail
passages.text:
I got a bad feelin' about dis, mon.

Wildseeds don't just go missing... especially da kind wit' powerful loa in dem! Even da bad eggs like Hakkar and Dambala be protected by da Winter Queen. Someone... or someting... must be stealin' dem!

But why? Dey weren't even ready ta be reborn...

Search da area and see if ya can pick up da trail. Missing loa be bad for business... and Bwonsamdi be in enough trouble wit' da boss already!

passages.title: Following the Trail
passages.text: Hakkar and Dambala both gone missin' at da same time? Oh, I got a bad feelin' about dis...

passages.title: Following the Trail
passages.text: Da tracks lead into da grove up ahead. I got a feelin' Hakkar and Dambala be somewhere nearby...

passages.title: Minions of Mueh'zala
passages.text:
Dese all be followers of Mueh'zala! Me shoulda known he be da one behind it all.

Mueh'zala be da loa of death from long ago. It be him who raised up Ol' Bwonsamdi, him who made me a loa.

Dat be before his worshippers started turnin' away from him. He always been a greedy one... but dis...

Mueh'zala be goin' too far dis time! We gotta stop him, or he gonna take all da loa in Ardenweald!

passages.title: Minions of Mueh'zala
passages.text: Mueh'zala be goin' too far dis time!

passages.title: Minions of Mueh'zala
passages.text: Ya did good! But dis be far from over...

passages.title: Stolen Loa
passages.text:
Hakkar and Dambala be somewhere in da grove.

We need ta hurry and find out what Mueh'zala be up to. Dem two loa been mighty powerful on Azeroth... powerful and evil. Who knows what Mueh'zala be plannin' for dem!

Search da Spirit Glen. Find da missing loa and see what Mueh'zala be meanin' ta do!

passages.title: Stolen Loa
passages.text: We gotta know what be happenin' ta da missin' loa!

passages.title: Stolen Loa
passages.text:
It all be makin' sense now. Mueh'zala be draining anima outta da other wildseeds so he can be wakin' Dambala and Hakkar before their time.

Da Winter Queen gotta be told 'bout dis before it too late...

passages.title: Gathering The Hunt
passages.text:
Loath as I am to aid Bwonsamdi, Mueh'zala must be made to answer for his crimes.

We will eradicate his worshippers and drive them from the forest before they cause more harm.

Rally the groves and muster the Wild Hunt. Ardenweald has need of its protectors.

Make haste, <huntsman/huntress>.

passages.title: Gathering The Hunt
passages.text: You're just in time. The Wild Hunt is locked in battle with Mueh'zala's forces.

passages.title: Cleansing the Forest
passages.text:
The Winter Queen has commanded us to drive Mueh'zala's forces out of Ardenweald.

This won't be an easy battle. The death loa's army is strong, and several of our hunters have been gravely injured.

Can we count on you to turn the tide in our favor, <name>?

Aid our fallen allies and vanquish Mueh'zala's minions!

passages.title: Cleansing the Forest
passages.text: The fight is far from over.

passages.title: Cleansing the Forest
passages.text: The Wild Hunt can handle pushing the rest of them out of the forest. Well done, <name>!

passages.title: Report to the Queen
passages.text:
Mueh'zala's forces are routed, and it's only a matter of time before the Wild Hunt completely purges them from Ardenweald.

But something tells me that the struggle between Bwonsamdi and Mueh'zala is far from over. That creepy little mask has gone silent...

You should hurry back to the Heart of the Forest and report to the Winter Queen. She will decide what we do next.

passages.title: Report to the Queen
passages.text: Welcome news, indeed. I will not soon forget Mueh'zala's transgressions.

passages.title: Tracking a Wild God
passages.text:
Dis be a dark place, <name>. We gotta track down da spirit who be trapped here.

Me tink me can pick up its trail... but dat be all dis ol' shadow hunter can do.

If me be tryin' ta fight wit' ya, da threads dat be tyin' me ta Azeroth might break. Den I gonna be stuck here, too.

C'mon. We best be moving.

passages.title: Tracking a Wild God
passages.text: We ain't done wit' dis place yet. Dere be loa trapped here!

passages.title: Loa Rescue
passages.text:
We be here for Ashamane, but me sensin' loa bein' tortured up ahead. Three of dem, if me be right.

Me don't know who dey be, but dey don't belong in da Maw.

We need ta be bringin' dem back ta Ardenweald, too!

passages.title: Loa Rescue
passages.text: Rezan be needin' us!

passages.title: Bet On Yourself
passages.text:
Dear Maw Walker... my friend... you're going to lose. Everyone knows you can't compete in the arena. 

The entire Challenger's Promenade knows it, the brokers in Oribos know it, even Zo'umlo knows it.

I've brought in a special challenger just to prove the point. Face Ti'or in the Theater of Pain and prove us wrong... or prove us right.

We will be betting, so don't disappoint.

passages.title: Bet On Yourself
passages.text: What did you prove?

passages.title: Bet On Yourself
passages.text: Your performance has netted me a nice profit... Zo'umlo bet poorly.

passages.title: Working for the Living
passages.text:
I see you are wondering where we acquire all of the challengers we supply to this arena.

We scour countless realms in search of opponents to provide the Maldraxxi with firsthand combat experience. 

Currently, I am in the process of procuring a new combatant--and with it, a lucrative betting opportunity. 

Would you make use of our portal and assist Zo'umlo in capturing Khogov the Expunger? You will be appropriately compensated, of course.

passages.title: Working for the Living
passages.text: Have you successfully captured Khogov the Expunger?

passages.title: Working for the Living
passages.text: Competing in the arena is but one way to contribute to this venture. There are many other tasks to perform, as well.

passages.title: Scourge War Machines
passages.text:
The Scourge's war machines make it exceedingly difficult for us to gain ground. They must be our top priority.

Though they are well protected, we must destroy them if we are to clear a path for our ground forces and grant them an opportunity to strike.

Plant these charges underneath the war machines and then clear the area.

passages.title: Scourge War Machines
passages.text:
A job well done, <name>.

Now our forces can advance without worrying about the enemy's weaponry.

passages.title: Divine Gratitude
Defending the Rampart
passages.text:
The Scourge are assaulting our outpost! We must defend it at all costs!

Slay as many of the fiends as you can!

passages.title: Frozen Solid
passages.text:
The breath of a frost wyrm can freeze even its largest foes in an instant. Our forces, unfortunately, have experienced this firsthand.

Their advance toward the citadel has come to a halt. I fear we may lose our foothold unless we act quickly.

Take this potion and use it to free our forces from their frigid bonds. Light be with you.

passages.title: Frozen Solid
passages.text: Always keep an eye to the sky.

passages.title: Frozen Solid
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. We will see to it they recover in safety.

passages.title: Rezan, Loa of Kings
passages.text:
Rezan be a powerful loa, one of great importance ta da Zandalari.

We need ta rescue him... but dis creature be projectin' a barrier of death. Notin' be gettin' in.

Unless... I be usin' me own anima ta shield ya from its magic.

Ya gotta act fast and kill da monster dat be drainin' Rezan. Me anima not gonna last forever.

Say da word when ya ready ta go.

passages.title: Rezan, Loa of Kings
passages.text: We need ta save Rezan!

passages.title: Rezan, Loa of Kings
passages.text:
Me be feelin' Rezan's essence inside of me... he be trustin' me wit' a great gift.

No matter what be comin' next, me not gonna let him down.

passages.title: A Savior for Lost Souls
passages.text:
The forest sighs in greeting, Maw Walker.

Your arrival was written in the stars, and awaited by the boughs. Now our work begins. 

Let us proceed.

Follow this path into the grove.

These are but the first steps on our journey together.

passages.title: A Savior for Lost Souls
passages.text: Our paths converge. Together we walk.

passages.title: A Savior for Lost Souls
passages.text:
Your presence warms the grove.

Now we learn, and grow.

passages.title: Glimmerflight
passages.text:
This so exciting!

Come, another test is in order. I can hardly wait!

passages.title: Glimmerflight
passages.text:
I did it! I flew!

I have adjustments I can make. Here, take these glimmerflies as thanks. I will collect more!

passages.title: WANTED: Appraiser Vix
passages.text:
For failure to pay debts upon lost wagers, theft of arena property, and for the slaughter of an authorized debt collector. All necessary violence is hereby sanctioned when confronting Vix.

Special warning to be on the lookout for numerous associates who have demonstrated a violent attitude toward outsiders.

Elimination of this felon is of the highest priority.

passages.title: WANTED: Appraiser Vix
passages.text: Eliminate Appraiser Vix.

passages.title: WANTED: Appraiser Vix
passages.text: Excellent work, Maw Walker. I shall dispatch Zo'umlo to retrieve our stolen property.

passages.title: Offer of Freedom
passages.text:
Just as I was, some of the Briarbane venthyr you encounter will have been compelled to serve Matyas. They likely will not want to fight you, but will have no choice. Once they are injured, they may be willing to pause to see if one of the sinstones you recovered earlier is theirs.

Free those you can. The use of a sinstone to compel others isn't fair.

passages.title: Offer of Freedom
passages.text: Have you released the compelled venthyr?

passages.title: Offer of Freedom
passages.text: You've made some friends today.

passages.title: Catalyze This
passages.text:
The grove grows in power, and so shall the spirits it shelters.

You have nurtured a spirit to rebirth on your own. Now you must learn to make use of catalysts.

When planted near a wildseed, catalysts grant the slumbering spirit strength beyond what it knew in life. Strength that it retains when reborn.

Catalysts are special and rare, though I have one here for you to use. Others can be found across the Shadowlands.

For now, plant the catalyst and witness the potential it holds.

passages.title: Catalyze This
passages.text: Nature holds as many secrets as it does gifts.

passages.title: How to Save a God
passages.text:
Many mortal souls suffer within the Maw. But so too do many spirits of Nature.

Anima alone cannot heal wounds inflicted by the Jailer. Spirits plucked from his grasp must be planted anew and tended with care.

These wildseeds are unlike any other. This grove, unlike any other. Within them lies dormant hope, a chance for even the weakest spirit to be reborn.

One such as this. Lay this spirit to rest within a wildseed. Let its rebirth begin.

passages.title: How to Save a God
passages.text: Let fate and compassion guide your hand.

passages.title: How to Save a God
passages.text: Your skills take root, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Greeting a God
passages.text:
Soon, the moment of the spirit's rebirth will be nigh. A fate all but extinguished by the Maw, rekindled by grove and caretaker.

Time will be the spirit's salve. Once enough of it has passed, lay your hands upon the wildseed and awaken them.

passages.title: Greeting a God
passages.text: Patience is the way of the forest.

passages.title: Greeting a God
passages.text:
And so a god is reborn by the hand of a mortal.

They greeted you with gratitude, yes? And perhaps surprise, as well.

passages.title: The Maw
passages.text:
adventurer, your arrival has set Maldraxxus ablaze. If you have any honor, you will do as I ask.

I believe I know where our answers may lie. The baron preceding Draka was lost to the Maw. It is said you have entered that dark abyss... and returned.

If the baron survived, he may know our next course of action.

You came here from Oribos. Return there, and see if you can find a way back to the Maw.

passages.title: The Maw
passages.text: What news from Maldraxxus, <name>?

passages.title: Too Many Whelps
passages.text:
We cannot hope to hold this ground if frostwyrms strafe the skies above us.

Cultists have been raising whelps from the dead nearby. The more of them we eliminate, the fewer monstrosities to breath deadly ice upon our forces.

Put an end to their efforts.

passages.title: Too Many Whelps
passages.text: A job well done, <name>. That should grant us a brief respite.

passages.title: This Thing of Ours
passages.text:
Au'narim is the top broker here. She keeps this place supplied with exotic creatures for us to fight in the arena. 

She's noticed your efforts and wants to meet you!

This is important. A broker's backing could lead to an invitation to compete!

passages.title: This Thing of Ours
passages.text: You must be one of these outsiders I hear so much about.

passages.title: Sure Bet
passages.text:
You appear to have great profit potential.

There are many interested parties willing to bet upon your performance in the Theater of Pain.

Go now, Louison will arrange your appearance.

passages.title: Seeking the Baron
passages.text:
Take this amulet. One like it is carried by each of the Four Horsemen.

The amulets are imbued with a power that links them to one another. That connection should help you locate Darion Mograine.

No doubt Darion has witnessed countless horrors in the Maw. Perhaps he has caught sight of the missing baron.

Let us hope he can lead you to our Azerothian allies as well.

passages.title: Mawsworn Menace
passages.text:
Our knights are strong, but they don't stand much chance scattered against such an opponent.

We need to thin the ranks of our foe. The Ebon Blade won't do us any good if they are cut down.

passages.title: Mawsworn Menace
passages.text: Let your blade do the talking!

passages.title: Mawsworn Menace
passages.text:
Our enemy is relentless, but we will continue to drive them back.

Stand vigilant, <class>.

passages.title: Fight and Flight
passages.text:
Mograine and Emeni will lead the assault on the western gate. 

You and Xandria will advance from the east. Secure the area and slay all who oppose you. 

Once we have them surrounded, we can strike the final blow against Gharmal.

passages.title: Fight and Flight
passages.text: This place is mired with atrocities. They must be purged.

passages.title: [OLD NOT USED]
passages.text:
Now that you have seen the basics it is time for us to expand your understanding.

I hope your little mind will be able to hold this information.

You seem capable so far, but you are so small. I'll be intrigued to see if you are bigger on the inside.

First. You need to learn more about the catalysts. There should be a small number growing in this very grove. Fetch me some and I can explain what they are.

passages.title: Fear to Tread
passages.text:
It appears we've escaped our enemies' notice for the moment. We should take the opportunity to scout the nearby area for signs of our allies.

We will draw less attention alone. The Ebon Blade will hold back, awaiting my signal.

Come, let us see what awaits us in this hellscape.

passages.title: Fear to Tread
passages.text: Champion? Tell me this is not an illusion.

passages.title: Fear to Tread
passages.text:
Praise the Light! I... I'd almost given up hope.

<Jaina looks upon the Ebon Blade knights.> 

Is this... all that remains of your forces?

passages.title: Soul in Hand
passages.text:
My instincts were correct. Whatever dark magic binds these souls together also keeps them more or less coherent.

It will take time, but we will find out what this thing knows. My interrogation will require use of the helm, but rest assured I will return it to your care.

Let's bring our prize to the Lord Admiral.

passages.title: Soul in Hand
passages.text:
It seems your search was a success.

Enough rest. There's much to be done.

passages.title: The Butchers of Bastion
passages.text:
Did these fiends show my kin mercy when they attacked Bastion? When they tore my brothers and sisters limb from limb and used them to create more of these... these monstrosities?!

No! The butchers of Bastion made clear their hearts that day!

They deserve only the eternal darkness that awaits them. Ensure that they meet it!

passages.title: The Butchers of Bastion
passages.text: This bloodshed will not bring them back... but it may spare others from the same fate.

passages.title: Kill Them, Of Course
passages.text:
These mindless monstrosities hail from the farthest reaches of the Shadowlands. The anima drought has fueled their relentless hunger, driving them to seek new sources.

Their presence here is inconvenient, to put it mildly.

They tear at the land searching for any anima they can find. We must thin their numbers and buy time to safeguard the knowledge locked within the Sepulcher.

Exactly the sort of work you're accustomed to, yes?

passages.title: Kill Them, Of Course
passages.text: How did the hunting go?

passages.title: Kill Them, Of Course
passages.text: Nicely done. You've bought us precious time.

passages.title: An Earned Bond
passages.text:
There is one more thing you should do, Maw Walker.

In rebuilding the Crest of Ascension you have earned more than just the trust of your fellow kyrian. It would seem our Forgelite Prime, Mikanikos, has rather enjoyed your time together and would like to soulbind with you.

Given his predilection towards, well, himself, I am as surprised as you are. You must have truly impressed him.

passages.title: An Earned Bond
passages.text: This is a moment to remember.

passages.title: An Earned Bond
passages.text: Never in all my millennia did I think I would see the day a steward would soulbind with an outsider. Times are certainly changing, are they not?

passages.title: Light the Forge, Forgelite
passages.text:
I think we have the materials I will need to light the forge, at long last.

I am afraid the place is in a state of disrepair. Between failed attempts at working without anima and simple neglect, I cannot hope to work the forge as it currently stands.

I would very much appreciate your help to get the place in order while I coax the forge to life once more.

passages.title: Light the Forge, Forgelite
passages.text: I am deeply grateful for your help. Now I can practice my craft again!

passages.title: All I Ever Will Be
passages.text:
This is the site of an ancient battle won by the previous Paragon of Courage. She sacrificed herself to serve the Shadowlands. I only hope my own end will prove as exemplary.

Many of my disciples meditate upon the scrolls here. With them, we remember the foundation of our courage.

Accompany Alexandros as he reflects on his shrines. Aid him in understanding where the source of his courage lies.

He will learn that this afterlife is not the one suited for him.

passages.title: All I Ever Will Be
passages.text: What have you learned?

passages.title: All I Ever Will Be
passages.text: Did this venture enlighten you?

passages.title: Do Not Forget
passages.text:
The Arbiter's judgment was, as always, infallible.

Though Alexandros's devotion to the Light is undeniable, it is the memory of his loved ones that truly fuels his strength. He was meant for Maldraxxus, not Bastion.

Nonetheless, our reclamation of the temple stands. My vengeance is not yet complete, but now I know that some of the Maldraxxi can still be trusted.

Go now. Return to your leader with news of our victory today.

And tomorrow, we shall purge our foes once and for all.

passages.title: Do Not Forget
passages.text: So we have proven our honor... and gained a new ally.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text:
We're nearing the island where the Horde's last expedition was lost. 

You need to be prepared for what's out there. Warm up on these combat dummies.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text: Do not bother me! Go and attack those combat dummies. Show me your power.

passages.title: Warming Up
passages.text:
Good, you've kept training since we set sail.

I need to speak with the crew about this storm. 

Spar with Throg. He will assess your skills and decide on your role once we make landfall.

passages.title: Stand Your Ground
passages.text:
Lok-tar! Nothing quite like a good fight in the rain. 

We will spar together and take the measure of your strength!

passages.title: Stand Your Ground
passages.text: You show promise, <class>. Perhaps you too will find glory on the island!

passages.title: Brace for Impact
passages.text:
Well fought, <name>. You bring strength and honor to the Horde!

Now we just--wait...

Do you hear that?

passages.title: Brace for Impact
passages.text:
This ship won't make it to the island in one piece.

Hold on to something, and pray that the elements will spare us from a grim death at sea.

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text:
The shore is littered with shipwrecks. This must be where the lost expedition crashed.

We'll need more supplies to help the injured recover. The nearby murlocs stole most of what washed up.

Slay those murlocs to get back what belongs to the Horde.

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text: The murlocs are carrying our first aid kits. Slay them and bring all of the kits to me.

passages.title: Murloc Mania
passages.text: Excellent work. Let's get the survivors back on their feet.

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text:
We must treat our wounded before we can begin for the missing expedition.

Take this first aid kit and tend to the survivors. I'll handle the others nearby.

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text: Use your first aid kit to help the others.

passages.title: Emergency First Aid
passages.text: We're back on our feet. Now let's move. The lost expedition is somewhere on this island.

passages.title: Finding the Lost Expedition
passages.text:
Breka Grimaxe went north to look for survivors. Join her to see what she's found.

I'm going to go up ahead to see if I can find anyone else. We'll meet again further within the island.

passages.title: Finding the Lost Expedition
passages.text:
So... hungry...

Dey took... everyone else... I be... da last one...

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text:
Won'sa said the quilboar have kidnapped the missing expedition.

The quilboar will kill you if you're not prepared. They're much smarter and deadlier than murlocs.

I won't see you die by their hands. We're going to spar one last time.

When we are done, you will cleave a path straight through the quilboar!

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text: You're ready to slaughter the quilboar! Let's speak to Won'sa and see what she knows.

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text:
Won'sa said the quilboar have kidnapped the missing expedition... including my daughter.

The quilboar will kill you if you're not prepared. They're much smarter and deadlier than murlocs.

I won't see you die by their hands. We're going to spar one last time.

When we are done, you will cleave a path straight through the quilboar!

passages.title: Enhanced Combat Tactics
passages.text: You're ready to slaughter the quilboar! Let's speak to Won'sa and see what she knows.

passages.title: Northbound
passages.text:
Da quilboar kidnapped da rest of da expedition and took dem north.

Dey said dey gonna use da expedition for some sorta sacrifice! 

Ya gotta head north as fast as ya can ta stop dem!

passages.title: Northbound
passages.text: I have good news... and most unfortunate news.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text:
A hunter like yourself needs a good pet by your side. Did you not bring one with you?

Hmm. I suppose I shall have to compensate for your lack of training.

Listen closely and learn quickly. I will teach you how to tame a beast and make it your pet.

You will need one if you are to fight the quilboar.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text: I will teach you how to tame beasts. Then, you will need to tame any of the surrounding wildlife.

passages.title: Taming the Wilds
passages.text:
Fine work. The lessons you learn from the inimitable Mithdran Dawntracker will last you a lifetime.

Now, down to the business of our quilboar foes...

passages.title: Down with the Quilboar
passages.text:
I have discovered that the quilboar are performing a shadow ritual on a survivor from the missing expedition.

The ritual is being performed by the tribe's leader, Geolord Grek'og. 

Slay Grek'og and save the survivor.

Show this brute that the Horde is not to be trifled with.

passages.title: Down with the Quilboar
passages.text:
You sure got some guts! I respect that. I joined this expedition thinkin' it'd be a quick and easy way to make a little profit.

But now with all this necromancy and crazy ogres... maybe I can make a LOT of profit!

passages.title: The Choppy Booster Mk. 5
passages.text:
You're in luck, 'cause I'm the ONE goblin who can help you find the rest of the expedition!

Feast your eyes on this fancy device here. Stole it off a gnome, improved on it, and made it my own!

I call it the Choppy Booster Mk. 5. Use it to find Shuja and the others.

passages.title: The Choppy Booster Mk. 5
passages.text: Why are you gabbing at me? Hop on the Choppy Booster Mk. 5 and get going!

passages.title: The Choppy Booster Mk. 5
passages.text: All right, time to bend some rules and make a giant boar!

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text:
I call this gadget "the Re-Sizer." It's what I used to unshrink the Choppy Booster Mk. 5.

Look, I'm gonna be honest. I got, at best, a passing understandin' of how this thing works.

That means I'm gonna be pushing a lot of buttons to see what happens.

I'm sure we'll figure out how to upsize one of these boars. Then we'll use it to trample those undead goons!

You hold the Re-Sizer while I fiddle with it. Then just press the button and, uh... hope for the best?

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text: Just don't point the Re-Sizer at me, okay? Use it on the boars.

passages.title: Re-sizing the Situation
passages.text:
So the giant boar was a fool's errand, and you turned the device into a weapon instead?

Good work. Let's see if you can pull this off.

passages.title: The Harpy Problem
passages.text:
The ogres are planning to sacrifice the rest of the expedition to fuel this ritual to control Kalecgos, leader of the blue dragonflight.

It seems one of the survivors was taken to the hills north of here. Bo scouted ahead to investigate.

Come, we'll see what he has found.

passages.title: The Harpy Problem
passages.text: I have found the missing member of the expedition... but we have many problems to deal with first.

passages.title: The Rescue of Herbert Gloomburst
passages.text:
The harpies plan to sacrifice the expedition's mage, a Forsaken by the name of Herbert Gloomburst.

Herbert's ethics are... questionable, but he always strives to serve the Horde. We'll need his magic to stop the ogres.

Let's move.

passages.title: The Rescue of Herbert Gloomburst
passages.text:
Thanks for the save! They must be desperate for sacrifices if they wanted to use someone who's already dead.

If anyone is going to drain my life essence to use in a forbidden ritual, it's going to be me!

passages.title: Harpy Culling
passages.text:
The harpies seem to be in league with the ogres. Many of them are gathering to attack our camp.

We must thin their numbers and thwart their attempts to eliminate us.

Perhaps they will learn it is best to leave the Horde be.

passages.title: Harpy Culling
passages.text: The harpies seem to be retreating to their roost. That should give us time to stop the ogres.

passages.title: Westward Bound
passages.text:
Thrall wants us to search west of here for the site of the next ritual.

We could use your help. I've already died once. It's not an experience I'd care to repeat.

passages.title: Westward Bound
passages.text:
A giant pit filled with necrotic energy and spiders.

I used to hate spiders. Now that I'm Forsaken, I don't think they're all that bad.

They will still definitely kill you, though.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text:
Thank you for rescuing me, <name>. Allow me to aid you in your druidic studies.

To escape from the pit, I took on the form of a stag. I may know of a way you can learn to do the same.

Come with me. There is an ancient druid stone nearby. Let us use it to commune with the wilds.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text: Come. We have no time to lose.

passages.title: A Druid's Form
passages.text:
Good! I can sense the blessing of the spirits flowing through you.

Focus, and you should find that you can take on a new form.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text:
If you want to be called a true hunter, you'll need to learn the art of trapping.

Fortunately, I happen to be an expert in it.

First, you will need to gather supplies from the surrounding area so you can fashion a proper freezing trap.

Herbert can supply you with a mote of ice. Scavenge the area for other materials.

You will need the trap to handle another issue that has recently arisen.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text: Did you acquire the necessary supplies? Herbert should have the ice mote, while the other two should be nearby.

passages.title: A Hunter's Trap
passages.text:
With a little work, this can become an effective trap.

Part of what makes a real <class> is the resourcefulness to use what your environment provides.

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text:
You've got some good spells for a novice mage. There are a few things holding you back, though.

For instance, it's absolutely clear to me you don't know Polymorph.

If you did, you would've been using it on the harpies that were attacking us!

Let's fix that. My spellbook has details on how to cast it... but my captors threw it into the nearby lake. 

Grab it for me, would you? Oh, and don't look through the book beforehand.

You will almost certainly regret it if you do.

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text: Hopefully my book isn't too damaged from sitting at the bottom of the lake.

passages.title: A Mage's Knowledge
passages.text:
Perfect! The page for Polymorph is smudged, but a little guesswork never stopped me from figuring out a spell.

It'll be quick for me to show you how to cast this properly.

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text:
I can't send you off without making sure you can cast Polymorph correctly.

Why, if you messed it up you may transform someone into something completely different!

I want to make sure I'm around to take notes if that happens.

Let's see... ah, Throg will do nicely! I can spot a prime test subject from a mile away.

Shall we begin?

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text: This will be so exciting! Let me know when you're ready to test polymorph.

passages.title: The Best Way to Use Sheep
passages.text: You've got the hang of Polymorph. Make sure to use it whenever you're faced with more than one foe!

passages.title: A Monk's Focus
passages.text:
You fought well against the harpies, but you'll need even more skill to best the challenges ahead.

We must meditate and focus if we are to gain more strength.

Come. I know of a place we can go.

passages.title: A Monk's Focus
passages.text: I can sense a change within you, <name>. Let's see what it is.

passages.title: One Last Spar
passages.text:
Let's have a quick sparring session before returning to camp.

I can sense new power rising from within you. I want to see it in action!

passages.title: One Last Spar
passages.text: You look stronger! Good. We'll need such strength if we're to crush these ogres.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text:
While you were destroying that army of the undead, the ghost of a paladin approached me... and asked for you!

They floated over to the ruins nearby.

You should see what this ghost wants. I do not know much about the Light... but I know not to ignore a ghost.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. It is good to finally see you.

passages.title: A Paladin's Service
passages.text:
Those who serve the Light will know its blessing. Accept this gift, <class>.

Call upon it when your strength fails and when hope seems lost. The Light will protect you from harm.

passages.title: The Brand Holds the Key
passages.text:
<Darion is unresponsive. The cage is locked, and doesn't appear easily broken.

Perhaps the holder of the key is this "Brand" he mentioned.>

passages.title: The Brand Holds the Key
passages.text: Are you willing to listen to my proposition?

passages.title: The Brand Holds the Key
passages.text:
My, my. Today certainly has been full of surprises!

Now, mortal, I'm curious what has brought you back to the Maw.

passages.title: A Cooling Trail
passages.text:
<The amulet burns hot in your hand. The magic that runs through it tugs slightly at your grip.

Perhaps the enchantment spoken of by Bolvar can now be used to find Mograine.>

passages.title: A Cooling Trail
passages.text: <Darion is trapped within the cage. He appears unconscious.>

passages.title: A Priest's End
passages.text:
You're a trained priest, right <name>? I have a grim request for you.

I passed by some injured members of the first expedition. I did what I could... but they were too far gone.

Can you perform a ritual to lay them to rest? 

Their spirits deserve to rest with honor.

passages.title: A Priest's End
passages.text:
Dere be no time ta talk. Dese recruits barely be alive!

I gonna teach ya how ta cast resurrection. It be da only ting dat can bring dem back.

Ya best be a wise <class>, 'cause dis be a powerful spell ta be knowin'.

passages.title: Hope Never Dies
passages.text:
So, mortal, you are here looking for someone. Well it just so happens that, clever as I am, it's quite possible I know where they are.

Allow me to propose a trade. That amulet you carry... it holds an interesting power.

You give me the amulet, and I will help you find this Maldraxxi baron.

And then you will leave. I don't mean to be rude, but I really prefer to keep a low profile.

Allow me to speed things along.

passages.title: Hope Never Dies
passages.text: Keep up. We have little time.

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text:
Ya gotta cast Resurrection on dese recruits ta be savin' dem.

Da necrotic magic of dis place be tuggin' at deir souls.

Quickly, now!

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text: Go on, use ya resurrection ta help de recruits.

passages.title: Resurrecting the Recruits
passages.text:
Ya got da mojo ta be a great <class>. 

Me task be done. It be time for me ta see da Other Side.

passages.title: Delving Deeper
passages.text:
It's quite a thrill to have a mortal for a business partner! The amulet really is intriguing.

What's that? Oh yes, that baron you're searching for...

Well it so happens that I learned of a Maldraxxi warlord being held in the lower courtyard of Perdition Hold. As you might guess by the name, it's not the most charming of places.

I would prefer to avoid the attention of the Jailer's forces. Fortunately, I have just the thing.

Give the word, and I will conceal us from the Mawsworn.

passages.title: Delving Deeper
passages.text:
My father... Alexandros Mograine. The Ashbringer.

I... never expected to see him again.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text:
Shuja mentioned a rogue from the first expedition. Goes by Drizza Sidestabber.

Drizza was last seen heading northwest... towards a large bear's den.

None of us can sneak around like you. See if you can find Drizza and bring her back here.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text: Did you get the roots? Make sure that bear is far away when you pick them.

passages.title: A Rogue's End
passages.text:
Here's the secret to making these poisons. It took me a long time to figure it out.

Now that you know how to make 'em, you can kill that ogre for me!

passages.title: The Deadliest of Poisons
passages.text:
You've got the poison. Now you gotta to take out that ogre. Goon's name is Gutgruk the Tough.

He usually patrols around the citadel. I betcha it's lookin' for your expedition right now!

Poison your blades, then take that monster down. Show him he ain't so tough!

passages.title: The Deadliest of Poisons
passages.text:
Drizza Sidestabber's died with honor. She will be remembered as a hero of the Horde.

And now you know how to make poison. Just... keep it away from me.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text:
While scouting the area, I saw an open portal near the bridge up the hill. That does not bode well for any of us.

It seemed like another warlock tried to seal the portal, but failed.

I know you dabble in such... affairs. Perhaps you could put your knowledge to good use and close that portal.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text: I see you have the grimoire that enacted the binding ritual.

passages.title: A Warlock's Bargain
passages.text:
Our bargain has been struck.

Call upon me from the Void, and I will answer.

<The voidwalker looks at the goblin's corpse.>

Let us see if you are stronger than those who came before you.

passages.title: A Warrior's End
passages.text:
Hail, <name>! You've grown stronger since we sparred on the boat. You may one day become a warrior of great renown!

Speaking of which...

I encountered a ghost on the bridge to the north that demands to meet a true warrior.

Perhaps you can see what it wants.

It did not seem hostile. It might even be willing to help us.

passages.title: A Warrior's End
passages.text:
You are no hero of myth and legend... but I see potential within you.

Stand still, and I shall share with you my mightiest technique.

And then I implore you to end my suffering.

passages.title: Hjalmar's Final Execution
passages.text:
You now wield my most powerful skill, young warrior. 

Now use it to finish me! These ogres trapped my spirit here long ago for daring to defy them.

Only through a glorious death will I finally be allowed to rest. 

It is the only way I will see my brothers and sisters in the afterlife.

passages.title: Hjalmar's Final Execution
passages.text: You seem stronger! If only all ghosts were as honorable as that one...

passages.title: A Bond Beyond Death
passages.text:
Since crossing into the Shadowlands, I've been so focused on our mission that I never even considered the souls of my family being here somewhere.

Whatever this realm called Maldraxxus is, I hope it is worthy of my father's service!

We must free him, <name>. There is... much I need to say to him.

passages.title: A Bond Beyond Death
passages.text: Every moment spent here tears at one's soul.

passages.title: A Bond Beyond Death
passages.text: I cannot thank you enough, <name>.

passages.title: A Soul Saved
passages.text:
Vyraz... all this time...

This cannot stand, <name>. We must avenge Krexus and cut him down!

He must have sent you to the Maw expecting that you would never return. He underestimated you. A fatal mistake.

Go with Mograine and claim Vyraz's head. I will warn our forces at the Seat of the Primus.

passages.title: A Soul Saved
passages.text: I cannot allow this wound to fester any longer. I will burn it closed here and now!

passages.title: To Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text:
The last remaining survivor is being held within the ogre's citadel.

Crenna and Herbert have a plan to get us inside.

A small group of us will gather up north. You're coming with us.

If we fail here, the ogres will gain control of Kalecgos and his powerful blue dragon magic.

passages.title: To Darkmaul Citadel
passages.text:
Darkmaul Citadel looms ahead. 

Herbert's proposed plan is... unconventional.

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Eyes
passages.text:
We need to get into Darkmaul Citadel, rescue the last survivor, and stop Gor'groth.

Herbert and Crenna are going to cast a spell to make you look an ogre... and then you're going to take us in as your "prisoners."

Speak with Herbert when you're ready.

passages.title: Right Beneath Their Eyes
passages.text: There may just be a way that we can save Warlord Thunderwalker.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text:
As we snuck in here I noticed the ogres erecting catapults to destroy our camp.

Cork must have anticipated this and gave me several explosives to use, "just in case".

Take these explosives and blow up those catapults!

Also don't shake them too hard.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text:
Make sure to give the explosives a nice wave goodbye when you use them on the catapult. 

It'll make them feel appreciated before they explode.

passages.title: Catapult Destruction
passages.text:
Good work! You didn't happen to save any of those explosives, did you?

...I didn't think so. Oh well! I have plenty of other ways to blow up my enemies.

passages.title: Wide Worlds of Catalysts
passages.text:
Catalysts come in different forms, for now we shall introduce you to two of them.

Speed catalysts can speed up the restoration process. This can obviously be helpful for managing how many souls we can recover.

Quality catalysts improve the quality of the material goods that a spirit might offer upon their restoration. 

Return to me when you have found an example of each. I will be eager to see whether your small little eyes are sharp enough to spot them.

passages.title: Trust Fall
passages.text:
Let us ponder the meaning of the Archivist's last words: "Victory only belongs to those brave enough to fall."

Hmm. It could be reference to the Volume of Victory. That is the most well-known of all the writings said to be kept in this tower.

That book is priceless, <name>. I mean that almost literally. We must do whatever is necessary to find it!

But, uh... What do you suppose "brave enough to fall" refers to?

passages.title: Trust Fall
passages.text: You have it?

passages.title: Trust Fall
passages.text:
This is it... the Volume of Victory! The single most important compendium of Maldraxxus military history ever assembled.

It must be mine! Uh, ours. I mean ours!

passages.title: Rebirth of the Grove
passages.text:
Though not yet withered, the conservatory wilts amidst the drought. This grove is not what it once was.

As warden, I bear the twin burdens of guilt and shame. Fate saw to this grove's decay and my failure to prevent it.

But fate has also seen to hope in its renewal. Hope in you.

I beseech you, mortal, to seek out Zayhad in the Heart of the Forest and restore what has been lost.

For as the wounded spirits must be reborn, so too must this grove.

passages.title: Rebirth of the Grove
passages.text:
The forest sings in gratitude, Maw Walker. 

My Queen is wise to place her faith in you.

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text:
It has been quite some time since we faced such a large number of Scourge. We were ill-prepared for an assault of this scale.

While we managed to escort many to safety, there are some who were wounded in the chaos.

Search the training grounds for any survivors from the onslaught.

We need all the help we can get.

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text: Any word on survivors?

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text: We'll see to it they receive proper attention.

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text:
It has been quite some time since we faced such a large number of Scourge. We were ill-prepared for an assault of this scale.

While we managed to escort many to safety, there are some who were wounded in the chaos.

Search the training grounds for any survivors from the onslaught.

We need all the help we can get.

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text: Any word on survivors?

passages.title: A Valiant Effort
passages.text: We'll see to it they receive proper attention.

passages.title: Imminent Danger
passages.text:
The Temple of Courage must not fall!

All kyrian learn to fight in its hallowed halls. Not only to protect Bastion, but to ensure their own safety when retrieving souls from across the veil. 

Travel there at once. Seek out Thanikos, the Paragon of Courage's loyal hand.

passages.title: Imminent Danger
passages.text: Not quite the army I hoped would come, but I welcome your blade by my side.

passages.title: Now or Never
passages.text:
In a fair fight our warriors could stand against countless swarms of these Maldraxxi.

This was no fair fight, outsider.

They came without warning. Without cause. We were caught unprepared.

They must not be allowed to encroach any further. This stops here.

passages.title: Now or Never
passages.text: We will not go down without a fight.

passages.title: Now or Never
passages.text: We have bought a staging ground, but much remains to be done.

passages.title: Stay Scrappy
passages.text:
I can rebuild this colossus's core systems, but a few things are beyond repair. Thankfully there were enough centurions present here that I believe we can improvise.

Replacements are in order!

I require an Anima Conflux to charge its systems, some Eternity Plating to protect its core, and an Archonic Resonator to make it go boom!

I'll take care of the rest. Quickly, now!

passages.title: Stay Scrappy
passages.text: Do you have the parts?

passages.title: Stay Scrappy
passages.text: That was fast! Well done, well done indeed!

passages.title: Rip and Tear
passages.text:
We will show these Maldraxxi insurgents the price for their betrayal.

The northern grounds have been taken by the House of Constructs, home to Maldraxxus' most resilient warriors.

They have earned no mercy this day, and we will give them none. We will carve through them side by side until this sacred ground is cleansed.

passages.title: Rip and Tear
passages.text: This is what must be done.

passages.title: Rip and Tear
passages.text: You fight with the poise of a true kyrian, outsider.

passages.title: Fight Another Day
passages.text:
Some of our brethren are still alive in there!

While many were lost in the initial assault, they seem keen on taking any survivors prisoner. I know not what they intend, but given their mastery of corpses we must assume the worst.

Some have already been taken to their necropolis above, but others remain in cages on the ground. Free all you can.

passages.title: Fight Another Day
passages.text: The kyrian leave none behind on the field of battle.

passages.title: Fight Another Day
passages.text: You are a true ally, outsider. Thank you.

passages.title: Leave it to Mnemis
passages.text:
I have deduced by the urgency in your collective voices that you wish to leave.

I will expedite your exit. There is a transport pad in the antechamber. I will ensure that the chamber is sealed once again on your exit.

Please accompany me.

passages.title: Leave it to Mnemis
passages.text: We must hurry. The Archon must know what transpired here.

passages.title: An Opportunistic Strike
passages.text:
I'm impressed you made it this far. But don't get too full of yourself.

Most of the fodder you plowed your way through were amateurs at best. Only one combatant will leave this arena a champion.

Each of the five... uh, three houses has fighters in the field. Most merely seek to test their own limits or earn a bit of favor. Only a few have a real chance at claiming victory.

Seek out those challengers if you wish to claim true glory this day.

passages.title: An Opportunistic Strike
passages.text: Are they finished?

passages.title: An Opportunistic Strike
passages.text: Still walking on two legs? My hopes for you are rising.

passages.title: Champion the Cause
passages.text:
Now you're starting to show potential! I'm guessing your name was well known on whatever mortal world you hail from.

But don't rest on your laurels. The harder you fight, the harder others will strive to strike you down. That's the Maldraxxi way!

Nothing wins the favor of the crowd like taking down a former champion. Two are in attendance today, attempting to recapture their past glories.

Slaughter them!

passages.title: Champion the Cause
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Champion the Cause
passages.text:
Good, the crowd's on your side.

Now there's just one last test.

passages.title: Build-A-Bomination
passages.text:
We need to get to work, every soul here needs a body.

We have the parts to build a body for Chordy. Chordy is a great scavenger, rebuilding him could allow us to find more construct parts easier.

Would you help me to rebuild him?

passages.title: Build-A-Bomination
passages.text: It will be nice to have Chordy back to his old self!

passages.title: Build-A-Bomination
passages.text: We were successful, Chordy is whole again!

passages.title: May I Take Your Order?
passages.text:
Chordy is just the first success, there will be many more!

As free souls show up here, speak with them and take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll soon have lots of new constructs to work on!

passages.title: May I Take Your Order?
passages.text: So many powerful souls, we must get to work immediately.

passages.title: Justice from Above
passages.text:
Our forces above cannot fully descend upon this area while the Margrave's crystals cover the sky in destructive blasts.

The Margrave's foul butchers work even now to extract the remaining anima from the kyrian they abducted in their assault on Bastion. We must advance at once.

I shall imbue you with the flames of courage so that you may mark the crystals. Once marked, I will destroy them from afar.

passages.title: Justice from Above
passages.text: You have done a great service here.

passages.title: Charging The Blade
passages.text:
We can't advance with those juggernauts bombarding our position! I led a strike against the nearest one, but conventional weapons do nothing against their imbued hides.

Thankfully, I have an idea.

Your runeblade can't deal with them as it stands, but if you could purge Gharmal's empowered masses and absorb their essence into the blade...

passages.title: Charging The Blade
passages.text: This may not work... but it may also be our only chance at victory.

passages.title: Stitching Time
passages.text:
With the proper resources we can build a force of construct warriors greater than anything ever seen in the Shadowlands.

Visit Arkadia Moa and see if you can secure the resources we need.

passages.title: Stitching Time
passages.text: You have acquired all the resources we needed.

passages.title: At Your Service
passages.text:
I suppose I should commend you. You certainly exceeded my expectations.

Rathan can be sentimental, but he is right. This place can be our new home, and here we can construct new bodies for the souls you freed.

Inform Baroness Draka that she has earned the allegiance of Princess Emeni and the constructs of Butchers Block! We stand ready for whenever she has need of our strength.

passages.title: At Your Service
passages.text:
Well done. Emeni and her constructs will make for powerful allies.

They will, however, need your assistance to reach their full potential.

passages.title: Trouble on the Western Front
passages.text:
The Ashbringer and your fellow Maldraxxi need reinforcements at the western gate. They are barely holding on!

Xandria and my kin will reinforce our position here and push forward towards Gharmal. We must make haste to Mograine--without both flanks, we cannot hope to achieve victory.

passages.title: Trouble on the Western Front
passages.text: I am glad Kynthia found you so quickly.

passages.title: A Master of Their Craft
passages.text:
If we wish to get a travel network up and running, we'll need a master mirror maker in our employ. 

I've heard rumors that one such tradesman has landed himself in the Ember Ward. I am sure it won't take much cajoling to convince him to join our ranks. 

Head back into the Ember Ward and find this master mirror maker.

passages.title: A Master of Their Craft
passages.text: Please do excuse my appearance. I assure you, this is not my normal attire.

passages.title: Double Tap
passages.text:
The House of Rituals occupies the southern half of the temple. Unlike the constructs, their key advantage in battle is their endless army of risen fighters.

Thankfully, the Archonic Resonator we recovered will take care of it.

As we carve our way through their forces, blast their corpses with the resonator. Its energy will sunder their souls, preventing them from being raised to fight again.

passages.title: Double Tap
passages.text: We must ensure our foe stays dead, or our efforts will be futile.

passages.title: Double Tap
passages.text: The Resonator is working at full capacity and our foes are dispatched. Excellent.

passages.title: Clear as Crystal
passages.text:
This Anima Conflux is completely drained of anima! Just a heavy hunk of metal!

Not your fault, of course. Not at all. But we need to charge it!

The Maldraxxi have extractors. Big green crystals, can't miss them. They're using it to drain anima from fallen kyrian. Very bad!

We can use them to charge the conflux, then our colossus here will be functional again!

passages.title: Clear as Crystal
passages.text: Not fully charged, but close enough! May have to disable a few safety features...

passages.title: A Time for Courage
passages.text:
I know not what awaits us across the chasm, outsider. By the Archon's grace I hope that my Paragon yet lives, but I fear the worst.

We will face this great unknown together, as we have the rest of Maldraxxus's horrors. To be kyrian is to follow the path, no matter how dire the circumstances.

Whatever happens, know that you have earned my undying respect this day.

passages.title: A Time for Courage
passages.text: Thanikos... is gone... isn't he.

passages.title: Follow the Path
passages.text:
Maldraxxus must answer for their crimes against Bastion. There shall be justice!

Let us go to Oribos and speak with the Tal-Inara, the Honored Voice. We will tell her what has transpired this day. Tell her that the kyrian will not stand idle against this aggression.

Artemede will inform the Archon. My brothers and sisters will surely prepare for war.

That must not come to pass.

passages.title: Follow the Path
passages.text: You looked troubled, outsider. What ails your mortal frame?

passages.title: Follow the Path
passages.text: I know why you have come. This kyrian has explained much.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Pridefall Hamlet
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Pridefall Hamlet. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Pridefall Hamlet
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: Tough as Silk
passages.text:
We are the heart of silk production in Ardenweald, but we can't do our work! 

Our grove has been completely taken over by spriggans and these strange shapeshifting... things.

The silkstriders who spin the silk are very delicate creatures. They need peace and calm, and a little music to keep them happy! But with all these monsters all over the place, they're super stressed out.

Please, can you get in there and eliminate these hooligans, and see if you can help get us up and running again?

passages.title: Tough as Silk
passages.text: We need to get silk production running again, for Ardenweald!

passages.title: Tough as Silk
passages.text: Thank you! We are so grateful for your help with slaying those cretins, and rescuing our people.

passages.title: The Shattered Harp
passages.text:
<The harp lies broken, with pieces missing.

Perhaps you can find more pieces, and get someone to repair it.>

passages.title: The Shattered Harp
passages.text: I lost my harp! It was taken and broken by those terrible creatures.

passages.title: The Shattered Harp
passages.text: You found my harp! And the missing pieces. Just one moment, and I can fix it.

passages.title: A Song for Silkstriders
passages.text:
There, the harp is fixed. I am too injured to take it to the silkstriders, but you are strong. You can help them.

Our precious silkstriders are all across the cliffs. When you find one, play the harp for them, and they will give you fresh silk. Make sure that there is nothing nearby to stress them out first though!

If you find yourself in need of a way to move about swiftly, just take a Silk Shooter there, next to me. Aim it where you want to go, and it will shoot silk to pull you there!

passages.title: A Song for Silkstriders
passages.text: Were you able to help the poor silkstriders calm down, and get their silk?

passages.title: A Song for Silkstriders
passages.text: Wonderful job! I'm sure the silkstriders appreciated the song you played. You look like someone who appreciates the fine arts.

passages.title: Save Ol' Gertie
passages.text:
We have to find Ol' Gertie! She is the broodmother of the silkstriders, and is our most reliable producer. We cannot lose her.

But I cannot get to her and see if she is all right. She is usually at the top of the cliffs, at the highest point. Can you get up there, and make sure that she is safe?

If she is not... then may justice fall swift and hard on the perpetrator.

passages.title: Save Ol' Gertie
passages.text: Have you found Ol' Gertie? Is she safe?

passages.title: Save Ol' Gertie
passages.text:
<Ol' Gertie lies dead of fear. 

But this little silkstrider larvae wiggles happily at you.>

passages.title: Thread of Hope
passages.text: <Gertie Jr. looks up at you with hope. Perhaps you can help get her to safety.>

passages.title: Thread of Hope
