passages.text:
Ol' Gertie is... dead?

But you found her baby! Thank you, thank you so much for bringing her safely out of there!

passages.title: Silk for Ardenweald
passages.text:
It's clear that we may not be able to consistently supply Ardenweald with silk. But there is something that will help.

Take Gertie Jr. and the silk you collected from the other silkstriders back to the Heart of the Forest. There, she will be safe, and perhaps grow up into a silkstrider as grand and beautiful as her mother!

passages.title: Silk for Ardenweald
passages.text:
Thank you for this silk! But... I see you brought something extra as well.

This little silkstrider will be safe now. I swear it.

passages.title: Pursuit of Justice
passages.text:
Draka stands ready to unleash the power of the necropolis upon Gharmal. We need only buy her time to focus its weaponry.

What we do now, we do for all of us. Bastion and Maldraxxus have both lost much to these fiends.

Gharmal will not be defeated easily... but united, our forces will finally bring them to justice!

passages.title: Pursuit of Justice
passages.text: Our fallen finally know justice.

passages.title: Skoldus Hall
passages.text:
<The object before you is emblazoned with runes, written in the language of domination. One of these runes reacts to your presence, lighting up with a bluish-gray light.>

<It beckons you to touch it.>

passages.title: The End is Now
passages.text:
Our forces have control of the House of Constructs, thanks to your intervention.

Now, all that remains is to vanquish their treacherous leader--Margrave Gharmal.

This battle has been long in the making, adventurer. I am at your side without hesitation.

Let us confront this monster. We will join Xandria to see Gharmal slain.

passages.title: The End is Now
passages.text: It is time.

passages.title: Never Had a Friend Like Me
passages.text:
I feel like you could use a little help, Maw Walker. There is knowledge I have which could make you more useful to the Necrolords.

So just this once... I will teach you something and you won't even have to lose a limb.

Soulbind with me and we'll see if you can learn anything.

passages.title: Never Had a Friend Like Me
passages.text: Now you can try to live up to my example.

passages.title: Forging A Friendship
passages.text:
When you first arrived I was uncertain of your potential. The Primus demands such perfection in his work... and you are far from perfect.

I see now that you bring new knowledge and ideas to our house. Your actions make us stronger. The Primus would be proud of you and wish for us all to learn from you. 

I am ready now to know your ways.

Let me soulbind with you now, so we can grow stronger together.

passages.title: Forging A Friendship
passages.text: Our shared knowledge will benefit all of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Cut to the Bone
passages.text:
I fear if our presence is known, so too is the presence of our comrades.

We must develop a contingency. With the foundry on such high alert, we cannot sneak about undetected.

Unless, of course, you were to provide a distraction. Perhaps thinning their numbers would suffice.

passages.title: Cut to the Bone
passages.text: He ought to be here... but he isn't.

passages.title: An Urgent Request
passages.text:
Champion,

A matter of great urgency has arisen--one that requires your immediate attention.

Due to the sensitive nature of recent events, I must withhold further details until we meet.

We have much to discuss. King Greymane and I await your arrival at Lion's Rest.

passages.title: An Urgent Request
passages.text:
I knew you would not hesitate to answer the call, <name>.

I will be brief.

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text:
Gharmal's rocs dominate the skies above, striking at our forces as we advance. We cannot move the necropolis into position until they are cleared out!

I would slaughter them myself, but the cowards remain out of reach, and I am not constructed for flight.

You, however, seem slight enough of build. Take my riding hook and latch onto a roc. 

Once you are atop of one, beat it to a pulp. Worry about the landing later.

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text: Annihilate them!

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text: I could hear their cries from here. Nice work!

passages.title: An Urgent Request
passages.text:
Champion,

A matter of great urgency has arisen--one that requires your immediate attention.

Due to the sensitive nature of recent events, I must withhold further details until we can speak in person.

There is much to discuss. Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron awaits your arrival in Orgrimmar.

passages.title: An Urgent Request
passages.text:
It has been some time since I last stood here, staring into the distance...

How could this have happened?

I'm afraid I have difficult news to share with you, <name>.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text:
The very heart of the Alliance is under attack.

The undead Scourge is swarming in numbers not seen since the return of Arthas Menethil. Amidst the chaos, something... terrible has happened.

What I am about to share with you has not yet been revealed to our allies. They will be told in due time, but I needed to speak to you directly before word gets out.

Allow me to explain.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text: There is much to discuss.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text:
We must find a way to rescue Anduin and the others. But in this moment, the safety of our citizens and our allies is our highest priority.

As such, I have reached out to those experienced in dealing with threats of this nature.

passages.title: Return of the Crusade
passages.text:
The Scourge's unbound hunger has been unleashed. It's only a matter of time before those monsters swarm our streets.

We need expertise in dealing with this menace. The death knights of the Ebon Blade have stepped forward to aid us, but even they can't do this alone.

The Argent Crusade has answered the call. I need you to work with them to keep our people safe, <name>.

I have sent word of your arrival to their commander. He awaits you at their camp just inside the city gates.

passages.title: Return of the Crusade
passages.text:
Ah, I was told to expect the arrival of a seasoned <class>.

Let's get to work.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text:
Please come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn.

We have received word of a conflict in the seas to the south, and we need the help of an experienced <class> to assist in the investigation.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text:
You are hereby ordered to present yourself at Grommash Hold immediately.

We have received word of a new, resource-rich continent in the south, and we intend to send you and a small contingent of soldiers to claim it for the Horde.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text: Lok'tar, <name>.

passages.title: Missing Stone Fiend
passages.text:
You or I could wield these sinstones directly, but I much prefer to use stone fiends for such tasks.

Exceptional results, no personal risk.

Unfortunately, my stone fiend did not return from its last errand.

Speak with Cryptkeeper Kassir in the archives above. He is loyal to the Accuser and will loan us his stone fiend.

passages.title: Missing Stone Fiend
passages.text:
<Cryptkeeper Kassir grins.>

So you finally listened to the Accuser, eh?

Better late than never.

passages.title: Ready to Serve
passages.text:
Do not mind Temel. His zeal for heralding sins is powerful, but he is still a stone fiend. He will obey.

Give Archivist Fane my regards.

passages.title: Ready to Serve
passages.text: Temel has told me quite the tale of your previous adventures together, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Stranger in an Even Stranger Land
passages.text:
<You arrive alone at the precipice of a strange city, knowing the leaders of Azeroth remain trapped in the Maw.

Wherever you are, it is clearly very, very far from home.

It appears your arrival has been noticed.>

passages.title: Stranger in an Even Stranger Land
passages.text: Try to communicate with the guards and enter the city.

passages.title: Stranger in an Even Stranger Land
passages.text: Could it be? An actual mortal being in the Eternal City? The Purpose be served!

passages.title: Constellan Writs and Stygia
Into Torghast
passages.text:
The bond to your covenant is growing stronger, <name>. Good. The power lies within you to venture into Torghast and rescue our allies.

You saw Baine Bloodhoof while assisting the broker in the Maw. Perhaps this Ve'nari knows a way to breach the Jailer's tower and find the chieftain.

When I peered into Torghast once before, you stood at my side. I believe that connection will allow me to see through your eyes as you navigate its torments.

Seek out Ve'nari and request her aid, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Into Torghast
passages.text: Do whatever you can, Maw Walker. We are depending on you.

passages.title: Into Torghast
passages.text: Well, Maw Walker, what are you waiting for?

passages.title: The Fracture Chambers
passages.text:
The longer you stay within Torghast, the more difficult it becomes for me to hold our tether.

But I will not let go of our bond.

I sense the Jailer's forces, but I also feel another energy: Maldraxxi forces. Strange.

Beyond that, the faint echoes of another living soul. Let us hope it is one of our allies, and not some foul trick.

Keep pressing onward.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Jaina
passages.text:
<Bolvar studies the objects you acquired from the brokers in Torghast.>

I sense Lady Proudmoore's magic upon this debris. And these notes describe methods to contain her power.

<The Highlord focuses on the items, peering into the darkness.>

By the Light! They are tormenting her with white-hot fires. Though her will is strong, there is only so much any mortal can endure.

I will modify Ve'nari's Attuned Shard using the items you returned.

You must find her, adventurer. Before it is too late.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Jaina
passages.text: You must find Jaina Proudmoore in Torghast.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Jaina
passages.text:
Two of Azeroth's architects of peace have been recovered.

Two remain captive.

passages.title: Mort'regar
passages.text:
I have heard whispers of Mort'regar.

A strange, shifting place between blocks of cells, filled with the shades of souls so tormented that they have forgotten who they once were.

Such a place could turn even the most stalwart heart to dust.

passages.title: Coldheart Interstitia
passages.text:
Torghast is a place of torments of both body and mind. Its very nature makes you doubt what is real.

<Jaina falters a moment, then recovers her composure.>

I caught fleeting glimpses of winged Mawsworn carrying Anduin and Thrall deeper into the tower. Taking them into the cold heart of vast cavernous recesses where light and hope seem like distant memories.

Do whatever you must to pull them out of that tower. The Jailer's forces will do everything in their power to stop you.

passages.title: Third Talon Vartox
passages.text:
This "win the spirit of the people" operation is noble and good. 

However, we must set our sights on cutting down our foe's tools. Third Talon Vartox, the leader of this incursion, also serves as the top stoneborn at the Tithelord's estate.

If we strike her down here, the Tithelord will be left exposed for our attack.

passages.title: Third Talon Vartox
passages.text: Is Vartox dealt with?

passages.title: Third Talon Vartox
passages.text: Excellent. Now he is left without his key defense.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Thrall
passages.text:
Using the totem you recovered, I will alter the Attuned Shard to guide you to Thrall's location.

<Bolvar hands you the crystalline object.>

Take care. You know the torments Baine and Lady Proudmoore endured in that accursed place. Thrall's confinement will be no less harrowing.

Beware. The deeper you journey into the Tower of the Damned, the closer you get to the Jailer himself.

Free Thrall, <name>... before all hope is lost.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Thrall
passages.text: All our allies must be saved, <name>.

passages.title: Torment Chamber: Thrall
passages.text:
You have braved torments beyond most mortals' understanding, <name>.

Well done indeed.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: The Eternal Terrace
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and The Eternal Terrace. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: The Eternal Terrace
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: No Place for the Living
passages.text:
A living mortal ... incredible!

Forgive my astonishment. I am Kah-Delen, an overseer of the Arbiter's attendants here in the Eternal City of Oribos.

You stand within the heart of the Shadowlands. While we are accustomed to receiving souls from all manner of worlds within the mortal realm, never before has one arrived that is quite so ... corporeal.

Answer honestly, mortal. Did you truly escape the Maw?

passages.title: No Place for the Living
passages.text: So where did you come from stranger?

passages.title: No Place for the Living
passages.text: Finally, the Purpose may be guiding us again.

passages.title: Audience with the Arbiter
passages.text:
I am Tal-Inara, Honored Voice of the Arbiter. I speak for she who is ever silent.

The Arbiter watches over Oribos. She blesses us with her wisdom. Every mortal soul that enters the Shadowlands passes before her for judgment.

In the merest fraction of a moment, she sees every glory, every folly, every joy, every regret. With this knowledge, she chooses an ideal afterlife for that soul.

At least, she did. Not long ago, catastrophe struck, and ...

Come. Some things are better seen than explained.

passages.title: Audience with the Arbiter
passages.text: The Purpose guides us always.

passages.title: Audience with the Arbiter
passages.text: We may find a shared cause in the Purpose. It has sent you to us.

passages.title: Tether to Home
passages.text:
It is disappointing that you were unable to stir the Arbiter, but we must not give up hope.

Your continued presence in the Shadowlands may help our cause. Perhaps your efforts would benefit from creating a tether to the mortal plane.

The map table in this chamber was put in place long ago by the First Ones, the wise architects of all you see.

If you have a memento from your homeworld, place it there. The table's magic can establish a connection.

passages.title: Tether to Home
passages.text:
<name>! I am relieved you survived that realm of darkness.

I am eager to hear the tale.

passages.title: A Doorway Through the Veil
passages.text:
The Helm fragment connected us while you were in the Maw. As if through a darkened pane of glass, I saw glimpses of what you endured. The terrors you faced.

At least the heroes of Azeroth yet live. They must be saved.

By affixing the Helm here, you gave us a tether to Azeroth that served to bring a few of us across the veil. But you, and other heroes who join us, require a stronger connection.

Our acolytes can open portals back. No doubt these attendants will be particular about their placement.

passages.title: A Doorway Through the Veil
passages.text: Have you helped the acolytes open the portals yet?

passages.title: A Doorway Through the Veil
passages.text: Your path and the Purpose are now entwining.

passages.title: The Eternal City
passages.text:
You should become familiar with the Eternal City and how best to navigate it.

We, the attendants, serve Oribos as its caretakers. 

Everything you see here is done in service to the Purpose. In this time of chaos and drought, we must adapt our perspective. It seems we are to serve the Purpose in a new way.

You mortals are not the only visitors here. Others have come as well.

Like you, the brokers are not of Oribos. They are congenial and willing to aid you. Usually for a price.

passages.title: The Eternal City
passages.text: Have you concluded your tour yet?

passages.title: The Eternal City
passages.text:
We hope you are comfortable here, <name>.

Consider these ancient facilities to be at your disposal.

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, <name>? Up for an adventure?

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: It's a good thing you were there. The gorm have been very hungry lately, and I do not appreciate being nibbled on. Never been my thing!

passages.title: Understanding the Shadowlands
passages.text:
As I sat upon the Frozen Throne all those years, <name>, I could peer into the Shadowlands. Brief glimpses, clouded and uncertain. Sights both wondrous and terrible.

We must work together to make sense of what has happened. To prevent the Maw from consuming all of reality.

Whatever Sylvanas and the Jailer want, we must stop them. But we cannot do so alone.

Perhaps Tal-Inara can put us on the path to find answers.

passages.title: Understanding the Shadowlands
passages.text: Let us align your path to the Purpose.

passages.title: Understanding the Shadowlands
passages.text: Your path and that of the Purpose are becoming one.

passages.title: The Path to Bastion
passages.text:
Within the Arbiter's Chamber are gateways to the infinite realms of the Shadowlands. As each soul was judged, a gateway would be opened to the appropriate afterlife. 

But since the... incident, all gateways have remained closed. Dormant.

We dare not use the Arbiter's sacred chamber for so mundane a purpose as travel. But here in the upper ring of the city, gateways can be configured for your needs.

Before us stands the means to activate a gateway. Together we can channel the anima to power it.

passages.title: The Path to Bastion
passages.text: Your destiny and the Purpose are being drawn together.

passages.title: The Path to Bastion
passages.text: Purpose be praised! Your path becomes clearer.

passages.title: Rule 7: Betrayal is Inevitable
passages.text:
Our arrangement has been quite lucrative. Reliable associates like yourself can be so hard to find.

I believe I can entrust you with a task I would usually perform on my own.

While working with the tracking runes you retrieved for me earlier, I detected a device of broker origin nearby. It must have been brought into the Maw by the captured expedition.

Please examine it and prepare it for transport back to the refuge. I will join you shortly.

This could be a valuable discovery.

passages.title: Rule 7: Betrayal is Inevitable
passages.text: Have you found the device?

passages.title: Rule 7: Betrayal is Inevitable
passages.text:
It seems our partnership has become rather permanent. Cartel Ve will not rest until we are both eliminated.

I suppose now would be the time to share one of my most important rules with you.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Halls of Atonement
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and the Halls of Atonement. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Halls of Atonement
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: The Banewood
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and The Banewood. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: The Banewood
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text:
Quite the surprise to find this beast so hale and hearty. It seems to have taken a liking to you.

If you're ever going to be as great as one of the Dawntrackers, you must learn how to handle multiple pets.

Allow me to show you how.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text: Be sure to dismiss your pet before we get started. Oh, and if it's injured, use Revive Pet to bring it back.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text:
I don't believe there is anything left to teach you, <name>. 

Now you must go forth and find more beasts to tame and call your own.

If you ever need to store or retrieve your pets, speak with me or any other stable masters you encounter in your travels.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Dominance Keep
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Dominance Keep. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Dominance Keep
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Feeders' Thicket
passages.text:
Work has been completed on a mirror that will allow travel between Sinfall and Feeders' Thicket. However, it has yet to be attuned.

The attunement process is quite simple. Just head to the mirror's location in the world, and pass through it once, returning to Sinfall. When you have done so, travel between the two mirrors should be seamless.

passages.title: Mirror Attunement: Feeders' Thicket
passages.text: Well done! The mirrors have been attuned and can be used at your leisure.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text:
I'm quite surprised to find this beast still alive and kicking. It appears to like you.

Before we finish, you had better learn how to wrangle multiple pets.

I'll give you one last lesson.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text: Make sure to dismiss your pet before we get started. Oh, and if it's injured, use Revive Pet to bring it back.

passages.title: The Art of Taming
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>. There's nothing left for me to teach you.

Gather as many wild beasts as you'd like. Just make sure not to lose focus on the ogres who are trying to kill us.

passages.title: Securing the Area
passages.text:
The Scourge's attack was as sudden as it was unexpected. Truth be told, they caught us unawares.

Through swift action, we were able to rally our defenses... though not before the tournament grounds were overrun.

We must secure the area before we can mount a counteroffensive.

Vanquish these monsters in the name of the Light!

passages.title: Securing the Area
passages.text: It appears we are making headway.

passages.title: This Quest is Temporary
passages.text: Dropping out of the sky is a key part of this playtest, so enjoy the ride.

passages.title: A Taste of Tirna Noch
passages.text:
I'm a simple mushroom with simple pleasures, <name>. And what's simpler than a nice, hearty meal?

Don't look so surprised. I need to eat just like anyone else! How else do you think I grew so big? Nice, tasty compost, that's how!

Back in my day, I had the pick of Ardenweald for where to feed. Now, not so much.

I've had a hankering for some of the loam that used to be around Tirna Noch. I haven't had shoots out there in a long time. Could you bring me some?

passages.title: A Taste of Tirna Noch
passages.text: Tirna Noch is a beautiful tree located east of Hibernal Hollow. You can't miss it.

passages.title: A Taste of Tirna Noch
passages.text: Mmmm, it smells just like how I remember it! Maybe a little stale, but you won't hear me complaining about a job well done!

passages.title: Bring Out Your Tithe
passages.text:
Unfortunately the Lord Chamberlain's gift isn't sufficient to cover the entire tithe we're expected to provide the Tithelord, but it will make a good start.

The loss of the tithe convoy is a terrible blow to our village. Our little community is already suffering greatly from the drought and the need to meet the Tithelord's demands. Still we must all do our part.

We have little time to accomplish this task. Can you help? Get the tithe from villagers and scour the area for every forgotten drop.

passages.title: Bring Out Your Tithe
passages.text: I was not sure this task was possible. Very impressive work.

passages.title: And Then There Were None
passages.text:
Ilka and Samu argued, you say? And you found a coded message indicating that the tithe was going to be sent out soon. Those are helpful clues that will allow me to put the puzzle together. 

It's clear to me now who betrayed the village and what we need to do about it! You deliver invitations to a meeting to our suspects and I'll prepare to reveal the traitor.

passages.title: And Then There Were None
passages.text: The Master knows what's best for us. We must do our part.

passages.title: And Then There Were None
passages.text: Nice that it all worked out in the end. Thanks for the unintentional help.

passages.title: Memory of Honor
passages.text:
<A tablet sits embedded in the ground near a broken armor display.

The runes on the epitaph conjure images of an ancient warrior in your mind. Clearly Maldraxxus honors the history of those who claimed great victories here.

Similar memorials seem to be spread throughout the trench. Perhaps they can offer more insight into the denizens of this realm.>

passages.title: Memory of Honor
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Memory of Honor
passages.text:
Many strive for greatness in Maldraxxus. Few truly achieve infamy.

Let us see if our names will one day be remembered.

passages.title: A Paragon's Reflection
passages.text:
<The Vault-Keeper examines you.>

You appear to carry a signature unique to one of the Paragons. If you know which Paragon, simply peer into their Soul Mirror to examine the memory of your choice.

If you require anything else, you need only speak.

passages.title: A Paragon's Reflection
passages.text: Did you find the memory you seek?

passages.title: A Paragon's Reflection
passages.text: I hope your experience was satisfactory.

passages.title: After Them!
passages.text:
We must move quickly! That anima will be key in fueling these citizens for the fight ahead.

Deathfang is ready to ride.

passages.title: After Them!
passages.text:
An excellent display of the strength of Sinfall, <name>. 

Let us continue, shall we?

passages.title: Dude, Where's My Necropolis?
passages.text:
Maintaining the portal between our sanctum and the Zerekriss is a difficult task. With enough resources, we could make it permanent and become the unstoppable force my baroness wishes us to be.

She has asked much of you, as have I. But this work will make your name a legend among the Maldraxxi, as my baroness's has become.

Help to empower us, and you will be empowered in turn.

passages.title: Dude, Where's My Necropolis?
passages.text: You do not cease to impress.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
That was real nice of you. Not too many people take care of us old folks around here.

She even gave you silk! How nice. Here, why don't you take it? I certainly don't need it.

passages.title: We Strike Now
passages.text:
The time has come. The Wild Hunt has driven the Drust back to their stronghold at the edge of Ardenweald.

Their scouts report that Gorak Zhar herself is among them. This may be our only opportunity to fully purge the minions of Thros from this realm.

Lord Herne awaits your arrival at the battlefront. Go with haste, <name>.

passages.title: We Strike Now
passages.text:
Good. You are here.

We are now ready to end the Drust's invasion once and for all.

passages.title: Assault on Darkreach
passages.text:
The Drust have inflicted enormous loss on this forest and its denizens, <name>. It is time we put an end to their atrocities.

We will drive the Drust from their enclave and close their gateway into Ardenweald. With you as our vanguard, victory is assured.

I will make my way into the heart of their camp. Find me once you have routed their forces.

passages.title: Assault on Darkreach
passages.text:
Well fought. The Wild Hunt will deal with the rest as necessary. There is one more foe for us to vanquish.

Are you prepared?

passages.title: Ingra Drif
passages.text:
Ingra Drif, the Drust captain, has been spotted inside Darkreach. This is our chance to destroy him for good.

I know him and his cruelty all too well, <name>. Whatever you do to him, it's better than what he deserves.

passages.title: Ingra Drif
passages.text:
Good. The Drust have been dealt a significant blow.

The spirits of those lost to Ingra Drif's treachery can at last be at peace.

passages.title: Their Last Line of Defense
passages.text:
Those sneaky Drust are protecting Gorak Zhar with their evil magic!

I can sense several foul runes that are scattered across Darkreach. If you destroy them, we can easily shatter the barrier around that nasty Gorak Zhar.

Hurry! I will meet you inside the enemy camp.

passages.title: Their Last Line of Defense
passages.text: Ha! There's nothing left to protect her now. Let's finish this!

passages.title: Unmasked
passages.text:
Thanks to your efforts, the shield that protects our prey has been made brittle as a dried leaf.

Our hunt is all but complete. 

Come, let us put an end to the vile Gorak Zhar.

passages.title: Unmasked
passages.text:
Oh, Ara'lon... even after all he endured, he found a way to smile again... only to...

<Lady Moonberry wipes her eyes.>

There will be time for tears later. We still need to stop the Drust. For Ara'lon... and the forest he fought to protect.

passages.title: The Call of the Hunt
passages.text:
I fear Lord Herne will have further need of our aid before this night is over.

Come, I'll put some wings on you. We'll have to fly if we want to keep up with him.

passages.title: The Call of the Hunt
passages.text: Damn the Drust! This was all a diversion!

passages.title: Build One More
passages.text:
All these souls deserve a new construct, and when rebuilt any of them will make a valuable addition to our forces.

We must start somewhere. 

You should be able to find Malleable Flesh through out the Shadowlands. A few of the other parts may be harder to locate.

Collect parts and use the Abominable Stitching Table to build another construct.

passages.title: Build One More
passages.text: Remember, you can find parts from almost anything in Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Build One More
passages.text: So many powerful souls, this new additional shall bolster our forces greatly!

passages.title: The Archon's Answer
passages.text:
Your cleansing is complete, and you are whole.

Our plan was a success. Undergoing such a rite, so soon after your arrival, has attracted Kalisthene's attention once more. 

Now is our opportunity to request an audience with the Archon.

Stand before her and be proud of what you have accomplished. No matter what happens now, you have done all that any aspirant could hope to.

passages.title: The Archon's Answer
passages.text: You are worthy of Bastion's grace, <name>. May it serve you well.

passages.title: More the Merrier
passages.text:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!

passages.title: More the Merrier
passages.text: So many souls, we have much work to do!

passages.title: Soul Survivor
passages.text:
I knew when you helped me in the Etheric Vault, that you were a just and worthy leader.

I have come here to offer you my help and services in your efforts to bring Maldraxxus back into balance.

Please, build a construct for me, and allow me to help you as you have helped me.

passages.title: Soul Survivor
passages.text: Are you willing to do this?

passages.title: Soul Survivor
passages.text: Miru is a very old soul and a survivor. We would be well aided by building him a construct.

passages.title: Disrupting the Chain
passages.text:
From the desk of the Tithelord:

All supply carriages must re-route to Stonevigil for collection assistance. Once complete, you may resume your regularly scheduled routes.

passages.title: Disrupting the Chain
passages.text:
Well done.

We will bleed this miscreant "Harvester" dry.

passages.title: Prison of the Forgotten
passages.text:
<As you stare at the object you've found, you sense it may lead you to another part of this wretched tower.

Perhaps Ve'nari may know more of its purpose.>

passages.title: Prison of the Forgotten
passages.text: <The lock appears to be sturdy, yet old and untouched. Dust has collected considerably upon it.>

passages.title: Prison of the Forgotten
passages.text: <As you place the key into the device, it shudders for a moment and begins to unlock.>

passages.title: Deep Within
passages.text:
Who... who are you? Have you come to extract more of my memories?

I'm afraid there aren't any useful ones left, save for the memories of my imprisonment.

Or perhaps you're here for something else?

passages.title: Deep Within
passages.text: What do you want of me?

passages.title: Deep Within
passages.text: You could be the key to my freedom. Will you help me, mortal?

passages.title: Reawakening
passages.text:
If you can retrieve my memories, I can help you. At least I believe I can.

Then, perhaps, we can help each other.

passages.title: Reawakening
passages.text: Have you found what was taken from me?

passages.title: Reawakening
passages.text:
It's been an age since I knew anything other than the contours of this hellish prison.

Thank you, mortal. Now to aid you.

passages.title: A Damned Pact
passages.text:
Yes... I begin to remember. Power. Power with a purpose. That is what I can offer.

Runes. Runes are the key. I've recalled some of them, but to infuse them into your equipment, I require my hands.

Well, one hand would suffice. Both would be better.

Find a way to free me from my bonds, mortal. Then I can offer the power you seek. After that, freedom... and perhaps the downfall of the one who bound me.

passages.title: A Damned Pact
passages.text:
Breaking a prisoner's chains? I'm not sure I know how that could be done, unless...

It's dangerous, but I believe there may be a way.

passages.title: A Grave Chance
passages.text:
First you'll need a vessel to house anima and a way to expel it. I happen to possess such a device, which I'll be pleased to give to you.

For a price, of course.

You recall Zovaal's Cauldron, I trust? The denizens there were forged in unholy fire. Assuming their anima is of a similar nature, it should be able to melt even the metals of the tower.

With my device and their anima, I believe you can achieve your goal, Maw Walker.

passages.title: A Grave Chance
passages.text: Were you able to acquire the anima?

passages.title: A Grave Chance
passages.text:
Your success continues to impress, Maw Walker.

Though I admit, such feats are becoming less unexpected as I come to know you more.

passages.title: The Weak Link
passages.text:
This ought to be enough to break the bonds that hold your newfound ally.

<Ve'nari pauses for a moment.>

Before you do so, I offer a word of warning.

No creature imprisoned in that place should be trusted. Tread carefully, mortal. 

After all, it would be a shame to lose so valuable a business partner.

passages.title: The Weak Link
passages.text: It's good to remember something new again.

passages.title: The Weak Link
passages.text:
Freedom. Of a sort. Yes... this is good. You have my thanks.

What was it you wanted? Ah, power. Yes. Very well, then.

passages.title: Trading Favors
passages.text:
Welcome, friend. 

I can see by your garb that you must have quite a storied history. Many unique relics befitting of one that has traveled the worlds and vanquished many foes.

There are those of us that find great value in such things, and would willingly part with our own valuables for a taste of what you may find. 

Let your curiosity guide you to the dark hallway across from the cookpots in the next room. Down there, you will find answers.

passages.title: Trading Favors
passages.text:
Ah, you must have been sent by Ta'rela. We have need of your services.

Trust me, we will make it more than worth your while.

passages.title: WANTED: Enforcer Kristof
passages.text:
WARNING!

Shrouded patrols have increased throughout the Ember Ward. By order of Enforcer Kristof, all who are found near the asylum will be forced to endure the Light. 

Use extreme caution when venturing beyond our sanctuary. Even the shadows are not safe so long as Kristof remains in power. 

A reward awaits whoever is able to rid the ward of this tyrant. 

- Dispatcher Raluca

passages.title: WANTED: Enforcer Kristof
passages.text: No tears will be shed over the loss of such a miscreant. Coin is not abundant in this ward, but take this, the owner is long gone and it will fetch a fair price.

passages.title: WANTED: Summoner Marcelis
passages.text:
Be advised:

Summoner Marcelis and his cohorts are dabbling in dangerous magics. They are calling forth ashen elementals to ravage these Light-scorched lands. 

We cannot let such acts continue. 

Any who can are urged to put an end to this madness. 

- Dispatcher Raluca

passages.title: WANTED: Summoner Marcelis
passages.text: You'll get your reward when you slay Marcelis, and not a moment sooner.

passages.title: WANTED: Summoner Marcelis
passages.text: Your reward, as promised.

passages.title: WANTED: Aggregate of Doom
passages.text:
Attention all workers: 

We got ourselves a problem down in the thicket. 

A golem is trekking through the worksite, causing all sorts of trouble. 

Grab a rock and get to throwin'. The dredger that takes it out gets the rest of the day off. 

- Foreman Scug

passages.title: WANTED: Aggregate of Doom
passages.text: You did it then? Fair enough. Now we can all get back to work.

passages.title: WANTED: Duke Anton
passages.text:
Loyal Citizens of Revendreth: 

Duke Anton and his decrepit house are relics of noble venthyr society. 

His attempts to tarnish my name are laughable at best. 

It is time someone rid us of Duke Anton's presence for good.

I shall offer double whatever pathetic sum he can muster. 

Sincerely, 

Lord Darion of House Redelav

passages.title: WANTED: Duke Anton
passages.text: House Redelav sure has deep pockets. But you've earned it, I suppose.

passages.title: WANTED: The Pale Doom
passages.text:
Notice to all: 

A lingering menace lurks in the Endmire, dangerously close to Darkhaven's border. 

If alone in your travels, take care to avoid this monstrosity, lest it make you meet your true death.

Those with a sense of adventure and a well-armed brigade might manage to slay this beast. If so, a reward will await you upon your return. 

Sincerely, 

Taskmaster Gavril

passages.title: WANTED: The Pale Doom
passages.text: There's no shame in turning down the bounty. Not everyone has what it takes to slay a devourer.

passages.title: WANTED: The Pale Doom
passages.text: You have done Darkhaven a great service by slaying that beast.

passages.title: WANTED: Lord Darion
passages.text:
To Whom it May Concern: 

Lord Darion of House Redelav thinks that he can buy his place in society. 

He flaunts his wealth, using it to win favor of other lords and ladies. Is there no price on decency? 

This is not the way the noble houses of Revendreth should conduct themselves. 

I implore you to find Lord Darion and help him meet his true death. 

The honor of House Briarbane rests in your capable hands.

Warmest Regards, 

Duke Anton of House Briarbane

passages.title: WANTED: Lord Darion
passages.text: Hopefully this means House Briarbane will stop their whining.

passages.title: Rule 4: Make A List
passages.text:
I've discovered that one of the Jailer's inquisitors is attempting to devise a method to track my movements.

Clearly, that is a problem for me... and by extension, it is a problem for you.

The inquisitor has risen to the top of my list of potential threats. In the past, I would have had to deal with him myself. But now... I have a business partner.

Put an end to him, yes? And if you can, determine exactly how he intended to track me.

passages.title: Rule 4: Make A List
passages.text: Have you learned anything of Inquisitor Devaki's tracking methods?

passages.title: Rule 4: Make A List
passages.text:
Fine work. This should keep the both of us safe from the Mawsworn. 

I will hold onto the sphere that you found for the purpose of study.

Don't you have other matters to attend to?

passages.title: Rule 5: Be Audacious
passages.text:
You have proven yourself a useful associate, <class>. In thanks, I have crafted a cypher that will allow you to venture further into the Maw.

But... it is experimental in nature. You will have to test it in the field. And I have just the test in mind.

Cartel Ve has foolishly sent more agents into the Maw. They were captured and taken to Perdition Hold. I must know why.

Breach the fortress and learn what has become of the captive brokers. Nothing is more valuable than knowledge of your enemy's plans.

passages.title: Rule 5: Be Audacious
passages.text: What have you discovered, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Rule 5: Be Audacious
passages.text:
The Beastwarrens, you say... I wonder what they are plotting...

Such an embarrassment that they were discovered and captured in the first place. It seems Cartel Ve has become quite careless in my absence.

You have my gratitude for your assistance, as always. I will inform you when I have need of your services again.

passages.title: Rule 6: Concealment is Everything
passages.text:
I have made a startling discovery, <name>. 

Do you recall how the captured agents of my cartel were taken to the Beastwarrens? 

The Mawsworn seem to think they possess a means of tracking me. And now, strange new runes empower the Jailer's hounds.

Clearly, we cannot have that.

This new cypher will grant you solace from the screeching in the Beastwarrens. Brave its caverns and secure those runes for inspection.

If we are to counter their effects, I must know how they work.

passages.title: Rule 6: Concealment is Everything
passages.text: The runes... you have them?

passages.title: Rule 6: Concealment is Everything
passages.text:
Interesting... runes that can detect brokers by using our extracted essence.

Let us hope you were able to stop any further production. I will keep these for study.

At some point, you will certainly need to walk the nightmarish plains of the Beastwarrens again. My cypher will continue to allow you to do so.

passages.title: Rule 3: Trust is Earned
passages.text:
Before you leave this cursed realm, there is one final task you must complete for me.

The Mawsworn regularly transfer souls to various blocks of Torghast from many different areas in the Maw.

I happen to know of one such area. Place this beacon there so I may be informed when the next transfer happens.

And if you are seen by the enemy... well, you are known for your prowess in combat, yes?

passages.title: Rule 3: Trust is Earned
passages.text: I will have opportunities for trade in the future, Maw Walker. I am certain our paths will cross again.

passages.title: Rule 3: Trust is Earned
passages.text:
One of your associates was taken into Torghast? 

It sounds as if he put up quite the fight. Perhaps he could also prove useful... if he were to be rescued.

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text: Did you bring back the carcass?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text:
I found this scroll while you were cleansing the temple.

These are dire words, and I suspect it only gets worse. Collect more of these scrolls so I can determine just what these so-called Forsworn want.

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text: We must defend the temple, <name>.

passages.title: Dangerous Discourse
passages.text:
These words...

It is as I suspected.

<Eridia stares grimly ahead.>

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text:
You have made great strides with our pride. I hope you found value and fulfillment in working with the larion.

The time to meet with Pelodis has come. You must decide whose way of life is more rewarding, and which you would prefer to pursue.

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text: The pack has welcomed you, <name>. I hope that you feel it.

passages.title: Pride or Unit
passages.text: It is done.

passages.title: Dredhollow
passages.text:
That was a narrow escape.

But I believe this presents an opportunity to finally turn the tide of this strife and defeat the Fearstalker. Meet me at Dredhollow: the abandoned hunting lodge of the Fearstalker. 

We must take separate paths. The Fearstalker will soon be after us again.

passages.title: Dredhollow
passages.text:
I am glad you made it here alive.

General Draven has informed me of a plan that might just work.

passages.title: WANTED: Gorgebeak
passages.text:
Thief! Pilferer! Menace!

The insidious menace known as Gorgebeak threatens our harvest of ambrosi for tribute to our great Archon. She must be stopped!

If any are willing to take on this foul fowl, I have tracked her nest to the western edges of Firstborne's Bounty. Proof of her demise shall be amply rewarded.

--Gerdus

passages.title: WANTED: Gorgebeak
passages.text: What business have you with this simple tender?

passages.title: WANTED: Gorgebeak
passages.text: Our harvest is saved! Oh thank you, brave adventurer, our tribute may be saved yet!

passages.title: Journey to Ardenweald
passages.text:
The warning you received from the Primus needs to reach the Winter Queen of Ardenweald, <name>. The Eternal Ones must stand together against the coming darkness.

The Winter Queen oversees the cycle between Death and Life. In her forest slumber ancient spirits of nature that must be reborn.

I fear the anima drought will have taken an especially grim toll upon her realm. 

The night fae can lead you to the Queen. Bring her this message, and she will know what needs to be done.

passages.title: Journey to Ardenweald
passages.text:
We haven't seen anyone come through the gateway in a very long time! Certainly not someone like you.

What brings you to Ardenweald?

passages.title: Hands on Approach
passages.text:
When I was imprisoned in the Etheric Vault, the anima scroungers would come to steal what little strength my soul still had. I swore I'd have revenge upon them should I ever escape.

Now, with my blade hands... it's time for my revenge! 

I've seen anima scroungers near the House of Constructs. I want their leader dead and the anima they took from me recovered!

passages.title: Hands on Approach
passages.text: Did you kill them all?

passages.title: Hands on Approach
passages.text: Guillotine can be vicious, but sometimes that's exactly what the situation demands.

passages.title: First on the Agenda
passages.text:
Let's make a deal, <name>. I'll seek out the Winter Queen on your behalf if you complete a few of my duties in my stead. The Queen isn't the only one who's been kept busy by the drought!

First, you're going to help my fellow fae here with their spriggan problem. Boot their leader off that poor moth! Featherlight will tell you where to go after that. 

We'll reunite in Tirna Vaal if you survive.

Oh, and I would stay on the path if I were you. Ardenweald can be dangerous for the unwary!

passages.title: First on the Agenda
passages.text: Not bad! Not bad at all!

passages.title: First on the Agenda
passages.text: If you can handle the spriggans, then perhaps I can give you some of the more interesting items on Lady Moonberry's agenda. Excellent!

passages.title: Cut 'Em Down to Size
passages.text:
Idle hands are a wasted opportunity. I need to keep my hands busy, or else these blades wouldn't be worth anything!

I hear there's a devourer in Revendreth that's as tall as a house. Let's show the other constructs a thing or two by taking that monster out!

passages.title: Cut 'Em Down to Size
passages.text:
Good work, both of you! 

Guillotine's efforts have not gone unnoticed. I've seen the others redouble their efforts to follow her example.

Thank you both, again.

passages.title: Welcome to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
The warchief will be waiting for our mission report from Exile's Reach. I must deliver it at once.

For now, Cork Fizzlepop will show you around the city. Orgrimmar has much to offer, so explore it as you see fit.

I'll send for you once I've given my report to the warchief.

passages.title: Welcome to Orgrimmar
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! Long time no see, am I right?

Warlord Grimaxe asked me to show you the sights. Let's go!

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text:
Orgrimmar's a big city. Way too big to explore on foot. Warlord Grimaxe has arranged for you to receive a mount to help you get around.

She said to speak with Rohaka at the stables... but I can't seem to remember the way there.

Don't worry, <name>! All we need to do is ask a guard for directions. If you ever need help finding something, the city guards will show you where to go.

Let's ask a nearby guard for directions to the stable master. Then we can be on our way!

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text: Welcome to the stables, <class>. I've been expecting you.

passages.title: Finding Your Way
passages.text: Warlord Grimaxe instructed me to give you a mount, but there's something we need to do first.

passages.title: License to Ride
passages.text:
Warlord Grimaxe told me you'd be coming to the stables to pick up your mount.

But before you go charging into battle, you'll need to learn how to ride it first.

Speak with Kildar when you're ready to learn how to ride.

passages.title: License to Ride
passages.text: Now that you've learned the basics, feel free to return any time you want to advance your riding skills or purchase additional mounts!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! Have you decided on a combat specialization yet?

Since you're a <class>, you already know about the different classes available to adventurers. But did you know that there are also areas of specialization within each class?

Choosing a specialization is an important decision. Your specialty determines your combat role in a party, as well as the kinds of weapons and abilities that you will use.

Let's go speak with Telotha Pinegrove to learn more about specializations!

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text: Greetings. Have you come to learn about combat specializations?

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Excellent choice of specialization, <name>.

Feel free to test out your new abilities on the training dummies outside on the upper level of the building.

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text:
I don't know about you, but I'm in the mood for some good ol' fashioned recreation!

Why don't we head over to The Wyvern's Tail and cool off with a few pints of Cobo Cola?

While we're there, speak with Innkeeper Nufa to make The Wyvern's Tail your new home. That way, if you ever find yourself stranded without a flight master nearby, you can use your hearthstone to return to the inn.

Not only is it faster than a wyvern, but you'll save yourself some dough in the process!

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: How can I help you today, <class>? Are you looking for a place to stay?

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: As long as The Wyvern's Tail is your home, you can find a warm fire here when you return.

passages.title: An Urgent Meeting
passages.text:
I've been looking for you all over Orgrimmar, <name>.

Warlord Grimaxe has delivered her mission report to the warchief. The Horde has need of you once again.

I was ordered to find you and deliver the message without delay. It has been an honor to fight alongside you, <name>.

Lok-tar ogar!

passages.title: An Urgent Meeting
passages.text: Good, you're here. The warchief wishes to speak with you.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Mission Statement
passages.text:
The warchief has requested to meet with you in person.

Lady Sylvanas was impressed with the prowess and courage you displayed during our mission to Exile's Reach. 

Now that you've arrived, I will make the introduction.

passages.title: Battle for Azeroth: Mission Statement
passages.text: The Dark Lady has placed her trust in us. We will not fail her, <name>.

passages.title: Blank
passages.text:
Kul Tiras is the greatest naval power in Azeroth, and a former ally. But we've had little contact with them since Jaina's father, Lord Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, was defeated at Theramore.

Many have criticized Jaina's decision that day, saying she believed so deeply in the promise of peace between the Alliance and Horde that she betrayed her own father.

Perhaps she feels the time has come to atone for this.

Loath as I am to put Jaina in harm's way... Kul Tiras must join the Alliance.

Good luck.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text:
Today, we must turn our gaze inward. We are beset by foes here, in Ardenweald, from all sides.

Travel our lands, weapon in hand, and bring hope and victory with you. Bring aid to those in need, and remind them that we are here for them, and Ardenweald will not fall.

Remind them that our great purpose will be fulfilled, and we will not let the groves wither.

You, Maw Walker, will unite us today.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you brought hope and faith to our people today?

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Our bonds are stronger, our roots grow deeper, due to your actions this day. We will hold strong against the onset of foes that plague us, as groves weave together in defense, thanks to you.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text:
We do not turn out backs on our allies, even when we face darkness here in Ardenweald.

In Revendreth, they battle against the forces of Sire Denathrius, who has proven himself a false leader.

We cannot allow those that make Sinfall their home to lose hope.

Travel to Revendreth and supply aid to them. Show them that we will not let them falter, that we are stronger together.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: How goes the battle in Revendreth?

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: As we aid our allies, we all remember the bonds that forge us together in our world. Together, we will overcome, and only together, will the Shadowlands function once more.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Maldraxxus defends us from forces that threaten the Shadowlands, or at least, they once did.

Now they are plagued by infighting and an imbalance in power.

We have few allies there, but those that remain, we must maintain.

Go there, give them aid, and help them reunite the houses such that the armies of the undying may defend us once more.

Without them, we are but one invasion from complete annihilation.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: Have you aided the forces of Maldraxxus?

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: We are now one step closer to reforging the army that will defend our worlds. This is a good thing you have done today.

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text:
The denizens of Bastion have long served the Shadowlands with faith and honor. Without them, souls would not arrive for us to nurture, and our lands would wither and die.

We cannot allow them to fall, for without Bastion, we are lost.

Travel to the golden fields, weapon in hand, and provide aid to our besieged allies. We will show them that in these dark times, they are not alone.

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: Have you aided Bastion today?

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: Even in dark times, we cannot allow others to be alone with their troubles. It is only when we stand together that the Shadowlands can become whole again.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text:
Our hunters do not have the time for proper training, and so we must train them in the field.

Our allies in Bastion are in desperate need of support, and I wish one of the trainees to accompany you in this endeavor.

Do you hear that, trainee? Today, you accompany the Maw Walker!

Maw Walker, do not go easy on this one.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text: I hope that today's trainee survived the trip, but I am not overly confident.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text: Good, a tired trainee is a trainee that has seen combat and gained many experiences. You have done well with this one.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text:
Get up, trainee, you must get up!

Look at this one! Needs much more training before we stand a fighting chance against our enemies. 

We have precious little time to build combat prowess these days, with so many foes at our backs.

Take this one with you today, show them the ways of battle, and keep them safe from overwhelming odds. It is the only way we will make enough progress.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: How goes the training?

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: You have done well, we will allow them to rest a moment. Today they have learned that even in the calmest meadow, there is always danger.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ay there, ya got a moment?

Lotta things going on down in Ardenweald. Bad stuff, bugs and things. Look delicious, but probably give me ol' stomach a nasty one.

We're lookin' pretty solid here today, ya see? Probably could use a hand down there. Maybe they give us a hand in return, see? 

Do I gotta spell it out for you? Get on over there, ya big goof.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Ain't never been a friend to no Night Fae, but maybe it's about time we went lookin' for more allies. Gotta start somewhere, I suppose.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text:
We are attacked by enemies on all sides, Maw Walker. 

And Ardenweald faces a similar threat.

It is in our best strategic interests to forge lasting alliances with those outside of Maldraxxus. Though we may be under assault, we are still the strongest military might in the Shadowlands. Under our protection, they will thrive and grow, and in turn, provide us with aid in our times of need.

Together, we are strong. This is the doctrine of the phalanx, and it will be ours as well.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you secured allies in Ardenweald?

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Stability in Ardenweald will serve us as we move against the enemy. This was a solid strategic choice, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald has long been one of our closest companions in the shepherding and nurturing of souls. Now they are beset by many foes, and we will not allow them to fall!

Make haste to their forested lands, and with the blessing of the Archon upon you, serve a glorious purpose. Stand with them in their time of need, a gilded shield, a reminder that they are not alone!

Bastion stands with them, and with us, they will never falter!

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you served in Ardenweald today?

passages.title: Aiding Ardenweald
passages.text: Today we are blessed that the Maw Walker has brought our divine purpose to Ardenweald! Our allies rejoice in your victories!

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text:
In our own golden hills, evil abounds. We will not allow it to take root and fester!

Raise your voice, Maw Walker, and shout to the foes of Bastion! We are coming for them!

With haste, now, seek out those in need of your might. Bring the sharpened blade of faith to bear against doubt and uncertainty. Crush despair with a gilded fist, and let it know the vengeance of the Archon!

For Bastion!

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: Do the hills echo with the cries of your victories, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: The hills speak of your faith and honor, our forces radiate with each victory! Glory to Bastion, glory to the Archon, glory to the Maw Walker!

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text:
The kyrians of Bastion serve a unique purpose in the Shadowlands, and without them we will be unable to replenish our forces. Should we wish to stand triumphant in Maldraxxus, we must extend some of our might to aid them.

Travel to Bastion and provide support, so as to stabilize their situation. In doing so, we will secure the future of our armies and cut off the supply to our enemies.

War is not always fought on the battlefield, but often in the means of replenishment.

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: Have you secured the situation in Bastion?

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text: We are one step closer to returning our supply of souls to a functioning form, Maw Walker. This is an important advancement in the war for Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text:
If'n the kyrians of Bastion don't get souls to the Shadowlands, we got no one to join up, and no anima to gain in them sinstones. Be in a bad place, you know, now and in the future, if things ever bother to get better.

We got things figured out here today. Head on over to them golden hills of Bastion and give 'em a hand. Bet they pay us back some day. They're all about honor an' stuff.

<Rendle wipes his nose loudly.>

passages.title: Aiding Bastion
passages.text:
Always wanted to eat a steward, never got the chance to. Really wonder what they taste like. 

Was a good thing you did for them, anyway. Just got some idle musings I do.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text:
In the fetid wastes of Maldraxxus, we yet find allies. Their sacred duty, to defend the Shadowlands, has not been forgotten by all.

We must take flight, now, to stand side by side with our bone-bound brethren. Shoulder to shoulder, hand in hand, we will push back those that would sow chaos and discord.

A spear of gold and bone we will form! And thrust it into the heart of evil!

Go now, Maw Walker, as the tip of the spear, to glorious battle!

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: Have you pierced the heart of evil in Maldraxxus?

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: Glorious! The gilded halls of Bastion stand firm with our allies in Maldraxxus, may they never wane in their battle for righteousness!

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text:
The allies we have here in Maldraxxus may be few, but we cannot turn our backs on them. Every hand we pull out of darkness and into our fold, is a hand that can hold a weapon or wand.

Walk our lands, find those seeking aid, and provide it. Crush our enemies, and show them that we are at once everywhere. Make them fear you.

Fear is the seed that breeds doubt, and doubt is the root that crumbles empires.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: How goes the battle?

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: Our rival houses will think twice before stepping foot outside of their strongholds again. Blood and glory to you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Once was a time that those bony lot in Maldraxxus were the defenders o' all of us here in the Shadowlands. Now they spend their time destroyin' what little they got left.

All's I know is that if things keep up like this, one big ol' swath of devourers could sweep in and wipe us all out.

Get over there and help them good ones keep the peace, maybe they help us out some day, too.

passages.title: Aiding Maldraxxus
passages.text: Maybe things get a bit more stable down there in Maldraxxus, now. Would do us all a lot o' good.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text:
Our allies in Revendreth are all that stem the tide of Denathrius's forces from overtaking the rest of the Shadowlands. 

Once, we would be charged with righting this wrong, but our armies have dwindled with the actions of our rival houses.

Today, you will be the messenger from Maldraxxus, carrying a message of justice in the name of the great cycle of which we all take part.

It is your Primus-given duty to aid Sinfall against those that seek to break the cycle.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: Have you broken the forces of Denathrius?

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: With your aid, we have once again been able to perform our sacred duties in defense of the Shadowlands. Little by little, we right the wrongs that have sent us awry, that the cycle can begin anew.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text:
Oi there, got somethin' for you to do today.

Lots of problems outside of Sinfall, there are. Big problems, little problems, all sorts of problems.

We're not gonna make much headway against Denathrius with his lot at our heels all the time, ay?

Get out there an' get some muck on your boots.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: What do ya want?

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: Ya did a good thing today, an' we're safer for it. Never been one to give a compliment, me, but today I gotta say ya did a good one.

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text:
Take flight to Revendreth, where those that are loyal to the Shadowlands are under siege from the forces of Sire Denathrius.

We cannot allow them to fall. Without the aid of Sinfall, the forces of Revendreth will grow unchecked, and their dark alliance with the Jailer will threaten us all.

We of Bastion will not allow this to happen! Raise your swords, ready your shields, take wing and bring the glory of Bastion to Revendreth!

passages.title: Aiding Revendreth
passages.text: Even those that are far from our lands are necessary allies in these dark times. With faith and honor we will serve them, and the Shadowlands, until evil clips our wings!

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text:
I have another trainee for you to look after, they need some training on the battlefield. Take them out to, oh, let's say Ardenweald. 

<Sakaa waves her hand vaguely in the direction of Ardenweald.>

Plenty of things to maim over there, maybe they learn a thing or two about wood.

<Sakaa smirks.>

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Oh, well, good job carting this one around, then. Hope they didn't give you any trouble.

Maybe a little trouble would be acceptable.

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Look at this lot! Bones and gristle, all of them. Need some meat on their bones and some training in their heads.

Take this trainee out and get them some real combat experience.

Ardenweald's a good spot, plenty of things to fight there. Learn some new tactics, get them used to the chaos of battle, all that stuff.

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text: You back already?

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text: Good, good, I can already see this one's learned a thing or two today. I'll take it from here.

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text:
It is our great duty to take our aspiring warriors and train them in combat. 

Today, this is your trainee. Take them to Ardenweald, show them what it means to be in the glorious service of the Archon. Defend our allies, and bring faith to their lands.

Teach them the ways of battle and honor.

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text: How fares the training?

passages.title: Training in Ardenweald
passages.text: You have returned with your charge intact, most benevolent. Carry the lessons of the teacher with you.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text:
What better place to stretch our wings than right here on our own fields?

Take one of our trainees out with you today, show them the ways of combat in Bastion against the growing threats we face here.

Part of their training will be courage when facing off against those they thought their brethren.

It has been known to break hearts and ranks before.

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: How fares your heart today?

passages.title: Training Our Forces
passages.text: Let this one rest, now. Facing threats from within, let alone against ones you once considered kin and ally, can take a mighty toll.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text:
Useless minions, the lot of them. All of this fodder needs to get trained.

Here, take this one with you today. Get them away from me, go to... Bastion. Yeah, Bastion, far away from me.

Plenty of things to test them against, there. 

If you get them killed, I don't want to hear it.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text: Any luck with this sad lot?

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text: Well well well, kind of surprised you managed to make it back with your trainee intact. Guess you're a better instructor than I gave you credit for. Going to keep that in mind.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text:
I have yet another minion, er, recruit that needs training.

Take them on out to the fertile fields of Bastion. There is plenty to learn over there that they won't find around these parts, perhaps it will help them grow into a better soldier. 

Maybe you pick up some new tricks while you're out there, too.

passages.title: Training in Bastion
passages.text: Thank you for showing them around today. There's plenty to learn still, though.

passages.title: The Blade of the Primus
passages.text:
That's everything I need. Time to get to work.

I'd stay close, if I were you. Forging a weapon is never a simple task when the Primus's handiwork is involved.

If he taught me anything, it was to expect the unexpected.

passages.title: The Blade of the Primus
passages.text: Stay close, now.

passages.title: The Blade of the Primus
passages.text: The Primus was always fond of his trials. It seems you've passed this one. Well done.

passages.title: Never Enough
passages.text:
Well done, recruit. These were merely the first of many assignments in your future.

Matters here demand my attention. Report to Baroness Draka and see what need she has of you.

I will watch closely as this war unfolds.

passages.title: Never Enough
passages.text: Good work. I see that our defenses have been shored up.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
Oh no, no no no. The Jailer's taken all the souls, and now he's also got a whole lot of anima! Who knows what he's going to do with it!

You need to go back there! You're the Maw Walker!

See what you can learn of his power, and slow him down however you can. I believe in you!

Be careful, ok?

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text: You did great! We learned a lot from your reports, and it sounds like you did some good down there. Good job!

passages.title: The Path to Glory
passages.text:
It's been some time since I had a chance to craft a weapon that powerful! Good to know that the skills I learned from the Primus haven't dulled.

You'd best get back to the baroness with that runeblade. I'm sure the margrave will want to know you wield it, as well.

The Primus was notorious for thinking ten paces ahead of everyone else. I suspect he knew that someone like you would take up that blade.

passages.title: The Path to Glory
passages.text: You wield a fine weapon. Now you must put it to use.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
We have been able to do little to stem the flood of souls into the maw, until now. You, Maw Walker, have the power to put a stop to this.

We know little about the Jailer's lands, save that he is powerful beyond imagining.

I ask something of you today that I would not place upon anyone else. You must travel to his lands, and do what you can to slow the growth of his forces.

We must buy more time.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
You have shown us many things we could not see ourselves, and now perhaps we can begin to formulate a plan. 

You have done us a great service today.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
We cannot allow the Jailer to grow in power. You alone can take the battle to his lands, and you must do so, or we will all fall.

Return to his lands, Maw Walker. He has already shown his hand, and we know he grows in power with each passing day.

His forces must be slowed, make what progress you can.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text: You seem different, somehow.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
He has seen you, and you are now marked. Wear this as a badge of honor. None other could have done what you did.

He is not afraid, yet, but he will be.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
We know little about the maw, Maw Walker. Only you have the power to traverse those lands and return.

What I am about to ask of you I would not dare ask of another.

We cannot allow the Jailer to grow in power. You must travel to the Maw and take the battle to his lands.

Make what progress you can, we must slow down his forces however possible.

passages.title: Storm the Maw
passages.text:
We have learned much from your travels into the Maw, and we shall plan for the future.

There was no other way to slow the Jailer's consolidation of power, you have done us a great service, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text:
When we ferried souls to the Arbiter, we never thought this would happen. We watched in despair as they were cast into the Maw, one by one, then by the hundreds and thousands.

Souls that have been devoured, consumed, their anima lost to us. Return to us what you can.

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: Have you secured the lost Anima Embers?

passages.title: Anima Salvage
passages.text: While it is not the same as returning the souls, their power shall not go to waste. You have my thanks.

passages.title: Meet the Margrave
passages.text:
Word of the runeblade has reached Margrave Krexus. He wishes to see it for himself.

With such a weapon by your side, you pose a threat that the other houses cannot ignore. Perhaps we can use that to our advantage.

But enough talk. Follow me.

passages.title: Meet the Margrave
passages.text: Show me this runeblade of yours, mortal.

passages.title: A Rousing Aroma
passages.text: <Sabina is unresponsive. Her exposed flesh cracked and blistered. Perhaps something with a pungent aroma will rouse her.>

passages.title: A Rousing Aroma
passages.text: Sabina remains unresponsive.

passages.title: A Rousing Aroma
passages.text:
<Sabina begins to stir. >

Are... are they back? Help... help me.

passages.title: Rubble Rummaging
passages.text:
I do not know how long it's been since my captors left me here, but the Light has... taken its toll. 

You must help me escape. The key to my shackles should be hidden nearby. Perhaps among the rubble? That's likely where I'd hide something small.

passages.title: Rubble Rummaging
passages.text: Have you found the key?

passages.title: Rubble Rummaging
passages.text: This looks like it could fit.

passages.title: Safe in the Shadows
passages.text:
I cannot recollect what happened. Perhaps the Light has burdened my memory? Who knows how long I've been out here...

The last thing I remember before things went dark... my companions and I had finally found refuge in the shadows. I worry for their well-being. 

So long as my assailants remain at large, my companions could be in danger. Will you find them and ensure they're still safe in the shadows?

passages.title: Safe in the Shadows
passages.text: They've perished? Are you sure? Who could have done something so cruel...

passages.title: Setting Sabina Free
passages.text:
Release me. Please, you must do so. I cannot linger in the Light any longer. 

This unease, it's so... familiar, but it will pass. I will feel myself once again, once I have returned to the shade.

I'll stay as still as silence while you work the lock.

passages.title: The Endmire
passages.text:
Oi! You.

Not sure what landed you in the Endmire but I need your help.

See these torches? It's my gig to keep 'em lit. But it ain't like they runnin' on flint n' tinder.

My stash of infused rubies got hauled off by some devourers when my back was turned. Can ya find 'em before we both get ate by one of these horrors?

passages.title: The Endmire
passages.text: Just going to be clear on this: I... HATE... THIS... GIG.

passages.title: The Endmire
passages.text:
Much obliged. These torches keep the effects of the Endmire at bay. Even scares away the devourers for the moment. Only lasts so long though. 

I miss the good ol' days of only having to worry about manifestations down here.

passages.title: It Used to Be Quiet Here
passages.text:
Well... You don't look like the rest of 'em, do you?

<Chiselgrump shrugs.>

Doesn't bother me. Keep my head down and do my job, making sure these sinstones stay in good shape.

Keep breaking my tools, though.

Bring me some more chisels and I'll teach you an old dredger construction trick.

passages.title: It Used to Be Quiet Here
passages.text: Got those chisels yet?

passages.title: It Used to Be Quiet Here
passages.text:
Yeah, these'll last me awhile.

Alright, I'll show you the trick to making a barricade quickly...

passages.title: The Path of Ascension
passages.text:
With the anima you collected, we can once again start up the Path of Ascension.

The eternal training ground of the kyrian, the Path is an ancient tradition and favored amongst many of the kyrian, aspirant and ascended alike.

The Hands of Courage, Apolon and Artemede, have stepped up to lead this tradition. Once you herald the Path's rebirth, speak to them to learn more.

passages.title: The Path of Ascension
passages.text: By your hand, the coliseum is powered by anima once more. Glory awaits you and your allies in the Path of Ascension!
