passages.title: Among the Kyrian
passages.text:
You will be well at home among the kyrian, <brother/sister>. We welcome your aid.

The Archon was so confident in this outcome that she has arranged a grand reception for you in honor of your efforts against the Maldraxxus incursion into our realm.

For now, all you must do is journey to the Seat of Eternal Hymns. I shall meet you there.

passages.title: Among the Kyrian
passages.text: Much has culminated in this moment.

passages.title: A Proper Reception
passages.text:
Though the path you follow is not that of a traditional ascended, it is a kyrian path all the same.

To follow it is to bask in the footsteps of the innumerable lives before us, forever in service to a good far greater than we can achieve alone.

To join us amidst such strife is an accomplishment worthy of recognition. Our Archon has called all among us to join her in welcoming you to our ranks.

passages.title: A Proper Reception
passages.text: This is the final step of joining our ranks. Should you have second thoughts, have them now.

passages.title: A Proper Reception
passages.text: May this be but the beginning.

passages.title: Your Friend, Dactylis
passages.text:
With the materials you gathered, you are now ready to craft your lure.

Report to Dactylis. She will be able to help you craft not only this, but many more items of all kinds later.

Once you craft your lure, return to me and I will give you your next instruction.

passages.title: Your Friend, Dactylis
passages.text: Inspired by the Collectors, we must take the time to craft by hand. Through crafting we practice patience, diligence, and humility.

passages.title: Your Friend, Dactylis
passages.text: Every time you craft, a piece of yourself is imbued in whatever you create.

passages.title: Into the Coliseum
passages.text:
The time of your challenge has come!

As you are not a being of Bastion, you shall act as a tactician for your soulbinds. You have developed mighty bonds between each other... let us see how they handle the coliseum.

Let me know when you are ready to begin. Show us the merit of your bonds!

passages.title: Into the Coliseum
passages.text: This is just the first of many challenges ahead of you, <name>. Remember to stay humble.

passages.title: Into the Coliseum
passages.text:
A lesson in humility. But not one without purpose.

This blueprint will serve you well.

passages.title: Herald's Footpads
passages.text:
Sometimes, sheer force of will is not enough. A piece of equipment can save your life.

This blueprint you found can teach you to craft your first piece of equipment.

Bring it over to Dactylis. She will be able to aid you in this as well.

passages.title: Herald's Footpads
passages.text: Welcome back. How may I aid you?

passages.title: Herald's Footpads
passages.text: Ah, a new blueprint! Let us get started, yes?

passages.title: Overcoming the Trial
passages.text:
These new footpads can give Pelagos the edge he may need to defeat Kalisthene.

Return to the Path, <name>. Equip Pelagos with these footpads and overcome your opponent.

It may take a few tries, but all trials do.

Go in service, and in glory!

passages.title: Overcoming the Trial
passages.text: More trials lie ahead, <name>. Your future experience with the Path of Ascension is yours to guide!

passages.title: Redemption for the Redeemer
passages.text:
<Energies of death and innervation struggle to free themselves from the blade and consume you to your very core.>

<The bonds of warding placed on this blade by Prince Renathal will not hold for long. It should be taken to Sinfall where more permanent arrangements have been made for this prisoner.>

passages.title: Redemption for the Redeemer
passages.text:
Denathrius once served a noble cause. His charismatic leadership and understanding of the dark desires were instrumental in the redemption of more souls than your world has known.

Perhaps in time, he could be this again. If the right lessons were to remind him of his true purpose.

passages.title: Sanguine Depths: An Ally Within
passages.text:
There are whispers of a prisoner within these depths that may be of use to our cause. 

Whether this information can be relied upon is unknown. It is just as likely to be a trap, but still, we must investigate. 
We cannot afford to ignore an opportunity such as this. 

Venture into the Sanguine Depths and recover this valuable prisoner.

passages.title: Sanguine Depths: An Ally Within
passages.text: This naaru shall prove an invaluable ally.

passages.title: The Accuser
passages.text:
It is time to hunt our final prey, the Accuser.

Anima drought or not, her sycophantic adherence to sacred "rituals" flies in the face of the Master's will. I can't wait to see the fear in her eyes.

passages.title: The Accuser
passages.text: We meet again. Under dire circumstances I fear.

passages.title: On the Trail
passages.text:
In my visions, I witnessed Tyrande cutting through an endless storm of malevolent, nightmarish beings.

Up ahead... is that...? Yes. I believe it is the very place I saw.

Come. It may hold a clue as to where my mother has gone.

passages.title: On the Trail
passages.text:
Some vile force in this place intends to stop us from finding Tyrande.

If experience serves, that means we must be on the right track.

passages.title: Not My Job
passages.text:
Right. So, 'em devourers are going to start creepin' out of the Endmire soon. 

And with the anima drought puttin' the squeeze to the fangs... well... we ain't gettin' help from them until it's too late.

Us dredgers could use someone in your line of work. Professional destroyer as it were. 

If you can spare the time, meet me out at the Dredgewood. We'll scoop up a couple of lads and see if we can't make a stand.

passages.title: Not My Job
passages.text: I see you decided to get your hands dirty and join us gents in the labor pool.

passages.title: Descended
passages.text:
Though we have stopped the creation of more juggernauts, one of their most vile creations yet draws breath. It was born of one of the most pained souls they took from my temple in Bastion.

As I flew above their ranks I could hear their surgeons chanting its name above the din of combat--Woeblade. It is an affront to all the kyrian stand for, an atrocity beyond any other.

Mark it with the flames of courage when you engage, and we will help you destroy it.

passages.title: Descended
passages.text: May our victory bring them peace.

passages.title: Audience with the Winter Queen
passages.text:
Zephyrs herald the Queen's arrival. Hushed silence descends upon the grove.

Wait, watch, and speak when the time has come.

passages.title: Audience with the Winter Queen
passages.text: The Queen shoulders so much because of this drought. But she is powerful, and I know we will make it through.

passages.title: Audience with the Winter Queen
passages.text:
Gone so soon... the forest must be in even more dire straits than I realized.

<Moonberry looks crestfallen for a moment before resolutely setting her hands on her hips.>

Well, then we'll just have to help ease the Queen's burden. Then she'll have the time to grant you an audience!

passages.title: Nightmares Manifest
passages.text:
Oh, this isn't good. As soon as you left, the spirit's nightmares spilled out all over Tirna Vaal. 

I've done everything to try to soothe her. I've tried singing to her, I've tried telling her stories, but nothing I do seems to calm her.

Please, would you confront and dispel her nightmares? That might be the only thing that will work.

passages.title: Nightmares Manifest
passages.text: Her dreams are usually beautiful.

passages.title: Nightmares Manifest
passages.text:
There, that seems to have calmed her. I can feel her dreams begin to ease.

You really do have a knack for this!

But I'm worried that we're only buying time, and we need to do something more drastic.

passages.title: Call of the Hunt
passages.text:
You've done so much, but the Queen's focus is still divided across the forest.

If you want to deliver your message, then we need to help lessen her burden.

Let's start with the Wild Hunt. They are the protectors of Ardenweald, and dealing with the threat of the masked fae has stretched them thin.

Seek out Hunt-Captain Korayn at Glitterfall Basin. Last I heard, her hunting party could use reinforcements.

And don't let her ferocity put you off. She's quite nice as long as you're not her prey!

passages.title: Call of the Hunt
passages.text:
Lady Moonberry said she would be sending a strong hand to help secure this grove.

Now, how are you in a fight?

passages.title: Return to Tirna Vaal
passages.text:
We of the Wild Hunt are always prepared to return to the cycle in defense of Ardenweald.

I must move on, and so should you. I advise you to return to Droman Tashmur in Tirna Vaal. Others will need your help.

Here, take this. It is a gift and a thank you.

Helping each other is the only way to survive this drought.

passages.title: Return to Tirna Vaal
passages.text:
Oh, you have a spirit cradle! That will be quite useful, indeed.

Assuming we can calm this chaos, of course. The wildseed you bonded with is having intense nightmares... and they're manifesting all over the grove!

passages.title: The Sea of Souls
passages.text:
Some force here seeks to keep us from finding Tyrande.

The trail of bodies seems to go into this... stream of souls. 

I suggest we split up. I will follow along the bank of the river. You enter its current and follow the trail.

Should you need me, I will be close at hand.

We will find Tyrande, no matter where this course leads.

passages.title: The Sea of Souls
passages.text: Tyrande must see reason. She cannot save the kaldorei if she remains lost within this darkness.

passages.title: Shadowlands: A Chilling Summons
passages.text:
The time has come, <class>.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon requests your presence atop Icecrown Citadel. Meet me in Stormwind, and I will take you to him.

I would not keep him waiting.

passages.title: Shadowlands: A Chilling Summons
passages.text:
It is good that you have arrived.

We need heroes like you in this dire hour.

passages.title: First Time? You Have to Fight!
passages.text:
When it comes to warfare, strength of will is as critical as strength of arms. A demoralized soldier is a defeated soldier!

We have the numbers to overwhelm the constructs with a full scale assault, but only if our forces are fully committed to the charge. Some may fall, but their sacrifice will secure our victory!

Take this battle horn and rally our troops. Remind them of their duty to the Chosen!

passages.title: First Time? You Have to Fight!
passages.text: Have you rallied the troops?

passages.title: First Time? You Have to Fight!
passages.text: Our forces stand ready to fight once more!

passages.title: Tending to Wildseeds
passages.text:
We infuse wildseeds with anima from the animacones we collect in the surrounding area.

But the caretakers are missing, and we have wildseeds in need of an anima infusion.

This is an absolute mess that must be corrected before the Winter Queen arrives!

I've already gathered a basket of animacones. Can you use them to infuse a few of the wildseeds?

I'll show you how it's done, but then I have to look for the missing caretakers.

passages.title: Tending to Wildseeds
passages.text:
Fine work. We mustn't stop tending to the wildseeds that the Winter Queen has chosen to be saved.

Now, perhaps you can lend me a hand with another matter.

passages.title: Into the Light
passages.text:
I am afraid that you must endure the next stretch of the stroll without me, adventurer.

While my compatriots and I have secured access to the elevator that shall carry us up to Sinfall, we are unable to utilize it.

The Master has redirected a massive beam of Light directly onto the elevator's landing.

Venthyr that get close are obliterated.

Dredgers sent up never return.

We need someone who can walk in the Light to discover what is happening up there.

Lady Sybille will show you the way.

passages.title: Into the Light
passages.text:
<Breakfist is badly injured.>

Too many... couldn't make it...

passages.title: Shooing Wildlife
passages.text:
Things are chaotic here in the Tranquil Pools. I'd be devastated if the Winter Queen saw this.

This is meant to be a peaceful place where we give anima to wildseeds.

But with the current drought, starving beasts have encroached on the pools and are trying to feed on the anima themselves.

Sadly, we need to put them down... or else they may endanger the spirits within the wildseeds.

passages.title: Shooing Wildlife
passages.text: I hate having to do this, but if it's a choice between sparing the beasts and saving the wildseeds, I have to choose the wildseeds.

passages.title: Shooing Wildlife
passages.text:
Normally, I wouldn't require help from whatever race you are.

Ah... my apologies. That was rude.

Please understand that Ardenweald is home to souls from across all of the mortal realm. It's hard for me to keep track of every race that arrives here.

passages.title: TEMP MAW RUN
passages.text:
<Placeholder Quest. Thank you for your patience as our dev team works to make the Maw experience the coolest thing we can. In the meantime, please enjoy a sample of a snarky sword and her fourth wall breaking objectives.>

Look, normally I would give you a quest to storm the very Maw itself looking for Prince Renathal before he gets transferred in to the dreaded Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

However, since that is NOT something we can do. Let's just assume we did and go talk to that projection of him 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(60568))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(60568))");
 
 
 
 
 
 const cta = WH.Tools.createWowheadClientCta();
 if (cta) {
 $('.db-page-collection-tracker-cta').append(cta);
 }

passages.title: For the Sake of Spirit
passages.text:
With all of the anima you recovered from Tirna Noch, it is only a matter of time before my grove becomes the target of every anima-seeking enemy of Ardenweald.

I hope Dreamweaver knows what he is doing with this ritual.

Proceed quickly. Speak with Dreamweaver, and see what needs to be done to aid the spirit within the wildseed.

passages.title: For the Sake of Spirit
passages.text:
You're ready to begin preparing for the ritual? Wonderful.

I am also ready!

passages.title: Hungry for Animacones
passages.text:
I have to apologize for the state of the Tranquil Pools. Normally, it's quite peaceful here.

The wildseed tenders tell me that the plants you see walking around have eaten all the animacones intended for use in Tirna Vaal.

Could you rip the animacones out of those plants?

We have wildseeds that are in need of that anima.

passages.title: Hungry for Animacones
passages.text:
Have you found the animacones? They're still useful, even if they're a little slimy. 

Trust me, the spirits don't mind as long as they get their anima.

passages.title: Hungry for Animacones
passages.text: The animacones! In this time of drought, we have to scrounge for every bit of anima we can get. Thank you.

passages.title: One Special Spirit
passages.text:
You've been a huge help to Tirna Vaal. I need to bring this anima to one of our newest wildseeds.

I'd love for you to come with me. It's only fair, since you're the one who recovered the animacones.

I'm quite excited for you! Let's go.

passages.title: One Special Spirit
passages.text: The howling wind becomes a gentle breeze. All is well once again.

passages.title: One Special Spirit
passages.text:
Starlight shines within Dreamweaver, radiant and serene.

And... two rivers meet in a lush delta. A wildseed and a mortal, both new to the forest. Bonded by spirit and by fate.

Long has it been since the boughs beheld such an event. The weald will be watching.

passages.title: Preparing for the Winter Queen
passages.text:
Tirna Vaal is ready for the Winter Queen's arrival! And it's all thanks to you.

You have more than upheld your end of our bargain... and yet I was not able to do the same.

That is absolutely unacceptable for a faerie like me! What would the others think if they knew I had failed to honor our agreement?

Please, allow me to make it up to you. I may not have been able to deliver your message to the Queen, but I have a special surprise that I hope you'll accept instead!

passages.title: Preparing for the Winter Queen
passages.text: Joy follows Lady Moonberry, a scent that lingers as a flower blooms.

passages.title: Preparing for the Winter Queen
passages.text: Shadows loom over Heartwood Grove. Things unseen crawl within the darkness.

passages.title: Glimmerfin Scale
passages.text:
<A brightly-colored scale fell to the ground as the murloc ran off. It was unlike any other murloc you've seen in Northrend.

Perhaps King Mrgl-Mrgl would know more about this new species?>

passages.title: Glimmerfin Scale
passages.text:
What do you have there? Oh! Isn't this colorful.

You say there's a new band of murlocs down south? That doesn't surprise me, strange things have been happening in the waters far from here, from what I've heard.

Well, if they're friendly, it's up to us to welcome them! Here's a few potions, you're probably going to need them.

passages.title: Glimmerfin Welcome
passages.text:
First thing's first, they're probably hungry. Life up here in the cold isn't quite as easy as it is elsewhere, and even the most acclimated murlocs sometimes have trouble finding food.

We're going to need to feed them, but also help them find food for themselves.

They're already watching you, so search the area around where you found the murlocs for food sources and show them what to hunt. Then bring the meat to their leader--just look for the biggest one.

passages.title: Glimmerfin Welcome
passages.text: Mrgg?

passages.title: Glimmerfin Welcome
passages.text:
Mrg?

<Glimmergut looks at you, then cautiously takes the crab chunks and hands them to a nearby forager. The forager and Glimmergut appear to have a short conversation about your crab hunt.

Glimmergut turns back to you and points down at the sand.>

passages.title: A Big Horkin' Task
passages.text:
<Glimmergut begins to draw in the sand.

The murloc traces the outline of what appears to be a large seal. He points at the picture, then upwards, indicating that the creature must be somewhere on the surface of the water.

The murloc then digs a small, shallow hole in the sand, and points at it several times.>

Mrg! Mrg! Grml.

<He cocks his head expectantly.>

passages.title: A Big Horkin' Task
passages.text: Grmgr?

passages.title: A Big Horkin' Task
passages.text:
Grml! Mrgl-rgml. M'gurgle.

<Glimmergut looks at the foragers next to him. They nod, and he nods back.>

passages.title: Seer of the Waves
passages.text:
<Glimmergut points across the ship. He wants you to take the blubber to someone.>

Mrg m'grrl.

passages.title: Seer of the Waves
passages.text: <The oracle takes the blubberfat from you, as if expecting your arrival, and arranges it in a small pile.>

passages.title: Pearl in the Deeps
passages.text:
<The oracle draws a circle in the sand, then points down into the deeps. There is something round down there that she is after, perhaps a pearl or stone?

The oracle motions for you to wait a moment before you leave. She waves her hands around frantically, then places them under her mouth, mimicking two large fangs.

You take this as a warning that there may be something waiting for you in the icy darkness.>

passages.title: Pearl in the Deeps
passages.text: <The oracle looks at you.>

passages.title: Pearl in the Deeps
passages.text: <The oracle takes the pearl from you and rubs it gently before peering deeply into its shimmering depths.>

passages.title: Trainer's Test
passages.text:
<The oracle finishes peering into the pearl and turns to face you. She appears to be deep in thought, staring directly at you and blinking a few times.

Finally, she nods. 

The oracle points at you, then points upwards. She places a hand a small distance above the ground, indicating something pet-sized.

Your surmise that there may be test of your connection with your battle pets ahead.>

passages.title: Trainer's Test
passages.text: <The oracle looks very excited.>

passages.title: Trainer's Test
passages.text: <The oracle looks excited at your return. She points rapidly down at the blubber pile next to her, where an egg has been softly nestled.>

passages.title: Guardian of the Smallest
passages.text:
<The oracle pats you on the shoulder, and seems quite pleased with all that you've done.

She holds up one finger, then spreads her hands wide and emits a terrible roar-like murgle.

She points outside, then at you, then your weapon, then nods seriously.

There must be one more trial to await you. It would appear to be a test of strength.>

passages.title: Guardian of the Smallest
passages.text: <The oracle claps excitedly.>

passages.title: Guardian of the Smallest
passages.text:
<The oracle pats you excitedly on the shoulder, and raises her arm in triumph.

She starts, then points quickly at the egg and rushes over.

The egg begins to hatch...>

passages.title: Enemies at the Gates
passages.text:
Lorkron is here. 

I tracked him all the way from the Glittering Falls. Then I saw the Drust try to flank our forces.

I'd say they were rather surprised that we turned the tables against them.

<Korayn's smile is fierce. She lifts her weapon and her voice to address all present.>

Huntsmen and huntresses, with me! We ride to defend the grove! Take no prisoners and leave none standing!

passages.title: Enemies at the Gates
passages.text: This attack... It is like they are being driven!

passages.title: Eye of the Scryer
passages.text:
Evading the Mawsworn's scryers requires powerful magical countermeasures.

The prime reagent? A luminescent eye, pried from the skull of a scryer recently shaken from its trance.

The scrying ritual begins as we speak. You will, of course, be compensated only for an intact eye.

Restraint is advised in its procurement.

passages.title: Eye of the Scryer
passages.text: Well? Do you have it, undamaged?

passages.title: Eye of the Scryer
passages.text:
Do you think he saw that one coming?

That was an attempt at mortal humor. You may laugh at your leisure.

passages.title: Ride to Heartwood Grove
passages.text:
A storm of strife and fear rains down upon Heartwood Grove. Sylvar flee from the flood.

Brave the torrent astride a stag. Becalm the deluge and be the salvation of those who would drown.

Make haste. Time wanes.

passages.title: Ride to Heartwood Grove
passages.text: We can't leave Heartwood Grove like this.

passages.title: The Missing Hunters
passages.text:
Strange creatures have been seen lurking just outside the grove. Terrible, ugly things.

Whatever they might be, they are not native to Ardenweald. 

It does not matter how they breached our borders, though. Every one of them must be eliminated.

I sent my best huntsmen and huntresses to slay them, but not one has returned. See if you can determine what has delayed them.

passages.title: The Missing Hunters
passages.text:
Only Ara'lon and Lumera survived? The rest have fallen?

<Korayn trembles with unbridled fury.> 

I will see to it that their bodies are retrieved. And this cannot go unpunished. We will avenge them all!

passages.title: Extreme Recycling
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt serves the Winter Queen under the leadership of Lord Herne. We are elite fighters, hunters, and trackers.

But we cannot fight without weapons and supplies. The droman here informs me that there are severe obstacles to their delivery.

I do not have time to wait. We need equipment, and we need it now.

See what you can scavenge from the field. A broken weapon can always be mended and put to use again.

passages.title: Extreme Recycling
passages.text: Did you find anything of use out there?

passages.title: Extreme Recycling
passages.text:
You found far more weapons than I expected.

Very strange. How could they acquire so many of OUR blades?

<Korayn appears troubled.>

They will be used against our enemies again, I swear it.

passages.title: Totem Eclipse
passages.text:
I can smell our foes' dark magic, twisting the air and muddling my mind. They are up to something. Bringing awful powers into Ardenweald.

If you see any of their totems, destroy them immediately. 

I always feel better after smashing something to pieces, don't you?

passages.title: Totem Eclipse
passages.text: What terrible magic has been brought into Ardenweald?

passages.title: Totem Eclipse
passages.text:
If it was not clear before, it is now. This is a personal hunt.

We will rid Ardenweald of this monster.

passages.title: Big Problem, Little Vorkai
passages.text:
Ara'lon's report matches what I have seen. Too many enemies, and too few of the Wild Hunt to dispose of them on our own.

Fortunately, I feel strongly inclined to take matters into my own hands. And avenge my fallen hunters. 

Let us depart. We will show those monsters the fury of nature.

passages.title: Big Problem, Little Vorkai
passages.text: Ardenweald will endure.

passages.title: Big Problem, Little Vorkai
passages.text:
We have slain so many, and yet more remain. We must get to the heart of this evil and tear it out.

If we don't, then soon it could spread all across Ardenweald.

passages.title: The End of Former Friends
passages.text:
Heartwood Grove was to give up its anima so that other groves could survive.

But then... I started seeing these masks on many of the other fae. Soon, everyone was wearing them.

I don't know what has come over them, but it's clear they mean us harm. Please... you have to...

They aren't the friends I once knew. Not anymore.

passages.title: The End of Former Friends
passages.text: Thank you. I tried so hard to save them... but once that mask is on, there is no return.

passages.title: Recovering Wildseeds
passages.text:
One of my tasks in Heartwood Grove was to tend to the wildseeds.

Some were chosen to be brought back to Tirna Vaal. But now the masked fae are draining the anima from them!

We need to save the ones that remain. I beg of you, recover any surviving wildseeds you can find.

The spirits within them were chosen to be reborn. I won't let them wither away!

passages.title: Recovering Wildseeds
passages.text: We need to split up and rescue as many wildseeds as we can.

passages.title: Recovering Wildseeds
passages.text:
You found more wildseeds! They're so weak... I can't stand to see them like this.

We need to finish this and bring them to Tirna Vaal as soon as possible.

passages.title: Heart of the Grove
passages.text:
We were supposed to take the heart of the grove to Tirna Vaal when we left this place to wither.

The masked fae struck before that could happen. They must be after the heart of the grove!

The heart contains all of the anima that was meant to save the other groves. We can't afford to lose it.

Can you secure it? I need to find Korenth, one of our healers. His skills will help any survivors we find.

passages.title: Heart of the Grove
passages.text: Do you have the heart of the grove?

passages.title: Heart of the Grove
passages.text:
Korenth is... gone? And the heart of the grove has been taken?

Then... then we have much to do.

passages.title: Regrowth of the Grove
passages.text:
The grove thrives, my mortal friend, but there is yet room for it to grow.

With enough anima, it can nourish even more wildseeds at once. Each one is a spirit that might otherwise be lost forever.

Speak with Zayhad once again, and see to the regrowth of the conservatory.

passages.title: Regrowth of the Grove
passages.text: Your efforts revitalize the grove, and with it, countless spirits in need of aid.

passages.title: Blossoming of the Grove
passages.text:
The conservatory grows hearty and hale. Now, it must blossom anew.

Though it requires much in the way of anima, every additional spirit that the conservatory rebirths returns your generosity tenfold.

Confer with Zayhad, so that this conservatory may grow ever larger.

passages.title: Blossoming of the Grove
passages.text: You have this grove's gratitude. Yet more spirits may now rejoin the cycle.

passages.title: The Grove Resplendent
passages.text:
You have done much to return the conservatory to its former splendor.

In ages past, this grove was a place of convalescence for spirits who were wounded upon their demise, and needed special care before being reborn.

It was a place rarely used... but now, it is critical to the continuation of the cycle.

Tell Zayhad that the time has come. The Queen's Conservatory must thrive for the good of Ardenweald.

passages.title: The Grove Resplendent
passages.text:
The conservatory, and the spirits who are tended here, are forever in your debt.

Thank you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Draw Out the Darkness
passages.text:
Now that we have the dagger, it will take the combined will of all of us to sever the weapon's link to the High Chieftain. 

Jaina, Anduin, and I must do our part to keep Baine's spirit grounded, so it will be up to you to deal with whatever force is unleashed when the blade is broken.

Are you up to the task?

passages.title: Draw Out the Darkness
passages.text:
Were it not for your efforts, I am certain my body and soul would be trapped in this forsaken place for eternity.

I owe you my life, <name>, and I will fight to my last breath to repay this debt.

passages.title: Misery Business
passages.text:
The Mawsworn have begun harvesting the misery of the souls flowing through Gorgoa, the river of souls.

Why? I do not know yet. But it behooves us to stop them.

Destroy the conduits that they deposit the misery into and bring me some samples of their work. 

Perhaps with some research, I can discern their intentions.

passages.title: Misery Business
passages.text: Have you halted their misery?

passages.title: Misery Business
passages.text: Your burden is great, but today you have saved souls from damnation.

passages.title: Recovering the Animacones
passages.text:
The grove's droman is wearing one of the masks. I fear he's going to drain all of the anima from the grove's heart!

That anima is meant for the forest's other groves. If we lose it... then Heartwood Grove would have been lost for nothing...

We'll carve a path to the Shrouded Mire to find the droman before it's too late.

Many of these masked fae have stolen Heartwood Grove's animacones. We must recover them along the way. 

In this drought, every bit of anima is precious.

passages.title: Recovering the Animacones
passages.text: We can't let the possessed take anything else from us.

passages.title: Recovering the Animacones
passages.text: So many animacones lost... at least we were able to recover these.

passages.title: Survivors of Heartwood Grove
passages.text:
Korenth... I can't believe he's...

We have to save whomever we can. Droman Krelnor is too strong for us to face alone.

I saw a few other survivors scattered around the grove. Hurry, we have no time to waste!

passages.title: Survivors of Heartwood Grove
passages.text: We must rescue my friends!

passages.title: Survivors of Heartwood Grove
passages.text: Derawyn... I can't lose her too! We can use the animacones to save her!

passages.title: Flight Test
passages.text:
I fix these to my arms... then they become wings, yes?

Then I jump off cliff. And fly!

You watch?

passages.title: Flight Test
passages.text: Did you watch me?

passages.title: Flight Test
passages.text: Hmm... did not work. What else, what else...

passages.title: Dying Dreams
passages.text:
We have lost so much... and this one is special.

<Moonberry looks at you, resolute. Her voice is strangely formal, her manner commanding.>

Come, <name>. We will carry her on the Path of Rebirth and entreat the Queen to save her.

Hurry and make preparations. We have little time.

passages.title: Dying Dreams
passages.text:
Well met, stranger. You arrive in... interesting times.

<Herne snorts a laugh.>

And with equally interesting company.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text:
The Horde has come under siege, adventurer.

The undead Scourge rises like a grim tide, in numbers not seen since Arthas Menethil sat upon the frozen throne. 

And as if that were not concerning enough... something terrible has occurred.

What I am about to tell you, I share in the strictest confidence. This information will be known by all soon enough, but I needed to speak with you directly first.

Allow me to explain.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text: There is much to discuss.

passages.title: Cause for Distraction
passages.text:
Though we must search for Thrall and Baine, we cannot neglect the protection of our citizens and allies in the process.

As such, I have enlisted the aid of those who are experienced in dealing with the Scourge.

passages.title: Return of the Crusade
passages.text:
I have witnessed the relentless advance of the Scourge firsthand. It is only a matter of time before they swarm our gates. 

The fate that befell Silvermoon must never be repeated. 

Death knights from the Ebon Blade have stepped forward to combat the threat, but even they will need reinforcements.

The Argent Crusade has answered the call once more. I ask that you aid them in keeping our people safe, <name>.

Their commander awaits your arrival.

passages.title: Return of the Crusade
passages.text:
<Commander Throgg grunts.>

You must be the one.

passages.title: The Sacrifices We Must Make
passages.text:
Hurry! We can use the animacones we gathered to save Derawyn.

I know they're intended for the wildseeds... but we can't let these monsters take anyone else from us.

passages.title: The Sacrifices We Must Make
passages.text:
The heart of the grove...

We have to get it back... for all those who have fallen.

passages.title: Recovering the Heart
passages.text:
Darkness grasps the heart of Droman Krelnor, as he grasps the heart of the grove.

Anima drains from the heart, nectar taken from ripened fruit. It must be stopped.

Foul magic bars the way. Anima in peril, anima the salvation.

Beseech Te'zan. An old soul, brimming with anima, the spark to ignite our hope.

passages.title: Recovering the Heart
passages.text: We've lost so much. Why would anyone do this?

passages.title: The Anima Must Flow
passages.text:
This device you see here can be used to send anima to the thirsting wards, aiding our people.

As each ward regains its flow of anima, it will begin to flourish. You may find those that live there ready to aid you in your journeys, or you may even find new challenges that await you.

Once you have brought some anima to our sanctum, use the device to direct it to a ward, and see the results for yourself.

passages.title: The Anima Must Flow
passages.text:
Anima is flowing to a ward once more. You will want to return to the device periodically and channel more.

As you gather anima and channel it into Revendreth, the flows will grow stronger. Though they will not last for long right now, eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making a permanent connection.

With anima flowing into our lands once again, it is only a matter of time until we unite all of Revendreth under our banner.

passages.title: Tower Power
passages.text:
This device is used to channel anima to our towers across Maldraxxus, empowering our forces stationed at them.

Though you may find the support they offer useful, bear in mind that the anima will likely attract the attention of our foes.

Use the device to direct our stores of anima toward one of our towers. You will soon see what true power can accomplish.

passages.title: Tower Power
passages.text: The anima must flow!

passages.title: Tower Power
passages.text:
Yes, yes! I feel the flow of anima. You will want to return to the device periodically and channel more.

As you gather and channel more anima to a tower, its connection to our sanctum will grow stronger. Eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making it permanent.

With enough anima flowing throughout Maldraxxus, our armies will be unstoppable!

passages.title: The Roots Thirst
passages.text:
This device can soak the roots of our great canopy in anima. The branches thirst for it.

As each of the great trunks is filled with anima, it will begin to bloom once more. You may find those under its boughs ready to aid you, or you may find new challenges that await you in the shade.

Now, bring anima to the sanctum, and use the device to direct it out into the weald. Let the blooms flourish once more.

passages.title: The Roots Thirst
passages.text: The leaves shake in anticipation.

passages.title: The Roots Thirst
passages.text:
The roots are soaked in anima once more. Return to the device periodically and channel more anima, so that all may drink deeply.

As you gather anima and channel it, the flows will grow stronger. While they will not last for long right now, eventually you will be able to reinforce the channel, making a permanent connection.

Soon, all will open their blossoms and bloom in full once more.

passages.title: Field Reports
passages.text:
We cannot anticipate where and when the Scourge will strike.

In order to mount a defense, the Argent Crusade has set up outposts at several key locations. But we have yet to receive word from them.

Seek out my field officers along the southern road. I expect a full report when you return.

passages.title: Field Reports
passages.text: Reinforcements? Thank the Light!

passages.title: Field Reports
passages.text:
The situation appears far more dire than we thought...

Commander Throgg must hear of this.

passages.title: [OLD NOT USED]
passages.text: [OLD NOT USED]

passages.title: Disrupting the Flow
passages.text:
<The tortured embodiment of the soul before you burns with magmatic flame. Whatever purpose it was meant for here in the cauldron has since been served.

The complete disregard for the remaining husk of this soul is unsettling. These efforts will continue if something isn't done.

Send the inhabitants of Zovaal's Cauldron a message.>

passages.title: Disrupting the Flow
passages.text:
Rejoice in your accomplishment, but do not forget the weight of your actions.

He is always watching.

passages.title: Front and Center
passages.text:
The runes on that blade... they are the same as the ones etched on the door to the Seat of the Primus. 

And one of them just began to glow...

Is this what I think it is, adventurer? Do you have the means to unseal the Seat? 

If so, then perhaps Vyraz's gambit was not for nothing. This could turn the tide of the entire war!

passages.title: Front and Center
passages.text: Come! Victory awaits!

passages.title: Front and Center
passages.text: By blood and thunder, we will crush our foes.

passages.title: Trouble in Paradise
passages.text:
I have given your presence here some thought, <name>.

It is clear to me that you are no ordinary arrival from Oribos. I do not know why you are here, nor what you hope to achieve. That alone is simply unprecedented.

You must understand... individuals do not merely come to Bastion on a whim. This fate is earned, and those that are chosen for it are uniquely suited to this existence.

So... I ask you... why are you here, truly?

passages.title: Trouble in Paradise
passages.text:
<Kalisthene peers down at you.>

What is it, mortal?

passages.title: Trouble in Paradise
passages.text:
<Kalisthene peers down at you.>

We have heard you, mortal.

passages.title: The Door to the Unknown
passages.text:
You empowered the final rune? Then we might yet turn the tide of battle!

Open the door, <name>! We'll hold the enemy back as long as we can!

passages.title: The Door to the Unknown
passages.text: <The runeblade glows brighter as you approach an old stone altar.>

passages.title: The Way to Hibernal Hollow
passages.text:
I've never seen a wildseed quite like this one. Even the ones that bonded with their caretakers in the past never manifested nightmares like this.

Then again, we've also never had a living mortal in our midst.

We need to bring this wildseed to Hibernal Hollow. There it can receive the care and attention it needs.

I'll place it into the spirit cradle. Can you ask Niya if she would accompany you?

The poor sylvar has been directionless since the fall of her grove. This would be good for her.

passages.title: The Way to Hibernal Hollow
passages.text: I'm surprised that any wildseed could spawn such nightmares.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text:
It is imperative that these reports reach Commander Throgg, but we are hard-pressed to defend the Crossroads.

Before you depart, I ask that you aid us in thinning the Scourge's numbers. It may grant us the reprieve we need.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text: In troubled times, the Light guides our path.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text: You have my thanks, <class>. It will take all of our might to vanquish the Scourge.

passages.title: Death Motes
passages.text:
I have a task for you, Maw Walker.

Souls deemed suitable for service among the Mawsworn are broken down to their barest essence. The resulting creature forms a black shade, devoid of all individual will.

It is a tragic end.

I wish to better understand this process--what is it about a soul that causes this transformation?

Fragments of broken souls rain down across Ruin's Cradle. Bring me some of them, so that I might learn more about our common adversaries.

passages.title: Death Motes
passages.text:
It is perhaps... ethically questionable to benefit from these motes, given their source. 

But such knowledge may prove vital in defeating our enemies.

passages.title: I Moustache You to Lend a Hand
passages.text:
A message from the Primus of Maldraxxus, you say? We haven't heard from him in... Well, it's been a long time.

This isn't a prank, is it? The Queen doesn't have time for pranks. But I do!

<Moonberry leans in close and whispers to you.>

And for this one, I think we need one more lily.

<Moonberry winks.>

Let me take a look at this message. You bring that last night lily to Featherlight, and then we'll talk.

passages.title: I Moustache You to Lend a Hand
passages.text: I hope that your arrival in Ardenweald is a sign that better times are on the horizon.

passages.title: Soothing Song
passages.text:
I will fly ahead to Hibernal Hollow and convince the Droman Aliothe to help us. Hopefully she will have agreed by the time you and Niya arrive.

This wildseed seems to take comfort in your presence, so you'll need to stick close to it.

Niya will also need to sing to the wildseed to keep it calm... or else the nightmares may return.

Spriggans love to interrupt our songs, so be on the lookout for them.

Let me know when you're ready to head off.

passages.title: Soothing Song
passages.text: How strange that such a small wildseed could cause so much trouble...

passages.title: Soothing Song
passages.text: It's good to see you again. The Wild Hunt could use your help.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text:
Before you depart... we are in desperate need of reinforcements.

These reports must reach Commander Gregor. But if you would help us thin the Scourge's numbers first, it would grant us a much needed reprieve.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text: In troubled times, the Light guides our path.

passages.title: Damned Intruders
passages.text: Thank you, <class>. We will need all the strength we can muster in the coming days.

passages.title: A Suitable Demise
passages.text:
Surviving in this miserable place has been difficult, but I must confess... sending a few Mawsworn to a suitable demise does bring me joy.

The soulforgers in Zovaal's Cauldron are among the cruelest minions the Jailer employs. I find satisfaction in disposing of their cores in the very forges which they maintain.

This of course has the added benefit of temporarily slowing down their arms production, if you require more sober justification for your actions.

passages.title: A Suitable Demise
passages.text: Next time, ask me how to run a stampede of mawrats off the edge of a cliff. That never fails to entertain.

passages.title: Wildseed Rescue
passages.text:
<Featherlight checks his notes.>

Let's see... There was a request for help regarding an imperiled wildseed and... something about an egg? The original note wasn't entirely clear, but the fae who sent it was... Ah! It was Korenth. Again.

Well, I suppose we'll find out what his trouble is soon enough!

I'll fly ahead and look for him. Stick to the path.

passages.title: Wildseed Rescue
passages.text: You survived!

passages.title: Wildseed Rescue
passages.text:
That was fun to watch! You had that bird ready to build a nest and raise hatchlings!

Oh, how I needed that laugh...

passages.title: Advancing the Effort
passages.text:
While the other crusaders regain control of the tournament grounds, you and I must press on.

Our forces previously attempted to set up a forward camp farther into Icecrown, but they were overrun.

With you by our side, I am confident we can reclaim the area.

passages.title: Advancing the Effort
passages.text: There is no stopping what has begun. We must continue our efforts.

passages.title: Advancing the Effort
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>. 

Preparations are underway. Soon the foothold will be stocked and ready for use as a staging ground.

For the time being, there are other matters that require your attention.

passages.title: A New Foothold
passages.text:
Our preparations are complete. It is time we take the fight to the Scourge.

Justicar Trueheart has tasked me with leading our efforts at the forward camp.

Meet me there and we shall continue our work together.

passages.title: A New Foothold
passages.text:
Our scouts report increased activity among the Cult of the Damned.

I believe it is time we learn exactly what our fanatical friends are planning.

passages.title: Fit For a Margrave
passages.text:
We're finally ready, my apprentice. We shall craft our greatest potion!

Though what the potion is meant for escapes me, I'm simply so proud of your progress. Margrave Stradama will be thrilled by your achievements!

Come, now. Let's present what we've made to her!

passages.title: Fit For a Margrave
passages.text: Go on, apprentice!

passages.title: Fit For a Margrave
passages.text: Ah... apprentice? Are you there? I feel... strange.

passages.title: Remnants of the Wild Hunt
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt is holding the line against these monsters, lest they overrun the road to Hibernal Hollow.

Too many of my fellow hunters have been possessed by the dark magic of those twisted masks.

But with you here, we might be able to turn the tide. 

Aid any hunters you can find before our foes turn them against us.

I will meet you farther within the meadow. If we rally our numbers, we can bring an end to this battle.

passages.title: Remnants of the Wild Hunt
passages.text: Thank you for rescuing my fellow hunters. We'll have time to respect those who have returned to the cycle when this is all over.

passages.title: Evacuation Effort
passages.text:
Our forces are in danger, and the fault is my own. Believing that the surrounding area was safe, I sent a small team to secure the abandoned camp in the valley to the southwest.

But our field reports were outdated or mistaken. The camp is a lost cause. We must now focus on rescuing those whom I assigned to it.

Head for the camp. Do what you can to save our allies.

passages.title: Evacuation Effort
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. Your efforts have saved many lives.

From here on out, I will ensure that our scouting reports are accurate and up to date. It seems the threats we face escalate with each passing day.

passages.title: We Can't Save Them All
passages.text:
I am surprised--but pleased--that you weren't torn to pieces! Well done.

But now... I fear we have a far more serious task to complete.

The Winter Queen has decreed that Heartwood Grove's anima is to be reclaimed, and its denizens must leave it to wither. Not all of their wildseeds will go with them. In fact, only a few have been chosen to be saved.

We are to bring the final list to Droman Krelnor.

passages.title: We Can't Save Them All
passages.text: Move along, stranger.

passages.title: We Can't Save Them All
passages.text:
<Droman Krelnor sighs wearily as he reads the short list of wildseeds.>

At least a few will be relocated to Tirna Vaal.

passages.title: Ride of the Wild Hunt
passages.text:
Thanks to your efforts, we have turned the tide of battle. We won't soon forget your aid. 

We should be able to hold Soryn's Meadow, now that this brute is dead. 

Ride with us, <name>. Let us return to the road and your wildseed.

passages.title: Ride of the Wild Hunt
passages.text:
It is good to see part of the Wild Hunt's strength restored... and also that you found the spirit cradle of use.

Now let us bring the wildseed within it to Hibernal Hollow.

passages.title: The Fate of Ara'lon
passages.text:
<name>, I have an urgent request to make of you.

Recently, the Wild Hunt has been encountering the masked fae in greater numbers... particularly in the area surrounding Blackthorn Grove. I sent a hunting party to investigate, but they have yet to return.

Ara'lon was leading the hunt. You have offered him aid before, yes? I ask that you do so again.

Search the area for signs of the missing hunters and report back to me.

passages.title: The Fate of Ara'lon
passages.text: Keep your voice down. There are masked fae are nearby...

passages.title: Archival Protection
passages.text:
The rarest volumes are kept at the top of this tower, protected by an entity called the Archivist.

This stoic guardian is incorruptible. Intractable. Completely uninterested in striking a fair bargain!

Its utter lack of business acumen is really quite upsetting.

Ah, well. I fear we have no choice but to dispatch this impediment. Shall we?

passages.title: Archival Protection
passages.text:
The volumes are not here!

The Archivist's final words must have meant something. A clue, perhaps?

passages.title: Passage to Hibernal Hollow
passages.text:
You have done the Wild Hunt a great service. I must repay you in some way.

The battle for Soryn's Meadow has turned. With the brute defeated, the Blighted forces lose their strength.

Allow us to escort you to Hibernal Hollow.

Speak to me whenever you wish to depart.

passages.title: Passage to Hibernal Hollow
passages.text:
Dreamweaver has told me much about your strange wildseed. 

I will do what I can to help.

passages.title: Medallion of Desire
passages.text:
The Medallion of Desire rests upon the neck of the Countess. 

It is a source of power for her, but not her only source of power. Claiming it by force would merit us only a short victory. For this we must be much more subtle.

Lucky for us, Theotar has come to me with a plan but he will need your help. Speak with him and see what the two of you can do. 

He was closer to the Countess than any of us for a long time and I would consider him our resident expert on her.

passages.title: Medallion of Desire
passages.text: Down for a little espionage and intrigue?

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text:
You have truly proven yourself a hero in the eyes of those who are its absolute judge.

I thank you for giving me the honor of holding it, even for this briefest moment. However, it is only proper that you be the one to enshrine the spear at it's rightful resting place.

Let us meet at Hero's Rest where you can do the honors.

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text: <The resting place of the spear lies before you.>

passages.title: Rightful Resting Place
passages.text: <Place the Spear of Kalliope in its rightful place knowing that only a true hero can do so.>

passages.title: Ascension Calling: Kleia
passages.text:
<This scroll details an invitation for Kleia to join you and Pelagos on the Path of Ascension.

It would be wise to deliver this to her at once.>

passages.title: Ascension Calling: Kleia
passages.text: Time to stretch my wings!

passages.title: Masks of Deception
passages.text:
My hunting party was ambushed not far from here. I narrowly escaped capture, but the others were taken deeper into Blackthorn Grove.

We must find and rescue them, but we are vastly outnumbered. We'll need to disguise ourselves while we search the grove.

See if you can find something we can use to do so. I need just a little longer to recover from my wounds.

passages.title: Masks of Deception
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: Masks of Deception
passages.text: Yes! We can use these masks to disguise ourselves.

passages.title: Blackthorn Captives
passages.text:
These disguises will allow us to explore the grove undetected, but beware of the overseers. Their Drust magic will more than likely be able to pierce through our deception.

We need to save the rest of my hunting party while we still can.

passages.title: Blackthorn Captives
passages.text: The Drust have taken so much from us...

passages.title: Blackthorn Captives
passages.text:
Gweyir is the only survivor... but she's already been afflicted by the Drust's cursed magic. 

We can't just leave her here. Not like this!

passages.title: Only Shadows Remain
passages.text:
We may not know who this dark herald serves, but it is clear that the message she brings has emboldened the Scourge and the Cult of the Damned alike.

This cannot be allowed to continue. We must vanquish her and strike a definitive blow against her master's new minions.

Lead the charge, adventurer. The Argent Crusade stands with you.

Light willing, we will put an end to this madness here and now.

passages.title: Only Shadows Remain
passages.text: May we continue our fight together.

passages.title: Only Shadows Remain
passages.text:
It seems that eliminating the herald has slowed the Scourge's advance.

We will have to remain vigilant. Thank you for all you have done, <name>.

passages.title: Medallion of Avarice
passages.text:
The Medallion of Avarice was the tool of the Curator.

With its power it granted her authority over the Catacombs Ward. Combined with her knowledge of the vast library of sinstones Revendreth has accumulated over the ages, the Curator was a master of her craft.

When Denathrius defeated my first rebellion, he tossed both myself and the Curator into the Maw. 

The Curator was clever, though, and she hid the medallion before Denathrius could act. Come, let us speak of plans.

passages.title: Medallion of Avarice
passages.text:
The Curator is one of the few remaining true venthyr forged during the founding of Revendreth.

Her memory is vast, but her time in the Maw has fragmented the order of those memories.

She will need your help.

passages.title: Deep Echo Trident
passages.text:
<The trident glistens in the sunlight.

This should give your soulbinds the ability to interrupt their foes in the Path of Ascension.>

passages.title: Deep Echo Trident
passages.text: Trident? Very very nice! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: Blueprint: Deep Echo Trident
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a trident that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Deep Echo Trident
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Fortitude
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to fortify your soulbinds in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Fortitude
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: The Hunt for the Baron
passages.text:
<The amulet Bolvar gave you flickers with a faint red light, then grows dim.

To be useful in finding Darion Mograine, you must find a way to restore its potency.

You recall an area called Zovaal's Cauldron that was teeming with dark magic.

Perhaps the amulet's power could be restored there.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Phial of Serenity
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a phial that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Phial of Serenity
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Phial of Serenity
passages.text:
<Your steward friend gave you an extra bottle to store this potion in.

This should keep your soulbinds fighting in the Path of Ascension, as your phial does.>

passages.title: Phial of Serenity
passages.text: Phial? Very nice! Just like friend! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: Blueprint: Spiritforged Aegis
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a shield that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Spiritforged Aegis
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Citadel of Loyalty
passages.text:
The medallions, the source of magic the crown focuses, are still bent to the will of Denathrius. 

Forge cannot solve this. Citadel of Loyalty can.

Taken over by the Forsworn in recent times. If we can get the crown to the temple, we can break the loyalty to the medallion's former master.

passages.title: Citadel of Loyalty
passages.text:
Here we are. I'm glad we have your friends here too.

We are going to need it if we hope to reach the temple.

passages.title: Lowering Their Defenses
passages.text:
We can alter the crown to expunge Denathrius's corruption in the medallions.

Problem, Forsworn have set large barrier protecting the temple. Only there can Denathrius's influence be truly broken.

Drain the anima from the barrier's sources that power it. Barrier will disappear.

passages.title: Lowering Their Defenses
passages.text:
Excellent work. 

Barrier around the temple is gone. To fix the crown, we must go there.

passages.title: Disloyalty
passages.text:
There are many enemies of Bastion here. 

If we thin their numbers, it will further mend the tension between our realms. 

Show no remorse. 

I will take to the skies to support from above. I will be able to provide ground support when needed.

passages.title: Disloyalty
passages.text: Forsworn defeated? Good. The fewer of them there are, the happier I am.

passages.title: How to Wear Seven Medallions
passages.text:
One venthyr cannot wear seven medallions and command the power they bestow, nor command respect from anyone looking at them.

What I propose is the crafting of an artifact that can contain the power of the medallions. Focusing that power to one wielder.

Unfortunately, Revendreth lacks the craftsmanship needed to channel such powers. Not without turning the wearer into a puppet of Denathrius.

No, for this, we must employ the aid of a realm that specializes in service.

Draven has the details.

passages.title: How to Wear Seven Medallions
passages.text:
After much strategizing, the Prince and I have developed a plan that requires the aid and resources of someone I once led actions against on behalf of the Master.

Prepare to shield your eyes. We need to go to Bastion.

passages.title: The Absent-Minded Artisan
passages.text:
Of all the foolhardy, misguided, exasperating...

<Guardian Kota snorts and stomps a hoof.>

But standing here does Sha'lor no good. We must find him and bring him back safely.

Come, meet me at the Autumnal Rise. We can survey the burrows below and see if there is any sign that he lives.

passages.title: The Absent-Minded Artisan
passages.text:
No!

Whatever that beast was, it's taken Sha'lor!

passages.title: By Trials Forged
passages.text:
You have shown strength, cunning and compassion since your arrival in Ardenweald. These are the values the greatest hunters possess. 

It has been a privilege to fight by your side, <name>. It would be my honor to continue, as your Soulbind.

passages.title: By Trials Forged
passages.text: Together we are stronger!

passages.title: By Trials Forged
passages.text: Together, we will guard Ardenweald.

passages.title: Bound in Dreams
passages.text:
I knew you were something special when Ysera's wildseed reacted to you. Without you, she would have been lost! It would have been a tragedy not just for Ardenweald, but your world as well!

Since then, I have seen you take on many more tasks to help others in need. With your help, Ardenweald grows stronger.

I would be honored to help you continue the good work you have been doing, and to become your soulbind.

passages.title: Bound in Dreams
passages.text: I am humbled by the care you have shown for others.

passages.title: Bound in Dreams
passages.text: I just know that together we can save Ardenweald and all the spirits who slumber here.

passages.title: Ulfar's Guidance
passages.text:
There is one who may know how to dispel the curse from Gweyir.

In the mountains of Drustvar lives Ulfar, an ancient Thornspeaker who sided with the humans of Kul Tiras against his fellow Drust.

Journey to his den and ask for his wisdom. He may hold the answers you seek.

Lord Herne and I will tend to Gweyir once she arrives with Ara'lon.

passages.title: Ulfar's Guidance
passages.text: You have come from beyond the veil to seek my wisdom? A long journey indeed...

passages.title: Into the Flame
passages.text:
I know the curse of which you speak. Dark magic that possesses the mind of the afflicted.

Long ago, the Drust were ruled by a sorcerer king named Gorak Tul. It was he who twisted our rituals and set us on the path of death and domination.

You will need to claim a portion of his power to break the curse. 

Take this fetish to Gol Inath and temper it in the Flame of Oblivion. But beware... it is a vile place, and danger lurks among its shadows.

passages.title: Into the Flame
passages.text: Gorak Tul's magic empowers the curse, and only his magic can break it.

passages.title: Into the Flame
passages.text: I can sense Gorak Tul's dark power seething within this fetish. Handle it with caution, <class>.

passages.title: Confronting Sin
passages.text:
Thanks to the raid launched against Castle Nathria, we have obtained an opportunity.

A soul, powerful and fused with dark purpose at the hands of the Master's experiments. 

Given this soul is from Azeroth, the Accuser has asked for your assistance in untwining the corruption done to his sinstone.

the Accuser awaits you in the lower levels of Sinfall.

passages.title: Confronting Sin
passages.text:
I make no presumption that all mortals from Azeroth know each other. 

When confronting a challenging soul like this, however, it helps to offer even the faintest of familiarity.

passages.title: The Jailer's Share
passages.text:
The Mawsworn's torturers have a talent for misery.

The suffering they inflict often produces more stygia than they can collect. The excess floats loosely in the air, left to drift into the abyss.

I have fashioned a conduit specifically for capturing the leftover stygia. You can borrow it if you wish.

There are a handful of prime gathering locations throughout Calcis. As you'll be using my conduits, we can split what you find upon your return.

passages.title: The Jailer's Share
passages.text: Were the conduits effective? How much stygia did they collect?

passages.title: The Jailer's Share
passages.text: It is satisfying to know that the Jailer's share now belongs to us. Well done, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Dust to Dust
passages.text:
The Mawsworn never cease to invent new forms of suffering.

Even the ground on which we tread is formed from souls pounded into dust. With the flood of souls passing through Gorgoa, the Mawsworn are keen to expand their domain.

At present, the Mawsworn are burying souls and crafting new terrain from their torment. It is not too late for some of them.

Free the buried souls and stop the endless expansion of suffering.

passages.title: Dust to Dust
passages.text: They are safe?

passages.title: Dust to Dust
passages.text: The curious forms of torment the Mawsworn invent will never cease to amaze me.

passages.title: The Arbiter's Will
passages.text:
We will all suffer if Bastion and Maldraxxus fall into war.

For some time, the Necrolords have been isolated. You must travel to their realm and seek the truth of their incursion.

Though our anima reserves remain low, they will be enough to open the way for you.

passages.title: The Arbiter's Will
passages.text: This slot shall suffice.

passages.title: The Search for Baine
passages.text:
I dare not step inside that accursed tower myself, of course.

While I cannot tell you exactly where your comrade is being held, I offer a gift to assist you.

Use it inside Torghast. It should take you somewhere near your missing ally. Baine Bloodhoof was his name, yes?

Either that, or you'll end up trapped within the tower's ever-shifting halls for all eternity.

But those are the risks one must take, I suppose. Best of luck!

passages.title: The Search for Baine
passages.text: You've found him!

passages.title: The Search for Baine
passages.text:
Finding Baine was no easy feat. But you braved the horrors of that tower and succeeded.

Well done.

But I fear your work is only just beginning.

passages.title: Kivarr the Thornspeaker
passages.text:
In my youth, I was mentored by a wise and powerful Thornspeaker named Kivarr. She passed from this world long ago, but her soul may yet rest within the Shadowlands.

Kivarr's knowledge is ancient and vast, far eclipsing my own. She may be able to offer you the guidance that I cannot.

Seek her out. Deliver the fetish to her. She will know what to do.

May the wind be your guide.

passages.title: Kivarr the Thornspeaker
passages.text: Kivarr... yes, I have heard of someone by that name. Ara'lon may know where to find her.

passages.title: Disrupting the Cycle
passages.text:
The shacklers in the Tremaculum are an awful sort.

Souls are tortured there until they turn malevolent. They are then outfitted as guards so the cycle can continue. 

If you wish to slow the rate at which the Jailer raises his armies, start at the source. 

Disrupt the cycle at the Tremaculum.

passages.title: Disrupting the Cycle
passages.text: Well done, Maw Walker. The Jailer's forces are vast, but they are not infinite.

passages.title: Grathalax, the Extractor
passages.text:
There are many powerful lieutenants among the Mawsworn, but there is one who is particularly important to the Jailer.

Far beneath the Tremaculum lives the Jailer's prime interrogator, Grathalax. Power is fed to him via conduits throughout the area.

His role is to make the process of anima extraction more efficient. His methods are... unkind.

I believe we would both benefit from the end of his existence.

passages.title: Grathalax, the Extractor
passages.text: The end of Grathalax will deal a great blow to the Jailer's infrastructure. Well done.

passages.title: A Land of Strife
passages.text:
It is imperative that you identify the cause of the attack on Bastion.

We will require your aid to open the gateway. Once the focus is sufficiently powered, we will call upon the gate to Maldraxxus and direct it into position.

From there, the fate of this war must rest upon your shoulders.

passages.title: A Land of Strife
passages.text: Time is precious, now more than ever.

passages.title: A Land of Strife
passages.text: The way is open. The eternal battlefields of Maldraxxus await you.

passages.title: A Hunger for Flesh
passages.text:
<The bile-soaked cloth bears a deathly odor. Upon closer inspection, it appears familiar. The insignia of the Argent Crusade is unmistakable.

Commander Gregor will want to know of this at once.>

passages.title: A Hunger for Flesh
passages.text:
This... This is from one of our own... from within the city walls.

I will send word to our patrols. Remain alert, <name>.

Should the Scourge rise up from within our own ranks, find me at once!

passages.title: Kivarr's Den
passages.text:
Kivarr... I have not heard that name in many an age.

She used to make her home near Eventide Grove to the south. Ara'lon knows the area well. I suggest you take him with you.

I fear that the situation with Gweyir weighs heavily upon him. Perhaps joining you on the hunt will do him some good.

passages.title: Kivarr's Den
passages.text: Kivarr has made her home in Ardenweald for many an age, but she has always kept to herself.

passages.title: Kivarr's Den
passages.text: This is the place, but Kivarr is nowhere to be found...

passages.title: A Hunger for Flesh
passages.text:
<The bile-soaked leather bears a deathly odor. Upon closer inspection, it appears familiar. The insignia of the Argent Crusade is unmistakable.

Commander Throgg will want to know of this at once.>

passages.title: A Hunger for Flesh
passages.text:
This... This is from one of our own... from within the city walls.

I will send word to our patrols. Remain alert, <name>.

Should the Scourge rise from within our own ranks, find me at once!

passages.title: Heart of the Crest
passages.text:
With this greatest of gifts from Ardenweald, we have the final piece to rebuild the Crest of Ascension.

Let us make certain Willowblossom's sacrifice is not in vain.

passages.title: Heart of the Crest
passages.text: <The vessel seems drawn to the spot.>

passages.title: Heart of the Crest
passages.text: <Willowblossom's essence will suffuse the crest, completing it so Bastion can once more invest new Ascended.>

passages.title: Take The Fight To Them
passages.text:
Our scouts report that Margrave Gharmal gathers their forces at the House of Constructs.

Our necropolis and our new kyrian allies have already begun an aerial assault. I need you to lead our forces on the ground.

Meet me within Zerekriss. We will begin our attack immediately.

passages.title: Take The Fight To Them
passages.text: Victory will be ours.

passages.title: Forge Ahead
passages.text:
The Eternal Forge has anima again?

Ah! Yes! So exciting!

You must go. Find Forgelite Selene. She will help! So much to make!

passages.title: Forge Ahead
passages.text: Beautiful, is it not? I was not sure if I would ever see the forge empowered so ever again.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text:
The scroll you recovered details all manner of horrific ways to 'integrate' fallen kyrian into Gharmal's constructs.

It is also incomplete. There must be more of these among Stitchflesh's remaining followers.

I saw a number of surgeons and their lackeys retreat into the Hall of Chains just ahead as we arrived. I suspect they hold more of these scrolls.

We must ensure they are never read again.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text: This foul work must be destroyed.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text: Well done. I will see that these are destroyed personally.

passages.title: Wake of Ashes
passages.text:
It feels as if the Maw itself is sentient... and taking notice of our presence.

We must leave at once. Bolvar must be informed of what is happening here.

I will bring my father with us. Lead the way out of here, <name>. With haste.

passages.title: Wake of Ashes
passages.text: Now to get you and your... associates out of here.

passages.title: Extra Limbs
passages.text:
We cannot carry out the baroness's plans alone. What she proposes will require a well-coordinated unit.

Three individuals maintained Nurakkir alongside me. When the necropolis fell, two of my soulbinds fell with it.

There remains a single soul paired with mine. My sister, Xennir, survived the wreckage--though grief besets her.

Meet with Xennir. Guide her through her trauma, and return when she is ready to rejoin the fight.

passages.title: Extra Limbs
passages.text: We have suffered so terribly. I must preserve what I still have.

passages.title: The Other Foot
passages.text:
It is a fool's errand to command a necropolis without someone to repair it and keep it airborne. Nurrakir's mechanic was slain in the crash.

But opportunity arises in dire times. Vyn has told me of an... altercation among the constructs. One of their own resisted the reckless scavenging of Nurakkir, and was promptly detained for his objections.

Find this individual. An enemy deserter could make for a potential ally.

passages.title: The Other Foot
passages.text: So you need a mechanic? Well, you're in luck!

passages.title: Outside Influence
passages.text:
It takes a particular kind of magic to pilot a necropolis. The Eyes' helmsman perished with Nurakkir.

But Baroness Vashj has informed me of a means to acquire a new helmsman.

Follow me to our house's communications beacon. My baroness has taught me a way to summon just the individual we require.

I suspect she will not be pleased at the prospect of serving us. I trust you will encourage her compliance.

passages.title: Outside Influence
passages.text: I appreciate your punctuality.

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text:
The necropolis is nearly in position. Now is the time to strike!

We must force Gharmal into the open together. Join me on my roc, and we will unleash your runeblade's power on the juggernauts.

The Margrave will be unable to ignore their deaths. Once they leave their blighted tower, we can finish them once and for all.

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text: Every moment the juggernauts remain standing, our position is in jeopardy!

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text: Such power! Gharmal will have no choice but to face us now.

passages.title: Call In a Favor
passages.text:
We will do just as my baroness commands. Let us conjure a helmsman before us... however displeased it might make her.

Activate the beacon and prepare yourself for a fight. The liches regard all Eyes as their enemies, and I am certain your reputation among them does you no favors.

passages.title: Call In a Favor
passages.text: My baroness's trust in you is well warranted.

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Alacrity
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to hasten your soulbinds in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Persistence
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that encourages your soulbinds to persevere in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Persistence
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Discord
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to damage your soulbinds' enemies in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Discord
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Blueprint: Kyrian Smith's Kit
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a kit that lets you repair a piece of armor while out adventuring.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this kit.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Kyrian Smith's Kit
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: REUSE ME - SCS
[[Deprecated]]
[[Deprecated]]
[[Deprecated]]
[[Deprecated]]
Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. As long as this is still happening, we need to save as many as possible!

The Jailer twists the cycle of life and rebirth. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Oh, wonderful news!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, circumventing the natural order of the Shadowlands.

The Jailer denies these souls their rightful eternities. Only you, Maw Walker, can set things right.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Well done. They have been spared a truly cruel existence.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I'm sure you've seen firsthand the souls that continue to pour into the Maw. 

We must act now to cut off the Jailer's power, denying him as many souls as possible. That power belongs to the Necrolords.

I shall direct your efforts to save these souls, and help find them a place among the armies of Maldraxxus.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Excellent Maw Walker. Our armies here will grow stronger with each soul you return.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

Their anima, our very lifeblood of the Shadowlands, is going with those souls to fuel the Jailer. You rescued me from the Maw. I see no reason you cannot pull more souls from that abyss. 

Bring souls you rescue from the Maw to me and I shall see them put to better use. At least in Revendreth they have a chance of redemption.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
A very good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

Never fear, their fate is better in our hands than the Jailer's.

passages.title: Rage Against the Cage
passages.text:
You're looking for a mechanic, are you? Look no further!

I've been toiling on a new necropolis for ages. When Nurakkir collapsed, we saw a golden opportunity! We came to salvage parts from the wreckage, but these brutes locked me up when I criticized their methods.

But now you need help, right? I'm your construct!

You get me out of here, and you've got yourself a new mechanic!

passages.title: Rage Against the Cage
passages.text: Got a way to free me?

passages.title: Rage Against the Cage
passages.text: Thanks for the rescue! I owe you one.

passages.title: Rule 2: Keep a Low Profile
passages.text:
Though you may wish to depart with your precious souls in tow, we now have additional matters to settle first.

The Eye of the Jailer is upon you. And that does not bode well for either of us.

Take this device. You will reinforce my wards to ensure he does not take notice of me as well.

The last thing I need is a loud, inelegant mortal bringing more attention my way. I can't have the Jailer capturing me, after all.

I'm far too valuable.

passages.title: Rule 2: Keep a Low Profile
passages.text: Our business is not yet complete. Attend to my wards.

passages.title: Rule 2: Keep a Low Profile
passages.text:
That should be enough to hide us from the Jailer's sight.

I need you alive. For the time being, at least.

Now, back to business.

passages.title: Hatred Abated
passages.text:
As agreed, you may take my memory for the trials you seek.

Heed this warning, mortal--even as an echo of my physical form I will attack without hesitation. Expect no mercy, for I will show none.

You have done me a great service this day. See to your business.

passages.title: Hatred Abated
