passages.text: A worthy acquisition--you did what you must. I will inform Adrestes of this spy network.

passages.title: Power of the Primus
passages.text:
As a Necrolord, your duty is to defend the Shadowlands. To carry out such service, the Primus grants us his strength.

Stand upon the altar of the Primus. Let his power become your own.

passages.title: Power of the Primus
passages.text: It is a great gift to wield the Primus's power.

passages.title: Power of the Primus
passages.text: You are a Necrolord, <name>. We stand strong.

passages.title: The Hunt's Gratitude
passages.text:
The forests of Ardenweald are safer with your help, envoy of the kyrian.

As a reward for your aid, we shall allow you to capture our memory. It is an honor to be chosen to help train the mighty warriors of Bastion.

Whenever you are ready.

passages.title: The Hunt's Gratitude
passages.text: The Wild Hunt are incredible hunters. I look forward to seeing what your soulbinds learn.

passages.title: Caretaker of Faeries
passages.text:
Tirnenn and faeries hold many dissimilarities.

While tirnenn stand patient and calm, like the trees that grow tall and protect us, faeries dance and dart and declare their desires directly.

Despite these differences, we stand together. Learning, growing, evolving.

We will help you and yours achieve the same symbiotic serenity.

passages.title: Caretaker of Faeries
passages.text: It seems you have already learned from the tirnenn. I look forward to seeing what else they have to share!

passages.title: Oozing with Opportunity
passages.text:
They called me mad! As a matter of fact, they still do!

Ah, but none of them have the mental acuity of Doctor James Mortimus of the very much in-tact House of Plagues, nor his handsome smile! Fools!

With the catalyst you have so kindly provided, dear...whatever you are...certainly not a kyrian...

I digress!

We shall get to whatever it is you wanted in a moment, for now is the time of SCIENCE! Come, come, let me show you the wondrous fruits of my labors!

passages.title: Oozing with Opportunity
passages.text: It appears you were successful. Well done, as always.

passages.title: Filching Phylacteries
passages.text:
This phylactery holds the soul of Thran'tiok... her very essence.

Be quick in whatever you need to do. I must get this piece of her soul away from here before she returns.

Her paranoia shall truly be her end.

passages.title: Filching Phylacteries
passages.text:
It is fortunate that you were able to capture the lich's memory without encountering her herself.

Such a powerful being is not to be underestimated.

passages.title: No Other Way
passages.text:
Corinth will not surrender his memory willingly. You must weaken him sufficiently before he will relent to the soul mirror's energy.

You will find him deep within the Desiccation in Revendreth, locked away among the other light-scarred venthyr. Once you free him, he will surely attack in his confused rage.

Subdue him, and capture his memory. He may then roam free among his kind.

passages.title: No Other Way
passages.text: Another worthy acquisition. Corinth will be a worthy test of your skills.

passages.title: Back to Him
passages.text:
Even with Humility's Guard in hand, if you are to convince Athanos to join the Path of Ascension once more then you must prove yourself a worthy adversary.

Enter the ring and wield the spear against him. Even with its power you cannot hope to defeat him, but it should be able to parry his mighty stomp.

Thwart his assault for long enough, and he will surely allow you to capture his memory.

passages.title: Back to Him
passages.text:
<Dactylis' face expresses what appears to be surprise.>

You actually did it? Very well! A most worthy opponent indeed.

passages.title: The Eye of the Jailer
passages.text:
<The air around you stands still. A chill of domination suffuses your being. You hear a voice.>

Yes... I remember you...

Do you think that because you evaded my grasp once, that I would let it happen again?

No. The Maw answers to me. All that befalls you here will be because I willed it so.

Death comes for you, mortal. Everywhere you go, my eye is upon you.

passages.title: Dark Developments
passages.text:
<The torn document appears to have been written by Surgeon Stitchflesh.>

...the kyrian flesh improves strength, obedience, and dexterity twofold! Such potential!

Now, if subject number one-three-five succeeds in a proper wing transplant at last...

<It continues on for some time. You should bring this to your kyrian allies.>

passages.title: Dark Developments
passages.text: Allow me to read this for a moment.

passages.title: Opportunity Strikes
passages.text:
This sanctum cannot function on anima alone. It will take many willing souls working in harmony to unlock the full potential of the Seat of the Primus.

Our Soul Warden is always in search of new souls to induct into the sanctum. Your ability to travel back and forth from the Maw will undoubtedly prove useful to him.

You should pay him a visit to see what assistance you can offer.

passages.title: Opportunity Strikes
passages.text: With your unique abilities, we have an opportunity we've never had before.

passages.title: Ember Court: Venthyr Volunteers
passages.text:
Oh, hello again!

Did you hear that I have been given command of the guard for the Ember Court? That would probably be more impressive if there were already recruits.

I need to get these recruiting posters up. If you can take care of that, I can meet the interested recruits here and then we can test their combat skills when you return.

passages.title: Ember Court: Venthyr Volunteers
passages.text: Those posters need to be put in visible locations and the recruits need to be tested.

passages.title: Ember Court: Venthyr Volunteers
passages.text: Hah! I anticipate some fun with this. I will test the remaining recruits!

passages.title: Ember Court: Tubbins's Tea Party
passages.text:
Theotar need tea for party? Tubbins make best!

Special tea. Very special. Only I can make. Recipe need very good water from garden place. Good pool on special floaty island!

You go get and Tubbins makes tea!

passages.title: Ember Court: Tubbins's Tea Party
passages.text: Need special water to make special tea. Makes sense.

passages.title: Ember Court: Tubbins's Tea Party
passages.text:
Mmm, water taste clean...

Like me! I'm cleanest!

passages.title: Ember Court: Mushroom Surprise!
passages.text:
I had not realized the fame of my fungi had reached so far. I'd be delighted to provide a mushroom feast to the Ember Court!

Hmmm... I will need you to collect some rare specimens and will loan you my favorite foraging bag. It will help you find the very best fungi. It's never failed me.

Let's see, I need tiny lacy bells from Bastion and some of those Ardenweald fancy purple frills. From the very tops of our mushrooms here I will need the feather caps. You'll need to grapple your way up there.

passages.title: Ember Court: Mushroom Surprise!
passages.text: Have you filled the foraging bag?

passages.title: Ember Court: Mushroom Surprise!
passages.text: Well, those smell good and ripe! You're pretty good at this, <name>.

passages.title: An Early End
passages.text:
Within the Hall of Chains lie more constructs that are nearly complete. As we speak, the Margrave's forces work fervently to graft the last pieces of flesh to their horrific visages.

If they are allowed to finish their work, then the destruction we have wrought thus far will make little difference in the final conflict. Our flank will be overrun by a fresh wave of horrors, and the day will be lost.

That must not come to pass. Destroy any of these abominations you encounter.

passages.title: An Early End
passages.text: Every abomination denied is one less foe to contend with when we face Gharmal.

passages.title: Field Trip
passages.text:
Now that you have the catalyst, you need only bring it to Mortimer in Maldraxxus. Our last correspondence indicates that his laboratory is still in-tact within the former House of Plagues.

Exercise caution in your journey--what remains of the house is fraught with danger, and Mortimer himself has earned a less than pristine reputation among his peers.

passages.title: Field Trip
passages.text: Ah, yes! You must be the one from Bastion! Marvelous!

passages.title: The Heart of the Forest
passages.text:
I knew we were gonna get along! Welcome to our covenant. Well, almost.

There's just a few details left. Little things. You know. Oaths to be made, blood pacts to sort out, firstborns to be promised.

<Moonberry snorts a laugh.>

I'm just kidding!

Well, not about the oaths part. We take those seriously around here.

I'll meet you at the camp outside the Heart of the Forest!

passages.title: The Heart of the Forest
passages.text: This is going to be such fun!

passages.title: Humble Beginnings
passages.text:
With Humility's Guard whole once more, you may be able to coax Athanos back into the arena.

Travel to Aspirant's Crucible, where your journey began so long ago. Seek Forgelite Sophone--she guides all those who seek an encounter with Athanos.

Present the spear to her. She will know your intent and instruct you further.

passages.title: Humble Beginnings
passages.text: What is that you have there?

passages.title: Humble Beginnings
passages.text: I never thought I would see this spear again! This will be most interesting.

passages.title: The Boon of Shapes
passages.text:
<Moonberry looks serious.>

Mortal though you are, you have chosen to become one of our champions. While you uphold our cause, we are obligated to extend hospitality to you within our sacred hall and grant you certain boons.

As a member of the Court of Night, I can bestow our powers on chosen mortals.

<name>, <class> of Azeroth, I bid you welcome to the first tree, Tirna Achiad, the Heart of the Forest.

Please, follow me.

passages.title: The Boon of Shapes
passages.text: Accept this boon and use it for the benefit of Ardenweald.

passages.title: The Boon of Shapes
passages.text:
May this boon aid you in the trials ahead, <name>.

Before our Queen grants you our power and we accept you formally into our midst, there are certain... traditions which we must uphold.

passages.title: I'll Only Say This Once
passages.text:
At last, we are fully prepared to enact the baroness's plan.

Now that you have arrived, I will recount our roles one final time. Then we will seize our fate.

Listen closely.

passages.title: I'll Only Say This Once
passages.text: Let us put our plan into motion.

passages.title: The Banshee's Champion
passages.text:
I... we... I mean... he's...

<The young courier gulps.>

We found him. We found the Blightcaller.

I was on patrol like I'd done a hundred times before only there he was sitting on the front porch of that old house with those terrible dogs and I swear he smirked at me and stared with those fiery red eyes and--

<The young courier wipes his brow.>

He's at the Marris Stead. Our forces have him surrounded, but, uh...

You should probably gather your friends. I don't think he plans to surrender.

passages.title: The Banshee's Champion
passages.text: What news do you bring of the Blightcaller?

passages.title: The Banshee's Champion
passages.text:
At long last, one of the most notorious enemies of the Alliance has met his end.

Well done, <name>. Well done indeed.

passages.title: The Banshee's Champion
passages.text:
<The messenger appears visibly shaken.>

Word has reached us of... well, I'm not quite sure how to put it...

The Blightcaller has been found.

Horde forces have been scouring Azeroth for any sign of him. Determined to make him answer for his crimes.

One of our Argent patrols has found him. Not hiding in some distant land. Just... waiting at his old homestead.

We have him surrounded, but, uh, I confess I don't like our odds.

Perhaps you could gather your allies and bring him to justice.

passages.title: The Banshee's Champion
passages.text:
<A wry smile crosses the Regent Lord's face.>

A fitting end to the Blightcaller. I only wish I had been there to see it.

passages.title: Of Hearsay and Heresy
passages.text:
Echthra has taken residence in one of the few remaining structures in the former House of Eyes in Maldraxxus.

Bring the anointment oil to her, and she should allow you to capture her memory. Take caution, for she is well-known both as a master marksman and--perhaps more notably--for her quick trigger finger.

Good luck, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Of Hearsay and Heresy
passages.text: Be cautious. There are many in the House of Eyes who would not tolerate your presence.

passages.title: Of Hearsay and Heresy
passages.text: Let us have words quickly--before I change my mind.

passages.title: The Princeguard
passages.text:
Renathal carries himself well, but hides great pain. His wounds from Denathrius have not healed.

He is vulnerable.

He intends to send you to secure his old fortress of Darkwall Tower with banners and rely on his own strength to deter enemies. This is a poor tactical choice.

Take this small reserve of anima with you and revive Chelra the Bladewall. She was last seen at Darkwall. Revive her and she can aid you in taking the tower.

passages.title: The Princeguard
passages.text: I have suffered in stillness for months. I worried I would never wake again.

passages.title: The Princeguard
passages.text:
Well fought. That will not hold them for long, but it should buy Renathal the time he needs.

Thank you, mortal, for the infusion. I shall put this precious anima to good use while it lasts.

passages.title: A Bountiful Haul
passages.text:
Chordy want to go on adventure! You want to go too, yes?

I scavenge, weapons, armor, and valuable luckydos! Though, luckydos seem to be in short supply these days.

We go to land of tree people! If we search together, we'll find many luckydos!

passages.title: A Bountiful Haul
passages.text: Did we find anything good?

passages.title: A Bountiful Haul
passages.text:
Where did you find these? They're positively covered in filth!

Ugh, that smell! Here, take this and go clean yourself up.

passages.title: Things They Leave Behind
passages.text:
Chordy bored. Chordy want to go on adventure! You want to go too, yes?

Pale people in tall buildings have many shinies and luckydos. We go there and find some for ourselves!

You ready to go?

passages.title: Things They Leave Behind
passages.text: Did we find anything good?

passages.title: Things They Leave Behind
passages.text:
Interesting finds. These will be quite useful.

Thank you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Follow Me
passages.text:
Assuming the others are in position, we are prepared to steal the necropolis.

You and I must push forward to rendezvous with Ansid. Khaliiq will regroup with Vyn once their tasks are complete.

Come along, adventurer, and stay near. I will shroud the both of us in shadow, so long as you are at my side.

passages.title: Follow Me
passages.text: Keep your eyes open.

passages.title: Follow Me
passages.text: It seems we've been discovered. Times like these demand flexibility.

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text: Yes? Did you find anything on your supply run?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
There's work that needs doing 'round here. Mmmm hmmm.

Spotted a big ol' carcass nearby. I aim to salvage it for parts. 

Figure you could come along, help me drag it to Rathan. He'd like that. Mmmm hmmm. 

Reckon I could even carry you there and back. You don't look too big.

Ready to get going?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text: Yes? Did you find anything on your supply run?

passages.title: Corpse Run
passages.text:
<Rathan gives Flytrap an apprehensive look.>

That's... that's great!

Thank you both for bringing back these resources!

<Rathan flashes you a nervous smile.>

passages.title: The Forge of Bonds
passages.text:
<name>, are you ready for another gift?

The next boon we grant thee is one of bonds. As you have bound yourself to us, we shall bind to you. In the binding of souls, we become something greater.

<Moonberry leans in close.>

Sounds scary, huh? Don't worry! You and your soulbind will both strengthen each other.

When I asked for volunteers, many fae stepped forward. I picked someone I just know you're going to like. And this will be a boon for her, too.

Go to Flutterby. She'll help you both.

passages.title: The Forge of Bonds
passages.text: Oh, wow! I love guiding soulbinding! It's my favorite duty!

passages.title: The Boon of Binding
passages.text:
<Flutterby clasps her hands before her and assumes an air of tranquility.>

Soulbinding is not an irrevocable act. However, such a bond must be carefully considered before it is made.

You and your soulbind will know each other's hearts and minds. Your hopes and fears; your dreams and memories; all will be shared between you. 

As long as the bond exists, you are intertwined; always together even when apart.

Once complete, your connection will transcend physical space and empower you both.

passages.title: The Boon of Binding
passages.text: When you are ready, we may proceed.

passages.title: The Boon of Binding
passages.text: You... have lived a very interesting life.

passages.title: Set Me Free
passages.text:
Ansid has been captured and imprisoned by the foundry's guards.

It seems they were expecting us, completely shattering the element of surprise. My baroness would be disappointed in my lack of foresight.

This plan cannot succeed without Ansid. One of these soldiers is bound to possess the key to his cage.

Should you find it, we may yet carry out my baroness's will.

passages.title: Set Me Free
passages.text: Take caution.

passages.title: Set Me Free
passages.text: Expertly navigated. Perhaps you should pilot the necropolis.

passages.title: The Hunt Watches
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt protects. Many eyes watch for danger. Many ears listen for secrets.

Watcher Vesperbloom directs the eyes and ears of the forest.

Seek out our new growth, then turn to her for guidance.

passages.title: The Hunt Watches
passages.text: Ah. You're here. Good.

passages.title: The Hunt Watches
passages.text: We have much to do.

passages.title: Know Where to Strike
passages.text:
It is the Wild Hunt's duty to hunt down those who would harm our charges and to ensure the security of our borders. But as the crisis has grown, so have our duties to Queen and Grove.

This is where I come in. It is my duty to be aware of all that goes on within the endless forest. It is my charge to help deploy our resources, so that we may aid our queen.

Allow me to demonstrate...

passages.title: Know Where to Strike
passages.text: Every victory furthers our cause.

passages.title: Know Where to Strike
passages.text: They will succeed in their mission, I have no doubt.

passages.title: The Play's The Thing
passages.text:
You may be wondering about the last boon we may grant thee, O' champion of Ardenweald, petitioner to our Hunt.

<Vesperbloom could be smirking... Or it could be a trick of the light.>

Before our Queen grants you our power and we accept you formally into our midst, there are certain... Traditions which we must uphold.

Lady Moonberry awaits you in the Sanctum Hall with more information.

Break a leg.

passages.title: An Echo in the Darkness
passages.text:
adventurer, I... I am beset by dark visions. A power emanating from within Torghast.

A familiar sensation. One I have not felt since...

Come to Oribos. Do not delay.

passages.title: An Echo in the Darkness
passages.text: <Bolvar grimaces in pain.>

passages.title: The Highlord's Vision
passages.text:
<Thrall's brow is furrowed.>

We were speaking with the Highlord when he was struck by a jolt of agony.

He said he could see something stirring in the Maw. Inside the Jailer's tower.

The pain seems to be getting worse. We need to find out what he's sensing.

passages.title: The Highlord's Vision
passages.text: We must know the truth.

passages.title: The Highlord's Vision
passages.text: This is dire indeed.

passages.title: A Mourneblade Born
passages.text:
While his father was missing, I cared for Anduin like a son. To see him like that, at the mercy of Sylvanas...

<Bolvar's eyes flare with fire.>

Something must be done.

Take a moment. Let me know when you are ready to discuss what comes next.

passages.title: A Mourneblade Born
passages.text: We have to save Bolvar!

passages.title: Grave Intent
passages.text:
My spies have identified several astral projectors that Margrave Gharmal uses to rally their troops in the Stitchyard.

I do not wish for a swarm of frenzied constructs to descend upon us during the final confrontation. Surely you see the wisdom in cutting their fervor.

See to it that these projectors are destroyed. We believe them to be along the yard's perimeter.

passages.title: Grave Intent
passages.text: Gharmal's influence runs deep in this place, but it will fade more quickly thanks to your efforts.

passages.title: Keys to the Ruin
passages.text:
At last, our target is within reach.

The necropolis rests above us, moored to this platform by a necrotic restraining bolt.

Twigin can fly you to the apex of the necropolis. It will be ours to command once you insert this keystone.

We will prepare for our departure. Rejoin us when you are done.

Victory will soon be ours.

passages.title: Keys to the Ruin
passages.text: Our mission is nearly complete.

passages.title: Keys to the Ruin
passages.text: Come, <name>. Would you not witness your success firsthand?

passages.title: Machinations of War
passages.text:
With Bastion as our ally, we have the strength to crush Gharmal and the House of Constructs.

We'll gather the supplies for the attack, but our soldiers need a great champion to follow into battle.

Prove to them that you are the champion they seek.

passages.title: Machinations of War
passages.text: Well done, Maw Walker. Our forces are prepared to strike.

passages.title: This Way Out
passages.text:
We are fully prepared to launch the necropolis. We must hurry before Margrave Gharmal tries to interfere.

Speak with Vyn when you are prepared, but we mustn't waste time.

We will cast our shadow upon all of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: This Way Out
passages.text: It is time to depart.

passages.title: Troubled Souls
passages.text:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!

passages.title: Troubled Souls
passages.text: So many souls, we have much work to do!

passages.title: PH - UNUSED
passages.text:
You have proven your dedication to not only your soulbinds and their training, but to the ways of the kyrian.

Stand proudly in your accomplishments, but know that there is no end to what you can learn.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed. The Archon requests your presence.

passages.title: Unity
passages.text:
A unique construct has chosen to join us, but its unethical creation leaves it most unsettled.

The fusing of fragmented Kyrian souls within this construct, gives it pain and suffering. We must find a way to harmonize these souls so they can live together in peace.

Create the Bindings of Wellbeing and bring ease to the Soulfused Construct.

passages.title: Unity
passages.text: Have you helped this construct?

passages.title: Unity
passages.text: So many souls now in harmony. Perhaps with time this construct will find happiness and a home here.

passages.title: Iron Solution
passages.text:
News of our work here has spread, new souls have arrived seeking to join us!

Take their requests for new construct bodies. We'll see if we can build them new constructs too!

passages.title: Iron Solution
passages.text: So many souls, we have much work to do!

passages.title: Searching the Grove
passages.text:
It is clear that a struggle took place here. I fear that Kivarr may have been taken by the Drust.

I scouted the surrounding area before you arrived. Eventide Grove has been overrun.

The Drust cannot have taken her far. We may yet be able to find her. I just pray that we are not too late...

passages.title: Searching the Grove
passages.text: Ulfar sent you to find me? Free me from this cage, and I will do what I can to aid you.

passages.title: A Swift Intervention
passages.text:
The Drust just took Kivarr away. They said they were going to sacrifice her in one of their rituals!

If we hurry, you may still be able to save her! I've seen where the Drust keep their sacrificial altar... it's scary, but I can take you there!

There's no time to waste! Follow me!

passages.title: A Swift Intervention
passages.text:
Not a moment too soon! I appreciate your punctuality.

My den is not far away. We should hurry before more Drust arrive.

passages.title: Nox Root
passages.text:
In order to perform the ritual, I will need some nox root from Darkreach.

It is a unique plant that only grows within soil that has been corrupted by Drust magic.

Darkreach lies to the west, not far from my den. What was once a peaceful, verdant grove is now filled with blight and ruin.

I will travel to the Heart of the Forest to prepare the ritual. Meet me there when you have gathered the nox root.

passages.title: Nox Root
passages.text: Have you brought the reagents?

passages.title: Nox Root
passages.text: Good, you were able to find enough nox root for the ritual. Unfortunately, we have another problem...

passages.title: Ember Court: Guest RSVPs
passages.text:
Prince Renathal will wish to invite certain guests to each Ember Court.

In the future, we'll be able to adjust the guest list to make it easier to please everyone in attendance. But, we should follow the Prince's lead on this first one.

Work with Lord Garridan and Lady Ilinca to ensure that Cryptkeeper Kassir is able to attend and returns his RSVP.

If you haven't met Cryptkeeper Kassir yet in your adventures, you may need to introduce yourself before he'll listen to you.

passages.title: Ember Court: Guest RSVPs
passages.text: The prince is wise to hold court. A timeless tradition of influence and prestige in this realm.

passages.title: Witch's Satchel
passages.text:
I sent Ara'lon to steal a witch's satchel from the Drust... a dangerous task from which he has yet to return.

The Drust's nightscreamers carry many reagents we need to perform the ritual. We cannot proceed without one.

You must go to the Oaken Assembly to procure one of their satchels... and find Ara'lon, if you can.

passages.title: Witch's Satchel
passages.text: Do you have the satchel? And what of Ara'lon?

passages.title: Witch's Satchel
passages.text: This contains everything we need. Give me a moment and I will prepare the reagents for our ritual.

passages.title: The Broken Spear
passages.text:
<The shattered remains of a sylvari spear litter the ground. You recognize the spear as belonging to Ara'lon.

This confirms that Ara'lon was here. Unfortunately, he is nowhere to be found.

Lord Herne will want to know of your discovery.>

passages.title: The Broken Spear
passages.text: What news do you bring?

passages.title: The Broken Spear
passages.text:
Though this bodes ill, I am not ready to give up hope that Ara'lon survived. He may still be out there.

I will assemble a search party. We will find him and bring him home... no matter what fate has befallen him. Thank you.

passages.title: Ritual of Purification
passages.text:
I have finished making preparations for the ritual. The moment of truth has come.

The Drust fetish that Ulfar gave you will channel the ritual's power into Gweyir. It should counteract the curse that imprisons her mind.
 
This will not be pleasant. It may not even work. But this is the only chance we have to free her.

passages.title: Ritual of Purification
passages.text: The ritual is our only hope of freeing Gweyir. We must try...

passages.title: Ritual of Purification
passages.text:
You performed the ritual admirably, but the Gorak Zhar's power was too strong for Gweyir to withstand. There is nothing more we can do, I am afraid.

It seems the masked fae are lost to us after all...

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Quickness
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to make your soulbinds fleet of foot in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Quickness
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Gilded Abacus
passages.text:
<A beautifully crafted abacus rests in your hands. Its frame glimmers and shines in the light, its beads smooth auric orbs.

Your steward will appreciate this as not only a useful gift, but an exquisite one.>

passages.title: Gilded Abacus
passages.text:
<Your companion stares in awe.>

No words to say... so beautiful! Can keep track of much more now. But what to count...

Aha! Count your things! No worry, am excellent counter. Woo-woo!

passages.title: Request of the Highlord
passages.text:
The information you uncovered in Maldraxxus should quell the drums of war between the Necrolords and the Kyrian.

And this message from the Primus... extraordinary!

I would advise you to enlist Highlord Fordragon's counsel, but he appears preoccupied. Visitors from your world have come to seek him out. Quite insistently, I might add.

The nuances of mortal interaction elude me. But it seems the nature of their dialogue was rather... intense.

Perhaps you can assist the Highlord with this matter.

passages.title: Request of the Highlord
passages.text:
<Even through his scarred, molten visage, the emotion on Bolvar's face is plain.>

My daughter... here. I never thought...

passages.title: A Glimpse into Darkness
passages.text:
When I put the Lich King's crown upon my head, I wanted the world to believe I was dead. Even my daughter, Taelia. I... thought a lie would be kinder than the truth.

But she is no longer the little girl I left in Kul Tiras. I see my choice was a selfish one.

<Bolvar pauses.>

She and Lady Menethil have asked me to peer into the Maw to see if our allies yet live. It is a dangerous request, but one I cannot refuse.

Help me focus on the broken helm. Together, we may find a glimpse of truth.

passages.title: A Glimpse into Darkness
passages.text: There is much to do.

passages.title: A Glimpse into Darkness
passages.text: A troubling vision indeed. But we must not give up hope.

passages.title: The Captive King
passages.text:
King Anduin has not been found inside Torghast. I fear we could spend eternity searching those endless corridors to no avail.

We must know what fate has befallen him. To peer into the tower represents a grave risk, yet we have little choice.

Stand with me, <name>. We will use the broken Helm of Domination to see into that hellish place.

Perhaps together we can hold back the hungry darkness.

passages.title: The Captive King
passages.text: We must peer into Torghast before Anduin is lost to us.

passages.title: The Captive King
passages.text:
Anduin may appear unharmed, but his soul is imperiled.

Sylvanas Windrunner cannot be allowed to carry out her plan.

passages.title: Stolen Away
passages.text:
There is much you need to be told, <name>.

The Scourge has returned. With the Helm of Domination shattered, their evil runs rampant. Unchecked.

What's worse, Sylvanas Windrunner has sent her agents into the very heart of our kingdoms to take those who thwarted her efforts in the war.

Speak to Whitemane. She can tell you the rest.

passages.title: Stolen Away
passages.text:
There is much you need to be told, <name>.

The Scourge has returned. With the Helm of Domination shattered, their evil runs rampant. Unchecked.

What's worse, Sylvanas Windrunner has sent her agents into the very heart of our kingdoms to take those who thwarted her efforts in the war.

Speak to Nazgrim. He can tell you the rest.

passages.title: The Wayward Baron
passages.text:
It has come to my attention that you seek to uncover a plot by the baron Kel'Thuzad. 

That upstart has been a thorn in my side since he arrived at the House of Rituals. Not only did he pilfer my rightfully earned title, he has since shut me out of the house's dealings.

I have yet to find evidence that would mar Sin'dane's adoration for her new baron, and thus I offer an arrangement. I grant you access to the House of Rituals, and in return you help me bring down Kel'Thuzad.

Do we have an accord?

passages.title: The Wayward Baron
passages.text:
<Balmedar's voice resonates from the floating eye.>

You didn't really think I would risk meeting you here in person, did you?

Come, we have much work to do.

passages.title: Playing Favorites
passages.text:
We will have to construct an illusion to allow you entry into the House of Rituals. However, not just any illusion will do. In order to join Kel'Thuzad's inner circle, we require something... specific.

We're going to need a body.

Fortunately for us, one of the baron's favorite acolytes is performing a ritual outside of the house itself. You'll need to fight your way to her, but of that I'm sure you're capable.

passages.title: Playing Favorites
passages.text: Don't you have a corpse to procure?

passages.title: Playing Favorites
passages.text:
I must say it was satisfying watching you wipe the smug look off of Nelesis's face. She always thought she was so superior.

But enough revelry. We have work to do.

passages.title: A Fitting Guise
passages.text:
The ritual to complete your disguise should be quite simple with the assistance of my oculus. Even a <class> like you should be able to manage it.

When you are ready, simply hold the empowered crystal above Nelesis's corpse. My oculus will do the rest.

passages.title: A Fitting Guise
passages.text:
An impressive resemblance. You may just be able to pull this off.

Well, what are you waiting for?

passages.title: The Pupil Returns
passages.text:
Now that you have your disguise--and I have assurance of your loyalty--it is time you reported to your new master.

Find Kel'Thuzad within the Vault of Souls. Do whatever tasks he requires of you, but keep your eyes open for anything untoward.

My oculus will continue to accompany you so that I can provide guidance when the time is right.

We will uncover this new baron's true intentions.

passages.title: The Pupil Returns
passages.text:
Ah, you've returned. I take it the ritual went well?

Come, we have much to accomplish.

passages.title: The Baron's Plan
passages.text:
You have done well in my service, Nelesis. When the time has come to take my rightful place, you will be well rewarded.

Until then, I will require your utmost devotion and secrecy.

Our preparations are almost complete. Come, walk with me, and I will show you the splendor of our works.

passages.title: The Baron's Plan
passages.text: Walk with me, acolyte.

passages.title: The Baron's Plan
passages.text:
There are but a few tasks remaining before we can complete our ritual.

You must begin immediately.

passages.title: Mistress of Tomes
passages.text:
The kyrian will no doubt make a worthy sacrifice for our ritual, but I am not entirely versed with the magics of his kind. I have requested that the Baroness Ninadar assemble a list of appropriate literature, so that I can ensure my ritual will have the desired effect.

As you know, the baroness enjoys exploiting her title, so expect to be faced with some manner of mundane tasks in exchange for her cooperation. 

Return when you have procured the tomes, acolyte.

passages.title: Mistress of Tomes
passages.text:
Kel'Thuzad always seems to have the most studious of pets, doesn't he?

What is it the baron wishes of me, acolyte?

passages.title: Cantrip Collections
passages.text:
One of the... more regrettable duties of the Mistress of Tomes is the collation and maintenance of our scroll library. Unfortunately, many of our acolytes are less than prompt when it comes to returning items they have borrowed, which requires me to seek them out and retrieve them myself.

Of course, this is far too menial a task for a baroness, but that is why lackeys like you exist.

Go, and retrieve my scrolls. Feel free to use whatever persuasive means you have at your disposal.

passages.title: Cantrip Collections
passages.text: Have you found my scrolls?

passages.title: Cantrip Collections
passages.text:
Wonderful. Kel'Thuzad's pets are nothing if not reliable.

We are done here.

passages.title: Errant Enchantments
passages.text:
The House of Rituals is a place of constant study. Every day, new incantations and formulae are concocted to further the arts of necromancy. 

It can be difficult to keep track of such innovation. To aid in cataloguing our progress, our sorcerers have applied the use of enchanted quills and parchment. Unfortunately, if not properly stored, these implements tend to run amok. 

Of course, they were not properly stored. Find the implements and return them to where they belong.

passages.title: Errant Enchantments
passages.text: Enchanted quills will not collect themselves, now will they?

passages.title: Errant Enchantments
passages.text:
Much better!

I simply cannot abide a disorganized Grimoirium.

passages.title: Necessary Ingredients
passages.text:
As you are well aware, a ritual of this complexity requires several reagents. I have asked that Carver Jor'dan prepare what I'll need.

Seek him out in the Reagentry, and provide whatever assistance he requests.

passages.title: Necessary Ingredients
passages.text: You are Kel'Thuzad's acolyte, are you not?

passages.title: Heart of the Forest
passages.text:
The baron requests a veilwing's heart, but procuring one is going to be something of a problem. 

<Jor'dan gestures to the disarray nearby.>

As you can plainly see, one of our sorcerers proved incapable of restraining the beast. I regret to inform you that our only specimen has escaped.

It cannot have gone far, though. If you follow its tracks you should be able to catch up with it and retrieve the heart yourself.

I assure you the baron will not be able to perform his ritual without it.

passages.title: Heart of the Forest
passages.text: Did you find the veilwing?

passages.title: Heart of the Forest
passages.text:
This specimen should work nicely for the baron's ritual.

I will add it to his parcel.

passages.title: Cage Free Spores
passages.text:
I will need your assistance with the collection of one other reagent for your master. These spore clusters he requests--while normally a trivial matter--will require a bit of work.

You see, as the veilwing rampaged throughout the Reagentry, it toppled and broke several nearby cages hosting the blightrays from which we harvest the clusters.

You will have to collect them through more... conventional means. 

The clusters are fragile, however, so try not to damage them while subduing the creatures.

passages.title: Cage Free Spores
passages.text: Do you have the spore clusters?

passages.title: Cage Free Spores
passages.text:
This should do.

I will assemble the reagents together to return to your master posthaste.

passages.title: Explosive Schemes
passages.text:
The brokers deal in objects most exotic and profound. If Kel'Thuzad requires reagents from them, his ritual must be outside the normal scope of the House of Rituals.

This mysterious reagent could be the key to unlocking Kel'Thuzad's plan. We must get a hold of this delivery from Oribos. 

I have taken the liberty of concocting an alchemical bomb. Use it to ambush the caravan and retrieve whatever they are transporting.

passages.title: Explosive Schemes
passages.text: The caravan will arrive any moment now. Make haste!

passages.title: Explosive Schemes
passages.text:
Well done.

Now we must work quickly, before we are discovered.

passages.title: No Crate Unturned
passages.text:
That explosion will likely bring onlookers from the House of Rituals. We must act quickly.

Search through the debris for anything that looks out of the ordinary. It is likely that Kel'Thuzad's mystery reagent won't be hard to spot.

passages.title: No Crate Unturned
passages.text:
The runes on this blade... they are a hallmark of domination magic!

This is not good, <class>.

passages.title: Blinding the Brokers
passages.text:
We cannot allow Kel'Thuzad to discover who stopped his shipment. 

None must be left to tell the tale of what transpired here.

passages.title: Blinding the Brokers
passages.text:
The guards have been dealt with? Good.

We have more pressing matters, now.

passages.title: Designed to Fail
passages.text:
The pieces are all coming together. The kyrian, the Paths of the First Ones, and runes of domination? 

Kel'Thuzad is looking to breach the Maw!

We cannot allow this to happen! The Maw has been locked away from the Shadowlands for good reason. Opening that floodgate could be catastrophic!

The baron is too powerful to confront headlong, so we will stop his ritual instead. Return to him with his reagents. I have made some "modifications" that should provide a calamitous end to his scheme.

passages.title: Designed to Fail
passages.text: My acolyte returns. What have you brought me?

passages.title: Designed to Fail
passages.text:
I see you managed to procure the reagents from Jor'dan, and... wait, what's this?

I am impressed that you managed to procure the shipment from the brokers when my sorcerers could not!  

You are quite the resourceful one, acolyte!

passages.title: Caught in the Act
passages.text:
Well then, since it was you who managed to procure the missing reagent, I find it only fair that you assist me with the final ritual! 

I can guarantee that this incantation will see you promoted to a full sorcerer of the house!

The preparations are already made. We can begin as soon as you are ready.

passages.title: Improvised Implements
passages.text:
There must be some way we can get ourselves out of these cells. 

I don't see anything I can use over here. Search your cell for anything that can facilitate our escape.

passages.title: A Helpful Hand
passages.text:
It takes but a simple act of necromancy to animate a hand. Unfortunately, since you will be in closest proximity, you must be the one to command it.

When you are ready, I will reanimate the hand. Once you have control, use it to pull the lever at the end of the hall. 

Couldn't be simpler, right?

passages.title: A Helpful Hand
passages.text: We have no time to lose!

passages.title: The Better Part of Valor
passages.text:
We now have no choice but to make a strategic retreat. Kel'Thuzad is far too fortified within the necropolis, and if Ninadar is his ally, then the House of Rituals is firmly in his grasp.

It will take nothing short of an army to save the margrave now.

passages.title: The Better Part of Valor
passages.text:
The margrave has been captured? So Kel'Thuzad has seized control of the house!

This changes things.

passages.title: Making a Smarter Dredger
passages.text:
If he be hostin' fancy courts with you and Temel, this dredger's gotta be special...

Smarter. Stronger. Quicker to apologize when they accidentally knock over the refreshments table and spill anima all over some poor duchess...

I got an idea! Broker bloke at the Night Market was tryin' to sell me some important drinks. Kaja'Extreme or somethin'.

Says it bigguns the brain, yeah? That's just what we need! 

Take these Scorchshrooms, that broker loves them, but note he rotates his costs each week.

passages.title: Making a Smarter Dredger
passages.text: You got the Kaja'Extreme?

passages.title: Making a Smarter Dredger
passages.text: Alright, <name>, let's make some muck!

passages.title: Dredging up a Name
passages.text: Oi, why aren't you addressing me by my proper name? Wait, I don't remember my name, proper or other. Does this mean I have amnesias? Oh no, I don't have a name, please, help!

passages.title: Dredging up a Name
passages.text: Oh yeah, that name totally fits my personality, or at least I think it does.

passages.title: Homegrown Help
passages.text:
Every good party herald needs an assistant. Which is why I have you!

But every good party herald's assistant... also needs an assistant.

Which is why I procured permission from the prince for you to create your own dredger butler. We can start him on security while we cozy up to the guests and procure the necessary reading materials to train him on the social protocols of the different realms. He'll be entertaining the whole court in no time. 

No, don't thank me. You've earned this!

passages.title: Homegrown Help
passages.text:
You ready to get your hands dirty?

Makin' dredgers ain't pretty work.

passages.title: Stronger Together
passages.text:
We are to meet Baroness Draka aboard the Zerekriss above this position. Trust our allies' judgment in the battle ahead--true courage is knowing when to rely on the wisdom of others.

The plan is simple. Clear out our flanks to ensure Gharmal's forces do not interfere with our true goal, then assault the Margrave himself.

If we fail, we fail in the name of justice.

passages.title: Stronger Together
passages.text: Welcome to Zerekriss, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Fight and Flight
passages.text:
Alexandros and Emeni will lead the Chosen assault on the western gate. 

You and Xandria will direct your forces at the eastern gate. Secure the area and eliminate any resistance. 

Once both flanks are secured we can attack Gharmal directly.

passages.title: Fight and Flight
passages.text: This place is filled with horrors... horrors we will purge.

passages.title: The Butchers of Bastion
passages.text:
Did these fiends show my kin mercy when they attacked Bastion? When they tore my brothers and sisters limb from limb and used them to create more of these... these things?!

No! The butchers of Bastion made clear their hearts that day!

They deserve only the eternal darkness that awaits them. Ensure they see it!

passages.title: The Butchers of Bastion
passages.text: Go bravely, <name>.

passages.title: The Butchers of Bastion
passages.text: All this bloodshed will not bring them back... but it may spare others the same fate.

passages.title: Justice from Above
passages.text:
Our forces above cannot fully descend upon this area while the Margrave's crystals cover the sky in destructive blasts.

The Margrave's foul butchers work even now to extract the remaining anima from the kyrian they abducted in their assault on Bastion. We must advance at once.

I shall imbue you with the flames of courage so that you may mark the crystals. Once marked, I will destroy them from afar.

passages.title: Justice from Above
passages.text: You have done a great service here.

passages.title: Dark Developments
passages.text:
<The torn design document appears to be written by the late Surgeon Stitchflesh.>

...the kyrian flesh improves strength, obedience, and dexterity twofold! Such potential!

Now, if subject number one-three-five succeeds in a proper wing transplant at last...

<It continues on for some time. You should bring this to Artemede.>

passages.title: Dark Developments
passages.text: Allow me to read this for a moment.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text:
The scroll you recovered details all manner of horrific ways to 'integrate' fallen kyrian into Gharmal's abomination constructs.

It is also incomplete. There must be more of these among Stitchflesh's remaining followers.

I saw a number of surgeons and their lackeys retreat into the Hall of Chains just ahead as we arrived. I suspect they hold more of these scrolls.

We must ensure they are never read again.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text: This foul work must be destroyed.

passages.title: Burn Before Reading
passages.text: Well done. I will see that these are destroyed personally.

passages.title: An Early End
passages.text:
Within the Hall of Chains lie more abominations that are nearly complete. As we speak the Margrave's forces work fervently to graft the last pieces of flesh to their horrific visages.

If they are allowed to finish their work, the constructs we have destroyed so far will mean little in the final conflict. Our flank will be overrun by a fresh wave of horrors, and the day will be lost.

That must not come to pass. Destroy any abominations you come across.

passages.title: An Early End
passages.text: May your blade strike true.

passages.title: An Early End
passages.text: Every abomination denied is one less foe to contend with when we face Gharmal.

passages.title: Trouble on the Western Front
passages.text:
Alexandros and our Maldraxxi allies need reinforcement at the western gate on the Margrave's opposite flank. They are barely holding on!

Our forces will reinforce our position here and push forward towards Gharmal. We must make haste to Mograine--without both flanks we cannot hope to achieve victory.

passages.title: Trouble on the Western Front
passages.text: I am glad Kynthia found you so quickly.

passages.title: Charging The Blade
passages.text:
We can't advance with those juggernauts bombarding our position! I led a strike against the nearest, but conventional weapons do nothing against their imbued hides.

Thankfully, I have an idea.

Your old runeblade can't deal with them as it stands, but if you could purge Gharmal's empowered masses and absorb their essence into the blade...

passages.title: Charging The Blade
passages.text: This is a long shot, but it just might work...

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text:
Gharmal's rocs dominate the skies above, striking at our forces as we advance. The Zerekriss can't get into position until they are cleared out!

I would take care of them myself, but I'm not much of a flier. Don't have the balance for it!

Take my riding hook and latch onto a roc. Once you're riding, just start hitting it 'til the job is done.

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text: Teach 'em a lesson!

passages.title: Aerial Advantage
passages.text: I could hear their cries from here. Nice work!

passages.title: Grave Intent
passages.text:
My spies have identified several astral projectors that Margrave Gharmal uses to rally his troops in the Stitchyard.

I do not wish for a swarm of frenzied constructs to descend upon us during the final confrontation. Surely you see the wisdom in cutting their fervor.

See to it that these projectors are destroyed. We believe them to be along the yard's perimeter.

passages.title: Grave Intent
passages.text: A blow inflicted to the enemy's morale can be as effective as traditional combat.

passages.title: Grave Intent
passages.text: Gharmal's influence runs deep in this place, but it will fade more quickly thanks to your efforts.

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text:
The Zerekriss is nearly in position. Now is the time to strike!

We must force Gharmal into the open together. Join me on my roc, and we will unleash your runeblade's power on the juggernauts.

The Margrave will be unable to ignore their deaths. Once he leaves his blighted tower, we can finish him once and for all.

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text: Every moment the juggernauts live our position is in jeopardy!

passages.title: Power of the Chosen
passages.text: Such power! Gharmal will have no choice but to face us now.

passages.title: The End is Now
passages.text:
Our forces have control of the House of Constructs, thanks to your intervention.

Now, all that remains is the fall of the instigator themselves--Margrave Gharmal.

This battle has been long in the making, adventurer. I am at your side without hesitation.

Let us go to this monster. We will join Xandria to see him slain.

passages.title: The End is Now
passages.text: It is time.

passages.title: An Expected Visitor
passages.text:
One Alexandros Mograine of Maldraxxus is meeting with the Paragon of Courage in Archon's Rise. Xandria has requested you join them.

The two worked together recently to repel a nascent secondary assault on the Temple of Courage. Xandria seems to trust him well enough, so we have granted him access to the hold...for now.

I suspect they will not stay here long. You should make haste.

passages.title: An Expected Visitor
passages.text: Good. Now we can begin the mission.

passages.title: Nipping at the Undergrowth
passages.text: <The small gorger nips at your heels hungry and seeking your protection. Maybe it will like some of the plants here?>

passages.title: Nipping at the Undergrowth
passages.text: Collect Endmire Vineroot for your small gorger.

passages.title: Nipping at the Undergrowth
passages.text: <The gorger munches loudly on the vineroot and in between mouthfuls looks at you inquisitively.>

passages.title: Vineroot on the Menu
passages.text: <Again the small gorger shows up and you can clearly see is looking for more Endmire Vineroot.>

passages.title: Vineroot on the Menu
passages.text: Collect Endmire Vineroot for your small gorger.

passages.title: Vineroot on the Menu
passages.text: <You barely get your hand back as the gorger snags the bundle. You can't help but notice he looks to be getting bigger. In between bites he spits out something.>

passages.title: Vineroot Will Not Do
passages.text: <Clearly bigger, the gorger looks at a vineroot you point to and you can see the hint of menace in its eye at being offered the root again. It looks longingly at the devourer mites nearby.>

passages.title: Vineroot Will Not Do
passages.text: Collect Infused Endmire Fruit from the Devourer Mites in the Endmire or Banewood.

passages.title: Vineroot Will Not Do
passages.text: <When you drop the fruit at the feet of the gorger he devourers each one whole,  clearly it is enjoying them. Looking at you not eating it lets a couple fall for you.>

passages.title: Hungry Hungry Gorger
passages.text: <The gorger spawn bounded up to you, but was clearly looking at the devourer mites the entire time.>

passages.title: Hungry Hungry Gorger
passages.text: Collect Infused Endmire Fruit from the Devourer Mites in the Endmire or Banewood.

passages.title: Hungry Hungry Gorger
passages.text: <As you drop the fruit the gorger snaps some out of the air before they hit the ground. But you do see that the gorger has brought you a small item.>

passages.title: Shades of Muck
passages.text:
Yeah, this here muck pool's got everythin' we need to make your dredger butler.

We'll make this one special just for you. Made to specifications, as the fangs say.

First up, you gotta choose its color. Us dredgers comes in all kind of different shades of muck.

Take a peek at some me fellow dredgers and let me know what color we should dredge up for your butler.

We can recolor a dredger after-the-fact, but it ain't pleasant.

<Rendle shudders at the thought.>

passages.title: Shades of Muck
passages.text: What color you thinkin' of?

passages.title: Shades of Muck
passages.text: I'll get the pigment all ready for you, but we're gonna need a little something extra for this dredger mucking.

passages.title: Search the Place
passages.text:
Zerekriss is ours... along with everything it contains.

The Primus was personally involved in the design of this necropolis. It was truly a sight to witness his hands shape the form of this vessel.

It would be wise to search the room. Perhaps he kept some tools here that might be of use to us.

passages.title: Search the Place
passages.text: What did you find?

passages.title: Search the Place
passages.text: These belonged to the Primus!

passages.title: To Current Matters
passages.text:
Ye've done good here, champion. MOTHER and I will be figurin' out what te do next.

Ye best get back te matters at hand, and do what ye can te empower that necklace o' yours.

I've got ways te reach ye once MOTHER and I have fixed things up here.

passages.title: To Current Matters
passages.text: You're back. I suppose there's something around here for you to do.

passages.title: To Current Matters
passages.text:
Ye've done good here, champion. MOTHER and I will be figurin' out what te do next.

Ye best get back te matters at hand, and do what ye can te empower that necklace o' yours.

I've got ways te reach ye once MOTHER and I have fixed things up here.

passages.title: To Current Matters
passages.text: <name>, it is good to see you again. There's much to do around here.

passages.title: Shadowlands: A Chilling Summons
passages.text:
The time has come, <class>.

Highlord Bolvar Fordragon requests your presence atop Icecrown Citadel. Meet me in Orgrimmar, and I will take you to him.

I would not keep him waiting.

passages.title: Shadowlands: A Chilling Summons
passages.text:
It is good that you have arrived.

We need heroes like you in this dire hour.

passages.title: Doing the Dew
passages.text:
The Thistledrop is magnificent creature. The roots go deep into the earth where they drink of waters most ancient. With these waters they collect the very essence of the land into a drop of dew that enables our artisans to craft powerful armaments.

Help us gather the dew and you will be well rewarded.

Hurry, before it evaporates!

passages.title: Doing the Dew
passages.text: The dew evaporates quickly, hurry now!

passages.title: Doing the Dew
passages.text:
This dew will help our craftmasters a great deal!

Thank you, little one.

passages.title: Take Heart
passages.text:
Mograine and I spoke at length when he visited Bastion. He suggested that should we manage to kill Gharmal, his heart could be used to empower the Crest of Ascension.

The Margrave bears the power to shape form in ways few beings can. Though his results are grim, if we could harness that power our Ascended would be stronger than ever before.

It is not our way, but our way is changing, I think. Perhaps this is a step on our new path.

passages.title: Take Heart
passages.text: It must be done.

passages.title: Take Heart
passages.text: I am relieved that I am not the one to carry that thing back to Bastion.

passages.title: Return to the Hold
passages.text:
Let us ferry the heart to Elysian Hold swiftly.

There are many in the Shadowlands who would strike at us to take its power for their own. Keep your eyes open, Maw Walker.

We return to our kin victorious this day.

passages.title: Return to the Hold
passages.text: I am glad to be among our own once more. Maldraxxus is not to my tastes.

passages.title: Crest of Greatness
passages.text:
Once you are ready, all you must do is place the heart within the sphere here on the Crest of Ascension.

Mikanikos's handiwork will ensure that its energy is channeled properly to aid in our ascension rituals, and its power should help protect the Crest against any further attack.

May the House of Constructs never set foot in our realm again.

passages.title: Crest of Greatness
passages.text: <This looks to be the orb Xandria directed you to place the heart in.>

passages.title: Crest of Greatness
passages.text:
<The Fleshshaper's Heart fits readily into the glowing sphere. As it enters, you hear faint clicking sounds within the Crest, as if it were designed to accept such power readily.

Thus begins a new era for the kyrian.>

passages.title: Honored Attendance
passages.text:
It is my humble honor to be the Ember Court's first guest.

Please inform Prince Renathal and all of your other compatriots that I will certainly attend whenever you wish to open the gates.

passages.title: Honored Attendance
passages.text: If Kassir is coming, we had better ensure this is a formal affair.

passages.title: Formal Entertainment
passages.text:
The Accuser will be pleased that you have chosen such humble and formal entertainment for the first Ember Court.

I look forward to the occasion.

passages.title: Formal Entertainment
passages.text: Ancient rituals? This is my kind of party!

passages.title: Formal Refreshments
passages.text:
Tubbins's tea ready soon. Go tell Theotar and friends.

Tubbins is best!

passages.title: Formal Refreshments
passages.text: Tubbins had better bring Gubbins along. He's the fun one!

passages.title: Small Bites
passages.text:
The reviews are in, adventurer. Our menu is too Revendreth-centric!

All the best courts have exotic appetizers, small plates, and other specialties that guests can look forward to every time they come.

And for a court like ours, which boasts frequent guests from other realms, we simply must do better!

Do not worry, after tireless research, I have drafted a very particular list of ingredients for you to find me.

Bring them to me, and I will serve our guests eternity on a platter!

passages.title: Small Bites
passages.text: Are you sure Picky Stefan wanted ALL of these things?

passages.title: Small Bites
passages.text:
I never understand you mortals' fascination with cheese... It looks disgusting.

But Picky Stefan gets what Picky Stefan wants!

passages.title: Anima Tastings
passages.text:
You started a trend, adventurer!

Your constant gallivanting around the different realms of the Shadowlands has inspired a new flair for the exotic among Revendreth's elite. If it's from outside Revendreth, the venthyr want to try it.

And I know just what the next big thing will be: anima tastings!

Think about it: we--and by 'we' I mean 'you'--bring back fresh anima from all the different realms you travel to.

Then socialites get to sip it and pretend it tastes like wherever you got it from!

passages.title: Anima Tastings
passages.text: That's a whole lot of anima you got there. That's all just for drinking?

passages.title: Anima Tastings
passages.text:
Hips already sent over a name for the Master of Anima he wants to lead the tastings.

I'll get her on the staff and have this stuff delivered to her.

passages.title: Comfy Chairs
passages.text:
I want guests to sit.

Standing is hard. I know 'cause I stand a lot.

Guest should sit and be comfy.

I make comfy chairs for all guests to sit.

Guests be happy, stay longer!

passages.title: Comfy Chairs
passages.text: Boot knows his stuff. If he says we should make chairs, we should make chairs.

passages.title: Comfy Chairs
passages.text:
<Temel can't stop himself from feeling the soft vulpin fur.>

Ooo, these chairs are going to be so comfortable!

passages.title: The Professionals
passages.text:
Smart move bringing in the specialists, adventurer.

Once you get into this week's Ember Court, be sure to let the specialists know what you want them to do.

Breakfist down in the dredger pools can smash or clean things to make the court more Messy or Clean for you.

Crooked Crick in the refreshments area can adjust Decadence.

Lady Ilinca in the embassy area can adjust Formality.

Cosmin the Illusionist on stage can adjust Excitement.

Wing Commander Vulpek at the front gates can adjust Danger.

passages.title: The Professionals
passages.text:
Phew, those professionals know how to get a job done!

I'll make sure they're at every Ember Court from now on, you just gotta swing by and give them orders before the gates open.

passages.title: Hunting the Wilds
passages.text:
The supply of attuned anima is running low again. I'm surprised that we've managed to stretch our resources so far without a resupply.

You've proven yourself proficient at tracking down what is needed, perhaps you could assist us once again?

The runestags that roam Ardenweald's forests are particularly suffused with the power of the wilds, anima retrieved from them will be optimal for our needs.

Good hunting!

passages.title: Hunting the Wilds
passages.text: Worry not about the runestags, after some time they will return. This is just one part of the eternal cycle.

passages.title: Hunting the Wilds
passages.text:
Good job! Your efforts will go a long way to keeping our production moving ahead.

Thank you!

passages.title: Called to the Hunt
passages.text:
The Wild Hunt is made up of fae who have dedicated their lives to the protection of Ardenweald and its denizens. Each member has skill sharp as a blade and sense unlike no other.

We have spoken to a duo, an evoker and a huntress, who will permit us to capture their memories for training if we help them on a particular hunt.

Meet Alderyn in Claw's Edge. He is one you seek.

passages.title: Called to the Hunt
passages.text: You are not of these lands. How may I aid you?

passages.title: Called to the Hunt
passages.text:
The envoy of the kyrian, armed with the perfect weapon to pierce our quarry's armor.

Are you ready for a hunt?

passages.title: Piercing the Shell
passages.text:
Our quarry is one of the gorm, native creatures who were once helpful beasts of the realm, until the drought drove them mad.

This particular beast has not only grown to a frightening size, but also has a shell so strong that none of our weapons or arrows have managed to pierce it.

This spear you bring, infused with the anima of Bastion, could be the exact weapon we need to pierce the gorm's armor and put him down.

My sister went ahead to scout. Let's not linger.

passages.title: Piercing the Shell
passages.text: The terror has been put down. Your aid, and your spear, were quite useful.

passages.title: Just Wing It
passages.text:
For untold ages, the humble Ardenmoth has supplied the scales for the creation of armor for the Wild Hunt. 

Now, with our attention divided between the threats to the realm and the anima drought, it has become increasingly difficult for our foragers to find the perfect scales that we require.

Only the scales of the highest quality are suitable. If you should obtain any in your travels and return with them, I shall ensure you are well rewarded.

passages.title: Just Wing It
passages.text: Have you the scales?

passages.title: Just Wing It
passages.text: Ah, remarkable quality! You've done well!

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text:
Right, here's the gig: we need anima.

Not just a bit or a pinch, but a lot. See, anythin' worth doin' can't be done without anima. Not in the Shadowlands. Not if we are gonna fix this mess Denathrius got us in.

So, we need your increasin'ly resourceful self to beg, borrow, steal, nick, burglarize, pulverize, pirate-ize, earn, swindle, or otherwise become the source of a great charity of any anima you can get.

Bring it to me, an' I'll stock our coffers, as it were, so you can put it to use.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: How goes the anima hunt? You pinch us a pint or boost us keg?

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: Now that's a right grey professional job that is. This anima will get us makin' some fancy stuff in no time.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text:
Hail, Maw Walker.

As our influence over Bastion grows, so too does our need for our most precious resource--anima.

We must replenish our reserves. Scour the realms for all that you can find and return here with the anima. 

With our precious reserves replenished, we can direct the anima wherever it is needed most.

Go in service, <class>.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: Every drop of anima is a gift in these times.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: You have my thanks, Maw Walker. We will not let it go to waste.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text:
We require your strength, Maw Walker.

The houses of our enemies grow stronger by the hour. In order to press the attack we must find new sources of anima to bolster our reserves.

Search the realms for this precious resource and bring it back here to the Sanctum. Let none deny you!

With your help the rival houses shall fall, one by one, and we will emerge victorious!

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: The march to victory will require more anima.

passages.title: Replenish the Reservoir
passages.text: Your contributions fuel our conquests on the battlefield. The final victory will be ours!

passages.title: Wake The Sleepers
passages.text:
The land speaks to me, <name>. Ardenweald is a realm of cycles, but it has never faced an anima drought such as this.

We will need the aid of all who reside here if we are to make it through this crisis.

Many souls slumber within the forests and hills. If they can provide us some of their anima, we may be able to endure a little longer. Should you encounter any of the souls in your travels, please awaken them and send them to me.

passages.title: Wake The Sleepers
passages.text:
This dew will help our craftmasters a great deal!

Thank you, little one.

passages.title: Say The Magic Words
passages.text:
Ever since I cast my first spell, I've not been able to get enough of magic!

It's not as hard as all those liches say it is. You focus your thoughts, say the words, and magic starts happening!

There are tomes documenting ancient spells stored in the Archivam of Revendreth. Help me gather them so I can learn some new spells!

passages.title: Say The Magic Words
passages.text: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text:
Each covenant is vital to the Shadowlands. Though they have been isolated and divided as of late, the Purpose depends on the success of their efforts.

All of the covenants must bolster their strength to face the threat of the Banished One. But your contributions cannot be divided. They must be focused upon a single path. Other mortals may make a different choice.

Speak to your potential allies. Then make your choice at the map of the Shadowlands before me.

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text: Have you made your decision?

passages.title: Choosing Your Purpose
passages.text: All is as expected. Trust always in the Arbiter's wisdom.

passages.title: In A Bad Light
passages.text:
I've heard about the chaos in Revendreth. Reports of exiles driven mad and burned in the Desiccation. 

The very thought of all that suffering fills me with the urge to do something about it.

If you are headed there, please let me accompany you. I simply must help as many as I can!

passages.title: In A Bad Light
passages.text: Did we cure them all?

passages.title: In A Bad Light
passages.text:
Suffering is commonplace among those in Revendreth, but you and Roseboil were able to help a few of them nonetheless. 

Well done.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
You must prove your worth to us again <name>.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet you say you seek penance. This task will start to demonstrate that you are serious about earning back our trust.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Kyrian.

passages.title: Standing Toe To Toe
passages.text: <The gorger is clearly bigger, it gestures with its head towards one of the other gorgers as if urging you to attack it.>

passages.title: Standing Toe To Toe
passages.text: Attack and defeat devourer gorgers in the Endmire.

passages.title: Standing Toe To Toe
passages.text: <There is little expression you can see on the gorger's 'face' but it appears as if it is very full of itself as if it defeated them on its own. It does offer you a shiny thing it found.>

passages.title: Ready for More
passages.text: <Again the gorger is strutting ready for more fighting, staring down the the closest gorger.>

passages.title: Ready for More
passages.text: Attack and defeat devourer gorgers in the Endmire.

passages.title: Ready for More
passages.text: <Head high the gorger is really strutting his stuff and is clearly thinking you make a great team. He looks up at you ... and he spits up something that he thinks you might like.>

passages.title: A New Pack
passages.text: <The gorger is more than fully grown, rivaling most of the other devourers in the area. It clearly wants to stay with you, but it appears to be uneasy straying too far from the world eaters. Maybe if you take one down together it will not hold as much sway over the gorger.>

passages.title: A New Pack
passages.text: <The gorger gestures in the direction of a worldeater, seemingly feeling up to the challenge with you by its side.>

passages.title: A New Pack
passages.text: <The gorger is ecstatic that you took down a worldeater. It's excitement is palpable and it is on the brink of picking you up and carrying out off on a new adventure.>

passages.title: Exiled by Paranoia
passages.text:
The liches of the House of Rituals were an instrumental piece in the Maldraxxi attack on Bastion. They are not currenty our allies, and it would be difficult to convince one to let us capture their memory for our training purposes.

We have made contact with a necromancer who has a score to settle with one of the liches. Find her and she will aid you in capturing this memory.

passages.title: Exiled by Paranoia
passages.text: <Karaxi is sifting through a book very carefully.>

passages.title: Exiled by Paranoia
passages.text: My plan is truly coming to fruition. An outsider, here to help me enact my revenge!

passages.title: Those Who Hunger
passages.text:
I've heard reports that the number of gorm sightings have risen greatly the past few days.

Normally they're simple decomposers, playing their part in the great cycle, but in great numbers the gorm can be aggressive. If left unchecked, their ravenous hunger will cause untold destruction.

The Wild Hunt has called for a gorm hunt. Meet your quota and you will be well-rewarded.

passages.title: Those Who Hunger
passages.text: Ah, good work. The gorm serve their purpose, but as in all things, balance must be maintained.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
You must prove your worth to us again <name>.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Necrolords.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
You must prove your worth to us again <name>.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text:
You must prove your worth to us again <name>.

We have not forgotten your betrayal.

Yet we know you seek penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.

passages.title: Prove Your Worth
passages.text: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

passages.title: RRP Test Quest
passages.text: RRP Test Quest

passages.title: Professions - Reuse
Return Those Animacones!
passages.text:
Reports say that once again the spriggan are proving to be a nuisance, <name>.

Word is that a bunch of them broke into the stores at the Heart of the Forest and made off with a huge store of animacones.

Needless to say, we need those animacones back.

The report says the spriggan group split up as they were making their escape, so any one you see is as likely to be carrying the animacones as the next. 

Good luck.

passages.title: Return Those Animacones!
passages.text: Were you able to find the animacones?

passages.title: Return Those Animacones!
passages.text: You were able to retrieve all of them? Outstanding!

passages.title: Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Professions - Reuse
Runestone Roundup
passages.text:
Stone is a rare material in Ardenweald. Yet, I've heard tales that those who were masked by the Drust have small stones upon them.

I'd like you to retrieve some of these stones for the Wild Hunt, so that we may better understand their link to our enemy.
Face the masked and collect the stones from their deceased forms and I'll compensate you for your efforts.

It's a gruesome task, but one that must be done.

passages.title: Runestone Roundup
passages.text: How goes your investigation?

passages.title: Runestone Roundup
passages.text: You were able to retrieve all of them? Outstanding!

passages.title: Scouting from a Safe Distance
passages.text:
The resurgence of the Scourge is troubling enough, but there are also reports that the Cult of the Damned has risen anew as well.

If true, then that bodes ill for us all. We cannot allow the cultists' machinations to continue unchecked.

I suggest we engage in some reconnaissance.

passages.title: Scouting from a Safe Distance
passages.text: Notice anything unusual?

passages.title: Scouting from a Safe Distance
passages.text:
They must be planning something. Though what, I cannot say.

I will instruct our scouts to observe and report.

passages.title: A Bundle of Lilies
passages.text:
This grove needs something special, something to make it really stand out.

I have a plan, but first I need flowers.

Not just any flowers, but Night Lillies. They have a sweet scent that evokes starlit nights spent standing on a hilltop overlooking the majesty of the land.

As you go exploring Ardenweald, look to the waterways for Night Lillies growing in the waterways and collect them.
I will pay you for your efforts, of course.

passages.title: A Bundle of Lilies
passages.text: Were you able to find any of the lillies?

passages.title: A Bundle of Lilies
passages.text:
Ah, their scent is lovely!

Having a few of these placed around the grove will greatly help with morale.

passages.title: Blood from a Bone
passages.text:
I want nothing more than to make for Revendreth immediately... but it seems they have their own challenges to face.

All know of the mark we left on Bastion. The venthyr are sure to be wary of allowing us into their realm.

Once again, we must turn to you. Your renown across the Shadowlands has earned you the trust of many. Now, we need the trust of Revendreth.

passages.title: Blood from a Bone
passages.text: You're just in time. I've received a missive.

passages.title: A Message from the Justicar
passages.text:
Justicar Trueheart has sent a personal request for your immediate assistance, <name>.

The frozen winds of Icecrown await your return.

passages.title: A Message from the Justicar
passages.text: I am glad for your return, <name>.

passages.title: A Message from the Justicar
passages.text:
Justicar Trueheart has sent a personal request for your immediate assistance, <name>.

The frozen winds of Icecrown await your return.

passages.title: A Message from the Justicar
passages.text: I am glad for your return, <name>.

passages.title: Tal-Inara's Call
passages.text:
Your presence is needed within the Enclave.

It is time for you to choose a covenant to ally yourself with.

passages.title: Tal-Inara's Call
passages.text:
Your presence is needed within the Enclave.

It is time for you to choose a covenant to ally yourself with.

passages.title: Eyes to the Sky
passages.text:
