The House of Eyes still reels from Akarek's demise. They search for direction. For purpose.

Perhaps you can help them find it. Continue to gain the trust of the Eyes. Their skills will be invaluable to our cause.

passages.title: Eyes to the Sky
passages.text: You've done well, Maw Walker. The Eyes place their trust in you.

passages.title: You'll Never Walk Alone
passages.text:
<You have stumbled upon some messy notes. Some of the lines seem incomprehensible while others seem melodic.>

Like wind and rain, discord storms my mind, tossing and blowing.
...
I must find the golden skies.
...
Remember, walk on, heart full of hope, and you'll never walk alone.

<It seems as though an aspirant cannot find their way home. You should inform someone at Hero's Rest.>

passages.title: You'll Never Walk Alone
passages.text: Ah, these wise words are certainly Eurgon's. I'm happy to report he made it home.

passages.title: Shortsleeved Doublet
passages.text: Thank you! I will put this away until the time is right to wear it.

passages.title: Long Sleeved Doublet
passages.text: Oooh, it has sleeves that go past my elbows, thank you! I can't wait until we find the right time to wear it.

passages.title: Looking Fabulous
passages.text:
<Your butler shakes his head back and forth imagining the flowing locks in the portrait.>

Oooh, thanks, I am sure we could find a good time to cut my hair like this!

passages.title: The Spikey Look
passages.text: I bet if I curled into a ball using it the spikes would be pretty scary, not that I would think of doing anything like that at a party, unless we could use that... I will just save this poster for when the time is right for this cut.

passages.title: A Memorable Look
passages.text: Ooh, this look feels fitting for a role like mine, I am sure many other dredgers have assisted while sporting this sparse, scraggly look. I can't wait to try it out!

passages.title: Black Muck Dye
passages.text: Ah, black muck, it stains the fingers, but is very distinguished. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.

passages.title: Blue Muck Dye
passages.text: Do you think the blue muck looks like the sky? Dirk thought it did, but I don't think so. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.

passages.title: Green Muck Dye
passages.text: I have only visited the Banewood Muck Pool once, but I found it was a bit crowded myself, I definitely prefer working solo. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.

passages.title: Bubbling Red Muck Dye
passages.text: Ooh, its still warm. I could live out in the Ember Ward. I will save this for the next time we need to dye my doublet. I want to remind you that we will need one for each dying, but I can keep this one ready.

passages.title: Fighting for Attention
passages.text:
Maintaining a watchful eye on the Cult of the Damned has proven challenging... and perilous.

Several of our hippogryph riders recently ran afoul of the cult's winged terrors. Though a few were able to escape, the others were captured and brought to Aldur'thar.

Do what you can to free them from their captors. We cannot afford to lose any more of our forces.

passages.title: Fighting for Attention
passages.text:
You have my gratitude.

I assure you this will not be forgotten.

passages.title: Swollen Anima Seed
passages.text: The masked sylvar set aside a single seed laden with anima; for what purpose, you can only imagine. Droman Tashmur would appreciate the return of such a precious resource.

passages.title: Swollen Anima Seed
passages.text: What have you brought me? Why would the masked ones be collecting anima so? A concern for the future. Thank you for bringing this to me. It will nourish many wildseeds.

passages.title: Catch A Star
passages.text:
I require your aid on a... delicate matter, <name>.

Starfly Wings form a vital ingredient for some of our creations and our supply is exhausted.
They are tiny things, very fragile, and I am ill able to handle them delicately.

Could you obtain the Starflies for me? They must be caught alive in order for their wings to not spoil and we desperately need them. 

I'll ensure that you are compensated for your time, of course.

passages.title: Catch A Star
passages.text:
Outstanding! I could see the shine coming from your pack before you even arrived.

Thank you!

passages.title: Parasol Components
passages.text: Sheets of fine cloth, wooden parasol ribs, wooden dowels and metal braces, everything you would need to put together new parasols. These are worth a lot of gold in the Ember Ward. Mats would certainly reward you handsomely if you brought him this cache.

passages.title: Parasol Components
passages.text: Oh, wow, this is a real find you have. Here, a heap of Infused Rubies for the bundle, the best you will see here in the ward. And if you see one of my goods you might like, let me know.

passages.title: It's a Dirty Job
passages.text:
We gotta fix up this muck pool before we go makin' that dredger butler of yours.

Looks like the anima shortage caused all sorts of problems for this pool.

Them muck pools gotta have plenty of filth and fiber in 'em to grow good dredgers.

But between them devourers and nasty elementals formin' from all that wild muck, I can't get close enough to feed it!

Help me out and throw some of that filthy rubble into the pool, yeah?

passages.title: It's a Dirty Job
passages.text:
I can smell it from here.

<Rendle inhales deeply and sighs.>

Home sweet home.

passages.title: The Last Word
passages.text:
Inquisitor Darksion was an aspiring practitioner of the arcane arts before Denathrius locked her away.

I've heard she will share her knowledge with anyone that releases her from imprisonment.

I want to learn all she knows! We must free her!

passages.title: The Last Word
passages.text: Did we find anything good?

passages.title: The Last Word
passages.text: You have helped strengthen our forces, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Venthyr Ettiquette
passages.text: You know, I really like that Theotar, he knows his stuff and is nice to us even though at times he assumes we can read minds. Silly Venthyr.

passages.title: Ardenweald Etiquette
passages.text: This one looks fun, I like reading about dreams, and it has pictures!

passages.title: Bastion Etiquette
passages.text: This seems pretty strict, I am surprised that they come to parties, I think it says here that might not be allowed. Well, I will make sure I memorize it word for word, I am sure they will have already.

passages.title: Maldraxxi Protocols
passages.text: Not going to lie to you, this sounds really dry. Do I at least get to wear their cool armor?

passages.title: A Brokered Deal
passages.text:
Hey, <name>. I've found a lucrative business proposition that'll help me... us... greatly! See, Au'narim is willing to give us supplies if we can help him recover from a trade deal that went sideways.

Apparently, several of his cohorts never returned from a job. He needs us to follow their path and recover the item they failed to deliver. Simple, right?

To ensure we don't have any mishaps, I've taken the liberty of acquiring a few items that may be of help to us.

So, you in?

passages.title: A Brokered Deal
passages.text: Did you find the item in question?

passages.title: A Brokered Deal
passages.text: I knew the Maw Walker would deliver.

passages.title: Training Program
passages.text:
Sergeant Krashj is an adequate drill master, but these recruits need proper training with a real warrior. Someone who has been bloodied on the battlefield. Someone like me!

And I know just the fight that will whip these troops into shape.

Let's go teach them a thing or three.

passages.title: Training Program
passages.text: Is it dead?

passages.title: Training Program
passages.text: You two make quite the team. It's good to have dependable comrades in arms.

passages.title: Field Training
passages.text:
Though it was not by our hand, Maldraxxus has dealt a great injustice to the kyrian of Bastion. We must do all that we can to make amends.

The Forsworn menace continues to be a thorn in their side. Sounds like the perfect opportunity to both show our support and for our recruits to gain some combat experience.

passages.title: Field Training
passages.text: You and Marz work well together. He'll take the hit whenever you need him to.

passages.title: A Fountain for Fae
passages.text:
Nuuminuuru spends their days protecting and taking care of many faeries throughout Ardenweald. They have expressed concern about some faeries in their care whom they have not seen in some time.

Report to Nuuminuuru and see if you can help them find their scattered sprites.

passages.title: A Fountain for Fae
passages.text: A greeting to you, ally of the soulbearers.

passages.title: A Fountain for Fae
passages.text: A faerie fountain for a rare relaxation... an enticing incentive indeed.

passages.title: Fanciful Distractions
passages.text:
Ever chasing their fleets of fancy, my faerie friends are seldom seen.

Their mercurial natures oft lead them astray, tracing them paths to distraction and dismay.

Seek my friends, insist they return to my roots, and both you and they may receive recompense.

passages.title: Fanciful Distractions
passages.text:
My wards know to return to my roost, to spin stories of their pursuits and strengthen their spirits.

The longer they flit away, the deeper the creases of my concern grow.

passages.title: Fanciful Distractions
passages.text:
The waters of your realm revitalize my wards in ways those of our home cannot.

Once again, they return to rest.

passages.title: On Silver Wings
passages.text:
<Your butler is in shock after you tell him he will be flying.>

If you really need me to follow you around in the air... of course I will do that... please not too high...

passages.title: Ascension Calling: Mikanikos
passages.text:
<While this scroll mimics Kleia's invitation to the Path of Ascension, it is very clearly written in Sika's hand.

It details an invitation for Mikanikos to participate in the Path, along with Bron.

Perhaps you should bring this to Mikanikos.>

passages.title: Ascension Calling: Mikanikos
passages.text:
Me? Take part in the Path of Ascension? What a surprise!

Bron and I will participate, of course. The leaps we can achieve in centurion development... Imagine!

passages.title: A Thread Of Hope
passages.text:
The Court of Night is akin to a thirsty flower, it quickly draws up its nutrients. If well supplied it will bloom and if its supply is depleted, it withers.

Our roots are beginning to dry, we need more anima!

I've sent workers out to place silk lined catchers along the roads and paths that cross Ardenweald. These catchers will collect a tiny bit of anima, not much but enough for what we need.

Seek them out and return the Anima Infused Silk to us.

passages.title: A Thread Of Hope
passages.text: Were you able to find the silk?

passages.title: A Thread Of Hope
passages.text: Well done. Our leaves lift to the sky in thanks.

passages.title: Bursting the Bubble
passages.text:
<The words of the shadowy herald are dark and foreboding. Whatever "the Banished One" intends to accomplish, it must not come to pass.

Something foul bubbles within the cauldrons nearby. Judging by the care with which the cultists are tending to them, their contents must be crucial to their plans.

Several barrels containing what appears to be a new type of plague have been left unattended. Perhaps they can serve as instruments for sabotage.>

passages.title: Bursting the Bubble
passages.text: What have you discovered?

passages.title: Bursting the Bubble
passages.text:
Thank the Light, you have returned unharmed!

Were you able to learn anything about what the cult is doing?

passages.title: Arboreal Tactics
passages.text:
The spriggan of Ardenweald have always been a nuisance. But under Mueh'zala's influence, they could grow into a threat that looms over all of the Shadowlands.

Let's test these troops against a real opponent.

passages.title: Arboreal Tactics
passages.text: I see you and Marz have been busy. Job well done, both of you.

passages.title: Mysterious Soul Mirror
passages.text:
<A shimmering soul mirror draws your attention on Devos's corpse.

Peculiar that she would keep one on her person. Perhaps Thenios will want to see this.>

passages.title: Mysterious Soul Mirror
passages.text: How can I be of service?

passages.title: Mysterious Soul Mirror
passages.text:
<Thenios studies the mirror closely.>

I see.

passages.title: Soul Led Astray
passages.text:
Uther was a being of justice on your world. I am sure it was quite surprising for you to see his fate here, following a leader who embodies what he stood against in life.

I believe you should witness this memory firsthand. Take it to my soul mirror. View the memories within.

passages.title: Soul Led Astray
passages.text: Sometimes the hard truths are the most important to witness.

passages.title: Soul Led Astray
passages.text: I hope that this memory helps you to understand Uther's path.

passages.title: Rodent Removal
passages.text:
<The weapon buzzes with a dark, static energy. Whatever this Mawsworn was testing, it appears to have been somewhat successful on the nearby rodents.

Further investigation may yield additional information.>

passages.title: Rodent Removal
passages.text:
Serves them right for leaving this unattended.

I am sure we can find other uses for it.

passages.title: Digging Around
passages.text:
The thin pale ones of Revendreth have been hoarding anima. 

I've heard they've been hiding it away, digging holes in the woods and just leaving it there. Anyone could come along and take it.

I say that should be us!

Let's go get some anima.

passages.title: Digging Around
passages.text: Thank you for the supplies. I'll see about setting some aside for you at regular intervals.

passages.title: A Fallen Friend
passages.text:
A bracelet delicately woven with living vines falls from Vivanna's wrist as she is slain. In the vines is written, 

"Until Winter's end.

-Flwngyrr"

passages.title: A Fallen Friend
passages.text:
<They take the bracelet from your hand. A minute passes before they speak again.>

Her favorite was Azurebloom Tea.

Thank you for bringing this to me.

passages.title: Grinder
passages.text:
It's tough keeping these hands of mine razor sharp. With all the hacking and cleaving, they can grow dull so quickly! What's a girl to do?

The House of the Chosen makes some very fine quality sharpening stones. I doubt they will just hand them over, but I'm sure my blades can persuade them otherwise.

How about we pay them a visit and see how many stones they can spare?

passages.title: Grinder
passages.text: Did you kill them all?

passages.title: Grinder
passages.text:
I see Guillotine's "negotiations" were successful.

Thank you, Maw Walker. These sharpening stones will be useful.

passages.title: Fungal Feeding
passages.text:
Just as I was making progress on our alternative defense research, my spore samples ran dry!

The mushrooms I was using can only be found in a particularly unpleasant location to the southeast. To collect an appropriately sized sample, you'll have to--how do I put this--feed them. 

Don't ask me why, but apparently, they mature fastest with a nice, rotting corpse nearby.

Try luring a few undead to our fungal friends. That should give 'em all the nutrients they need to grow big and strong.

passages.title: Fungal Feeding
passages.text: Any luck with those samples?

passages.title: Fungal Feeding
passages.text:
Oh, these are just lovely!

I hope you didn't get your hands too dirty.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Must be nice to have the leisure to just sit and think all the time. 

I've barely got time myself, with all the work I have keeping this place together!

Still, that was nice of you to help out the old turtle.

passages.title: Bastion
passages.text: After being set back by a surprise attack by Maldraxxus forces and an army of their own fallen kin known as the Forsworn, the Ascended stand to lose control of Bastion if they are not given aid.

passages.title: Bastion
passages.text: Bastion is in dire need of your aid.

passages.title: Drink to the Dead
passages.text:
The Forsworn are ravaging the temples of Bastion, and the aspirants are leaving behind their supplies as they flee.

All those wonderful bottles of nectar falling into the hands of the Forsworn? I think not! 

There's no way we can save all of the aspirants, but we can keep the Forsworn from taking those supplies. Besides... we could all use something to drink around here.

passages.title: Drink to the Dead
passages.text: Did you find us some supplies?

passages.title: Drink to the Dead
passages.text: Uh, I see you brought back a few friends?

passages.title: Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald still faces threats from the Drust, as well as other nefarious forces.

The Winter Queen could use your aid in fending off the forces that seek to destroy Ardenweald.

passages.title: Ardenweald
passages.text: Ardenweald would be most appreciative of your help.

passages.title: Maldraxxus
passages.text:
With the houses in shambles, the loyal army of the Primus struggles to hold their ground in Maldraxxus.

They need help to tip the scales in their favor.

passages.title: Maldraxxus
passages.text: The armies loyal to the Primus need your aid.

passages.title: Revendreth
passages.text:
Chaos rules Revendreth in the wake of Sire Denathrius's betrayal. 

They are in dire need of your aid!

passages.title: Revendreth
passages.text: Revendreth would be most grateful for your aid.

passages.title: Cleaning Out the Vault
passages.text:
The Scourge's rampant aggression has proven difficult to predict, even for us.

By the time we knew they were upon us, it was too late.

With our forces spread thin, we are left with what you see before you.

Enter the vault. Slay our enemies where they stand.

Soon the Shadow Vault will be ours once more.

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, <name>? Up for an adventure?

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: That was close. Those pests can quickly blast away whole chunks of Ardenweald if we aren't careful. We've got enough problems on our hands as it is!

passages.title: A Fatal Failure
passages.text:
Acolyte, we could use a hand here!

It seems one of your fellow pupils botched their ritual in spectacular fashion. Now destructive necromantic energies are running rampant throughout the house.

This threat must be dealt with. Can you assist?

passages.title: A Fatal Failure
passages.text: Have you taken care of the threat, acolyte?

passages.title: A Fatal Failure
passages.text:
Well done, acolyte. The rest should dissipate with time.

Take this, it was left behind by the feckless adept that created this mess. I hope you will put it to better use.

passages.title: Casting Doubt
passages.text:
<A note has been left here for Kel'Thuzad. It does not appear that he has read it.>

Baron, I do not trust your new favorite acolyte. Something has been off about them ever since they returned from their ritual with the Kyrian remains.

Your work is too important to allow such discrepancies. The acolyte should be disposed of.

Faithfully,

Sorcerer Vutral

passages.title: Regalia de Rigueur
passages.text:
Ah, if it isn't Kel'Thuzad's favorite acolyte? I simply cannot understand how a baron like him would surround himself with such... homely company.

When was the last time you even chanced at a looking glass? Those faded robes do your station no justice.

I would take it upon myself to update your drab apparel, if I weren't sufferring such a shortage on the house's preferred amethystine tint.

You could always fetch some yourself. The sorcerers usually have some stashed among their tomes and altars.

passages.title: Regalia de Rigueur
passages.text:
I will need large quantities of amethystine powder if I am to fix...

<Moret gestures at you broadly.>

...this.

passages.title: Regalia de Rigueur
passages.text:
It brings me great relief that your pallid vestments will no longer offend my vision.

Do try keep them in better repair henceforth.

passages.title: Introductions are in Order
passages.text: Now yous is all set with yer new dredger, go ahead call on them and officially introduce yerself.

passages.title: Introductions are in Order
passages.text: I am so confused...

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
Well <name>, it seems you are serious about earning your way back into our good graces.

It seems you are serious about this penance. This task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Kyrian.

passages.title: Tirna Scithe: A Warning Silence
passages.text:
The songs of Tirna Scithe have faded as the grove wanes, yet there is now silence. Droman Oulfarran's voice has not been heard in some time. The trees whisper of penumbral shadows, discordant songs, and dying roots. All is not well.

Friend of Ardenweald, travel to Root-home. Delve into the Mists. Remove that which threatens us.

passages.title: Tirna Scithe: A Warning Silence
passages.text: What has silenced the grove of Tirna Scithe?

passages.title: Tirna Scithe: A Warning Silence
passages.text: Word of your aid has been sung through the roots. Thank you, friend of the forest.

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, <name>? Up for an adventure?

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: She seemed nice. The Mushroom Kingdom, was it? Hmph, never heard of it. Things kids get up to these days....

passages.title: House of Rituals
passages.text:
The Ritualists are the ones behind this war. Every act of treason has been committed under their orders.

We cannot defeat their sorcery with strength of arms alone. Victory will hinge on our knowledge of what they are plotting.

Continue to bolster our forces. I will look for a way to infiltrate the House of Rituals.

passages.title: House of Rituals
passages.text:
It seems we may have our way into the House of Rituals.

Do not mistake this lich for an ally. He pursues only his own agenda. But for now, our goals align... and we can use that to our advantage.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
So you have taken the first step to reclaiming our trust.

Now you must prove that was not another false start in our relationship. 

This final task should prove your willingness to rejoin our ranks.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

passages.title: Mobilize Maldraxxus
passages.text:
It will be difficult to reach Kel'Thuzad while he is in his necropolis.

Go now. It will take time for us to muster an army that can pierce his defenses.

passages.title: Mobilize Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Our forces stand ready.

Let us end this.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
You return as requested. Impressive, maybe you have indeed turned a new leaf.

I wish to see you complete one more task for us. To prove your dedication to this transition. 

Not that we doubt you, but you must understand your previous behavior gives us reason to doubt that dedication.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text: So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
You still have the same strength you had before it seems.

The question is - do you have any loyalty left within you?

I have one more task so you can demonstrate that loyalty again.

passages.title: Rebuild Our Trust
passages.text:
So, you have done as we ask and are ready to rejoin our ranks?

Once you complete this task with me you will leave your current Covenant and rejoin the Necrolords.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
I remember those guys. Bad news. 

They should stick to their own realm of existence!

Nice job cleaning house.

passages.title: Staff of the Primus
passages.text:
The Staff of the Primus. The final piece of our leader's regalia.

I can't deny the pride I feel in restoring this hall. You should feel the same sense of accomplishment.

The statue awaits you, <name>. Bring glory to this realm.

passages.title: Staff of the Primus
passages.text: I sense power. Power and ease.

passages.title: Herbicidal Tendencies
passages.text:
My gas is the most potent in all of Maldraxxus, but I've heard some of the others saying that it's not the strongest in the Shadowlands. 

They claim there are some plants in Ardenweald with a bloom that is far more pungent than my gas. Nonsense!

Let's go and check these plants out. If their stench is as strong as the stories claim, I might even be able to mix them in with my own gas!

passages.title: Herbicidal Tendencies
passages.text: Having fun picking flowers?

passages.title: Herbicidal Tendencies
passages.text:
How is it possible for him to smell even worse than before? 

Ugh. At least he gets results.

passages.title: Burying Suspicion
passages.text:
It will do us no good to disguise yourself as Nelesis if word reaches Kel'Thuzad that she was slain. 

You must ensure that no one who sees you enter the cave survives.

passages.title: Burying Suspicion
passages.text:
You left none behind to raise alarm? Good.

We can proceed with the plan.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Nothing wrong with picking flowers for a living. It's good, honest work.

And giving those blasted spriggans a kick in the rear is worthwhile too. Nice job.

passages.title: Snapper Soul
passages.text: <The Snapper Soul is determined. The shape of the dragon turtle will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Snapper Soul
passages.text: Ah. The essence of the dragon turtle! A fine shape. It is now yours, should you choose to use it.

passages.title: Gulper Soul
passages.text: <The Gulper Soul is patient and calm. The shape of the Gulper will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Gulper Soul
passages.text: The shape of the Gulper is now yours to call upon and use.

passages.title: Ardenmoth Soul
passages.text: <The Ardenmoth is plentiful in Ardenweald. Delicate looking creatures, they have hidden strength. Their magic can soothe the most tortured soul... or send the unwary into an eternal sleep. The shape of the moth will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Ardenmoth Soul
passages.text: Ah, the moth. Such beautiful creatures. Their shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Ursine Soul
passages.text: <The Ursine Soul is stalwart and brave. The shape of the bear will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Ursine Soul
passages.text: Ah. The heart of the bear! A fine shape. It is now yours, should you choose to use it.

passages.title: Crane Soul
passages.text: <The Crane Soul dances with grace. The shape of the crane will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Crane Soul
passages.text: The grace of the crane! A fine shape. It is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Veilwing Soul
passages.text:
<Graceful, dangerous, powerful. No creature in Ardenweald is more respected for its fierce defense of its family or territory than the veilwing. 

You have defeated a foe who endangered not only Ardenweald, but all of the Shadowlands. For this, Champion of Ardenweald, you have earned a special boon - the ability to call upon the essence of the veilwing and take their shape.>

passages.title: Veilwing Soul
passages.text: You have shown rare bravery, <name>. For this the forest recognizes you. Let all know your ferocity in defending our borders, and the love you have for our charges.

passages.title: Gryphon Soul
passages.text: <The Gryphon Soul is agile and swift. The shape of the gryphon will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Gryphon Soul
passages.text: Ah! You are swift like the gryphon it seems. The shape of the gryphon is yours to call upon.

passages.title: Hippogryph Soul
passages.text: <The Hippogryph Soul is intelligent and valiant. The shape of the hippogryph will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Hippogryph Soul
passages.text: Ah, the brave hippogryph. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Equine Soul
passages.text: <The Equine Soul is free-spirited and loyal. The shape of a horned horse will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Equine Soul
passages.text: A majestic shape, for certain. It is now yours, should you choose to use it.

passages.title: Leonine Soul
passages.text: <The Leonine sine Soul is powerful and brave. The shape of the lion will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Leonine Soul
passages.text: Ah, the lion. A wonderful shape. It is now yours to use.

passages.title: Moose Soul
passages.text: <The Moose Soul endures and protects. The shape of the moose will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Moose Soul
passages.text: The moose! A fine choice. It will be yours to call upon.

passages.title: Shadowstalker Soul
passages.text: <The Shadowstalker Soul is cunning and careful. The shape of the Shadowstalker will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Shadowstalker Soul
passages.text: The shadowstalker! You may use this shape to lurk within the forests.

passages.title: Owlcat Soul
passages.text: <The Owlcat Soul is a curious trickster, a beast of many parts working together in a playful balance, always seeking the next challenge. The shape of the owlcat will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Owlcat Soul
passages.text: Ah, yes. You have overcome many challenges with teamwork. I can see why the owlcat is now a shape you may call upon.

passages.title: Raptor Soul
passages.text: <The Raptor Soul is loyal and fierce. The shape of the raptor will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Raptor Soul
passages.text: Ah, the raptor! This shape is now yours to use if you so desire.

passages.title: Runestag Soul
passages.text: <The Runestag Soul is calm and enduring. The shape of the Runestag will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Runestag Soul
passages.text: The runestag! Long have they been companions of the Night Fae. Their shape is now yours to use.

passages.title: Stag Soul
passages.text: <The Stag Soul is noble and mighty. The shape of the stag will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Stag Soul
passages.text: Ah, the stag. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Shrieker Soul
passages.text: <The Shrieker Soul is swift and fierce. The shape of the veil shrieker will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Shrieker Soul
passages.text: The shape of the veil shrieker is now yours to use if you choose.

passages.title: Tiger Soul
passages.text: <The Tiger Soul is proud and strong. The shape of the tiger will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Tiger Soul
passages.text: The shape of the tiger is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Lupine Soul
passages.text: <The Lupine Soul is a fierce and free-spirited protector. The shape of the wolf will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Lupine Soul
passages.text: Ah, the wolf. A fine shape. You may now call upon the wolf as a soulshape to use.

passages.title: Wolfhawk Soul
passages.text: <The Wolfhawk Soul is cunning hunter. The shape of the wolfhawk will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Wolfhawk Soul
passages.text: The wolfhawk! Such an impressive hunter. Their shape is now yours to use.

passages.title: Wyvern Soul
passages.text: <The Wyvern Soul is proud and determined. The shape of the wyvern will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Wyvern Soul
passages.text: Ah, the wyvern. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text:
I hear amazing things about the realm beyond this garden, but honestly I am too old to wish to place myself in danger.

You are young and vibrant! Head out across the realm, and return to me with the stories of your adventures!

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text: Head out into the Shadowlands. Return to me with stories of your exploits.

passages.title: Aid the Covenant
passages.text: I find it helpful to have you do these things for me.

passages.title: A Spirit's Pride
passages.text:
I seek to understand more about the prideful beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.

passages.title: A Spirit's Pride
passages.text: Find a prideful spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.

passages.title: A Spirit's Pride
passages.text: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text:
I have a mystery for you, <name>!

Who doesn't savor a good mystery? 

We have found a spirit unlike any other, one who does not respond to being placed in a wildseed.

Each of us who touched it experienced a dream in which we saw you battling a great beast. Only when you defeated it did the spirit begin on its path to rebirth. 

We think we know the beast.

Are you up for discovering if these dreams were a portent?

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text: You did it! I cannot quite explain why that worked. Dreams can be strange, huh?

passages.title: Securing the House
passages.text:
Your journey into the Maw was impressive, but it will take even more phenomenal feats to earn the loyalty of the Maldraxxi.

Increase your renown among our ranks, Maw Walker. The Maldraxxi are dedicated soldiers, but they will not follow just anyone into battle. Let your deeds prove your worth to them.

passages.title: Securing the House
passages.text: Your actions have attracted the attention of the other houses--and those who question their orders.

passages.title: A Spirit's Duty
passages.text:
I seek to understand more about the Dutiful beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.

passages.title: A Spirit's Duty
passages.text: Find a Dutiful spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.

passages.title: A Spirit's Duty
passages.text: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.

passages.title: A Spirit's Heart
passages.text:
I seek to understand more about the Untamed beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.

passages.title: A Spirit's Heart
passages.text: Find an Untamed spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.

passages.title: A Spirit's Heart
passages.text: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.

passages.title: A Spirit's Might
passages.text:
I seek to understand more about the Martial beings in this realm.

If you could place one in a wildseed, as you did for me, I could observe the restoration process.

passages.title: A Spirit's Might
passages.text: Find a Martial spirit to restore. That is what I wish to see today.

passages.title: A Spirit's Might
passages.text: This is nothing like my home world, but it is still quite fascinating.

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text:
Come to pay old Marasmius a visit? I have a special task for you.

One of my shoots has found a strange place, a place even I've never seen before.

I'm not entirely sure what's in there or if it's even safe. But that's what my trusty mushroomancers are for!

What do you say, <name>? Up for an adventure?

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: Keep your guard up. It could lead anywhere!

passages.title: Into the Unknown
passages.text: You know I appreciate hard work, but it's important to take care of yourself from time to time. Hope you had fun, blew off some steam, and are ready to get back at it!

passages.title: De Other Side: Dealin' Wit' Da Boss
passages.text:
Ay, mon. Long time no see!

I be havin' a bit of trouble wit' me boss, Mueh'zala. Now, now... don't you worry. Your ol' friend Bwonsamdi got dis whole ting under control!

I just be needin' some help gatherin' me mojo back from a few ungrateful business partners.

You bring me da mojo, and we goin' ta take care of ol' Mueh'zala once and for all!

passages.title: De Other Side: Dealin' Wit' Da Boss
passages.text: First you get da mojo, then I get da powa'... then we be gettin' Mueh'zala!

passages.title: De Other Side: Dealin' Wit' Da Boss
passages.text: Now dat da ol' boss be a captive audience, he and I goin' ta be makin' some new arrangements. Ya best be goin' now, but don't worry... I be seein' ya soon!

passages.title: De Other Side
passages.text:
Ay, dere <name>! Ya be just da <class> I've been lookin' for!

It be your ol' pal Bwonsamdi reachin' out ta ya from De Other Side! I be havin' a little problem over here wit' de boss...

Ya be lookin' mighty bored just standin' around here in Ardenweald. Why don't ya come to De Other Side and help out an ol' friend? Bwonsamdi promise he gonna make it worth ya while!

Ya might want ta bring a few more adventurers wit' ya... just ta be safe.

passages.title: De Other Side
passages.text: Ay, dere mon! It be good ta see a friendly face. Your ol' friend Bwonsamdi be havin' a bit of trouble wit' da Bossman...

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Those are special moths! They really liven up the place, don't they?

You know moths work just as hard as anyone else, and they're under-appreciated. 

Thanks for savin' em.

passages.title: Stalking the Warrens
passages.text:
So, they are creating magical beasts deep within the Warrens. Their power is... substantial.

Maw Walker, I must trust in you to handle this. While I can provide insight, in combat I must admit your prowess exceeds my own.

Hunt the beasts that they train to hunt us. Show the Mawsworn that we too can bare fangs.

passages.title: Stalking the Warrens
passages.text: I suspect this will not be your last foray into the Warrens.

passages.title: WANTED: The Key of Eyes
passages.text:
I seek a mercenary of unparalleled might to venture into the House of Eyes and procure the "Key of Eyes".

Above average compensation is assured for the one who can both deliver the key and regale me with the story of its previous owner's demise. 

Be warned that the grounds once belonging to the House of Eyes are extremely dangerous and lone exploration is highly discouraged.

passages.title: WANTED: The Key of Eyes
passages.text: So, you've seen my posting?

passages.title: WANTED: The Key of Eyes
passages.text:
Ah, very good! And a million eyes appeared, you say? How frightening! 

Glad she's gone and the key's in my hands now! She used it to break into many a locked door, you know? A very powerful item! Very profitable too.

And now it's mine!

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Always nice to lend a hand to someone who's just tryin' to do their job. A metaphorical hand, obviously... although in your case, it's literal.

I know what metaphorical means!

Anyway, good work out there.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Ah, you're just in time. I've made quite the discovery.

I've managed to make a connection even further out than I ever have before.

How did I do it, you ask? Hard work, that's how! But you knew that. You're almost as hardworking as I am. That's what you're here for!

Up for an even more exciting adventure?

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text: I feel a breeze on the other side. I guess that means it's not underground.

passages.title: Go Beyond!
passages.text:
Must be nice to have the leisure to just sit and think all the time. 

I've barely got time myself, with all the work I have keeping this place together!

Still, that was nice of you to help out the old turtle.

passages.title: Seed of a Thought
passages.text:
Within wildseeds, spirits slumber and grow. But so too can catalysts, when seeds take the place of spirits.

Seed Merchant Daybreak trades in such seeds. She can supply you with the ones you seek. Choose one to plant within a wildseed.

The forest holds its breath and awaits your choice.

passages.title: Seed of a Thought
passages.text: Your talents as a cultivator continue to thrive.

passages.title: Seed of a Thought
passages.text: The branches of your expertise reach for the heavens and blossom. This is good.

passages.title: What's Old is New
passages.text:
These damn Scourge make me sick!

<Brollen spits on the ground.>

They're only good fer one thing--bein' dead!

Head tae the valley southwest o' here. Plenty o' gear fer the pickin' over there!

Gather up what ye can. I'll make do with what ye find.

passages.title: What's Old is New
passages.text: Find somethin' worth smeltin'?

passages.title: What's Old is New
passages.text:
These'll do nicely.

I'll get tae work.

passages.title: Blueprint: Skystrider Glider
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a single use glider, invented by Dresaelus.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this kit.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Skystrider Glider
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Steward Mail Pouch
passages.text:
<The pouch is well constructed, with plenty of room for scrolls and a division to keep letters flat. The stitching is clean, and the strap is adjustable to fit your steward's size.

You are certain your steward will love it.>

passages.title: Steward Mail Pouch
passages.text:
New pouch? Wow! Holds so much stuff!

Cannot wait to use it. Must show Sika! Thank!

passages.title: Blueprint: Empyrean Refreshment
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a table of refreshing snacks that would be quite useful while out adventuring.

Dactylis should be able to help you with the crafting.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Empyrean Refreshment
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: The Lost of Teldrassil
passages.text:
I learned that Sylvanas burned Teldrassil. I felt my heart break for the night elves.

And that was only the beginning. We know now that the souls lost that day did not go to their intended rest.

But you have the power to begin to correct that, Maw Walker.

If you find yourself in the Maw, look for any of those lost.

Please, bring them home.

passages.title: The Lost of Teldrassil
passages.text:
Thank you, Maw Walker.

You have brought back a little bit of the light from the darkness.

We will make this right, no matter how long it takes.

passages.title: From a Dark Place
passages.text:
You rescued some of the night elves from the Maw before. While the danger is still great, I must ask you to do it again.

I have to believe that we can save them. As many of them as possible.

Please, go and see if you can recover any more lost souls.

passages.title: From a Dark Place
passages.text:
I thank you once again, Maw Walker.

These souls are finally free of the torment and pain.

There are still so many more, but I am optimistic that we may yet save them.

passages.title: No Wisp Left Behind
passages.text:
More of the Kaldorei souls still languish in the Maw.

I ask you once again, Maw Walker, to find them.

Help correct this wrong.

passages.title: No Wisp Left Behind
passages.text:
It brings me joy to see more souls freed from that dark place.

Thank you Maw Walker, for continuing to help us.

passages.title: No Wisp Left Behind
passages.text:
More of the Kaldorei souls still languish in the Maw.

I ask you once again, Maw Walker, to find them.

Help correct this wrong.

passages.title: No Wisp Left Behind
passages.text:
It brings me joy to see more souls freed from that dark place.

Thank you Maw Walker, for continuing to help us.

passages.title: Our Realm Reclaimed
passages.text:
Though Forsworn still fight across Bastion, the Temple of Loyalty is ours, and with it our realm.

We will have to stay diligent to maintain control of all of the temples, and much remains to be decided with the fate of our fallen brethren, but today is a day of great victory.

Join me at the Crest of Ascension, and witness its final empowerment.

passages.title: Our Realm Reclaimed
passages.text:
This day would not have been won without you, Maw Walker.

On behalf of the Archon, the Paragons, and all kyrian--thank you.

passages.title: Growing in Power
passages.text:
Wonderful news, <name>!

You have gathered enough Anima. The Queen is now able to empower the Heart of the Forest!

passages.title: Growing in Power
passages.text: I am so excited!

passages.title: Growing in Power
passages.text: We're on the right track, <name>! Keep doing what you're doing and it will be back to its full, glorious, starryness in no time!

passages.title: My Heart is Full
passages.text:
<name>! Can you believe it? We have enough Anima that the Winter Queen can fully restore the Heart of the Forest!

You've done so much for us!

passages.title: My Heart is Full
passages.text: I am so excited!

passages.title: My Heart is Full
passages.text: We're so grateful for all your help, <name>. Seeing the Heart of the Forest like this again, full of power? My heart is filled with hope.

passages.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
passages.text:
Chromie is seeking veteran adventurers to embark on expeditions through time and space.

This is your opportunity to experience the legendary adventures of the past--today!

Speak with Chromie near the Stormwind Embassy for more information.

passages.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
passages.text: I'm glad you made it, <name>! Something tells me that your future is waiting for you in the past!

passages.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
passages.text:
Chromie is seeking veteran adventurers to embark on expeditions through time and space.

This is your opportunity to experience the legendary adventures of the past--today!

Speak with Chromie near the Orgrimmar Embassy for more information.

passages.title: Adventurers Wanted: Chromie's Call
passages.text: I'm glad you made it, <name>! Something tells me that your future is waiting for you in the past!

passages.title: The Jailer's Grasp
passages.text:
By peering into the Maw, Bolvar drew the Jailer's attention.

His worst fears have come to pass.

You must help me break the link, <name>! The fragment of the Helm is the key!

passages.title: The Jailer's Grasp
passages.text:
The Jailer... is gone... from my mind.

Thank you, <name>. You saved me from a darker fate than you could ever know.

For that, you will ever have my thanks.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text:
I have always had dreams.

Special dreams you could say.

Any place of tranquility or calm can come to me in a dream.

Even those that may have danger nearby, as calm can be found anywhere, if you know how.

Now I dream of your world, your Azeroth. 

I cannot travel to your realm. Help me connect to my latest dream through your eyes.

I have dreamed of a high place. A very high place. Do you know it?

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text:
You return.

This pleases me. 

More places of tranquility have come to me in dreams.

I see a sandy beach, Sunsets. 

I cannot travel to your realm. Help me connect to my latest dream through your eyes.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text:
I am glad you wish to continue your meditations.

It will help you be more centered.

I have had another dream. A warm dream of a cold place.

It is wrapped in white. Do you know of it?

Venture there and experience the vista I saw in my dream.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text:
Thank you for returning.

I have had another dream. Another vision of your realm.

In this dream the sky danced above me. 

On the edge of a cliff, in a northern land. 

Such a sight to behold. 

You must experience it for yourself.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text:
We have already experienced so much together.

I am grateful to have a companion on this voyage of discovery.

You walk where I can only project.

You touch that which I can only see.

I have had another dream.

Another coast. A statue. 

A large statue of a little one. 

Go, seek out the view from my dream.

passages.title: In Search of Inner Calm
passages.text: That was such a pleasant dream. I am glad to you got to experience the reality.

passages.title: Bonesmith Heirmir
passages.text:
<Alexandros Mograine left you a very straightforward letter of introduction for a certain Bonesmith Heirmir in Maldraxxus.

What aid might she be able to offer the Ember Court?>

passages.title: Bonesmith Heirmir
passages.text: What do you want, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Forgelite Sophone
passages.text:
<Polemarch Adrestes left you a very formal letter of introduction for Forgelite Sophone in Bastion.

What aid might she be able to offer the Ember Court?>

passages.title: Forgelite Sophone
passages.text: I assume you have need of me, Maw Walker. What can I do for you?

passages.title: Gormsmith Cavina
passages.text:
<Hunt-Captain Korayn left you a terse letter of introduction to Gormsmith Cavina in Ardenweald.

What aid might he be able to offer the Ember Court?>

passages.title: Gormsmith Cavina
passages.text: Do you need some armor repaired?

passages.title: Forgy
passages.text:
<Rendle left you a crumpled envelope addressed to Forgy in Darkhaven. On the outside of the envelope are very specific orders to tell Forgy that Rendle sent you.

What aid might Forgy be able to offer the Ember Court?>

passages.title: Forgy
passages.text: What can I do for ya, Maw Walker?

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text:
I'm glad to see you again, friend!

We have found another inert spirit gripped by dark dreams. Nasty stuff! 

In this dream, a noble figure that once embodied loyalty has been consumed by their own doubts, leading them down a dark path.

If you were to defeat the fallen paragon, I bet we'll be able to revive this poor spirit.

Will you help us once more, <name>?

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text: Another dream vision fulfilled. This is remarkable!

passages.title: Broker Business
passages.text: <A web covered box of assorted scholar supplies lays haphazardly on the ground. The make seems Broker in origin. Perhaps the owner is nearby.>

passages.title: Broker Business
passages.text: Oh! My missing supplies! How fortuitous.

passages.title: A Blackthorn Blend
passages.text:
Ah, just the mushroomancer I wanted to see! Mind getting me some clay?

There's all kinds of different soil, you know. It's not all just dirt! And clay... clay is something special. You ever try growing through clay? Oh, I guess not.

It's hard work to break down, but once you do the flavor is incomparable! My roots are looking forward to the challenge.

Blackthorn Grove has a particularly bitter and complex clay that is just what I'm craving. I'm sure they won't mind if you ask them for some.

passages.title: A Blackthorn Blend
passages.text: If they give you any trouble, just tell 'em Marasmius sent you. I bet someone there is old enough to remember me.

passages.title: A Blackthorn Blend
passages.text: Ooh, that's the stuff all right. It's bitter, sure, but wonderfully complex and subtle undertones. Mm! You'll have to try some sometime.

passages.title: Glittering Gritty Goodness
passages.text:
Well, hello there! Fancy helping me out today?

You ever been to Shimmerbough? Ever wonder why it's called that? I was there when it was named, you know.

Lots of people think it's the trees or the water, and they're right. But the secret to the shimmering is in the silt. The soil soaks and gains excess anima from the water, until the ground itself practically sparkles.

I could really go for some shimmersilt right now. Would you let an old mushroom relive his youth?

passages.title: Glittering Gritty Goodness
passages.text: Oooh, I always used to get tingly all over when I had shimmersilt. And that's a lot of tingling!

passages.title: Glittering Gritty Goodness
passages.text: Look at it sparkle and shine! I'm getting the tingles just looking at it. I feel ages younger already!

passages.title: A Royal Treat
passages.text:
So nice to see you again. I've got a special request for you.

The Winter Queen herself used to tend directly to groves, in the early times. Everything she touched burst with life and power. Even the ground she walked on.

Over time, the Queen's Garden came to be known as the Garden of Night, for the Queen had not tended to her garden in so long.

But the ground is still potent with her power. It's the finest meal I've ever had. I know this is indulgent, but you and I both know I deserve it!

passages.title: A Royal Treat
passages.text: Sometimes you just need to treat yourself to something nice.

passages.title: A Royal Treat
passages.text: Feel how luxurious the soil is! I'm going to savor this for a while. Thank you.

passages.title: Necrolord Arsenal
passages.text:
<Bonesmith Heimir begins reading the letter you hand her.>

Hmm. Mograine usually has more sense than this...

<Bonesmith Heimir finishes the letter and shreds it with her bony fingers.>

An order's an order. I'll arrange for a shipment of raw materials and forging equipment to be delivered to your court.

While you wait, Mograine asks that you clear out some of our enemies to help cover for my absence.

It was in the letter. Shame it's all shredded up so you can't read it.

passages.title: Necrolord Arsenal
passages.text:
Good. I've arranged everything needed on our side.

I'll be there.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: The Stalks
passages.text:
<Marasmius sighs.> 

They're at it again, up in the Stalks.

Seems like we didn't give them enough of a thrashing the first time, eh? What say you and I team up again and teach those younglings a lesson they won't forget?

Let me know when you're ready and we'll get 'em, just like before!

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: The Stalks
passages.text: Let's go, before they do any more damage!

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: The Stalks
passages.text: Hmph, serves them right. Think they can go stomping around my grove? I am the only one who gets to do any stomping! I am the one who stomps!

passages.title: Venthyr Arsenal
passages.text:
<Forgy reads the letter you hand him.>

Ah, Rendle sent you. Should've said so.

No problem. I'll get you everything you need to be bashing skulls at that court.

Gonna need some help convincing my boss for the time off, though.

Real stick in the muck, yeah?

Say you take care of some of the troubles around here, tell everyone it's for me--that'll do it.

passages.title: Venthyr Arsenal
passages.text:
Nice work. Boss gave the all-clear for me time off.

See you there, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Kyrian Arsenal
passages.text:
<Forgelite Sophone reads the letter you hand her.>

I see.

Wherever I may serve, I will go.

Are you willing to do the same? Will you serve Bastion where it has need?

passages.title: Kyrian Arsenal
passages.text: My hammer is yours.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Eventide Grove
passages.text:
I hope you're ready to fight.

The Drust are bolstering their forces in Eventide Grove. Most of Ardenweald doesn't remember them, but I do. You have to completely root them out to be rid of their presence, or they'll grow right back, tougher than ever.

Come with me. We're going to exterminate every last one of them. Let me know when you're ready.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Eventide Grove
passages.text: Quickly, before they spread any further into Ardenweald. Now's our chance.

passages.title: Hyphae Patrol: Eventide Grove
passages.text: Good work. They're still holed up in Darkreach, but that's the best we can do for now. Keep 'em contained, and then we'll burn them out.

passages.title: Night Fae Arsenal
passages.text:
<Gormsmith Cavina reads the letter you hand him.>

I'm not surprised the Hunt-Captain sent you to me. I am the finest gormsmith in all of Ardenweald, afterall.

Her orders are clear and I'm happy to help.

We'll need you to take on some extra patrols to make up for the lost time and resources.

Sound fair?

passages.title: Night Fae Arsenal
passages.text: Everything's ready. I'm looking forward to the adventure.

passages.title: A Meandering Story
passages.text:
<A quick glance at this heavy tome reveals flowery language and a plot that doesn't seem to go anyplace. At least not in the first few chapters.

There is some dirt on the cover, but the damage isn't too bad. This book doesn't seem to have found itself in too much trouble-- a bit like its plot.

Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>

passages.title: A Meandering Story
passages.text: Oh! You found one of my books! Thank you so much for returning it to me.

passages.title: A Wandering Tale
passages.text:
<This book might have a point, but the author is taking every possible detour along the way. Or maybe it's about the journey and not the destination...

In any case, Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>

passages.title: A Wandering Tale
passages.text: I was just thinking about this book! I had hoped it would come back on its own. Thank you for returning it to me.

passages.title: An Escapist Novel
passages.text:
<Action, adventure, thrills, chills... This book has it all! Penned by a mortal soul who led an amazing life, this book is a page-turner. 

But is it true? Could one person fight conspiracies, ancient evils, vast enemy armies, demons and even gods in a single lifetime?

On further reflection, it could be true, but what is a "duck" this book speaks of? That part sounds fake.

Still... it was a good story. Archivist Dreyden would probably be pleased to have his book back.>

passages.title: An Escapist Novel
passages.text: This was a good tale! Oh, I do hope the soul who wrote it down is doing okay in this drought! Oh dear me. Thank you for returning it to me.

passages.title: A Travel Journal
passages.text:
<This book appears to be a travelogue of this book's personal journey around Ardenweald! And self-written and published no less!

Flipping towards the end you see yourself enter the picture as a villain, unjustly attacking the book and opening it. 

You read "This book appears to be a travelogue of this book's personal journey around Ardenweald! And Self-written and-"

You hurriedly close the book, feeling queasy. It should go back to Archivist Dreyden.>

passages.title: A Travel Journal
passages.text: It was writing itself? How fascinating! The feeling of recursion will pass.

passages.title: A Naughty Story
passages.text:
<You have held this book for less than five minutes and it has already escaped once, bitten you twice and somehow managed to steal some gold.

This is not what you were expecting from a "Naughty Story" but then again, maybe you should have.

You bind the book closed so it will hopefully cause a minimum of mischief. Time to bring it to Archivist Dreyden.>

passages.title: A Naughty Story
passages.text:
You found one of my books!

Oh. That one.

<Dreyden sighs.>

I suppose I will take it back. Thanks, I guess.

passages.title: The Queen's Conservatory
passages.text:
I have heard that you are aiding us in restoring our sanctum, <name>. 

There is a very special magical grove that we know as The Queen's Conservatory. 

Within this magical sanctuary we nurture the spirits of old deities back to life. But its magic has waned with the anima drought. 

It is in need of your help.

It would mean the world to us if you could start the restoration process by acquiring the resources we need.

passages.title: The Queen's Conservatory
passages.text: You can go and Speak to Zayhad in your Sanctum to unlock the Queen's Conservatory once you have collected sufficient resources.

passages.title: The Queen's Conservatory
passages.text: I am so happy to see you have started to help restore the Queen's Conservatory to its former glory.

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text:
It's a joy to see the progress you've made in the restoration of the conservatory, <name>!

But there's still more work to be done.

We have found another inert spirit. A dark dream is preventing its awakening.

In this dream, the spirit is caught in the midst of a feud between ancient beings. Both are a bit on the unsavory side, but one is much, much worse than the other!

If you were to defeat the Father of Sleep, it should nudge the spirit from its slumber. Will you help?

passages.title: A Rare and Unusual Spirit
passages.text: Another dream vision fulfilled. This is remarkable!

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text:
This is a most curious place.

So much energy of rebirth. A fusion of different forms of magic. Not what I expected.

I too was committed to rebirth among my kind. This magic is both known to me, and like nothing I have seen before. Yet it all serves to balance. 

It is not just great spirits of import that help to maintain the cosmic balance.

Even the smallest of creatures can play a role. 

I can show you if you like? Visit the remains of one such creature, and we shall rekindle its spirit.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text: Return to me when you have found the remains that birthed the spirit animal.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text: You have seen them already? Yes, you did. I can tell.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text:
The time has come for us to rekindle another animal spirit.

This one was lost to fire and raiding in a distant land.

Go. Commune with the creature's remains. Release its spirit so that it may return here.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text: You have delivered this spirit back to us. It can now roam free here in the conservatory.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text:
The time has come for us to rekindle another animal spirit.

While appearing normal to you, and to the great winged creature that ate it, this creature was in fact somewhat special among its kind. 

You should travel to its grisly resting place and commune with its spirit so that it may join us in the conservatory.

passages.title: All Spirits Great and Small
passages.text: You have delivered this spirit back to us. It can now roam free here in the conservatory.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: Well done, <name>. With courage, you have faced every challenge along the way, and battled every day to claim your rightful place.

passages.title: A Calling in Revendreth
passages.text:
We got a lot of problems out there, boss. Big ones, little ones, really smelly ones, it's a lot.

If we're gonna take on Denathrius, the first thing we gotta do is clean up right here in Revendreth.

We get things cleaned up, yeah? Then we get some new allies, and we probably get our hands on some anima to boot.

It's a call to action, it is. And it's important that we get started right away.

Get on out there and get your boots muddy!

passages.title: A Calling in Revendreth
passages.text: What do ya want?

passages.title: A Calling in Revendreth
passages.text: Ya did a good thing today, an' we're safer for it. Never been one to give a compliment, me, but today I gotta say ya did a good one.

passages.title: A Calling in Bastion
passages.text:
Our forces are weakened by doubt and our temples are under assault. If we are to aid the rest of the Shadowlands, we must begin here, in Bastion.

Travel the golden fields and root out evil wherever you may find it. In time, we will rebuild our forces and our anima stores, and stand tall once more.

Today, you walk the path of courage--it is your calling. Show our people that doubt will not fester here.

passages.title: A Calling in Bastion
passages.text: Do the hills echo with the cries of your victories, Maw Walker?

passages.title: A Calling in Bastion
passages.text:
The hills speak of your faith and honor, and our forces radiate with each victory!

Glory to Bastion, glory to the Archon, glory to the Maw Walker!

passages.title: A Calling in Ardenweald
passages.text:
Ardenweald is fractured, its roots strangled. Before we can begin to regrow our glades, we must unearth the evils that have festered here.

We call to you, today, to defend our forests. Take the weald paths through our lands, aiding our allies and defeating our enemies. With these actions, we will renew our forces, and rebuild our anima. In time, hope will blossom.

Our trust is in you, our newest seedling.

passages.title: A Calling in Ardenweald
passages.text: Have you brought hope and faith to our people today?

passages.title: A Calling in Ardenweald
passages.text: Our bonds are stronger, our roots grow deeper, due to your actions this day. We will hold strong against the onset of foes that plague us, as groves weave together in defense, thanks to you.

passages.title: A Calling in Maldraxxus
passages.text:
Today marks the beginning of our path to victory.

Enemies surround us on all sides. Aid our troops on the battlefield and return with the resources we need to wage our war.

Once we have secured our home front, we can direct our efforts outwards.

Such is your calling. Failure is unacceptable.

passages.title: A Calling in Maldraxxus
passages.text: How goes the battle?

passages.title: A Calling in Maldraxxus
passages.text: Our rival houses will think twice before stepping foot outside of their strongholds again. Blood and glory to you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text:
An opportunity has arisen that will be perfect for you to display your... prowess... to the denizens of Revendreth.

Speak with Rendle. That dredger is disturbingly effective when it comes to hatching schemes. He says he has a plan for you.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text: It's right good of you to step up and take on this here challenge, it is. We've got a lot of work to do, here in Revendreth, so's I hope you're ready to get a bit dirty.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text:
<Laurel picks out a sad tune on her harp.>

Our groves wilt and wither,
and enemies wait at our gates!
The forest calls out in sorrow, 
"Please help us before it's too late!"

<The melody becomes a call to arms.>

O <huntsman/huntress>, now answer our calling!
Ardenweald is in need of your might!
Envoy Blodwyn will give you a mission,
to ride with the Wild Hunt tonight!

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text: I thank you for your visit, and entrust you with an important task. To regrow Ardenweald, we must begin by aiding its denizens.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text:
Elysian Hold requires anima to operate fully. We need as much as we can so it may serve our needs.

Our temples are fraught with challenges. By heeding their call you will recover anima for use within the sanctum here.

Speak with Hermestes first, who will guide you on the path of courage.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text: I knew you would answer the call, Maw Walker. There is much to be done.

passages.title: Ashes of the Tower
passages.text: Your first step towards obtaining the power is to retrieve... something. Yes, I believe it's coming back to me.

passages.title: Ashes of the Tower
passages.text: Have you recovered what is needed?

passages.title: Ashes of the Tower
passages.text:
Yes, this should be enough to engrave the runes. Upon lesser equipment, that is. 

Potent items will require more... more... Soul Ash. Yes, Soul Ash.

And you should hold onto it. I will ask for it when the time comes.

passages.title: The Elysian Fields
passages.text:
You must travel to Bastion, eternal home of the winged kyrian.

Do not be fooled by their golden fields and shining spires--the kyrian have been weakened by the great anima drought, and face the brink of civil war against their own fallen brethren.

They will benefit greatly from your aid. Seek one known as Kalisthene in the crossroads called Hero's Rest. She will direct you further.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: The Elysian Fields
passages.text: Why have you come to our realm, mortal?

passages.title: A Gift for an Acolyte
passages.text:
The materials you supplied were more than sufficient for my purposes. For that, you have my gratitude.

I think I know how to make the best use of the excess.

A dear friend of mine recently achieved the role of Acolyte in service to the Temple of Purity. You are new here, so I will spare you the details, but it is an honor to serve a temple before one reaches ascension.

I want to celebrate her success with a gift. Will you take this parcel to Acolyte Amalthina?

passages.title: A Gift for an Acolyte
passages.text: Welcome to the Temple of Purity. How may I be of service?

passages.title: A Gift for an Acolyte
passages.text:
What is this?

<She opens the parcel. A soft smile spreads over her face.>

This is wonderful. Thank you.

passages.title: More Than A Gift
passages.text:
You have no idea what you just delivered, do you?

<She opens the parcel to reveal a wreath of Larion plumage.>

I will explain, but first... I wish to return the favor.

Klystere and I frequent a resting place to the north of here, along the path to the Temple of Courage. We planted a flower for our enjoyment, as we spend so much of our free time there.

Bring me this bloom, if you would be so kind. Then I will tell you about the significance of this gift.

passages.title: More Than A Gift
passages.text: Did you find the place I mentioned? And the flower?

passages.title: More Than A Gift
passages.text: This is perfect. I appreciate your efforts on my behalf.

passages.title: Re-Introductions
passages.text:
Though you have chosen your path, the fate of the Shadowlands has yet to be determined.

The power of the Banished One grows. It falls to you, and others of your kind, to thwart him.

The Arbiter's Honored Voice, Tal-Inara, will aid you in choosing a covenant. Bolstering their strength offers our best chance at victory.

Let the Purpose guide you, <name>. Always.

passages.title: Re-Introductions
passages.text: Ah, <name>. I was wondering when you were going to appear. Your aid is needed.

passages.title: Hero's Rest
passages.text:
In light of the new arrivals to Bastion, Kalisthene has enabled the anima gateways to Hero's Rest once more!

Those wishing to partake of breathtaking views, unparalleled steward service, and all manner of training and repair facilities should venture to this most remarkable of locations at their earliest convenience.

Simply follow the path north and bear to the right at the crossroads.

Kalisthene will personally greet all new arrivals for this most joyous of occasions!

passages.title: Hero's Rest
passages.text: Welcome to Hero's Rest, crossroads of Bastion. You will find much to aid you in your journey here.

passages.title: Ye Olde Test of Strength
A Test of Guile
Return to Oribos
passages.text:
You have proven yourself a worthy ally of Bastion in your time here, <name>. Though I wish you could remain here, there are other realms in the Shadowlands that require aid more.

Return to Oribos when you are able and seek out Tal-Inara. She will help you decide where to best next focus your efforts.

Archon watch over you.

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text: You have fulfilled your purpose. Well done.

passages.title: Fruit of the Gods
passages.text:
You like sweet fruit? 

Stewards grow juiciest Purian. It special fruit! You find it many places in Bastion. It used for many things. 

Eat for nourishment.

Give to bells for blessings.

Give to stewards for treasure.

You find, I show you how!

passages.title: Fruit of the Gods
passages.text: You find sweet Purian?

passages.title: Fruit of the Gods
passages.text: Yes, this very sweet and ripe. Must use quickly, before it spoils!

passages.title: The Sweetest Tribute
passages.text:
Purian good to eat, yes, but better to give.

You find locked Silver Strongbox near steward statue. Give Ripe Purian fruit as tribute.

Then get nice surprise!

You try?

passages.title: The Sweetest Tribute
passages.text: You give Purian yet?

passages.title: The Sweetest Tribute
passages.text:
I hope you liked your surprise! 

You find more silver strongboxes, give Ripe Purian tribute!

Oh-ho! You want key to my Golden Chest? Ask me about Steward of the Day!

passages.title: A Fresh Blade
passages.text:
Though they were once unified in defending the Shadowlands, the houses of Maldraxxus have turned against each other.

Their armies clash within their realm and have even orchestrated an assault on Bastion. Now only the Necrolords remain loyal to the Primus.

Speak to Secutor Mevix at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. His tactical skills will ensure you are sent where you are most needed.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide you with transportation.

passages.title: A Fresh Blade
passages.text: Ah, another blade on our side! And you aren't even dead yet!

passages.title: Restoring Balance
passages.text:
Ardenweald is crucial to the cycle of rebirth for nature spirits that enter their realm.

Unfortunately, the anima drought has led to the loss of entire groves--souls that will never complete their cycle.

Now foes seek to destroy what remains of the once tranquil forests, threatening the already beleaguered Court of Night. 

Lady Moonberry of the Court has requested aid. Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: Restoring Balance
passages.text: Welcome! What brings you to the Heart of the Forest?

passages.title: Dark Aspirations
passages.text:
Prince Renathal has started a daring rebellion against his father, the nefarious Sire Denathrius who betrayed us all by pouring Revendreth's vast anima stores into the Maw.

You must travel to Revendreth and aid Renathal in his efforts. He is our best hope at restoring Revendreth to order.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: Dark Aspirations
passages.text: And to what do I owe the pleasure of a mortal visiting Revendreth at such an...inopportune time?

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text:
I wouldn't be a tactician if I didn't recognize when the mission is complete.

Much remains to be done before Maldraxxus can stand tall once again, but that day will come thanks to your efforts. 

There are other realms in need of your skills more than us. You should return to Oribos and see to it that they receive it.

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text: You have done well in Maldraxxus. Their path forward is clear.

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text:
I wish you could stay and relax here, maybe enjoy a play at the Star Lake Amphitheater, but there's simply no time!
