There are other realms out there that need your help, too.

You will always be a friend of the Court, but I'm afraid you must return to Oribos. The Shadowlands needs you!

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text: Your efforts in Ardenweald have not gone unnoticed, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text:
I truly wish you could remain here and aid our cause--it is truly the most pressing manner in all the Shadowlands--but Revendreth alone cannot stand against the growing darkness.

You must return to Oribos and ensure the other realms do not falter in their commitments. Tal-Inara will be able to guide you appropriately.

Thank you once again for your aid, mortal. May our paths cross again.

passages.title: Return to Oribos
passages.text: Revendreth stands stronger for your efforts. The Purpose is clear.

passages.title: I Could Be A Contender
passages.text:
Hold up there, <brother/sister>. 

If you are serious about fighting in the Arena you're going to need a manager. 
Lucky for you, <brother/sister>, I know a guy. He's just had some openings in his roster of fighters and you look like just the type of <class> he needs to fill his ranks.

Name is Louison, you can find him at the gate just east of here.

Tell him I sent ya, <brother/sister>.

passages.title: I Could Be A Contender
passages.text:
Oh, Anzio sent you? Hah, and here I was thinking you were just another nosy fan.

Yeah, you look like just the <class> I need!

passages.title: Of Great Renown
passages.text:
As you aid our sacred covenant across the Shadowlands, your connection to it shall grow ever stronger.

Your Renown will afford you many benefits over time.

Seek out Iona Skyblade at the front of the hold, near the Crest of Ascension. She will show you the glory of the path.

passages.title: Of Great Renown
passages.text: Greetings, Maw Walker. It is an honor.

passages.title: The Path Provides
passages.text:
All who follow the path are granted precious gifts by virtue of their connection with our covenant.

The strength of that bond, known as Renown, is reflected in the shining spires of Elysian Hold itself. Though you have yet to gain Renown, you will as you aid us across the Shadowlands.

When you are ready, I will show you all that the path can provide.

passages.title: The Path Provides
passages.text: Some say it is the Archon herself who grants our covenant its strength.

passages.title: The Path Provides
passages.text: Follow the path always, and all will be well.

passages.title: Our Most Precious Resource
passages.text:
You have fulfilled your calling, Maw Walker, and brought peace to our realm.

Stay vigilant, for others will similarly call upon you in time.

The anima you have so dutifully recovered will be of great use in the hold. Bring it to Haephus at once. He will ensure it is kept safe until it is needed.

Go in service.

passages.title: Our Most Precious Resource
passages.text: The Maw Walker returns triumphant! Have you any anima on hand?

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text:
As the flow of anima withered within Bastion, our mighty Archon entrusted me with guarding our stores until they are needed.

You may deposit any anima you recover into the reservoir here. By my life, and by the glory of the Archon, I will ensure they are kept safe.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: Anima is best kept here, safe from our enemies who would take it from us.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: Every drop is precious. I will keep it safe here.

passages.title: A Conduit for Good
passages.text:
While the gifts your bond shall bring you are substantial, you may also empower yourself further through the use of conduits.

Conduits act to channel the energy of your soulbind into your form more directly, increasing your potential in a myriad of ways.

Use the ones I have given you as a test of this power, but fear not--you will find others as you aid the Shadowlands.

passages.title: A Conduit for Good
passages.text: This is a crucial step in the path.

passages.title: A Conduit for Good
passages.text: Your soulbind will grow alongside you in time, but your training is complete for now.

passages.title: Return to Adrestes
passages.text:
Baine suffers within Torghast, but at least we know that he yet lives.

Rushing to his rescue would prove disastrous without a plan of attack. I will see to preparing one.

In the meantime, I suggest you bring the souls you rescued to Elysian Hold.

The kyrian are vital to the Shadowlands. If Bastion remains in turmoil, then all might soon be lost.

passages.title: Return to Adrestes
passages.text: Welcome back, Maw Walker. Our work has not paused in your absence.

passages.title: The Vessels of Metal
passages.text:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of smithing. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.

passages.title: The Vessels of Metal
passages.text:
<Au'berk inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft armors capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.

passages.title: The Vessels of Leather and Bone
passages.text:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of leatherworking. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.

passages.title: The Vessels of Leather and Bone
passages.text:
<Au'qil inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft armors capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.

passages.title: The Vessels of the Thread
passages.text:
You have the bearing of one familiar with the art of thread work. But perhaps you have more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.

passages.title: The Vessels of the Thread
passages.text:
<Au'phes inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft armors capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.

passages.title: The Vessels of Jewels
passages.text:
You have the bearing of a lapidary. Though familiar with the art of jewelcraft, perhaps there is yet more to learn.

Vessels that hold the power of the runes can be crafted by a hand such as yours. But this I cannot teach you.

Hmm, there is a way. I will entrust you with a memory of my recipes for the vessels. Take it to a master of your craft and they will show you the way.

What's that? Do not worry. It is merely an echo of my memory. What you restored to me remains intact.

passages.title: The Vessels of Jewels
passages.text:
<Au'vesk inspects what you brought to him.>

A memory? Fascinating... With this knowledge, I can teach you to craft jewelry capable of holding immense power. 

For a price, of course.

passages.title: The Call of Fate
passages.text:
I am the Arbiter's fatescribe. It is my duty to observe the strands of destiny that the Purpose lays before us.

Fate flows through you, mortal, as you journey through the Shadowlands. And now it offers you... a choice.

Return to Oribos, <name>, that I might help guide your path.

The Purpose is our way.

passages.title: The Call of Fate
passages.text:
Welcome, mortal.

Allow me to explain the choice that the Purpose has set before you.

passages.title: Filling the Tanks
passages.text:
<The containment pack appears to be intact, albeit empty. Perhaps refilling it with the appropriate mixture of liquids will render it functional once more.

Slaying the correct combination of slimes should provide all the fluid necessary.>

passages.title: Filling the Tanks
passages.text: An amazing find! You seem to have salvaged a fully charged unit... just throw this switch to activate it!

passages.title: Forest Refugees
passages.text:
Some of those displaced by the fallen groves have made a home for themselves at the base of the Heart of the Forest.

Hibernal Hollow is fortunate. We have supplies, when they may not.

If you would, bring these to Flwngyrr. They care for the refugees there.

passages.title: Forest Refugees
passages.text:
Many cries call in the night. Many creatures seek shelter.

This is a refreshing breeze.

passages.title: Friends in Dark Places
passages.text:
Even with all your aid, our sanctum will grow weaker without souls willing to help us.

Many souls that may have been destined for Bastion are trapped within the Maw. If you can find a way to free them, they will help us restore Elysian Hold's power.

Seek out what aid you can and do what we cannot, Maw Walker. Our very future may depend on it.

passages.title: Friends in Dark Places
passages.text: Back again so soon, Maw Walker?

passages.title: A Hero of Great Renown
passages.text:
As you gain renown across the Shadowlands, you will draw others to our cause. Some may provide resources; some may offer direct support.

Elspeth Larink will be responsible for putting their contributions to use. Speak with her to learn more.

passages.title: A Hero of Great Renown
passages.text: For the sake of the souls we defend, we must never falter.

passages.title: Glorious Ambition
passages.text:
The renown you earn through your deeds can and will greatly benefit our covenant. Our ambition is not confined within the borders of Maldraxxus, after all.

Allow me to demonstrate what we achieve as you gain renown.

passages.title: Glorious Ambition
passages.text: Talent is nothing without ambition.

passages.title: Glorious Ambition
passages.text: Surrender is the ultimate failure.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text:
We may hold the Seat of the Primus, but it will do us no good without the anima to power it.

As you fight beside our troops on the battlefield, seek out opportunities to recover anima to support the war effort.

Speak with Sergeant Romark. He can offer you additional guidance.

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text: There is much to be done, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Hopeful News
passages.text:
The terms of our bargain have been met. You may depart with the souls you acquired.

Perhaps the fate of this "Baine" is of interest to you or your allies. I suggest you return to Oribos and consult them.

No need to rush. After all, those held within Torghast are tortured for centuries.

Kindly remember not to tell anyone about our arrangement. Discretion is key between business partners, after all.

passages.title: Hopeful News
passages.text: <name>! The darkness of the Maw lingers upon you. What news do you bring?

passages.title: Anima is Strength
passages.text:
You are victorious, Maw Walker. And with your success, our forces grow stronger.

Stay alert. Your strength will be called upon again soon enough.

Bring the anima you recovered to Akradia Moa at once. She will ensure its proper storage.

passages.title: Anima is Strength
passages.text: You walk with the stride of victory, Maw Walker. Do you bring anima?

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text:
With anima in short supply, Baroness Draka has tasked me with carefully managing our reserves as they are needed.

You may deposit any anima you recover into the reservoir here. Be assured that the Necrolords will defend it at all costs.

passages.title: The Soul Contact
passages.text:
Your reputation precedes you, Maw Walker... braving the Maw and bringing Baron Mograine back in one piece...

That was most impressive!

With our dire shortage of souls, we'll need you to do that again. Bring us more willing souls so we can restore this sanctum's power!

Seek out the broker who aided you before and ask if she will do so again. You may need her.

passages.title: The Soul Contact
passages.text: Back again so soon, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Sanctum Improvements
passages.text:
Your will to succeed is strong, Maw Walker. With the anima and the souls you have recovered, we can now begin to unlock our sanctum's true potential.

As we acquire more souls and more anima, we can gain even greater power from the Seat of the Primus. Remain relentless in your pursuit, and victory will be ours.

passages.title: Sanctum Improvements
passages.text: This is only the beginning.

passages.title: Sanctum Improvements
passages.text: When it comes to matters like these, patience is as important as strength. In time, our power will grow vast and unmatched.

passages.title: Conduits, What Are They For?
passages.text:
While the benefits of soulbinding are substantial, you may strengthen them further through the use of conduits.

Conduits act to channel the anima of our bond in a myriad of ways, vastly increasing both of our potential.

Let us test out the ones I have given you. Fear not--many others like it can be found throughout the Shadowlands.

passages.title: Conduits, What Are They For?
passages.text: This is an important lesson, my apprentice.

passages.title: Conduits, What Are They For?
passages.text: Our bond will grow in strength over time, but for now your training is complete.

passages.title: Paragon of the Court of Harvesters
passages.text:
Maw Walker. 

Your efforts have provided the Court of Harvesters a decisive edge in their ongoing conflict with the zealots and sycophants who cling to the lost cause of Sire Denathrius.

If you will join me in Darkhaven we can express our gratitude to you in a more... physical... way. 

With treasure, of course.

passages.title: Paragon of the Court of Harvesters
passages.text: Consider this the first of many rewards that we might provide for your continued efforts. Your continued efforts towards the agenda of the Court of Harvesters ensures the long term success of Revendreth, and the opportunity for additional rewards for you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Ascended
passages.text:
Maw Walker. 

Your efforts have provided the Ascended with a decisive edge in their goals.

We have rewards for you, and thanks.

passages.title: Paragon of the Ascended
passages.text: Continue to achieve the goals of the Ascended and we shall have treasures for you as a reward.

passages.title: Paragon of the Undying Army
passages.text:
Your continued advancement of the Undying Army objectives has earned you the continued respect of our forces. 

I have been authorized to provide you with a portion of recent spoils of war in gratitude. Please join me at the Seat of the Primus to collect these spoils at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Paragon of the Undying Army
passages.text: The Undying Army salutes you and proffers this flotsam of war in honor of your continued assistance. Aid us further, and more will come.

passages.title: Paragon of the Wild Hunt
passages.text:
Well met, <name>!

You have proven yourself to all of Ardenweald. We would grant you further rewards, for your valor and cunning on our behalf.

Meet with me at the Heart of the Forest.

passages.title: Paragon of the Wild Hunt
passages.text: Continue your efforts on our behalf and we will bestow more gifts on you. I look forward to seeing what you do!

passages.title: Edict of the Eternal Ones
passages.text:
Death appears to function differently for you, Maw Walker. Alas, you have shed some of your stygia.

Return to the place of your passing, and you shall find what you left behind.

passages.title: Building Your Renown
passages.text:
As you aid the court in your travels across the Shadowlands, your connection to us shall grow ever stronger.

In time, you will be able to reap the benefits of your growing Renown.

One of my most trusted and loyal followers, Rahel, has been watching you for some time. She can report as to your standing and the Renown you have garnered with my people.

Speak to her and she might explain better how this Renown might be best put to work.

passages.title: Building Your Renown
passages.text: Work with me and your legend will haunt the waking dreams of every venthyr in Revendreth.

passages.title: The Court's Bounty
passages.text:
Venthyr are drawn to new things, so we are going to make you the figurehead of our Sanctum. 

As your Renown throughout the Shadowlands grows, we will grow with you, accumulating power and influence we otherwise would not have access to. 

It will fall to me to track your Renown and quantify it as a resource. A true currency of Courts, if you will. 

Observe.

passages.title: The Court's Bounty
passages.text: With enough anima, anything is possible.

passages.title: The Court's Bounty
passages.text: As you can see, some have already begun to take notice of you.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. As long as this is still happening, we need to save as many as possible!

The Jailer twists the cycle of life and rebirth. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Oh, wonderful news!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. As long as this is still happening, we need to save as many as possible!

The Jailer twists the cycle of life and rebirth. This cannot be allowed to continue! We must thwart his plans.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Oh, wonderful news!

I will make sure these souls are well taken care of here in Ardenweald.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, circumventing the natural order of the Shadowlands.

The Jailer denies these souls their rightful eternities. Only you, Maw Walker, can set things right.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Well done. They have been spared a truly cruel existence.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, circumventing the natural order of the Shadowlands.

The Jailer denies these souls their rightful eternities. Only you, Maw Walker, can set things right.

Return to the Maw and save all that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Well done. They have been spared a truly cruel existence.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I'm sure you've seen firsthand the souls that continue to pour into the Maw. 

We must act now to cut off the Jailer's power, denying him as many souls as possible. That power belongs to the Necrolords.

I shall direct your efforts to save these souls, and help find them a place among the armies of Maldraxxus.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Excellent Maw Walker. Our armies here will grow stronger with each soul you return.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Maw Walker, I'm sure you've seen first hand the souls that continue to pour into the Maw. 

We must act now to cut off the Jailer's power, denying him as many souls as possible. That power belongs to the Necrolords.

I shall direct your efforts to save these souls, and help find them a place among the armies of Maldraxxus.

Return to the Maw and rescue those that you can.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text: Excellent Maw Walker. Our armies here will grow stronger with each soul you return.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

Their anima, our very lifeblood of the Shadowlands, is going with those souls to fuel the Jailer. You rescued me from the Maw. I see no reason you cannot pull more souls from that abyss. 

Bring souls you rescue from the Maw to me and I shall see them put to better use. At least in Revendreth they have a chance of redemption.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
A very good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

Never fear, their fate is better in our hands than the Jailer's.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw. 

Their anima, our very lifeblood of the Shadowlands, is going with those souls to fuel the Jailer. You rescued me from the Maw. I see no reason you cannot pull more souls from that abyss. 

Bring souls you rescue from the Maw to me and I shall see them put to better use. At least in Revendreth they have a chance of redemption.

passages.title: Return Lost Souls
passages.text:
A very good collection of souls. Not too broken, not too drained, and not too innocent.

Never fear, their fate is better in our hands than the Jailer's.

passages.title: Setting the Ground Rules
passages.text:
Back to rescue more souls? How intrepid.

Though I must say, your earlier escapade has drawn the Jailer's attention... and his ire. After all, none have successfully eluded him before. 

Except for me.

Now his forces are on high alert, hunting down any errant souls that the fabled Maw Walker may try to steal from him.

It has made things quite... inconvenient for me. If you and I are going to work together, we need to set a few ground rules.

And you must be properly equipped.

passages.title: Setting the Ground Rules
passages.text: Let us discuss the terms of our arrangement.

passages.title: Setting the Ground Rules
passages.text:
Take care of that Soulkeeper. I have no desire to go through the effort of procuring another.

Now, let us get to business.

passages.title: Keeper of Great Renown
passages.text:
As you grow in renown across the Shadowlands, the Heart of the Forest shall grow with you. 

Seek out Laurel, our Keeper of Renown. She will acquaint you with the magic that we bestow upon our huntsmen and huntresses.

passages.title: Keeper of Great Renown
passages.text:
<Laurel strums a little fanfare on her harp as you approach.>

Ah, our new champion and boon companion! Well met, <name>.

passages.title: The Forest Will Sing Your Name
passages.text:
<Laurel picks out an intricate melody on deft fingers, and sings.>

The keeper of word and deed, am I, 
the weaver of song and lore.
Boons are granted as you grow in Renown,
fulfilling the oaths we swore.

Each deed that you do is a seed of strength,
which will blossom in fabulous power.
Speak with me now and see what awaits,
our magic is yours to discover!

passages.title: The Forest Will Sing Your Name
passages.text: I cannot wait to compose a song for you!

passages.title: The Forest Will Sing Your Name
passages.text:
<Laurel plays a triumphant flourish.>

May your story grow as branches reaching for the skies! As our roots grow deep into the earth!

passages.title: A Call to Service
passages.text:
The Heart of the Forest requires anima to be renewed and to grow.

The Wild Hunt will need your help to recover what we need. Together we strand strong.

Speak with Blodwyn. She has been guiding assistance to where it is most needed.

passages.title: Who Shapes the Forest
passages.text:
You have fulfilled your calling, Maw Walker, and brought calm to our forest.

Stay vigilant, for others will similarly call upon you in time.

The anima you have recovered will be of great use to the Heart of the Forest. Bring it to Zayhad. They will ensure it is safe until it is needed. You will find them deep in the roots of the Heart of the Forest.

passages.title: Who Shapes the Forest
passages.text: The roots wilt without anima. With your gift, we may all grow.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text:
Groves wither, and our Queen weeps on barren soil. Anima, precious as water, now rare as snow. Our Queen gives of her own, shelters all beneath her boughs... but one tree does not a forest make.

Your gift will be treasured and protected. Anima nourishes our roots, as hope nourishes our hearts. Ardenweald may yet flourish once more.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: None to waste, and none shall be wasted. It will be safe until needed.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: Through famine and drought, the forest shall endure. Our gratitude defies description.

passages.title: Recover the Lost
passages.text:
Anima and souls. Wind and rain. Ardenweald needs both to thrive.

Souls meant for our boughs suffer in darkness. None escape the Maw... but you walk its shadows and return. You are their salvation.

Flutterby shepherds the flock with care and compassion. Speak with her. Bring our lost souls home.

passages.title: Recover the Lost
passages.text: I'm so glad you're here! We have so many souls to save!

passages.title: Do What We Cannot
passages.text:
Rumor has it that you've been to the Maw and back... and that you even made friends with a broker in there! 

So many souls destined for Ardenweald are trapped in that dark realm. They need our help... and we need theirs! We can't cultivate the Heart of the Forest's magic without them.

I know this is a lot to ask... but you may be our only hope of rescuing them. Please, venture into the Maw and do what we cannot. Ardenweald's future depends on it!

passages.title: Do What We Cannot
passages.text: Back again so soon, Maw Walker?

passages.title: Flutterback
passages.text:
Baine suffers within Torghast, but at least we know that he yet lives.

Rushing to his rescue would prove disastrous without a plan of attack. I will see to preparing one.

In the meantime, I suggest you bring the souls you rescued back to Ardenweald.

They deserve respite after their harrowing ordeal in the Maw, and they will surely prove vital to the Night Fae's efforts.

passages.title: Flutterback
passages.text:
Welcome back! I am so glad you didn't get trapped in there! It means none of our hard work will go to waste!

<Flutterby giggles.>

We've been busy!

passages.title: Recovered Souls
passages.text:
Oh, I wonder what sorts of shapes these souls might take!

Words can't express how grateful we are that you saved them. Not only have you brought an end to their torment, but they might be willing to aid us as well. 

Go speak with Zayhad. They haven't been able to tend the forest in a long while, but that might be about to change. This is all so exciting!

passages.title: Recovered Souls
passages.text: Leaves on the tempestuous wind find safe haven.

passages.title: The First New Growth
passages.text:
Long have we lain dormant. With souls, with anima, we grow once more. 

A choice now awaits. How shall we grow? You may decide which flower blooms first.

In time, with more anima and willing souls, the whole garden will prosper. For now, a single blossom signals hope for the future.

Lady Moonberry will want to know of your choice. Seek her out once it is made.

passages.title: The First New Growth
passages.text:
Well, you've been busy! I believe we are once again in your debt.

Thankfully, I think I have just the gift to give you in return.

passages.title: The Endless Forest
passages.text:
Well, that's all I have for you! Whew! You've been on a whirlwind tour of things around here, haven't you? Up and down and slantways and even into the Maw! Your head must be practically spinning.

<Flutterby giggles.>

You should check in with Lady Moonberry and let her know your training is complete!

She probably won't quiz you on what you've learned.

Probably.

passages.title: The Endless Forest
passages.text:
Welcome to the Court of Night, <name>. I just know we're going to save Ardenweald! Oh, and the rest of the Shadowlands, too!

And if we can't, and the forest withers away, and the Jailer breaks free from the Maw and plunges all of the realms eternal into crushing despair from which there is no return... 

Then at least we can say we had fun trying!

passages.title: A Conduit for Growth
passages.text:
While our bond is powerful in and of itself, you can also enhance it through the use of conduits.

Conduits channel the anima between soulbinds in many different ways, increasing both of our potential in the process. They allow us to attune ourselves to each other's unique strengths.

Let's use a few now. If they can further empower our bond, then they can aid us in protecting the forest.

passages.title: A Conduit for Growth
passages.text: We're going to do great things together.

passages.title: A Conduit for Growth
passages.text: You and Niya will grow together in time. But for now, your training is complete.

passages.title: Anima is Power
passages.text:
You did well, boss. Keep it up like that, right, and we just might 'ave a chance of survivin' this mess.

Keep your eyes open, though. Word of success like this gets 'round and it's only a matter of time till uvvers come callin' for your 'elp.

Now, right, all that anima you've recovered can be put to use 'round 'ere. Bring it down to Foreman Flatfinger. He'll ensure it stored away nice and secure.

passages.title: Anima is Power
passages.text: Boss returns the victor! You got any anima on 'and?

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text:
With anima in short supply these days, I've been entrusted to manage the reserves 'till they be needed.

Go 'ead and deposit any anima you collect into the reservoir 'ere. 
Be assured, It'll be safe an' secure in me care.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: I assure you, this here reservoir is the safest place to keep Anima in all of Revendreth.

passages.title: Into the Reservoir
passages.text: There we go, the anima is safe and secure now.

passages.title: The Souls Plight
passages.text:
Anima enables us to do many fings, but this sanctum can not function on anima alone. It'll require the combined effort of many souls workin' togeffer to unlock its full potential.

The Soul Warden is eager to be of service ever since you rescued 'im from the Maw. Your unique ability 'ta brin' souls from there will prove useful to him.

Why don't you go pay 'im a visit?

passages.title: The Souls Plight
passages.text: I'm pleased to speak with you once again, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Back into the Darkness
passages.text:
Souls continue to pour into the Maw, and with them the anima that could help us.

You were able to rescue me from that place. Can I count on your strength to repeat the same trick?
Please, get us more willing souls so we can bolster this sanctum's power.

Seek out what aid you can and do what we can't, Maw Walker. You are our last, best, hope.

passages.title: Back into the Darkness
passages.text: Back again so soon, Maw Walker?

passages.title: A Coalition of the Willing
passages.text:
The good people of Revendreth continue to suffer under the oppression of Denathrius's loyalists. We must bolster our forces before we can move openly against our former Master.

The willing souls you recovered from the Maw will prove a boon in these trying times.

Go to Foreman Flatfinger. He has been searching for assistance with building enhancements for our sanctum. Together, we will see Sinfall reach its full potential.

passages.title: A Coalition of the Willing
passages.text:
Oi! Wut's 'at, then? New souls, is it? 

Right, they 'ave a bit of potential, they do. Many fings I can do 'round 'ere wif their 'elp.

passages.title: Home Improvement
passages.text:
I've been finkin' of a bit of ways we could improve the place, but since you brought in all of the anima and souls to do it, I fink you should be the one to decide which improvement we start on first.

Don't get overwhelmed. As you bring in more anima and find more willin' souls, we'll be able to bring more capabilities to the place. For now, a single upgrade will fit the bill.

passages.title: Home Improvement
passages.text: Take your time. The first step's always the hard one.

passages.title: Home Improvement
passages.text:
Good choice. 

It'll take some time for the construction work to finish, but good fings take time don't they?

passages.title: Your Next Best Friend
passages.text:
You looking for a new friend? Hoo-hoo!

Lots of stewards who are happy to be friend. Plus, current friend can take break! Maybe go to Cliffs of Respite, rest feet, eat cake...

<Sika gets lost in a daydream.>

Hoo! Right!

I call stewards. You make new friend!

passages.title: Your Next Best Friend
passages.text: New friends, new friends! Stewards love making new friends!

passages.title: Your Next Best Friend
passages.text: Hoo-hoo! Have fun with new friend!

passages.title: Shared Souls
passages.text:
The power of the Harvesters flows through your mortal body. But you may wield even greater might by binding your soul to another.

Doing so has no known drawbacks, but offers many advantages for both parties involved. 

The Accuser will oversee the process. Meet her at the Forge of Bonds when you are ready.

passages.title: Binding Power
passages.text:
The power of the Harvesters flows through your mortal body. But you may wield even greater might by binding your soul to another. 

To soulbind with another is not an irrevocable bond. However, it is not to be entered into lightly.
You will experience one another's pasts. Your hopes, fears, dreams, your very memories--if any still linger. You will become kindred spirits in the truest sense.

Once complete, your connection will transcend physical space and make you stronger in more than mere brawn.

passages.title: Binding Power
passages.text: You have lived an... interesting life, thus far. I will endeavor to make it even more so.

passages.title: A Conduit For Change
passages.text:
While the powers from your bond are substantial, you may also strengthen the bond further through the use of conduits.

Conduits act to channel the energy of your soulbind into your form more directly, increasing your potential in many ways.

Use the ones I have given you as a test of this power, but fear not--you will find others in your travels.

passages.title: A Conduit For Change
passages.text: This step is crucial for your advancement.

passages.title: A Conduit For Change
passages.text: Your soulbind will strengthen over time, but for now your training is complete.

passages.title: Blueprint: Ring of Warding
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a defensive ward that may give your soulbinds an edge in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Ring of Warding
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Remnants of Hope
passages.text:
I studied the key you brought back from Torghast, <name>.

It confirms that Jaina Proudmoore is still being held somewhere in the tower. However we do not know precisely where.

Countless souls are captive inside that wretched place. A few may be intact, but many are shattered and broken.

Take pity upon the remnants and free those you can. Perhaps they will be able to aid our search.

passages.title: Remnants of Hope
passages.text:
It is good that you saved those tortured souls, <name>. A pity none could help our cause. 

I must ponder our path forward. You will hear from me again when I know how to best proceed.

passages.title: Information for a Price
passages.text:
We must continue our search for Jaina Proudmoore. I have a new strategy to suggest.

Since arriving in Oribos, I have been approached by many of the brokers. Some ask questions, others offer help--for a price.

You have encountered others of their kind inside Torghast. They may possess information we can use, though I doubt they will part with it freely.

Seek them out and appeal to their avarice. Offer to pay for whatever information they possess.

passages.title: Information for a Price
passages.text: A promising lead.

passages.title: Information for a Price
passages.text:
It seems the greed of the brokers has proved useful.

You may have acquired exactly what we need.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Kleia
passages.text:
Artemede has been personally training Kleia, running her through combat meditations and drills.

She has come far, and she is prepared to take on another trial in the Path of Ascension.

Return to the coliseum and guide her as her tactician so that she may reach victory.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Kleia
passages.text: As we expected. Kleia's strength continues to grow.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Pelagos
passages.text:
Though combat is not his strong suit, Pelagos has been reading, meditating, and training to better himself on the Path.

We believe he is ready to seek victory.

He requests you by his side to help him strategize. He is stronger with the help of his friends.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Pelagos
passages.text:
One day, Pelagos will need to face challenges on his own to grow.

For now, the comfort and support of his soulbinds is exactly what he needs.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Mikanikos
passages.text:
Mikanikos has been hard at work at the Eternal Forge, calibrating Bron and tuning his combat procedures.

He is confident in his recent changes, and requests permission to attempt another trial.

Enter the Path with Mikanikos so that he may assess his goliath's strengths and weaknesses.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Mikanikos
passages.text:
It seems Bron has grown stronger indeed!

I look forward to seeing how Mikanikos uses this new knowledge to improve centurions as a whole.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Kalisthene
passages.text:
Your soulbinds request your strategic mind in another trial.

Their sights this week are set on Kalisthene, that they may learn from the lessons her memory teaches.

When you are able, report to Artemede to return to the Path of Ascension. Aid your soulbinds in defeating Kalisthene to prove their growth.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Kalisthene
passages.text: Congratulations on the victory. I look forward to hearing what your soulbinds have learned.

passages.title: Prison of the Forgotten
passages.text:
I discovered an interesting item off the Warden you killed in the tower. 

Best not to ask how I know what you do and where you do it within the tower. Let's just say, I have my ways.

But this key could lead to something interesting within Torghast. Or something horrible. Most likely horrible.

You ought to explore a bit and see what it unlocks.

passages.title: Prison of the Forgotten
passages.text: <As you place the key into the device, it shudders for a moment and begins to unlock.>

passages.title: Lest the Trail Go Cold
passages.text:
From what the captive dredger told you, it seems Thrall has been taken deep into Torghast. The torments he is enduring must be unimaginable.

We need to learn where he is being held before the trail goes cold.

The tower is vast and perilous. Search where you are able. Bring back any clues you find.

Go carefully, <name>. The Jailer's eye is upon you.

passages.title: Lest the Trail Go Cold
passages.text: Have you found anything to help us locate Thrall?

passages.title: Lest the Trail Go Cold
passages.text:
<Bolvar studies the totem.>

Yes, this could point us to Thrall's location.

passages.title: Blueprint: Steward Mail Pouch
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a steward sized pouch, perfect for carrying mail.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Steward Mail Pouch
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Blueprint: Gilded Abacus
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a steward sized abacus, capable of calculating deposits and withdrawals at any distance.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Gilded Abacus
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Artisan Tool Belt
passages.text:
<The tool belt has many pouches and loops, and is outfitted with many tools and materials. 

It will allow your steward to not only assist you with crafting, but also carry common trade goods.>

passages.title: Artisan Tool Belt
passages.text:
Tools for me? Wow! Love making things.

Look forward to working together more!

passages.title: Blueprint: Artisan Tool Belt
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a well made tool belt, a perfect gift for your favorite steward.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Artisan Tool Belt
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Blueprint: Medallion of Service
passages.text:
<You have discovered a donation plan to earn Medallions of Service, the respected Kyrian symbol of commendation. By donating materials to your sanctum, you can receive Medallions to enter the Path.

Dactylis should be able to help you facilitate this.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Medallion of Service
passages.text: I see you found the donation ratios for Medallions of Service. I look forward to rewarding you upon your contribution of materials.

passages.title: Dredging up a New Look
passages.text: If ye look around the muck pool I am sure you will find an armor dye. It might be nice to have the option to dye me belt a different color.

passages.title: Dredging up a New Look
passages.text: Did you find one?

passages.title: Dredging up a New Look
passages.text: We dredgers are an adaptable lot. If you find other dyes we will have options to dye my belt or even a doublet if you find one. Also, we be good at follicle control, so if you find any fetching posters of good lookin' folk give it to me and I will learn how to grow mine to match.

passages.title: Blueprint: Vesper of Calling
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a single use chime, capable of summoning courier Hermestes anywhere in the Shadowlands.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this chime.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Vesper of Calling
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Spiritforged Aegis
passages.text:
<As you pick up the shield, your hands seem to lightly bounce off of it with ease.

This should help your soulbinds take a few hits in the Path of Ascension.>

passages.title: Spiritforged Aegis
passages.text: Shield? Yes! Nice! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: Vial of Lichfrost
passages.text:
<The vial, filled with a frosty liquid, is chill to the touch.

This should hinder your soulbinds' opponents in the Path of Ascension.>

passages.title: Vial of Lichfrost
passages.text: Strange liquid... Wow! Cold! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: Blueprint: Vial of Lichfrost
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a concoction that may freeze opponents in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this piece of equipment.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Vial of Lichfrost
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Ring of Warding
passages.text:
<You place down the ring and are knocked back by a protective bubble.

This should force your soulbinds' opponents away from an area in the Path of Ascension.

passages.title: Ring of Warding
passages.text: Ring? Wow! Very nice! I hold on for safe keeping.

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Focus
passages.text:
<You have discovered plans for a charm that seems to energize your soulbinds in the Path of Ascension.

Dactylis should be able to help you with crafting this charm.>

passages.title: Blueprint: Charm of Focus
passages.text: I see you have retrieved a new blueprint. I look forward to assisting you in your crafting.

passages.title: Dangerous to Go Alone
passages.text:
I trust you know well all that Elysian Hold can provide, but that alone will not be enough to thwart Denathrius.

You must have a soulbind to aid you, Maw Walker.

Seek out Soulguide Daelia in the chamber below. She has prepared for the ritual.

passages.title: Dangerous to Go Alone
passages.text: I see even now that your soul burns brighter than most.

passages.title: Collective Soul
passages.text:
You know conflict as well as any soldier in Maldraxxus, Maw Walker. But we do not fight alone.

There is great wisdom in leaning on the strengths of your allies. That is the Maldraxxi way.

Speak to Plague Deviser Marileth. He will show you how to soulbind and best reap its benefits.

passages.title: Collective Soul
passages.text: I'm so pleased to see you again, my apprentice!

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text:
You have already done so much to help us since you first step foot in our realm! I'm so glad you decided to join our covenant.

There will be plenty of time for reminiscing later, though. You have an audience with the Winter Queen herself to go to!

Let's not keep her waiting!

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text: Welcome to the Hunt.

passages.title: For Queen and Grove!
passages.text: Your actions here will echo beyond the veil. Aid the forest, and all mortal worlds may yet be saved.

passages.title: The Forge of Bonds
passages.text:
To best serve the court and the forest, you must bond with another fae.

It is an ancient ritual, one which will grant you great strength to face the many trials ahead.

Flutterby below will guide you further.

passages.title: The Forge of Bonds
passages.text: Oh, wow! I love guiding soulbinding! It's my favorite duty!

passages.title: Rule 6 Addendum: Save Me At Any Cost
passages.text:
You! You, there! Wait!

You are the infamous Maw Walker, yes? I have heard much about you.

Please, help me! My compatriots have been drained of their essence. The Mawsworn are using it to fashion their foul runes.

One of them bound me here, and I am sure to be next on his list. You must slay him in order to free me!

I can make it worth your while. I have collected a fair amount of stygia during my time in the Maw. It is yours, all of it, if you save me!

passages.title: Rule 6 Addendum: Save Me At Any Cost
passages.text: There is no time to waste. Hurry, before the Mawsworn return!

passages.title: Rule 6 Addendum: Save Me At Any Cost
passages.text:
Not a moment too soon! Those fiends were just about to put the sword to me. 

Here, as we agreed, is your payment in stygia. 

Though truth be told, I owe you a great deal more than this. I have nothing left to offer... except for wisdom and warnings.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text:
We have received word from Highlord Fordragon urging you to return to him in Oribos at once.

All I know is it pertains to the Maw.

You should go to him with haste. Anything involving that dark place must be our top priority.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text: I have dire news, <name>.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text:
Highlord Fordragon needs you in Oribos right away!

I'm not sure of the details, but the messenger mentioned the Maw.

You should go to him as soon as you can. If the Maw is involved, it must be serious!

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text: I have dire news, <name>.

passages.title: Acquisition: Crystallized Stygia
passages.text:
<This shard of crystal appears to have broken off of one of the massive crystalline structures throughout the area. It thrums with untapped energy.

Ve'nari would likely be interested in any of these shards you come across.>

passages.title: Acquisition: Crystallized Stygia
passages.text: What have you collected, <class>?

passages.title: Acquisition: Crystallized Stygia
passages.text:
Ah yes, the dormant stygia throughout the Maw will sometimes coalesce into forms such as this.

You were wise to bring this to me, <class>.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text:
Highlord Fordragon has requested your presence in Oribos.

We know only that it involves the Maw.

Go to him, and show him that the Maldraxxi will never falter. Even in the face of that dark place.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text: I have dire news, <name>.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text:
A messenger from Oribos has informed us that Highlord Fordragon has requested your presence in Oribos.

It seems it pertains to the Maw... and the Master's plans, no doubt.

I suggest you heed his summons, Maw Walker. We must leave nothing to chance.

passages.title: The Highlord Calls
passages.text: I have dire news, <name>.

passages.title: The Elysian Fields
passages.text:
You must travel to Bastion, eternal home of the winged kyrian.

Do not be fooled by their golden fields and shining spires--the kyrian have been weakened by the great anima drought, and face the brink of civil war against their own fallen brethren.

They will benefit greatly from your aid. Seek one known as Kalisthene in your new sanctum, Elysian Hold. She will direct you further.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: The Elysian Fields
passages.text: Why have you come to our realm, mortal?

passages.title: A Fresh Blade
passages.text:
Though they were once unified in defending the Shadowlands, the houses of Maldraxxus have turned against each other.

Their armies clash within their realm and have even orchestrated an assault on Bastion. Now only the Necrolords remain loyal to the Primus.

Speak to Secutor Mevix at the Seat of the Primus in Maldraxxus. His tactical skills will ensure you are sent where you are most needed.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide you with transportation.

passages.title: A Fresh Blade
passages.text: Ah, another blade on our side! And you aren't even dead yet!

passages.title: Restoring Balance
passages.text:
Ardenweald is crucial to the cycle of rebirth for nature spirits that enter their realm.

Unfortunately, the anima drought has led to the loss of entire groves--souls that will never complete their cycle.

Now foes seek to destroy what remains of the once tranquil forests, threatening the already beleaguered Court of Night. 

Lady Moonberry of the Court has requested aid. Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: Restoring Balance
passages.text: Welcome! What brings you to the Heart of the Forest?

passages.title: Dark Aspirations
passages.text:
Prince Renathal has started a daring rebellion against his father, the nefarious Sire Denathrius who betrayed us all by pouring Revendreth's vast anima stores into the Maw.

You must travel to Revendreth and aid Renathal in his efforts. He is our best hope at restoring Revendreth to order.

Pathscribe Roh-Avonavi in the Ring of Transference above can provide transport.

passages.title: Dark Aspirations
passages.text: And to what do I owe the pleasure of a mortal visiting Revendreth at such an...inopportune time?

passages.title: Sundered Souls
passages.text:
The traps... they didn't affect us before. Too many souls... escaping. 

They... made new traps... tear apart fleeing souls...

...too late for me. Destroy... so others might escape!

passages.title: Sundered Souls
passages.text:
<With the rending traps disabled, the souls here should stand a better chance of escaping their captors.

Though they may never escape the Maw, at least they have a chance of escaping the grim fate of becoming a mindless shade.>

passages.title: The End and the Beginning
passages.text:
I am so happy you restored our connection to the Queen's Conservatory!

In light of this accomplishment, the Winter Queen has requested you attend her at the Grove of Awakening! 

You will see first hand the purpose of Ardenweald and gain a greater understanding of our sacred charge before you too, take it upon yourself.

Hurry! Don't keep everyone waiting!

passages.title: The End and the Beginning
passages.text: Welcome. Together we shall thrive!

passages.title: Acquisition: Runeforged Shackles
passages.text:
<The chains here are carved with domination runes, imbuing them with the magic needed to subdue the most powerful of the Mawsworn's prisoners.

No doubt Ve'nari could find some use in studying these runes.>

passages.title: Acquisition: Runeforged Shackles
passages.text: Another transaction?

passages.title: Acquisition: Runeforged Shackles
passages.text:
Chains? Not exactly hard to find around here... wait, those runes...

You have a keen eye, indeed. The magic here is worth further study.

passages.title: Acquisition: Blazing Ingots
passages.text:
<The runesmiths have imbued this ingot with an enchantment that causes it to burn with inextinguishable flames. 

It is likely that this metal is used to empower the Mawsworn protectors of Zovaal's Cauldron. 

Bringing some samples of this ore to Ve'nari could aid her attempts at unlocking the Jailer's secrets.>

passages.title: Acquisition: Blazing Ingots
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: Acquisition: Blazing Ingots
passages.text:
Intriguing. I had often wondered what differentiated the Cauldron's protectors from the rest of the Mawsworn.

I hope these weren't too difficult for you to procure.

passages.title: Trust Issues
passages.text:
Ah, Maw Walker! Allow me to introduce myself. I am Ve'rayn. I deal with assets and liabilities for Cartel Ve.

I have heard that you are able to freely travel between Oribos and the Maw, a place of great interest to my cartel.

Would you mind if I ask you a few questions about it?

You will, of course, be properly compensated for your time and information. They are the most valuable of commodities, after all.

passages.title: Trust Issues
passages.text:
Cartel Ve was asking you questions about me?

I'm flattered. Make sure you never tell them anything.

Ever.

Come. There's work to do.

passages.title: Step of Faith
passages.text:
Our ascended fly across Bastion with ease, ensuring safety and prosperity across the realm.

Long ago we established a network of anima gateways to help our aspirants, goliaths, and stewards traverse our realm more quickly.

Go forth and activate the network once more, so that you too may be wherever you are needed in the mere blink of an eye.

passages.title: Step of Faith
passages.text: It has been many eons since the anima gateways were active.

passages.title: Strength in Numbers
passages.text:
Every soul in Maldraxxus has the potential for greatness, and we will need all we can muster if we hope to restore order to the Shadowlands.

With this addition to the sanctum, we can mobilize our forces and give them the chance to prove themselves on the field of battle.

Seek out Merick Feldscar. He will see to the deployment of our soldiers.

passages.title: Strength in Numbers
passages.text: Well met, <name>. Together, we will see our soldiers rule the battlefield.

passages.title: Powering the Portals
passages.text:
The Primus once maintained a network of portals that linked the necropoli of Maldraxxus directly to the Seat of the Primus. The lack of anima and recent destruction of many of the necropoli have rendered those connections inactive.

With the anima you have provided us, we have managed to reconnect one of those portals. You shall once more be able to travel to one of our great necropoli... assuming it still exists.

passages.title: Powering the Portals
passages.text: It has been many eons since these portals have been active. It's most exciting!

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Mirror Network
passages.text:
Right. So, we got a Scroll of Dark Empowerment ready for youz that should manifest 'em mirror frames for you. Pre'y standard work.

Thing is, after you going to need a proper mirror maker to get 'em up an' workin'. 

Prince Renathal might know a fang with the right skills. Best speak with him.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Mirror Network
passages.text: Enough anima in the right hands and we can construct whatever is needed in Revendreth.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Mirror Network
passages.text:
A network of mirrors to translocate throughout the realm will prove invaluable.

Rumor suggests of the former mirror maker of the Master was lost in the Ember Ward rather recently. 

You have proven to have a talent for convincing people to join our side.

passages.title: Restoring Power
passages.text:
Anima is power, <name>! 

When it was plentiful, the Primus ensured that his soldiers received all of the anima they required.

Now, in the midst of this drought, the Maldraxxi fight amongst themselves for any anima they can find. 

As our stockpile of anima grows, we can distribute it throughout Maldraxxus. It falls to us Necrolords to carry out the Primus's duty in his absence. 

Speak to Yondare Hex. She will show you how to do so.

passages.title: Restoring Power
passages.text: Yes, yes, you! You can help!

passages.title: Restoring Power
passages.text: Long have I waited to weave anima across Maldraxxus once more.

passages.title: Abominable Stitching and Me
passages.text:
Constructs have formed the backbone of Maldraxxi armies in more wars than anyone can count. A well-constructed body can turn any soul into a potent frontline weapon.

There is an old abominable stitching table outside of the sanctum that could be used to build our own constructs. With the anima you've secured for our covenant, we should be able to restore it.

Report to Miggsie once the work has begun. You can find her at Butchers Block.

passages.title: Abominable Stitching and Me
passages.text: You made the right choice.

passages.title: Abominable Stitching and Me
passages.text: You fixed the stitching table? That's great! Soon we'll be able to build our own constructs!

passages.title: Blink of an Eye
passages.text:
This was once a long tauralus ride, but not anymore!

By simply stepping through this portal, you can now journey to the House of Eyes in an instant.

The House of Eyes may not be what it once was, but valuable allies can still be found in the ruins of their once great necropolis.

Travel there now to test the portal's functionality.

passages.title: Blink of an Eye
passages.text: It worked! That was most unexpected.

passages.title: Blink of an Eye
passages.text: With more work, we can establish portals to other necropoli around the Shadowlands.

passages.title: Rule 6 Footnote: Don't Forget Anything
passages.text:
In the Maw, you must never forget to take everything with you.

Many things crawl within the Beastwarrens. The runes you brought back indicate that something of interest may have been left behind by the brokers who were taken there.

See if you can find it.

passages.title: Rule 6 Footnote: Don't Forget Anything
passages.text:
You're back! Thank goodness... I thought my one chance at salvation had slipped away!

You will save me, yes?

passages.title: Helping Hand
passages.text:
We may have the stitching table, but it won't do us any good without someone to use it... someone like Rathan!

I've heard that he's already gone to speak with the Necrolords. Perhaps if you meet with him, you could ask him to set up shop here.

With his assistance, we could be stitching abominations together in no time!

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Mirror Network
passages.text:
We got a Scroll of Dark Empowerment ready for youz that should manifest 'em mirror frames for you. Pre'y standard work.

Once you do the conjurin', then ol' Laurent should be able to work 'is magic as it were. Right proper glass guy he is.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Mirror Network
passages.text: Ah! At last, the tools I need are all in place. Now the real work can begin.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Command Table
passages.text:
We got a Scroll of Dark Empowerment ready for youz that should manifest a command table for you. Not just any command table, but one of 'em magic ones that lets you issue orders from afar.

Tactician Sakaa insisted she be your wing for that one. Never much trusted 'em wings as they ain't too kind to us dredgers but put 'em in charge of war and even Maldraxxus flinches.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Command Table
passages.text: Maw Walker.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Command Table
passages.text: We have much to accomplish, and as resourceful as you are, you are not able to be in all places at once.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: The Ember Court
passages.text:
We got a Scroll of Dark Empowerment ready for youz that should provide you with enough resources to get one of 'em fancy parties the fangs are fond of.

The Mad Duke is the one you should chat with 'bout this one. He used to run all the court parties back before he got roasted.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: The Ember Court
passages.text:
Come, come, my friend!

It is time... for a PARTY!

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Anima Conductor
passages.text:
Right. So we got all this anima you been collecting.

Thing is, all that anima originally got squeezed out of the other realms. The Master, he was big on drainin' anything that weren't him. 

So, we set up a Scroll of Dark Empowerment for you on the lower level. Should conjure somefin' strong enough for you to channel anima back into the Shadowlands, by way of Revendreth Wards. 

Seems to me there'd be some fringe benefits from somefin like that.

passages.title: Sanctum Upgrade: Anima Conductor
passages.text: It is time to begin restoring anima to the Shadowlands.

passages.title: Root Restoration
passages.text:
Anima once flowed freely, but we have been thirsting. You bring us nourishment in times of trouble. We grow.

We may now help others and share our bounty.

Watch our growth, then speak with Sesselie. They will guide you further.

passages.title: Root Restoration
passages.text: Ah. You're here. Good.

passages.title: Root Restoration
passages.text: We regrow with hope.

passages.title: Settling Disputes
passages.text:
In my search to find kyrian that would fit our purposes here, I have landed on two in particular -- Pelodis and Nemea.

However, the two are involved in quite the rivalry, and struggle to focus their attention elsewhere. I propose that you aid them in settling their dispute so that they may focus on the task at hand.

I doubt they shall work together, however, so you will need to pick one to aid us.

passages.title: Settling Disputes
passages.text: Ah, you come to aid in my dispute. Allow me to show you my ways.

passages.title: A Mycelial Network
passages.text:
Anima flows into the deepest of roots, feeding the mushrooms. Long has it been since we used the rings to travel across Ardenweald.

Restore our connection to the mushroom network.

passages.title: A Mycelial Network
passages.text: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm. Normally we'd be seeing some mushrooms sprouting by now.

passages.title: Misery's Company
passages.text:
<The husk of this poor soul has been stripped of everything, down to near nonexistence.

This suffering cannot continue. Save the others from their misery.>

passages.title: XX REUSEME
passages.text:
As you grow in renown across the Shadowlands, the Heart of the Forest shall grow with you. 

Seek out Laurel, our Keeper of Renown. She will acquaint you with the magic that we bestow upon our huntsmen and huntresses.

passages.title: Constellan Writ
passages.text: <The writing on the scroll changes rapidly. It likely holds ancient secrets that Ve'nari may find intriguing.>

passages.title: Constellan Writ
passages.text:
<Ve'nari examines the writ.>

Quite an interesting way to record one's secrets. This may prove a challenge to decipher.

Thank you for bringing this to me.

passages.title: Shifting Cryptogram
passages.text:
<The ever-shifting facets of the cube are inlaid with runes you cannot read. 

Ve'nari may have an interest in it.>

passages.title: Shifting Cryptogram
passages.text:
Ah, I have not seen these runes used in quite some time. An ancient broker method of encryption.

This will be useful should I ever intercept cartel communications.

passages.title: Mawsworn Patrol Map
passages.text:
<A diagram outlining Mawsworn movement patterns has been scrawled onto the parchment.

Ve'nari may find this useful.>

passages.title: Mawsworn Patrol Map
passages.text:
Valuable information, indeed. This will help me avoid detection whenever I must leave the safety of the refuge.

I trust you've already committed the patrols to memory, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Coldheart Flight Routes
passages.text:
<These diagrams contain detailed information concerning the patrols of the Mawsworn Kyrian. 

Ve'nari would relish this knowledge.>

passages.title: Coldheart Flight Routes
passages.text:
This will help mitigate the Mawsworn's aerial advantage. Caution must still be exercised, of course.

Do try to avoid their notice whenever possible. I would hate for one of them to follow you here.

passages.title: Chaotic Runes
passages.text:
<A series of unintelligible lines has been inscribed onto ancient parchment. 

Ve'nari would value this.>

passages.title: Chaotic Runes
passages.text:
Ah, yes. These were clearly written by someone in the grip of madness.

That is not to say that they are nonsense, however. Sometimes, only the insane can see the truth.

passages.title: Puzzling Cryptogram
passages.text:
<The markings on each side of the cube periodically switch positions. 

Ve'nari will be interested in this.>

passages.title: Puzzling Cryptogram
passages.text:
<Ve'nari laughs as she appraises the cryptogram.>

This... is a children's toy. Brokers use them to teach their cartel's encryption methods.

Not to say that this is worthless. Quite the contrary. In a place such of this, even a glimmer of mirth is valuable beyond measure.

passages.title: Worn Obleron Etching
passages.text:
<The etching on the crumbling manuscript hints at the origins of the Maw. 

Ve'nari would be fascinated by this.>

passages.title: Worn Obleron Etching
passages.text:
<Ve'nari glances over the manuscript.>

This is truly an ancient document. A pity it is in such poor condition. The secrets it holds must be priceless.

passages.title: Soulforge Blueprints
passages.text:
<As you scan the documents in your possession, you realize that they outline the horrific methods by which souls can be forged into armaments. 

Ve'nari would be intrigued by this.>

passages.title: Soulforge Blueprints
passages.text:
Raw materials must be hard to come by in the Maw. It does not surprise me that the Jailer's weaponsmiths would need to be... resourceful.

Perhaps the knowledge recorded in these blueprints should remain a secret.

passages.title: Shadebound Testimonial
passages.text:
<These appear to be the pain-induced ramblings of a tormented Torghast prisoner. 

Ve'nari would find value in this.>

passages.title: Shadebound Testimonial
passages.text:
Quite the find, Maw Walker. Firsthand information from within Torghast is rare and valuable. None who set foot in the tower return to tell the tale.

Present company excluded, of course.

passages.title: Venthyr Concordat
passages.text:
<This appears to be an encoded correspondence between a venthyr noble and a Mawsworn lieutenant.

Perhaps Ve'nari can decipher it.>

passages.title: Venthyr Concordat
passages.text:
<Ve'nari glances over the scroll, rotating it in various directions.>

It has been some time since I've seen a method of encryption so intricate. But I suppose the venthyr are nothing if not ostentatious.

Whatever the contents of this message might be, it is clear that its author wanted to keep it clandestine.

passages.title: Discarded Torments
passages.text:
<The torn and faded pages depict punishments deemed too lenient and therefore disposed of. 

Ve'nari may wish to study them.>

passages.title: Discarded Torments
passages.text:
Ah, a rare bit of insight into the minds of the Maw's eternal tormentors.

Quite fascinating... if a bit frightening.

passages.title: Shadehound Armor Plating
passages.text:
<The salvaged piece of plating is covered in runes that slowly shift and flow across its surface. 

Ve'nari would be interested in studying this.>

passages.title: Shadehound Armor Plating
passages.text:
An interesting artifact indeed, Maw Walker.

<Ve'nari gently taps the armor.>

You can almost hear the screams of the souls who were consumed to forge it.

passages.title: Indecipherable Map
passages.text:
<The map is covered in scribbles and notations that hint at realms unknown. 

Ve'nari would likely find this fascinating.>

passages.title: Indecipherable Map
passages.text:
<Ve'nari raises the map, inspecting it closely.>

And these stains--you said they were here when you found it?

passages.title: Mawsworn Shackles
passages.text:
<The shackles are part tangible, part ethereal. They scream into your mind when held. 

Just the sort of thing Ve'nari might be looking for.>

passages.title: Mawsworn Shackles
passages.text:
<Ve'nari snatches the shackles from your hands.>

Rather dangerous for a mortal such as yourself to be carrying these around.

<Ve'nari lifts and lowers the shackles slowly, as if to determine the weight.>

Though I must admit... these could prove useful.

passages.title: Box of Torments
passages.text:
<The insidious music box hums an endlessly repeating set of dissonant chords. 

Ve'nari may find it melodious.>

passages.title: Box of Torments
passages.text:
How soothing.

<Ve'nari takes a closer look at the item in her hands.>

I wonder...

<Ve'nari presses a diamond shaped etching on the side of the box. It clicks into place, then opens to reveal a secret compartment containing a small piece of rolled up parchment.>

Nothing is what it seems, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Wailing Coin
passages.text:
<The odd coin appears to be from a forgotten time. As you hold it, you are haunted by the cries of suffering souls. 

Ve'nari may recognize the coin's value.>

passages.title: Wailing Coin
passages.text:
An intriguing piece of currency.

I would be most interested to learn how it was minted...

passages.title: Words of the Warden
passages.text:
<As far as you can tell, this is a faded segment of a desiccated journal scrawled in Warden Korrath's hand. 

Ve'nari would find value in this.>

passages.title: Words of the Warden
passages.text: One can often find valuable information in the pages of an enemy's journal. You have done well to acquire this.

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Aleketh
passages.text:
<These appear to be a collection of pages from a tome studying the denizens of the Maw in unsettling detail. 

No doubt Ve'nari would wish to peruse this.>

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Aleketh
passages.text:
I believe I have seen the creatures described in these pages before. 

From afar, of course. Always from afar.

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Belidir
passages.text:
<These appear to be a collection of pages from a tome studying the denizens of the Maw in unsettling detail. 

No doubt Ve'nari would wish to peruse this.>

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Belidir
passages.text: Ah, yes. This will make for a fascinating study.

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Gyadrek
passages.text:
<These appear to be a collection of pages from a tome studying the denizens of the Maw in unsettling detail. 

No doubt Ve'nari would wish to peruse this.>

passages.title: Korrath's Grimoire: Gyadrek
passages.text:
Despite how long I have been here, there is still much about the creatures of the Maw that remains unknown to me.

Sometimes I have to wonder if it is better that way.

passages.title: Tormentor's Notes
passages.text:
<The crumpled and singed page describes the Mawsworn's preferred methods of interrogation and subjugation. 

Ve'nari may find it of interest.>

passages.title: Tormentor's Notes
passages.text:
Quite the vivid description.

I suggest you consider this a reminder of what will happen should you fail in your efforts against the Jailer.

passages.title: Mawsworn Orders
passages.text:
<The document outlines a set of orders issued by Warden Korrath. 

Ve'nari would find this illuminating.>

passages.title: Mawsworn Orders
passages.text: Well done, Maw Walker. These will allow us to better anticipate the enemy's actions.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Echthra
passages.text:
Your soulbinds request your strategic mind in another trial.

Their sights this week are set on Echthra, that they may learn from the lessons her memory teaches.

When you are able, report to Artemede to return to the Path of Ascension. Aid your soulbinds in defeating Echthra to prove their growth.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Echthra
passages.text: Congratulations on the victory. I look forward to hearing what your soulbinds have learned.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Alderyn and Myn'ir
passages.text:
Your soulbinds request your strategic mind in another trial.

Their sights this week are set on Alderyn and Myn'ir, that they may learn from the lessons their memories teach.

When you are able, report to Artemede to return to the Path of Ascension. Aid your soulbinds in defeating Alderyn and Myn'ir to prove their growth.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Alderyn and Myn'ir
passages.text: Alderyn and Myn'ir's dedication and focus can teach us much.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Alderyn and Myn'ir
passages.text: Congratulations on the victory. I look forward to hearing what your soulbinds have learned.
