passages.title: Drowned and Torn Asunder
passages.text:
Maw Walker! I am relieved to see you in this place.

A dark sect of kyrian who have allied themselves with the Maw stole my brothers and sisters from their posts in Bastion. They turned us over to a foul sea witch, the likes of which I've never seen.

This... Helya, I believe they called her... seems determined to break us so that we might also join her ranks.

Please, if you can, save my brethren.

passages.title: Drowned and Torn Asunder
passages.text:
We are in your debt, Maw Walker.

I don't know if we will ever escape this place, but you have at least bought us a chance to strike back at our foes.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Thenios has requested a Trial of Wisdom to exercise your strategic mind, as well as your soulbinds' abilities.

A trial against Alderyn and Myn'ir shall suffice. Let us see you and your soulbinds can do.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: Are you up for the challenge?

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Thenios has requested a Trial of Wisdom to exercise your strategic mind, as well as your soulbinds' abilities.

A trial against Thran'tiok shall suffice. Let us see you and your soulbinds can do.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Artemede's Challenge
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Trial of Humility
passages.text:
Are you prepared for a challenge, <name>?

Many kyrian struggle with their trials of humility at some point along their path. It is important to remember that we can always be learning and improving, no matter how far we have come. But as we continue training, we can overcome more obstacles than before.

It is time for your soulbinds to be reminded of this lesson. Let us witness you all succeed in a Trial of Humility.

passages.title: Path of Ascension: Trial of Humility
passages.text: I knew you would rise to the challenge. Well done.

passages.title: Report to Adrestes
passages.text:
You have chosen well.

The Kyrian have long ferried souls across the veil into the Shadowlands, ensuring a steady supply of anima for all the realms.

Their sacred purpose must be kept strong. Speak with Polemarch Adrestes and begin your future with your covenant.

passages.title: Report to Adrestes
passages.text: Hail, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Report to Mevix
passages.text:
You have chosen well.

The Necrolords, eternal protectors of the Shadowlands, must remain strong to ensure we may continue to fulfill the Purpose.

Aid them as best you can. Speak with Secutor Mevix and begin your future with your covenant.

passages.title: Report to Mevix
passages.text: I knew you would return.

passages.title: Report to Moonberry
passages.text:
You have chosen well.

The Night Fae fill a critical role in the eternal cycle of nature spirits. The balance of many worlds depends on their work.

Speak with Lady Moonberry and begin your future with your covenant.

passages.title: Report to Moonberry
passages.text: You're back! I knew you would choose us!

passages.title: Report to Draven
passages.text:
You have chosen well.

The Venthyr must return to their duty helping souls atone for their sins, saving them from an eternity in the Maw.

Denathrius's treachery must be righted. Speak with General Draven and begin your future with your covenant.

passages.title: Report to Draven
passages.text: A wise choice.

passages.title: Sinfall Veteran
passages.text:
Sinfall's influence grows thanks to your triumphs, <name>!

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Revendreth.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.

passages.title: Sinfall Veteran
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.

passages.title: Sinfall Tactician
passages.text:
Sinfall is gaining more respect than Denathrius could have ever hoped to earn! It is all thanks to your efforts, <name>.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.

passages.title: Sinfall Tactician
passages.text:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.

passages.title: Necrolord Veteran
passages.text:
The might of the Necrolords grows thanks to you, <name>.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Maldraxxus.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.

passages.title: Necrolord Veteran
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.

passages.title: Necrolord Tactician
passages.text:
You have brought great honor to the Necrolords. Such honor attracts the attention of others yet again.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.

passages.title: Necrolord Tactician
passages.text:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.

passages.title: Kyrian Veteran
passages.text:
Bastion is healing thanks to you, <name>. The path is clear.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Bastion.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.

passages.title: Kyrian Veteran
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.

passages.title: Kyrian Tactician
passages.text:
Look around you, <name>. Elysian Hold stands as a testament to the progress we have made thanks to you.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.

passages.text:

passages.title: Night Fae Veteran
passages.text:
Ardenweald is safer than it has been in quite some time, thanks to you.

Your accomplishments have not gone unnoticed, even beyond the borders of Ardenweald.

Tales of your victories have echoed through the halls of Oribos. Zo'sorg, the Master of Conflict, has requested a meeting with you in the Enclave.

They have a keen interest in the art of war. I suggest you don't keep them waiting.

passages.title: Night Fae Veteran
passages.text:
Ah, <name>. I have heard many stories of your prowess on the battlefield. 

I have interest in keeping great combatants like yourself well equipped. Zo'dash is authorized to further upgrade your armor and weapons.

passages.title: Night Fae Tactician
passages.text:
Your bravery has allowed Ardenweald to grow once again. It has also once again drawn the attention of brokers.

Zo'sorg has once again requested your presence in Oribos. Go at once.

The favor of Cartel Zo is not something we want to squander. A broker clan's trust is not one effortlessly gained.

Perhaps they have more rewards to bestow upon you.

passages.title: Night Fae Tactician
passages.text:
I see your skills in combat have improved even further. I trust you have made good use of our previous offer? 

Zo'dash is now instructed to offer the full suite of his services to you. I look forward to seeing their impact on your performance.

passages.title: Exploited Explorers
passages.text:
Chuck explains that something weird is happening in the jungle, and that his group has been captured by wild fungarians.

He asks you to rescue his friends to help find out what's going on with the jungle.

passages.title: Spores Galore
passages.text:
Chuck goes over again how the jungle seems to be alive and all wrong.

He asks you to recover the spores that are on the fungarians and the beasts they've infected.

Chuck is worried whatever is happening isn't natural.

passages.title: Temple Throwdown
passages.text:
My parents are busy defending the Shrine of the... Eight... Coconuts? I wasn't paying attention. That's probably why they left me here.

They told me I could train with the big white cat! I'm going to be a ninja!

<Anthea kicks several times in your direction.>

Ya! Kya! You better watch out!

...

I'm bored, do you want to pet battle? I brought all of my favorite pets with me.

passages.title: Temple Throwdown
passages.text:
I'm gonna get you!

<Anthea punches the air several times.>

 Biff! Pow!

passages.title: Temple Throwdown
passages.text: Ok, you win. Here's something I traded one of the grummle for. Have you met the grummle? They don't like it when I scratch behind their ears, but I do it anyway! They're just so cute!

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text:
Have you embraced the Holy Light yet, <brother/sister>? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers!

Take this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.

passages.title: Fear No Evil
passages.text: I think you now understand the power of the Light. The Light giveth hope, brother and the Light taketh from the darkness! BLESSED BE THE LIGHT!

passages.title: Dead On Their Feet
passages.text:
As the Jailer twists the souls here to his will, there are still some that continue to resist him.

I shall give you the ability to aid them in their resistance. Through Necrotic Cohesion we shall bind the runes, armor, and bones that reside here to create bodies for these souls. Bodies that will allow them to fight for us and their freedom!

Bind the Zealous souls and build us an army!

passages.title: Dead On Their Feet
passages.text: Excellent, <name>. Your efforts have bolstered our forces!

passages.title: Summons from the Matriarch
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

Let us not mince words--you are urgently needed in Silvermoon. 

We're experiencing a resurgence of Scourge in Quel'Thalas. With nothing to hold the Scourge in check, we'll soon be overrun. We must hold the line!

Meet me in the Hall of Blood, and we will get you a full briefing.

passages.title: Summons from the Matriarch
passages.text:
Good, you made it.

Let us begin.

passages.title: Briefing
passages.text:
We haven't much time. 

The Scourge have attacked Tranquillien, and there's nothing to hold them back.

We must take decisive action.

passages.title: Briefing
passages.text: We will find a way.

passages.title: Briefing
passages.text: We don't have time to waste.

passages.title: Tranquillien Besieged
passages.text:
Rommath has opened the way for us to quickly travel to Tranquillien. I warn you, it's already a bloody battlefield.

Take the portal, and I will be along right after you.

And <name>... keep an eye on Salandria. She may have excelled in her training thus far, but she has yet to be tested like this.

passages.title: Tranquillien Besieged
passages.text:
Not a moment too soon.

Let's get to work.

passages.title: Death to the Scourge
passages.text:
I haven't seen Scourge mustering in numbers like this since...

<Liadrin shakes her head, steeling herself.>

Never mind. There's no use dwelling in the past.

Our first priority is thinning their numbers enough that we can find out what--or who--is really behind this attack. 

Slay as many of the undead as you can.

passages.title: Death to the Scourge
passages.text: Once we've thinned out the numbers of the Scourge, we can strike at Vorath in his lair.

passages.title: Death to the Scourge
passages.text:
Well struck. 

But for every undead we strike down, more come. We must find a way to stop them at their source.

passages.title: Magus Installation
passages.text:
This is no mindless strike... I have a strong suspicion that some powerful entity is manipulating the Scourge.

Ever since the Helm of Domination was shattered, there has been a conceivable risk that someone else could exert their will and assume control over the undead--at least temporarily.

Rommath and I can help defend Tranquillien, but we need to break those lines. 

Clear a spot for us. Let us see if we can draw out their leader.

passages.title: Magus Installation
passages.text: Rommath and I are ready to help set up the wards, once you clear out a spot for us.

passages.title: Magus Installation
passages.text:
The wards are in place, and that should give us some breathing room.

But this san'layn has me worried.

passages.title: A Knight's Weapon
passages.text:
It's clear that this san'layn has decided to use the Scourge to empower himself somehow. We can keep taking him out, but he will just keep coming back.

We need a weapon that can break him for good.

I think I have a solution. Upstairs, you will find a newly forged ranseur. It has yet to be tempered with magic--we will need to unlock its full potential. It will be our instrument of the Light.

passages.title: A Knight's Weapon
passages.text: Have you acquired the ranseur?

passages.title: A Knight's Weapon
passages.text:
Good. That's exactly what we need. 

Now it's time to temper this ranseur with enough power to destroy this san'layn once and for all.

passages.title: An Honest Heart
passages.text:
If we are to defeat Vorath, we need to amplify the power of the ranseur. But we will not cut corners or impose our will to do it. That lesson has been learned.

However, the kyrian of Bastion are masters of ushering souls to their proper places. Perhaps they would lend a fragment of their power to our cause.

Go to Bastion, and find a way to empower the ranseur.

passages.title: An Honest Heart
passages.text:
I suppose if one happened to die, this wouldn't be such a bad place to end up.

This kyrian says he will help us.

passages.title: An Unbreakable Will
passages.text:
We're clearly dealing with someone who is using terrible magic to suspend his own death.

There's another force we know of that uses magic in this fashion. The Maldraxxi are intimately familiar with the trappings of death, and equally familiar with how to subvert it. Perhaps one of the Houses knows of a way to help us.

Go there, and seek out power that can break this unnatural loop.

passages.title: An Unbreakable Will
passages.text:
We're not in Quel'Thalas anymore.

Let's get what we need as quickly as we can--we've got no time to waste!

passages.title: Return to the Ghostlands
passages.text:
Such power! Surely not even Vorath can withstand the might of this weapon now. 

We have what we came to the Shadowlands for. The ranseur is ready.

Let's get back to Lady Liadrin in Tranquillien. I hope we're not too late to make a difference!

passages.title: Return to the Ghostlands
passages.text:
Now that you have the empowered ranseur, it's time to show our full might on the battlefield. 

Are you ready?

passages.title: I Am the Blade of the Light
passages.text:
It's time to put all that power and training into the field.

Take the empowered ranseur, and cut a swath of destruction through the Scourge!

We'll meet you at the doorstep of Deatholme.

passages.title: I Am the Blade of the Light
passages.text:
He's here. We've driven the fiend back into his cage.

Now to send him to his doom.

passages.title: Justice Long Overdue
passages.text:
You made short work of the Scourge in the Dead Scar, but we've a bigger target to face. It's time to test the mettle of your weapon against Vorath.

Let us finish this, together.

passages.title: Justice Long Overdue
passages.text: We will protect our homeland.

passages.title: Justice Long Overdue
passages.text:
It's done. Already the Scourge are beginning to scatter.

We can dispose of the rest in time.

passages.title: The Anvil-Thane's Designs
passages.text:
I see you eyein' our weapons here. Wouldnae ye know, I forged them myself!

So far, I've got designs for a staff, a one-handed axe, and a shield... I could make ye some, if you'd like!

O' course, that's what I'd normally say. Unfortunately I lost the designs in a bet down at the Grim Guzzler. If ye could get them back, as well as gather the materials, I'd be happy to forge ye some weapons!

passages.title: The Anvil-Thane's Designs
passages.text: Ye lookin' to challenge me?

passages.title: Brawl or Brew
passages.text:
Ach, Thurgaden sent ye did he? Ye'd think the Anvil-Thane would be made o' tougher stuff than the rest of this drunken lot, but I guess I was mistaken!

If ye want tae win back his designs, yer gonna have tae win 'em fair and square.

I've only got one question left fer ye.

Brawl? Or Brew?

passages.title: Brawl or Brew
passages.text: Not a single dwarf in 'ere has beaten me. What makes ye different?

passages.title: Brawl or Brew
passages.text: Ye put up a real challenge there! Take the plans, I dunnae how to read them anyway!

passages.title: It's Called Borrowing
passages.text:
<These complex blueprints detail Thurgaden's designs for his weaponry, but are hard to parse. Notes are scribbled in the margins in messy handwriting, listing modifications and notes Thurgaden left for himself.

Two notes in particular stand out to you. One denotes that he lent his engraving tool to the core hound trainer Kasea Angerforge, and the other wonders how many elementals they employ at the Grim Guzzler brewing operation.>

passages.title: It's Called Borrowing
passages.text: <Thurgaden is mumbling and cursing under his breath about how he will defeat Jarden in their next competition.>

passages.title: It's Called Borrowing
passages.text: Ye return, with my plans and materials at that! I bet ye knocked Jarden down a peg or two!

passages.title: Weapons o' the Dark Iron
passages.text: One step left, friend. Lend me a hand in my craftin', then you'll have yer hands on the most powerful weapons forged in the deepest fires of Blackrock Mountain!

passages.title: Weapons o' the Dark Iron
passages.text: These weapons shall rival even my own!

passages.title: Weapons o' the Dark Iron
passages.text: These weapons'll put the fear an' shame into even a mindless undead colossus!

passages.title: Unfair Fight
passages.text:
A cowardly pest that cheats his way out of the glory of death? Bah!

I have something that'll cut him down where he stands. But such an enhancement requires one who is strong enough to wield it properly.

Show me your mettle and fight! If you can prove yourself, I'll empower that ranseur of yours.

passages.title: Unfair Fight
passages.text:
Here, take the power we've honed and use it to defeat your hardest-to-kill enemies.

If that san'layn ever shows up here, well... he'll have an appropriately warm welcome.

passages.title: A Fair Race
passages.text:
A soul that refuses to cross the veil is a problem we kyrian are familiar with. I can help you.

But before I grant your weapon this power, I must know that you will not abuse it, and that your heart is true.

Let us run a race. Along the course, ring the bells. If your heart is pure, they will aid your speed. You must have at least five bells recently rung in order to complete the race.

Do not be distracted by shortcuts. And do not try to cheat to get ahead, it will not work.

Are you ready?

passages.title: A Fair Race
passages.text:
Such a stubborn young knight. She... almost seems to dredge up a memory of long ago.

Here, accept this gift of power. I wish you victory over your foe.

passages.title: Putting A Plan Together
passages.text:
While Maldraxxus pushes the main gate, we can take the side gate with the help of our Centurions.

The remains of many Corrupted Centurions taken by the Jailor litter this area. Their parts could be used to build new ones to help in the assault.

See if you can locate the parts we need to build a new Centurion.

passages.title: Putting A Plan Together
passages.text: Have you found the parts I requested?

passages.title: Putting A Plan Together
passages.text: These parts are more than enough to build a new Centurion!

passages.title: The First Move
passages.text:
While the covenants labor to defend the Shadowlands, the Jailer has not sat idle within Torghast. It seems he intends to set the next phase of his scheme into motion.

Polemarch Adrestes has brought us disturbing news from Elysian Hold. He will recount what he witnessed once you arrive.

Make haste. I fear that time grows short.

passages.title: The First Move
passages.text: We will continue to fight.

passages.title: The First Move
passages.text:
Anduin... now the Jailer's pawn...

We must take immediate action, <name>. It is time for the covenants to convene.

passages.title: The Battle of Ardenweald
passages.text:
With the betrayal of Sire Denathrius, and the absence of the Primus of Maldraxxus, we must assume that the Winter Queen is the Jailer's next target.

And we won't let anyone take her sigil!

Ardenweald has endured much, but it is a realm of great and mysterious power. Things aren't always what they seem.

We'll use this to our advantage, no matter who comes for the Queen!

passages.title: The Battle of Ardenweald
passages.text:
We just barely survived that! I definitely didn't expect THAT to happen.

But it's not over. We can't let our guard down!

passages.title: Wounded Memories
passages.text:
The arrival of Uther's wounded soul was the impetus for many events that led us to our current struggles.

Devos's broken trust. Her involvement with Helya. The rise of the Forsworn.

Bastion needs to change, but we struggle to find a solution.

Perhaps this soul fragment will provide valuable insight.

passages.title: Wounded Memories
passages.text: I have never seen a soul torn as Uther's has been.

passages.title: Wounded Memories
passages.text: Though Uther's soul is suffering, we must not lose hope.

passages.title: Step Into the Light
passages.text:
It is as I feared.

This fragment of Uther's soul was darkened by the mourneblade that slew him. His memories are shattered and twisted.

For Uther to move past his pain, to move past his grief, he must experience his past once again.

But he does not have to do this alone.

Using my soul mirror, we can aid Uther in walking through these memories. He can then come to terms with the emotions they contain. We must help him see past the distortions and understand the truths they hold.

passages.title: Step Into the Light
passages.text: We can learn from this.

passages.title: Step Into the Light
passages.text:
His memories are twisted and convoluted.

I am sorry, Uther, but we must continue.

passages.title: He Was My Student
passages.text:
Uther's memories of this Prince Arthas haunt him deeply. He is the reason Uther's soul was fragmented, why Devos fell the way she did.

The pain in these memories is palpable.

We have to dig deeper. Uther must face the source of this darkness.

Once again, you need to enter his past to protect his future.

passages.title: He Was My Student
passages.text: Uther needs our support.

passages.title: He Was My Student
passages.text:
The sting of betrayal haunts Uther deeply. But he can persevere.

He must!

passages.title: I Intend to Live Forever
passages.text:
Please, <name>. I am not finished.

There is one more memory that I must see. One more that must be faced.

It... it will not be easy. I will need support from all of you.

But it must be done.

passages.title: I Intend to Live Forever
passages.text: <Adrestes is deep in thought.>

passages.title: I Intend to Live Forever
passages.text:
<Adrestes breaks from his thoughts, a renewed resolve in his eyes.>

I believe this experience was the missing piece for Uther. And for me as well.

passages.title: A Triumphant Return
passages.text:
This temple represents a new dawn for Bastion, <name>.

The Temple of Devotion will stand as a place of fellowship. We will work with the Forsworn, as well as aspirants and kyrian of all experience and backgrounds, to forge a future of which all can be proud.

Let us return to Elysian Hold. I request that you join us for a momentous occasion--the ascension of a new Paragon and the creation of a new sigil.

passages.title: A Triumphant Return
passages.text:
Allow me to escort you to the Spires of Ascension, <name>.

As the new Polemarch of Bastion, it would be my honor.

passages.title: Compassion in Devotion
passages.text:
Our first order of business is to rededicate the Temple of Loyalty.

Pelagos has volunteered to stay here and help prepare for the ceremony. I requested that Nikolon bring his companions to meet us at Steward's Rest, to aid us in convincing some of the Forsworn of our new path.

Meet us there when you are able.

passages.title: Compassion in Devotion
passages.text: Let us begin.

passages.title: Reclaimable Anima
passages.text:
Mikanikos has explained much about Forsworn centurions to me, <name>.

I cannot say that I understood all of it, but it seems he has not yet found a reliable way to return them to their proper operating standards.

Their anima can still be useful, though!

Adrestes has focused on how to rededicate the temple, but not on his own safety. I worry the process will drain much of his anima.

If you can reclaim cores from the Forsworn centurions, we can use them as anima stores for Adrestes.

passages.title: Reclaimable Anima
passages.text: I've been working with Mikanikos on methods to reuse anima from Forsworn centurions. I can handle this!

passages.title: Reclaimable Anima
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. If Adrestes falters, I now have the anima to pick him back up.

passages.title: Rebuilding Faith
passages.text:
The Forsworn are lost, <name>.

They are like ghosts, haunting the Temple of Loyalty. Nowhere else to go. Leaderless, purposeless, abandoned.

We must show them that there is a path forward.

Let me accompany you into the temple. Allow me to talk to them, speak to their sensibilities. Perhaps we can convince them to give Adrestes's new path a chance.

passages.title: Rebuilding Faith
passages.text: The Forsworn may have abandoned the Path, but we had good reason.

passages.title: Rebuilding Faith
passages.text: It will take time and communication to repair the trust that has been lost, <name>... but there is hope again.

passages.title: Directing Dedication
passages.text:
The five temples of Bastion have stood strong since its very creation. The idea of rededicating one has never been broached before, and will no doubt require a significant amount of anima.

Underneath this temple are stores of anima we rationed for the drought. Now that anima is returning, we can use these reserves for our purposes.

You will need to use channelers and collectors throughout the grounds to redirect anima to the top. That should give me the power I need.

passages.title: Directing Dedication
passages.text: We endeavor to perform a monumental feat, one that has never been attempted before.

passages.title: Directing Dedication
passages.text: It is heartening to see so much anima flowing again.

passages.title: The Vesper Rings
passages.text:
Loyalty shall no longer be a demanded tenet of the Path, but rather a virtue that is earned. A choice.

We must show devotion to those who struggle, whether they are recently arrived souls or peers who need our aid.

It will take all the anima at hand to rededicate this temple. And in so doing, to ring in a new age for the kyrian.

I fear the Mawsworn may attempt to thwart our plans. Protect me during this ritual, <name>. We must see this through.

passages.title: The Vesper Rings
passages.text: <Adrestes cannot be distracted as he uses every ounce of himself for the task at hand.>

passages.title: The Vesper Rings
passages.text:
Devotion... it is born of compassion. Of service.

A worthy tenet indeed.

passages.title: New Sigil of the Kyrian
passages.text:
With a future of kinship and devotion secured for Bastion, a new sigil is born to represent our path forward.

Please report all that you have done to the Primus. When he is ready, we will deliver the sigil to him. 

Let us hope he can use it to thwart the Jailer's plan and save the Shadowlands.

passages.title: New Sigil of the Kyrian
passages.text:
Kyrestia was the first to be borne aloft by wings of duty and service.

That you have helped the Archon see a new path forward is a wondrous thing indeed, mortal.

passages.title: Yak Soul
passages.text: <The Yak Soul is cordial and resilient. The shape of the yak will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Yak Soul
passages.text: Ah, the yak. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Shoveltusk Soul
passages.text: <The Shoveltusk Soul is protective and determined. The shape of the shoveltusk will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Shoveltusk Soul
passages.text: Ah, the shoveltusk. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Saurolisk Soul
passages.text: <The Saurolisk Soul is agile and clever. The shape of the saurolisk will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Saurolisk Soul
passages.text: Ah, the saurolisk. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Spider Soul
passages.text: <The Spider Soul is nimble and cunning. The shape of the spider will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Spider Soul
passages.text: Ah, the spider. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Direhorn Soul
passages.text: <The Direhorn Soul is brutal and tenacious. The shape of the direhorn will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Direhorn Soul
passages.text: Ah, the direhorn. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Hippo Soul
passages.text: <The Hippo Soul is ferocious. The shape of the hippo will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Hippo Soul
passages.text: Ah, the hippo. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Kodo Soul
passages.text: <The Kodo Soul is calm and loyal. The shape of the kodo will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Kodo Soul
passages.text: Ah, the kodo. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: Mammoth Soul
passages.text: <The Mammoth Soul is brave and protective. The shape of the mammoth will be yours to call upon.>

passages.title: Mammoth Soul
passages.text: Ah, the mammoth. This shape is now yours to call upon.

passages.title: The Chains of Command
passages.text:
If we must hold a position so near to the Jailer's lands, we need to provide some assurances.

Vyraz and Helya have retreated within the walls of Desmotaeron. They have grown lax in their expected safety, which provides us with an opportunity.

We will take them by surprise. Strike swiftly and without mercy, and perhaps we can cut the heads off those snakes.

passages.title: The Chains of Command
passages.text: They haven't noticed us yet. That won't stay true for long.

passages.title: Gates of the Damned
passages.text:
We need to prepare for the assault before we signal Zerekriss. Once it is in place, our allies will use death gates to assault the area.

We will need to summon the death gates on this side. Find strategic locations for them.

passages.title: Gates of the Damned
passages.text: Once we have all of these death gates summoned, then the real fight can begin.

passages.title: Gates of the Damned
passages.text: That should be enough to let the bulk of the army through.

passages.title: Weapon in Hand
passages.text:
A moment, <name>.

I threw my axe Dra'gora at Helya during our first encounter in the Maw, and I haven't seen it since. If this is truly where she commands her forces, then perhaps it's held here.

I crafted that weapon in Nagrand, and it reminds me of many good days spent beside my family there. I want to feel its weight in my hands once again.

passages.title: Weapon in Hand
passages.text: I threw my axe in the heat of the moment...

passages.title: Weapon in Hand
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. I feared my axe was lost forever.

passages.title: Clip Their Wings
passages.text:
The skies are dark with Helya's kyrian followers. If we do not thin their numbers, Zerekriss and our aerial allies may have difficulties pushing forward.

I've noticed that the Mawsworn often use magical chains. We could turn their equipment against them and tear them down from the sky.

passages.title: Clip Their Wings
passages.text: We need to clear out the skies before we can begin the real assault.

passages.title: Clip Their Wings
passages.text: Our foes will learn that even the skies are no longer safe for them.

passages.title: A Job Done Right
passages.text:
We should be clear to start the assault.

Signal the Zerekriss. Let us show them the might of a Maldraxxian necropolis and the combined armies of the Shadowlands!

passages.title: A Job Done Right
passages.text: Nothing can stand against the might of Maldraxxus!

passages.title: A Job Done Right
passages.text: We have our opening. It is time to push ahead.

passages.title: Bending Bars
passages.text:
In all the chaos, the gates of the upper hold have been left open. If we slip through, they might not even notice us until it is too late.

One of Helya's lieutenants stands between us and Helgarde Keep. End them.

passages.title: Bending Bars
passages.text: We need to get through that gate.

passages.title: Bending Bars
passages.text: Now to sow chaos here.

passages.title: What Maldraxxus Does Best
passages.text:
Every enemy we vanquish here is one our army does not have to contend with. We will make sure they will not soon forget the true purpose of Maldraxxus. Show them what happens to those we deem a threat towards the Shadowlands.

Kill every Mawsworn in sight.

passages.title: What Maldraxxus Does Best
passages.text: Each Mawsworn we defeat is one less that will bother our forces in Korthia.

passages.title: What Maldraxxus Does Best
passages.text: They were foolish to think they could cross blades with us.

passages.title: Forsworn and Forgotten
passages.text:
Wait... I know you! The Maw Walker!

My brothers and sisters have been twisted... tainted. Some took power willingly from Helya, but others resisted. Now all of us are forced to submit to her power.

I escaped when the fighting started, but most of the remaining Forsworn are being subjected to horrific rituals.

Please, I beg you to free them. Then we will return to Bastion and submit to the Archon's judgment.

passages.title: A Traitor's Due
passages.text:
Vyraz has been a constant thorn in Maldraxxus's side since he betrayed us. As Baroness of the House of the Chosen, it is my duty to see this threat eliminated... and the murder of Margrave Krexus avenged.

As the Primus said, we must remove the head from this snake.

The time to strike is now!

passages.title: A Traitor's Due
passages.text: Vyraz is a stain upon Maldraxxus as long as he still draws breath.

passages.title: A Traitor's Due
passages.text:
<Draka spits on the corpse of Vyraz.>

And with that traitor's end, Maldraxxus will be unified once again!

passages.title: Pulling His Chain
passages.text:
They call this one the Keeper of Chains. Do not underestimate his power. He has bound nearby souls in preparation for an attack against our position.

I need you to eliminate this threat, Maw Walker, before it moves against our forces.

passages.title: Pulling His Chain
passages.text: Have you eliminated this threat?

passages.title: Pulling His Chain
passages.text: I knew we could count upon you, <name>.

passages.title: Victory in Our Name
passages.text:
With Helya and Vyraz taken care of, we have achieved a major victory against the Mawsworn today. It is also a showing of what the combined might of the Shadowlands looks like.

We should return to Korthia before something else arises.

passages.title: Victory in Our Name
passages.text: We have struck a blow against the Jailer's forces. Take your time to recover before the next strike.

passages.title: Victory in Our Name
passages.text:
There is no doubt that we will need to put pressure on Desmotaeron once again.

The witch of the Val'kyr will not let us walk free if she can help it.

passages.title: Filling an Empty Throne
passages.text:
Maw Walker.

In my long absence, you have done much to bring order and strength back to the necrolord covenant. In recognition, I invite you to witness a ceremony.

Return with me to my seat of power in Maldraxxus. It is time I rewarded one who was most loyal to our cause.

passages.title: Filling an Empty Throne
passages.text: This is the first step toward the restoration of Maldraxxus.

passages.title: The Roads We Walk
passages.text:
The armies of Maldraxxus are strong. They will recover from Vyraz's transgression. 

The first thing we must do is rebuild. Maw Walker, stand witness to a new era for Maldraxxus!

passages.title: The Roads We Walk
passages.text: Did you speak with each of our leaders? The army has much to celebrate.

passages.title: The Roads We Walk
passages.text: We must all move forward. The Shadowlands relies on our strength.

passages.title: Here's an Axe, Get to Work!
passages.text:
Our troops are meeting stiff resistance! Maw Walker, grab a weapon and take the fight to them!

Eliminate the Mawsworn forces and their commander defending these gates.

passages.title: Here's an Axe, Get to Work!
passages.text: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!

passages.title: Can't Turn Our Backs
passages.text:
That's Sylvanas and her Mawsworn dealt with... for now.

But we need to hurry and make sure that the Queen and her sigil are safe! 

The Winter Queen was just outside the Heart of the Forest, protecting the stolen wildseeds from the Maw.

passages.title: Can't Turn Our Backs
passages.text: The forest answers.

passages.title: Can't Turn Our Backs
passages.text:
Ardenweald depends on the cycle. Without these spirits, what purpose would there be?

I could not let the Jailer's forces destroy what we have fought so hard to protect.

passages.title: Report to Oribos
passages.text:
Ardenweald has withstood the unrelenting force of the Maw.

But it was still not enough.

Return to our allies in Oribos. There must be an answer for this loss, and action taken.

passages.title: Report to Oribos
passages.text:
The Jailer has begun his attack on Oribos.

What I have feared the most has come to pass.

passages.title: Dread Tidings
passages.text:
The threat the nathrezim pose to our forces must not be underestimated. They are cunning, rivaling the best veterans of the House of Eyes, and we do not know their full plan.

Among the venthyr there is one whose wrath scourged the nathrezim from the Shadowlands for many thousands of years. 

I ask you travel to Sinfall, seek out Prince Renathal, and deliver to him this missive. I shall send one of my own spies, the Baroness Vashj, to meet you there. Make use of her experience with the nathrezim.

passages.title: Dread Tidings
passages.text: Dread tidings indeed.

passages.title: Dread Tidings
passages.text:
The nathrezim have returned? I dared not imagine they would ever grow so bold again.

A shame they have not learned in their exile, and return to us as enemies instead of family.

passages.title: The Dawnkeep Prisoner
passages.text:
Oh, you have not heard the news yet.

We have him. Sire Denathrius, Master of Revendreth, imprisoned within his own blade.

We managed to best him during one of our recent raids of Castle Nathria.

It took an army of unparalleled valor and preparation. It took skill and wealth. It took a miracle.

And so the redeemer shall be redeemed. Would you like to know more?

passages.title: The Dawnkeep Prisoner
passages.text: Never underestimate bravery when it is backed by weapons and armor of legendary make.

passages.title: The Dawnkeep Prisoner
passages.text:
It may take ages upon ages, but we shall remind Denathrius of his purpose, and remind him how to be beautiful in his craft once again.

This place is strong with the Light. Few venthyr can tolerate such power for long without succumbing to it. A fitting place to teach uninterrupted.

passages.title: Convoy of the Covenants
passages.text:
A new sigil for the Venthyr would require all seven medallions to forge.

The Primus was correct. The person we need is the Stonewright. Her grievances against the Unseen could fill a library and she holds the last of the medallions we need. I believe you and I are long overdue in convincing her to join our cause.

I will make the arrangements. We shall go properly this time, with gifts and diplomacy. 

You should warn Chelra, she will want to arrange an escort.

passages.title: Convoy of the Covenants
passages.text: What do you bring me, Maw Walker? Be advised I have no patience for deception and am not above feeding messengers to the gargons.

passages.title: Convoy of the Covenants
passages.text:
Hmm. A letter from the Primus himself? I had wondered what had become of that old tyrant. 

<Glances over the proffered letter.>

I... see.

passages.title: The Unseen Guests
passages.text:
Dreadlords.

Of course. Of course they would come back now of all times. I half suspected they returned during the drought. 

I was not entirely convinced you were not one, the first time I saw you. They have gotten more clever over the eons since they fled Revendreth. 

But not clever enough... I think.

Come, Maw Walker. Follow me and do not make a fuss. Keep your weapon ready. The envoy you brought is not as well intentioned as you might have thought.

passages.title: The Unseen Guests
passages.text:
Chelra was a nathrezim the entire time I knew her? 

Even in death I must still contend with the schemes of the nathrezim. I have grown too trusting in my penance.

passages.title: Nal'ragas
passages.text:
The Stonewright's medallion must not stay in the hands of the nathrezim. 

From what the Accuser explained of our mission, the medallion is required if we wish to forge a new sigil for the Venthyr. I have no doubt that is why Nal'ragas and her ilk executed their ambush now.

The medallions are not subtle magic, and their affect on this realm is easily tracked. I suggest we give chase and eliminate this Nal'ragas before she can be reinforced.

passages.title: Nal'ragas
passages.text:
I have spoken with the Stonewright. Chelra fell to the master when I was a prisoner of the Maw. 

She was my friend and protector through countless ages, and I did not even know she had been slain, her identity stolen.

One more sin for Denathrius to atone for.

passages.title: Spy vs Spy
passages.text:
Nathrezim. Dreadlords. The Unseen Guests.

Call them what you will, they are a race that was crafted to be the greatest collection of spies and infiltrators in all of reality, once upon a time. 

Their intrusion has underestimated three things. Kael'thas Sunstrider, Baroness Vashj, and <name>!

I have brought a tool Kael'thas and I used to detect nathrezim when we served under Illidan. And I am the matron of spies!

Let us hunt these intruders down.

passages.title: Spy vs Spy
passages.text: Who says death is without its little pleasures.

passages.title: Spy vs Spy
passages.text:
The venthyr have grown complacent, unwilling to acknowledge the reality that nathrezim might return. The same blindness left them exposed to Denathrius' treachery. 

They will be far more vigilant now.

passages.title: De-Infiltration
passages.text:
Mal'Ganis.

It has been many ages since I have said his name. And now I find we must hunt him down.

If he has the Medallion of Wrath then there is nowhere he can hide. We can use the other medallions we have recovered to locate him.

Join me in Sinfall and bring your dreadlord hunting party. I suspect we will have need of them.

passages.title: De-Infiltration
passages.text:
The nathrezim may not be venthyr, but nor were they crafted from souls. In many ways, they are more my siblings than my fellow venthyr.

A shame what they have chosen to become.

passages.title: Cryptograms
passages.text:
If the nathrezim have infiltrated Sinfall they will be communicating, and not just through hand gestures or spoken words. They like to use magical written messages concealed by a simple cantrip, invisible to the average observer.

However, I have developed an incantation that should allow you to see these messages.

Find these cryptograms and bring me their contents. I can translate them if they are beyond your understanding.

passages.title: Cryptograms
passages.text: If the nathrezim have a flaw it is that they assume they are the only ones who get better over time.

passages.title: Cryptograms
passages.text:
This does not make sense. Their goals seem too wide spread. My assumption was that they had been planning to steal my medallion to deny us a new Sigil of the Venthyr, but it would appear their designs go beyond that.

What are they really up to? Here, you can have a translated copy.

passages.title: The "Unwelcome" Guests
passages.text:
Chelra, I mean Nal'ragas, would not have been working alone. We must assume the worst, that not all of our friends and allies are who they seem to be.

It will take time for the Court of Harvesters to render our detection ritual. While we do so we will be exposed. I ask that you use the techniques you employed at Dominance Gate within Sinfall to root out any nathrezim within our ranks. 

Good hunting.

passages.title: The "Unwelcome" Guests
passages.text: Subterfuge and counter-insurgence was never my strong suit. We always had souls sent here that were far better than I at such tasks.

passages.title: The Power of a Crown
passages.text:
We are ready.

The Court of Harvesters shall use the power of the medallions we have gathered thus far to locate the Medallion of Wrath. So long as they have not removed it from the realm we should be able to divine its presence.

This is not an easy ritual--the nathrezim specialize in avoiding detection. When you see the path, take it and move with speed.

And when you find them, wait for us before you engage.

passages.title: The Power of a Crown
passages.text: I will not suffer my medallion in the hands of these unwelcome guests.

passages.title: The Nathrezim
passages.text:
The Medallion of Wrath is more than just a powerful artifact. In the hands of a nathrezim it could be used to shape this realm to their dark purpose. What is more, while they hold it we are denied the ability to forge a new sigil.

They already nearly destroyed the Ember Ward with their reckless schemes. I will not have my medallion used for their ends.

Come, let us get it back.

passages.title: The Nathrezim
passages.text: This is worse than anything I could have anticipated.

passages.title: Medallion of Wrath
passages.text:
Maw Walker. I will march with my stoneborn into the depths of the Maw and rend the head off every nathrezim I find there.

However, Revendreth is still too strategic in this war to lose out of misplaced vanity. 

Therefore, as Harvester of Wrath, the second of that title, I offer you my medallion for safe keeping and utilization while I wage this war.

Use it to empower the Harvesters so they can prevent Denathrius from simply returning and regaining control with a snap of his fingers.

passages.title: Medallion of Wrath
passages.text: <The platform surges with power as it feels the proximity of the medallion.>

passages.title: Medallion of Wrath
passages.text:
<Inserting the medallion in the socket tugs violently at your soul as the energies link, flooding a sense of will and intent into everything around you unlike any other energy you have experienced before. 

Together, the Harvesters rule Revendreth uncontested.>

passages.title: The Meaning of Wrath
passages.text:
I will gather my forces and dispense a portion to Korthia immediately. I will also see to it that they are provided the tools Baroness Vashj and Kael'thas were able to conjure so that we might further defend against nathrezim incursions.

Other duties require my attention before I can descend on Korthia. I must secure Dominance Keep against further infiltrators.

I suppose the Primus will want an update. You may tell him you were successful.

passages.title: The Meaning of Wrath
passages.text:
Your strength in battle remains uncontested. Today, though, you prove your strength of diplomacy. 

I have already issued orders for the deployment of the Stonewright's forces. Well done in bringing her into the fold.

passages.title: Dreadlords!
passages.text:
This is the fifth dreadlord I have found infiltrating our forces this week. Unchecked they can cause tremendous damage to our foothold here.

In life I learned how to identify these creatures from a demon hunter. It makes it far easier for me to locate them, but I cannot be in all places at once.

We must report these findings to the Primus.

passages.title: Dreadlords!
passages.text:
More dreadlords? I should have suspected the fangs of Denathrius would find their way here again.

I am pleased to know that despite their setbacks in my absence, the House of Eyes has not lost their sight.

passages.title: Opening the Maw
passages.text:
The Jailer has gained another sigil, and his forces actively assault Oribos.

Bolvar Fordragon and Draka of Maldraxxus suggest taking the fight to the Jailer.

To do so, we need a way for their forces to safely come and go from the Maw.

This was considered impossible before you arrived, but now I believe we have a chance.

I must examine your anima to see if this is truly what the Purpose wills.

passages.title: Opening the Maw
passages.text: I do not do this lightly, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Opening the Maw
passages.text:
I do not do this lightly, Maw Walker, but we have no choice.

We must open a gateway to the Maw.

passages.title: Link to the Maw
passages.text:
The Fatescribe is certain that a second waystone has emerged in the Maw. It falls to you to locate it. 

I will create an anchor here in Oribos that links to your anima. Once you attune yourself to the waystone, this anchor will be bound to it.

If you are successful, the covenants will be able to send their forces inside and safely leave the Maw again.

Use what resources you have within the Maw to find this waystone.

Good luck, mortal. May the Purpose guide us all.

passages.title: Link to the Maw
passages.text:
You have that look about you, Maw Walker. 

The one that tells me you are about to ask for my help.

passages.title: Link to the Maw
passages.text:
Normally, I would consider your request bothersome and insulting.

But recent events have led me to believe that your proposal may prove beneficial to both of us.

passages.title: Mysteries of the Maw
passages.text:
The Maw is changing, mortal. And with change comes opportunity.

The Jailer has pulled a realm that was hidden deep within the Shadowlands into the Maw. It is a location of some interest to me, but I do not wish to approach it alone.

The Mawsworn are swarming the area, you see. There must be something of value that they seek.

I have a safe enclave nearby. Accompany me there and I may be able to help you find that waystone you're looking for.

Do we have a deal?

passages.title: Mysteries of the Maw
passages.text:
The Jailer desperately wants something here, yet his precious Eye cannot breach its defenses.

Oh well. Shall we?

passages.title: Korthia, the City of Secrets
passages.text:
We are on the threshold of attaining our desires, Maw Walker.

Your grand waystone cannot be far off. Of course, my needs are much more modest. A bit of useful information here, a priceless relic there...

I will survey the area to see if there is anything useful--or hazardous--nearby. Then we can proceed.

passages.title: Korthia, the City of Secrets
passages.text: I must find out more about you, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Get to the Point
passages.text:
Our position near the bridge to the Altar of Domination is under heavy attack! We can not afford to lose the ballista we have set up there.

Maw Walker, I need you to defend that position till our troops can push forward!

passages.title: Get to the Point
passages.text: Is our position safe?

passages.title: Get to the Point
passages.text: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!

passages.title: Opening to Oribos
passages.text:
The prophecies told us that one day this dormant waystone would be needed by a Maw Walker. That it would prove crucial to the fate of the Shadowlands.

It seems that day has come.

Draw upon the anima within you to activate this waystone. It will then be usable by all those who aid your cause.

If, as you say, Tal-Inara has created an anchor in Oribos, then that anchor will bring you back to us.

Go, <name>. Inform your allies that the Maw awaits... and that Korthia needs their help.

passages.title: Opening to Oribos
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. I am eager to learn of this realm pulled into the Maw.

It is time to begin our assault on the Jailer's forces.

passages.title: Somebody Feed Kevin
passages.text:
My family of slimes is always hungry for anima. Thankfully the bodies of the defeated here are a good source!

The more the slimes consume the larger they grow. Then what remains of the fallen will become part of our wonderful, happy family.

Take Kevin and let him consume fallen enemies till he is fully grown, then unleash him upon our foes!

passages.title: Somebody Feed Kevin
passages.text: Victory will be ours, Maw Walker!

passages.title: A Cry From the Heart
passages.text:
<The voice of Ysera emanates from the scroll as you read the words.>

<name>,

There is a matter of great importance which requires your help. Please meet me at the Heart of the Forest as soon as you can.

passages.title: A Cry From the Heart
passages.text: Thank you for coming so swiftly, <name>. Ardenweald is in need of your help.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text:
I have good news, <name>. With the covenants working more closely together, Huln's hunt has found greater success. He has solid leads on two more Night Warriors here in the Shadowlands.

He wishes for you to meet him in Maldraxxus about the first. Huln awaits you at the Sepulcher of Knowledge.

Hurry, <name>. Elune's power rips at Tyrande's essence. I do not know how much longer she can hold on.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text: I am glad to hunt by your side once more, <name>.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text: My continuing hunt for more Night Warriors has brought me here, <name>. Together we will track them down and ask for their help.

passages.title: By Your Leave
passages.text:
I have a task set before me by my Baroness, Lady Vashj. With assistance, my vengeance would be swift. But she must approve of your help as well as my release to assist you with your task.

Go to the Seat of the Primus. There we will speak with her.

passages.title: By Your Leave
passages.text: Good. You move swiftly.

passages.title: By Your Leave
passages.text: With your assistance I should be able to clear my list quickly.

passages.title: You Cannot Run
passages.text:
Zelmany was integral in the fall of my Margrave.

Sin'Dane believes he is trying to gather forces loyal to Kel'Thuzad so they might help him in his next plot.

We should look for clues to his location and then slay him.

passages.title: You Cannot Run
passages.text: The traitors cannot run!

passages.title: You Cannot Run
passages.text: One of the ringleaders is dead but I will not be satisfied until they are all dead.

passages.title: You Cannot Hide
passages.text:
There are those who held their affiliation with Kel'Thuzad secret even after he made his move. They too were involved in the fall of my Margrave, and they too shall die.

I have one name, Drava'ora, but there are more. Sin'dane had indicated these traitors carry marks of favor. She doesn't know who has them so we'll start killing until we find them.

The rest will see the example made.

passages.title: You Cannot Hide
passages.text: Those that remain will be scared into line.

passages.title: You Cannot Hide
passages.text: Traitors cannot hide.

passages.title: You Can Only Die
passages.text:
The last name on my list is a lich named Fal'zinge.

Sin'Dane has been keeping a close eye on him to learn more of what Kel'Thuzad is planning next. 

She wishes for Fal'zinge's execution to be brutal. 

We will find him in the Exoramas in the House of Rituals.

passages.title: You Can Only Die
passages.text: Another name for the list.

passages.title: You Can Only Die
passages.text: This can be the only end for traitors to Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Akarek Avenged
passages.text:
The last of those traitors involved in taking down Margrave Akarek are dead. 

It will not bring our Margrave back, but I am still pleased.

My Baroness wished for us to inform Margrave Sin'dane that the job was done before departing for Ardenweald.

passages.title: Akarek Avenged
passages.text: Traitors will not be tolerated.

passages.title: Magical Mystery Tour!
passages.text:
<Lady Moonberry's voice rises from the scroll.>

<name>! It seems Huln got into some trouble. And--well--it's complicated. We could really use your help in Revendreth! Please meet me at Dominance Keep.

See you soon!

passages.title: Magical Mystery Tour!
passages.text: I'm glad you could get here so quickly! We've run into a little bit of a hiccup.

passages.title: Out On the Edge
passages.text:
It sounds like Huln was taken elsewhere, and by the Stonewright herself!

We should look for signs she came through the area. Hopefully that will lead us to Huln!

passages.title: Out On the Edge
passages.text:
We found Huln and conveniently he was with just the person we need to help with the ritual!

I love it when things work out for everyone, don't you?

passages.title: Back to The Heart
passages.text:
We should hurry back to Ardenweald!

You go on ahead and find Ysera. I'll escort the Stonewright there and make sure Huln gets back.

passages.title: Back to The Heart
passages.text: I am glad to see you again. We do not seem to have much time.

passages.title: The Power of Elune
passages.text:
We have done as much as we can with the time we had.

Now we must lend our power to Thiernax and the others, and hope Tyrande survives.

passages.title: The Power of Elune
passages.text: It has been so long...

passages.title: Winter's Sigil
passages.text:
My sister... After all this time... She did not abandon me...

<The barest hint of a smile graces the Winter Queen's face before it is gone. She turns her attention to you with the weight of eons.>

Attend me, <name>. Take my sister's tear, and come to the Heart of the Forest.

passages.title: Winter's Sigil
passages.text: Well done.

passages.title: Winter's Sigil
passages.text:
<Ysera sighs, relieved.>

Such peace has returned to Ardenweald and to those who dwell within. My dear friend has been saved. I do not know what comes next, but I have hope.

This could not have been done without your help, <name>. Thank you.

passages.title: Feral Shadehound
passages.text:
<The runed armor husk pulses with power and seems to struggle for its freedom.

Release your feral shadehound and bind it to you.>

passages.title: Vault of Secrets
passages.text:
You've helped us regain a semblance of order, Maw Walker, but the outlook is dire.

The Jailer's forces have launched an all-out assault upon the ruins of our vault at the outer reaches of Korthia. Clearly the Banished One seeks something of value inside.

The vault's defenses activate when the structure is threatened, so getting inside won't be easy. But we must recover whatever the Jailer is seeking before his Mawsworn do.

I've enlisted the aid of a necrolord who can help open the vault.

passages.title: Vault of Secrets
passages.text: We have our smith. Now we must move forward with the plan.

passages.title: Vengeance for Korthia
passages.text:
While opening the vault is our priority, I must ask a favor.

When Korthia was pulled into the Maw, my people were terrified. We fled to the area you see before you, a place of peace called the Scholar's Den.

The Mawsworn soon descended upon us. Most of my kind were slaughtered. Others were taken captive.

If I could claim vengeance myself, I would. But I... I am ill-equipped for battle. Not like you.

Please. Show these monsters that their defilement of Korthia will not stand!

passages.title: Vengeance for Korthia
passages.text: Vengeance will not bring back the fallen, but it gives those of us who survived a measure of satisfaction.

passages.title: The Knowledge Keepers
passages.text:
Our vault was built to store countless secrets and artifacts. Even if we gain entrance, we can't be certain of what the Jailer is looking for.

Certain attendants are given the title of record keeper. They track items stored in the vault, and are known for their utmost discretion.

A number of keepers have been taken captive by the Mawsworn and are being tortured for information.

Save the record keepers, <name>. They can help us determine what the Banished One seeks.

passages.title: The Knowledge Keepers
passages.text:
I am relieved to see more of my people freed from the Jailer's grasp.

Now we must determine what he's looking for.

passages.title: Let the Anima Flow
passages.text:
Tal-Galan briefed me on the situation and explained the vault's workings. As well as any scholarly type could, at least.

First we need to ensure the vault is getting power. They use underground conduits to feed it anima.

The attendant says that one of these conduits is tucked away in a cave in Scholar's Den.

You get me there and I'll find a way to fix it. Just watch my back while I figure out how these Korthian devices work.

passages.title: Let the Anima Flow
passages.text: After the drought the Shadowlands suffered, I'll never take flowing anima for granted again.

passages.title: Phantasmagoria
passages.text:
<The strange mote of otherworldly energy glows with an erratic rhythm. 

Ve'nari may find it of interest.>

passages.title: Phantasmagoria
passages.text: How beautiful. That this Phantasma is able to exist outside of the tower at all is unbelievable. Something is most curious about it's nature...further study is needed.

passages.title: Secrets of the Vault
passages.text:
What fortune! You rescued the record keepers before the Mawsworn could steal their knowledge of the vault's relics.

But their records are fragmented. Incomplete. I pray there's enough left to learn the truth.

I will attempt to coalesce the knowledge that remains into a message. If the Purpose wills it, we will learn what the Jailer wants and to whom this item originally belonged.

I must focus for a moment. Let me know when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Secrets of the Vault
passages.text: Are you ready to begin?

passages.title: Secrets of the Vault
passages.text:
We know what the Jailer wants.

Now we must reach the vault before his forces acquire it.

passages.title: The Anima Trail
passages.text:
So the Jailer seeks the Primus's sigil. We must beat the Mawsworn to it. To open the vault, we need to power it with anima.

You helped the Bonesmith repair the first conduit. The trail of anima in front of us leads to the next. 

If we can activate it, then there should be enough anima flowing into Korthia to get us inside the vault.

Come, we must make haste!

passages.title: The Anima Trail
passages.text:
A chasm!

We will need a way to get across to the next anima conduit.

passages.title: Bone Tools
passages.text:
So the device we need to open this vault is stuck on a floating island, eh?

Not a problem.

I see plenty of sturdy creatures around here. Like I always say, no bone goes to waste!

Bring me a pile of their bones. I'll use them to craft hookshot points for us to use to grapple over there.

passages.title: Bone Tools
passages.text: Remember, I just need the bones. Flesh only gets in the way.

passages.title: Bone Tools
passages.text: Yes, this will do. Think I'll save one to show the other smiths back home.

passages.title: Lost Records
passages.text:
Some of the record keepers fled to this mountain when Korthia was pulled into the Maw.

I see no sign of them, but they may have left records behind. 

Take this beacon. I fashioned it using information from the previous record keepers you rescued.

It will lead you to any intact records that are on this mountain.

passages.title: Lost Records
passages.text: Have you recovered the records?

passages.title: Lost Records
passages.text: Excellent. I should be able to extract the Primus's message from these records.

passages.title: To the Vault
passages.text:
Thanks to the Bonesmith's repairs of both conduits, anima should now be flowing to the vault. That gives us a chance to get inside--assuming we can reach it.

Our Maldraxxi allies have wrangled transportation to get us to and from the vault. I suggest we make haste.

If the Jailer's minions obtain the sigil of the Primus before we do, it won't just be Korthia that suffers. All the Shadowlands may be forfeit.

Let's go, Maw Walker. Our forces will be awaiting us.

passages.title: To the Vault
passages.text:
Tal-Galan informed me of the situation.

We must get you into that vault.

passages.title: Defending the Vault
passages.text:
To reach the vault, we'll need to carve a path through the attacking Mawsworn.

The covenants are doing their best to drive off these monstrosities, but our allies can't hold out forever. The Mawsworn are intent on reaching the prize before you.

We could use your help fighting against the Jailer's forces, Maw Walker.

Purpose guide us all.

passages.title: Defending the Vault
passages.text: Purpose guide your blade!

passages.title: Defending the Vault
passages.text:
Good work fighting those Mawsworn.

We'll take it from here, <name>.

passages.title: Keepers of Korthia
passages.text:
We've barely held out against the Jailer's forces. Now that you're here, we can finally make some progress.

I know your priority is to enter the vault, but our record keepers must also be recovered. 

They are the authorities about everything kept in the vault. We can't let the Jailer learn what they know.

passages.title: Keepers of Korthia
passages.text: A pity all three keepers did not survive. Good work tracking down the two that did.

passages.title: Into the Vault
passages.text:
The destruction here is... overwhelming.

<Tal-Galan quietly utters a prayer.>

Anima flows into what remains of the vault. We should now be able to enter.

Once inside, I will work on recovering the Primus's sigil. 

Please show reverence within the vault. It is a sacred place that few are allowed to see.

Even the prophecies did not foretell that a living mortal would gaze upon the secrets within.

passages.title: Into the Vault
passages.text:
The Primus's sigil! Hmm... I sense a familiar magic upon it.

Yes. All those things I saw through your eyes from Torghast...

passages.title: Untangling the Sigil
passages.text:
The Primus's sigil is bound together with the magic of memory. It reminds me of something you have encountered before.

You made an ally of the Runecarver, that poor soul trapped in the bowels of Torghast. He took those memories you found and helped you forge them into weapons and armor.

Perhaps he can separate the sigil from this tangle of memories.

It's our best chance to secure the sigil. But the way will be perilous.

passages.title: Untangling the Sigil
passages.text: We are free. There is still hope to fight back against Zovaal.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text:
I have dreamed that Tyrande Whisperwind is crucial to the survival of Ardenweald.

The night fae have been searching for others like her who were once Night Warriors. We have recruited an ancient ally of Azeroth, Huln Highmountain, in order to look for them.

Elune's power is too much for any mortal to contain--even Tyrande. I do not know how much longer she can hold on.

Allow me to explain further, then you must hurry to meet Huln in Maldraxxus.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text: Ardenweald appreciates your help.

passages.title: Hunting Amid Houses
passages.text:
Word of your deeds has spread across the Shadowlands.

I know together we will be able to find this Night Warrior swiftly.

passages.title: Researching Korthian Relics
passages.text:
<You find a torn book regarding relics that were being kept within Korthia.

A name written within its pages begins to glow: "Roh-Suir."

The book spins in your hand and points in a direction while Roh-Suir's name pulses.

Perhaps this Roh-Suir could help you discover more about the relics you've found.>

passages.title: Researching Korthian Relics
passages.text: Relics? Research? We have much more urgent matters at hand!

passages.title: Interrupt the Interrogations
passages.text:
Shhh... quietly!

The invaders will kill me if they find me here, just as they have killed so many others!

<Roh-Suir points frantically in the direction of the Mawsworn.>

They're torturing the Archivist!

You must find a way to rescue her. We cannot allow the Mawsworn to learn all that she knows!

passages.title: Interrupt the Interrogations
passages.text: There is no hope until and unless Archivist Roh-Senara is safe.

passages.title: Interrupt the Interrogations
passages.text: What did we do to deserve such cruelty?

passages.title: Carving Out a Path
passages.text:
While I abhor violence and prefer a reasoned response to conflict, there is no alternative here.

In order for Roh-Suir and I to escape safely, you must deliver a decisive strike to the Mawsworn who have invaded Seeker's Quorum.

Carve out a path so that we may escape.

passages.title: Carving Out a Path
passages.text: Attacking the Mawsworn is risky, but necessary. I pray they did not follow us.

passages.title: Carving Out a Path
passages.text: You bought us the moment we needed to make our escape.

passages.title: The Sundered Staff
passages.text:
I have no choice but to trust you with the secrets of the Lodestaff.

In the right hands, such as those of a trained Archivist, the staff can locate influential relics from the afterlives of the Shadowlands.

It was split into three segments to ensure that it would not fall into the wrong hands. The invaders have found the pieces, but they are yet not aware of their significance.

Recover the pieces of the staff. Each segment is held by a different member of the Mawsworn.

passages.title: The Sundered Staff
passages.text: Were you able to recover all three segments of the Lodestaff?

passages.title: The Sundered Staff
passages.text: I cannot fully describe the relief I feel now that we have the Lodestaff.

passages.title: Recover the Research
passages.text:
Though the circumstances are grim, we cannot neglect the Purpose.

On the bodies of the attendants in the Seeker's Quorum, you will find scrolls detailing our ongoing research. What is written on each of these scrolls represents efforts equal to many of your lifetimes.

Retrieve them, before they are destroyed and lost forever.

passages.title: An Infusion of Anima
passages.text:
Normally we would infuse the Lodestaff with energy from the Netherstar, another relic of note.

Regrettably, that is not an option. But, in a pinch, anima is an acceptable substitute.

Take the Lodestaff. Brandish it near recently slain devourers in the estuary below us.

The staff should draw in and absorb their anima.

passages.title: An Infusion of Anima
passages.text: The Lodestaff is humming with vibrant energy! The anima worked better than I could have hoped.

passages.title: Finding One's True Purpose
passages.text:
All our efforts have led us here.

With the combined wisdom of the Archivists, and a little help from a <race> <class>, we will attune the Lodestaff to the relics that we seek.

Should we succeed, we will have what we need to re-establish the Archive.

Our sacred work can then continue.

passages.title: Finding One's True Purpose
passages.text: Is it over? Was the attuning a success?

passages.title: Finding One's True Purpose
passages.text: So much has been taken from us. And yet, due to Roh-Senara's sacrifice, there is hope.

passages.title: Establishing the Archive
passages.text:
I will head to Keeper's Respite, where there is some small semblance of safety.

There, we will establish a new archive.

Meet me there when you are able.

I hope we can count on you again. We will have need of your assistance there in the future.

passages.title: Establishing the Archive
passages.text: It is hard to imagine how I will continue without the Archivist.

passages.title: Hope Ascending
passages.text:
There is one final thing we must do.

Meet us atop the peak of Hope's Ascent.

passages.title: Hope Ascending
passages.text: I was beginning to worry that you had given up on our cause.

passages.title: Consulting the Experts
passages.text:
We can restore the functions of the Lodestaff, but it will require the wisdom of the Archivists.

Not just me, but the Archivists who have come before. They were laid to rest near here. Given the scale of the destruction of Korthia and the likely possibility that this destruction will continue, this may be our last chance to visit their memorials before they are irrevocably ruined.

Visit the Archivists' memorials. Take Roh-Suir with you, so that he may take note of their messages before they are lost.

passages.title: Consulting the Experts
passages.text: Do not fear the Archivists of old. They are here to help.

passages.title: Consulting the Experts
passages.text: I trust you and Scholar Roh-Suir learned from the Archivists.

passages.title: A Terrible Power
passages.text: This strange shard pulses in your hand. An aura of dread radiates forth from it like a chill wind, sending a shiver down your spine. Perhaps the Primus could tell you more about this... if you could find him.

passages.title: Centurions March!
passages.text:
Three of our Centurions have broken through the side gate. They need additional anima to continue their assault.

Several of my assistants tried to deliver anima to them, but failed. Please get recover the anima and assist the Centurions in the attack.

passages.title: Centurions March!
passages.text: Have the Centurions succeeded?

passages.title: Centurions March!
passages.text: Quite extraordinary work Maw Walker!

passages.title: A Matter of Urgency
passages.text:
Maw Walker, there is a matter of urgency that has not been addressed.

Our Fatescribe is missing. They have not found their way here. They would have been in Seeker's Quorum before...

<Pathscribe Roh-Vess pauses.>

Can you look for the Fatescribe? Many attendants used the caves near the ruins to hide from the mawsworn.

passages.title: A Matter of Urgency
passages.text: You are searching for the Fatescribe too? I must find him. I cannot fail.

passages.title: Rescued from Torment
passages.text:
The Mawsworn are not only killing those they find in the Seeker's Quorum. They are interrogating the survivors.

We should help save those we can. It's possible one of them might have seen the Fatescribe.

passages.title: Rescued from Torment
passages.text: I struggle to believe that not a single attendant has any information on where the Fatescribe might be.

passages.title: Looting the Looters
passages.text:
<The Mawsworn was carrying a Korthian artifact.

It's unclear what the enemy wants with such relics, but you suspect the attendants in Keeper's Respite would want to see them returned.>

passages.title: Looting the Looters
passages.text: Now this is special. This implement is used by the Fatescribe in his work.

passages.title: The Last Place You Look
passages.text:
I came here hoping to locate the Fatescribe or something to help me find him.

Evidence shows he was here and survived a Mawsworn attack. The only other place I haven't looked is a meditation chamber on the opposite side of the ruins.

It's too dangerous for me to head back into the Seeker's Quorum alone. Could you help me?

I must find the Fatescribe. It's a matter of great importance.

passages.title: The Last Place You Look
passages.text:
Mad ramblings and incense. Weak clues, but they're all we have.

We need to search the Sanctuary of Guidance.

passages.title: Redirect the Search
passages.text:
I believe the Fatescribe was headed to the Sanctuary of Guidance. A holy place for the attendants of Korthia.

Fortunately, because you seem to be in the habit of picking up every piece of trash you find, we have the Fatescribe's Implement!

I'm sure that will prove useful in locating him. But first, on to the Sanctuary.

passages.title: Redirect the Search
passages.text:
<name>! At last! 

You know that I cannot do this without you.

passages.title: Echoes of Fate
passages.text:
The devourers have swarmed this place, but our focus must remain on finding the Fatescribe.

Attendants who worshipped here would leave offerings of anima at the shrines.

The implement you found will resonate if the Fatescribe has been nearby. With any luck, it will give us insight into where he has gone.

passages.title: Echoes of Fate
passages.text:
Using an illusion to hide.

Can you imagine anything so clever?

passages.title: Revenge Delayed
passages.text:
<The Korthian protector is gravely wounded and struggles to speak.>

Devourers... swarmed the sanctuary. Too few of us...

My duty... incomplete.

The Purpose... I...

<The protector's voice fades.>

passages.title: Revenge Delayed
passages.text: <You have completed the protector's task.>

passages.title: Under the Illusion
passages.text:
The Fatescribe has collected the necessary items to create an illusion in this chamber. Fortunately, we can use his own implement to dispel it and reveal him.

He will be grateful to see a friendly face, I'm sure.

I must say, you've proven to be incredibly helpful in this task. I truly couldn't have done it without you.

passages.title: They Could Be Anyone
passages.text:
<The still-warm head of the dreadlord Azodius grimaces at you.

The attendants at Keeper's Respite should be told of the Fatescribe's abduction.

No doubt Highlord Fordragon will want to hear of this unexpected threat.>

passages.title: They Could Be Anyone
passages.text:
News of the nathrezim infiltrating Korthia is deeply troubling.

How long have they been here? What is their goal?

passages.title: Claim the Sky
passages.text:
