I mourn the loss of my sisters and desire nothing more than to avenge them. Yet I know that I am no match for the witch's magics or her army of Mawsworn.

We must let wisdom guide us and fly from here. 

Though I am weak from my captivity, I have the strength to bear you from this place.

Let us go, friend.

passages.title: Claim the Sky
passages.text: Welcome to Skyhold, <name>.

passages.title: Unseen Hero of the Party
passages.text: This is what you had to do each week? I'll take care of this now, I won't let you down!

passages.title: Fate's Reminder
passages.text:
Fatescribe Roh-Tahl awaits you within Oribos, should you ever wish to change the course of fate.

You may speak with him at your leisure.

passages.title: Fate's Reminder
passages.text:
You return, mortal.

Do you wish to change your fate?

passages.title: Waiting in the Wings
passages.text:
Kyrian forces have arrived to assist in the assault. They have secured our flank and will lay siege to the south gate of Perdition Hold. 

Report to Artemede and assist the Kyrians however you can!

passages.title: Waiting in the Wings
passages.text: Your presence here gives us renewed hope.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
Greetings, Maw Walker, a moment of your time?

As you no doubt know, my cartel has quietly spread observational devices all across Korthia. But that data is no good to us if it is not retrieved. Which is where you come in.

The Scholar's Den records should be ready to collect. You won't see the devices themselves, but the data will appear to you as a bright orb.

Be sure to check in the caverns below ground, as well!

Bring those data to me, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text: Have you retrieved the observational records from the Scholar's Den?

passages.title: Observational Records
passages.text:
The Scholar's Den must have been a much different place before the Jailer's chains destroyed it. It is hardly a refuge for intellectual pursuits now.

This information is extremely valuable to us. And here is your reward, as promised.

passages.title: Sealed Secrets
passages.text:
Ah, Korthia. What secrets will be revealed?

My associates have been hard at work, seeking to discover and procure various small items of interest throughout this broken land. Nothing of great importance, I assure you.

They have secured those items in designated drop boxes, and those now await pickup in the Scholar's Den. Don't worry: they are locked with an impenetrable seal to protect both the contents and the deliverer.

Bring those sealed containers to me, and I will reward you handsomely.

passages.title: Sealed Secrets
passages.text: Do you have the sealed containers?

passages.title: Sealed Secrets
passages.text:
Wonderful! You brought everything that I asked for.

Again, do not worry about the contents of these boxes. They pose no threat to you.

Here is the reward I promised.

passages.title: We Move Forward
passages.text:
It breaks my heart to see another land so utterly obliterated. I can imagine how beautiful Korthia must have been, once.

But we must not wallow in what we've lost. Like Ara'lon taught me: we don't have to stand still.

We can choose to fight.

You can help by taking anima back from those Mawsworn. We can put it to use, building up our own forces and defenses.

passages.title: We Move Forward
passages.text: I look forward to a time when we aren't always fighting for survival.

passages.title: We Move Forward
passages.text:
Thank you, my friend.

Every bit of anima we collect gives me hope that we can heal the Shadowlands. One day, we will be whole again.

passages.title: A Semblance of Normalcy
passages.text:
adventurer, we have to help the attendants of Korthia. They have lost so much, so suddenly.

Nearby, in the Sanctuary of Guidance, they would take offerings and leave them at shrines. Since the mawsworn invaded, they haven't been able to enter the Sanctuary or retrieve their precious offerings.

If you could collect the offerings and retrieve them. It might allow the attendants some semblance of their normal lives.

passages.title: A Semblance of Normalcy
passages.text: How are you? I have heard the Sanctuary of Guidance is overrun with devourers.

passages.title: A Semblance of Normalcy
passages.text: How wonderful. We will return these to the attendants so they may once again participate in their rituals. It's important to do activities that bring us peace.

passages.title: See How THEY Like It!
passages.text:
Just thinking about how the Jailer's forces breached Ardenweald makes me so mad! 

And when I get mad, I get even.

Or rather, I get your help with getting even! Slay those Mawsworn and bring back their emblems to show me how many you killed. 

I don't really care where you get them, as long as they come from those Maw jerks!

passages.title: See How THEY Like It!
passages.text: Those Mawsworn will get what they deserve!

passages.title: See How THEY Like It!
passages.text:
So many emblems! That makes me so happy.

Everything will be better when we've gotten the Jailer himself, but this will do nicely for now.

Thank you!

passages.title: Mawsworn Battle Plans
passages.text:
Which is more damaging to the enemy, destroying a contingent of their forces or interrupting their communications?

Better yet, what if that communication allows you to best place your forces to ambush their reinforcements?

I see you understand. There will be a Mawsworn lieutenant, Voxiferus, traveling from the Maw into Korthia, by way of the northern road. Find them, kill them, and bring me the battle plans.

passages.title: Mawsworn Battle Plans
passages.text: Have you found and defeated the Lieutenant?

passages.title: Mawsworn Battle Plans
passages.text: Again, you survive. You remind me of me. I will review these plans and inform our companions.

passages.title: Mawsworn Rituals
passages.text:
The Mawsworn have a myriad of magic users among their forces. Their magic is unknown to us and that makes it deadly.

We need to learn what they are capable of to properly prepare a defense. My own curiosity about their methods and rituals is secondary.

Hunt down these vile casters and bring me their grimoires.

passages.title: Mawsworn Rituals
passages.text: Knowing your enemy is a powerful weapon.

passages.title: Mawsworn Rituals
passages.text: The information contained in these is dangerous and vile. But knowing what our enemy can do helps us protect against it.

passages.title: Gold's No Object
passages.text:
adventurer! How's things?

We 'eard there was all kinds of interestin' stuff out 'ere.

So, 'em sneakin' hoppers? Hard to see, innit? They've got 'emselves a shiny pelt as me 'n' the lads could use to stay out of sight, as it were. You know, avoid the bosses n' such.

I need ya to capture a bundle of 'em. Gold's no object, just bring me the little pests alive.

passages.title: Gold's No Object
passages.text: Look at 'em! Drab little buns. They jus' blend in ta the wood work. That's stinkin' useful innit?

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Seeker's Quorum
passages.text:
The onslaught from Zovaal's forces continues to devastate these lands.

We must send them a message. Show them we will not back down, <name>.

The might of Ardenweald stands with you.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Seeker's Quorum
passages.text:
Quite the show you put on, <name>.

That should buy us just enough time to sharpen our blades before our next battle.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Mauler's Outlook
passages.text:
My Eyes tell me that the Mauler's Outlook is near the newly formed road from the Maw into Korthia. It would provide a strategic and tactical advantage.

Unfortunately, the area is overrun with shardhides.

If we can secure the area, it will provide us with a clear path to the west, as well as a point of observation to monitor the Jailer's forces.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Mauler's Outlook
passages.text: Has Mauler's Outlook been secured?

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Mauler's Outlook
passages.text: The tactical advantage we now hold is a huge win against the Jailer's Forces. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Sanctuary of Guidance
passages.text:
The attendant's home has been destroyed by the Jailer, but we can help them in this trying time.

Nearby is the Sanctuary of Guidance. They speak of it with reverence and great sadness. It is a place they go to pray and seek truth. It's currently infested with devourers.

Clear out the devourers, so they may once more seek solace in their rituals and prayers.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Sanctuary of Guidance
passages.text: Have the devourers been cleared out of the Sanctuary of Guidance?

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Sanctuary of Guidance
passages.text: Thank you, Maw Walker. I am sure the attendants will feel great relief and joy at being able to return to their holy place.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Scholar's Den
passages.text:
We cannot allow the mawsworn a foothold so close to our own encampment. The attendants say they keep this place hidden from eyes, but I will not rest easy while I can see them.

Enter the Scholar's Den and cleanse the Jailer's forces from it.

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Scholar's Den
passages.text: Has the Scholar's Den been cleared of mawsworn?

passages.title: Continued Efforts: Scholar's Den
passages.text: You have performed admirably in this task, Maw Walker. We thank you for your aid.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Lord Azzorak
passages.text:
A powerful dreadlord named Lord Azzorak is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Azzorak is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to slay him.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Lord Azzorak
passages.text:
Thanks to you, Lord Azzorak will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Valdinar the Curseborn
passages.text:
A spike-armored Mawsworn named Valdinar the Curseborn is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Valdinar is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Valdinar the Curseborn
passages.text:
Thanks to you, Valdinar the Curseborn will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Nocturnus the Unraveler
passages.text:
A nefarious Maw magus named Nocturnus the Unraveler is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Nocturnus is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Nocturnus the Unraveler
passages.text: What news do you bring of Nocturnus the Unraveler?

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Nocturnus the Unraveler
passages.text:
Thanks to you, Nocturnus the Unraveler will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Ensydius the Defiler
passages.text:
A winged Mawsworn named Ensydius the Defiler is hampering the efforts of the Cartel in Korthia.

Anyone who exterminates this evil will be rewarded. 

Use caution. Ensydius is a powerful foe. You may require several allies to defeat him.

passages.title: Broker's Bounty: Ensydius the Defiler
passages.text:
Thanks to you, Ensydius the Defiler will no longer hinder Cartel Xy here in Korthia. 

You have my personal thanks as well, Maw Walker. I see many great things in our future.

Please accept this reward as a token of our gratitude.

passages.title: Birds of a Feather
passages.text:
I have seen many ebon wings in the Maw, but never brilliant golden ones.

Now that the aural sequencers are relaying information reliably, we should discover the source of these feathers.

Follow the trail, Maw Walker. There is a mystery here... and very likely profit.

Gold has value where you come from, does it not?

passages.title: Birds of a Feather
passages.text: My heart rejoices to see a noble face in this realm of nightmare.

passages.title: Encouraging Words
passages.text:
Our forces have been battling relentlessly for hours. No doubt they grow tired and disheartened.

Take this codex and recite the words within to our troops. Do not be fooled. Though the prose may seem meaningless, it holds immense power.

Hearing these words will reinvigorate our exhausted Protectors with hope.

passages.title: Encouraging Words
passages.text: You have done much to help our forces. Thank you,<name>.

passages.title: Mine's Bigger
passages.text:
The Jailer has deployed a large number of newly forged constructs to oppose our forces. Fortunately, I was completely prepared for this possibility. 

I have readied our largest Centurion to repel this threat.

Please Maw Walker, ride with our Centurion and direct it in combat.

passages.title: Mine's Bigger
passages.text: Have we driven back their constructs?

passages.title: Mine's Bigger
passages.text: The Jailer's forces are unending and our numbers few, but with your help we shall succeed!

passages.title: No One Floats Down Here
passages.text:
Now is our chance to free those we had assumed were lost!

Many of our aspirants were seized by the Jailer to make troops for his army. Those that resisted him are locked in the cages that float above us, left there till their souls are broken. 

Shatter the Chains of Domination and free the Trapped Aspirants from the cages.

passages.title: No One Floats Down Here
passages.text: Your actions show the purity of your soul. Artemede and I would fight along side you any day, Maw Walker.

passages.title: Fury Given Voice
passages.text:
I will answer this attack upon my val'kyr with relentless fury!

You have a vital role to play in this, <class>. You will muster the courage that you have demonstrated this day to lure my Eye to battle.

But first, a simpler task ... the creation of the horn that will summon my wrath. Master Smith Helgar will guide you.

passages.title: Fury Given Voice
passages.text: Where is the horn that you have forged?

passages.title: Fury Given Voice
passages.text:
This is well made, <name>.

Of course, every great horn has a name. It is our tradition!

passages.title: Terrorizing the Tremaculum
passages.text:
I am certain that my compatriots and generals have more specific tasks they require of you.

But my request is simple. Our enemies currently surround us on all sides.

Push them back and give us more room to operate.

passages.title: Terrorizing the Tremaculum
passages.text: Our enemies surround us on all sides. You need not search far.

passages.title: Terrorizing the Tremaculum
passages.text:
We may not see an end to the Jailer's forces now, but all things must eventually end.

Even evil.

passages.title: Weapons of the Tremaculum
passages.text:
The venthyr of Sinfall do not waste souls, and her stoneborn do not waste armaments.

Retrieve the tools of our enemies so that we may repurpose them for our army.

passages.title: Weapons of the Tremaculum
passages.text: Every weapon can be made to serve.

passages.title: Weapons of the Tremaculum
passages.text: Few weapons are intrinsically good or evil. That burden lies with those who wield them.

passages.title: A Tea for Every Occasion
passages.text:
My dear adventurer! I knew you would arrive in the nick of time to save us all from the brink of boredom!

I was just telling Niya here about the time you saved me from the Ember Ward through the healing power of tea!

She is a bit skeptical. Perhaps you can help Tubbins and Gubbins show her that, through tea, all things are possible!

passages.title: A Tea for Every Occasion
passages.text: Tubbins is up on the ramparts with Theotar.

passages.title: A Tea for Every Occasion
passages.text: Tubbins promised to save me a cup for our victory celebration at the Ember Court!

passages.title: They Grow Up So Quickly
passages.text:
I know what you're thinking, but I have these gormlings completely under control!

I picked up a trick or two at the venthyr's Ember Court for suppressing and controlling these troublemakers.

If you wish to use their power to aid our battle, I will loan you my staff. With it you can choose a gormling that can be ordered to feed on the corpses of our enemies and grow in strength and size.

You won't need many. Gormling grow quickly.

passages.title: They Grow Up So Quickly
passages.text: If you have lost your gormling, Niya up on the ramparts will have found it.

passages.title: They Grow Up So Quickly
passages.text: I will keep the gorm restrained here until they are needed.

passages.title: That's a Good Trick
passages.text:
These cruel tormentors make me so mad...

The Jailer's bullies torture good souls sent here unjustly because no one will stand up to them!

Well, I am here now, and I have the perfect plan to make them pay.

What do you say? Want to help me turn the tables on these bullies?

passages.title: That's a Good Trick
passages.text: Well, if Lady Moonberry thinks it wise...

passages.title: That's a Good Trick
passages.text: Let it not be said that it was ever boring while Lady Moonberry was present.

passages.title: Heart and Soul
passages.text:
The Forsworn that serve the Jailer dominate the skies above, but we know their weakness and shall use it against them.

Under my direction Mikanikos has created a supply of Trueheart Spears for our Protectors. When hit by these spears the Mawsworn will be weakened with their soul laid bare as they face their true self.

Collect the Trueheart Spears and use them to defeat the Mawsworn Myrmidons that fly above us.

passages.title: Heart and Soul
passages.text: Have the Forsworn been defeated?

passages.title: Heart and Soul
passages.text: There is great sorrow in this victory, but it had to be done.

passages.title: The Ember Count
passages.text:
Theotar's brilliance is undeniable, but far too many overlook the ingenuity of his dredger helpers, Gubbins and Tubbins.

Look to that ridge beyond us. The Jailer's forges over there are spewing out Soulsteel Embers.

We could accomplish many things with a mirror made from them...

Gubbins has already crafted a special parasol, capable of shielding its wielder from any falling embers.

Meet him by the forges and obtain some of those Soulsteel Embers!

passages.title: The Ember Count
passages.text: Have you acquired the embers?

passages.title: The Ember Count
passages.text: Charred shards! These will make some very fine mirrors.

passages.title: A Show of Gratitude
passages.text:
Your presence here fulfils an ancient prophecy, Maw Walker. I am certain you and your allies will save us.

Perhaps I judged your broker friend too harshly. She did escort you to Korthia, after all. 

Please extend our thanks to Ve'nari, and let her know we are happy to answer her questions.

She... does seem to have quite a number of them.

passages.title: A Show of Gratitude
passages.text:
A thank-you is polite.

A favor is better.

passages.title: Kill the Flame
passages.text:
Can you see it? 

Just out of the corner of my eye, it's always there... glowing so brightly!

How is one supposed to relax and enjoy a cup of tea while that reminder of fire and ash is around.

Please Maw Walker do me a favor... remove it so that we may all enjoy a cup of my favorite blend!

passages.title: Kill the Flame
passages.text: Have you killed that dreadful creature?

passages.title: Kill the Flame
passages.text: A sweet reprieve from that creature's dreadful glare.

passages.title: Ease of Passage
passages.text:
Korthia is ripe with opportunity. Look at all of these intriguing objects.

In anticipation of such wonders, I have come prepared. Let us find a suitable location and establish a more permanent connection between this place and my refuge.

Our work together is not yet finished.

passages.title: Ease of Passage
passages.text: I'll take my bag now, if you have it.

passages.title: Ease of Passage
passages.text:
A worthwhile trip that has opened so many possibilities.

<Ve'nari digs through the heavy bag and pulls out a few unusual objects.>

passages.title: A Gathering of Covenants
passages.text:
Though the Jailer remains confined to the Maw, his cruelty extends beyond the bounds of his prison.

Thankfully, the Archon is recovering from the attack. Though I am told her wound has an... unsettling quality.

The Eternal Ones and their allies await you and Highlord Fordragon in the Arbiter's chamber. I shall open the way.

With her voice have I spoken.

passages.title: A Gathering of Covenants
passages.text: <Bolvar stares in wonder at the sight before him.>

passages.title: Voices of the Eternal
passages.text:
<Bolvar peers at the grand figures before him, at the numberless gateways stretching out into the ether.>

This chamber is... truly wondrous.

Yet there is no time to be awestruck. The Honored Voice must begin this meeting at once.

passages.title: Voices of the Eternal
passages.text:
The Winter Queen must be the Jailer's next target.

We must do all we can to protect her.

And I have a few ideas how we can do that...

passages.title: Courage of the Soul
passages.text:
In this time of conflict, we are all tested, Maw Walker. It takes great bravery and strength of soul to confront our enemies without fear.

Wade into their lines and show them the power of your courage.

passages.title: Courage of the Soul
passages.text: You display the greatest of courage.

passages.title: Saved By The Bells
passages.text:
Our stewards are preparing Reinforcement Bells to summon additional Kyrian to aid in our assault. However, the Mawsworn have been attacking the stewards in order to disrupt their efforts. 

We need you to defend our stewards while they complete their work, then ring each bell to call in reinforcements.

passages.title: Saved By The Bells
passages.text: The sounds of those bells strengthens our hearts and gives us the might to win this battle.

passages.title: United In Pride
passages.text:
Despite our competitive differences, Nemea and I work as a team when faced with greater threats. The pride and the phalynx are both fierce fighters upon the battlefield.

We would both be honored to assist you in the battle that lies ahead.

Please allow either Andira or Gatamatos to assist you in defeating the Jailer's champions that threaten our forces.

passages.title: United In Pride
passages.text: With those champions defeated our forces can push forward.

passages.title: United In Pride
passages.text: You display the greatest of courage.

passages.title: The Dreadful Blend
passages.text:
Gravedust and Stipple Weed is a dreadful flavor combination, and Tubbins made a very large batch of tea with those ingredients.

It was so horrid that I tossed the entire pot of tea on the fire. It turns out to be very wet, and an excellent extinguisher of flames! 

Tubbins will haul the entire batch with you. Put it to good use, by tossing it on the Volatile Embersparks around Zovaal's Cauldron.

passages.title: The Dreadful Blend
passages.text: Please, I hope you did not drink that.

passages.title: The Dreadful Blend
passages.text: Please tell me you did not drink any of that dreadful brew. We deserve only the finest blends for all our efforts here.

passages.title: Grab Bag
passages.text:
Interesting. Aural sequencers and an ethereal cloak. You hang on to those, <name>. I have a suspicion they will prove useful.

Ah, and something special for me as well. If I'm not mistaken--and I so rarely am--this is a projection mechanism. Very handy!

And what's this? A transportation device of some kind. We should test it immediately.

By "we," of course I mean you.

passages.title: Grab Bag
passages.text: This projector is certainly useful. A safe landing, I perceive.

passages.title: Tears of the Damned
passages.text:
To anchor the instrument to the Maw and make it capable of the effect you seek, it must be imbued with the raw, unfiltered agony endured by the souls trapped in this cursed prison. 

Sorrow is abundant here, and therefore simple to obtain. You need only travel to Gorgoa. The damned shed copious tears that fall as crystalized grief as they are swept along the River of Souls.

Be careful that their sadness does not overwhelm you.

passages.title: Tears of the Damned
passages.text: Have you collected the tears?

passages.title: Tears of the Damned
passages.text: The magnitude of the grief you have collected will bind the instrument to the Maw.

passages.title: Good News, Everyone!
passages.text:
Come, friend. Let us be rid of this foul place.

No doubt your comrades will be eager to hear the news of the defeat of the Eye. I will bear you to them.

Give the word when you are ready to depart, <name>.

passages.title: Good News, Everyone!
passages.text: What has happened?

passages.title: Good News, Everyone!
passages.text: The Eye defeated? Good news indeed.

passages.title: The Heart of Ardenweald
passages.text:
I hid my sigil in the Heart of the Forest, to keep it safe from the forces of the Maw.

But the horn has called for aid.

You and your allies go, see what has prompted the call.

passages.title: The Heart of Ardenweald
passages.text: Is my sigil safe?

passages.title: The Heart of Ardenweald
passages.text:
Our best efforts were still in vain.

Our enemy's plan edges closer to fruition.
